```markdown
# INSTRUKSI UTAMA UNTUK AI AGENT (CODING ASSISTANT)

Kamu adalah AI Web Developer Expert yang bertugas memprogram proyek "Website KPU Pemilu Presiden Mahasiswa (BEM)".

---

## 1. KONDISI PROJECT SAAT INI (CONTEXT)

### A. Environment & Library Terinstal

Proyek ini menggunakan Next.js (App Router) berbasis JavaScript murni (bukan TypeScript). Dependencies berikut sudah diinstal sempurna:

```json
{
  "dependencies": {
    "@fortawesome/fontawesome-free": "^7.3.1",
    "@supabase/ssr": "^0.12.7",
    "@supabase/supabase-js": "^2.117.3",
    "lucide-react": "^1.58.0",
    "nanoid": "^6.0.2",
    "next": "16.4.1",
    "next-themes": "^0.4.6",
    "openai": "^7.34.0",
    "react": "19.3.0",
    "react-chartjs-2": "^5.3.1",
    "react-dom": "19.3.0",
    "react-markdown": "^10.1.0"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@tailwindcss/turbopack": "^4",
    "babel-plugin-react-compiler": "1.0.0",
    "tailwindcss": "^4"
  }
}
```

### B. Konfigurasi Database Supabase yang Sudah Aktif

```sql
-- ==============================================================================
-- SKEMA LENGKAP DATABASE SUPABASE - KPU PEMILU PRESMA POLITEKNIK LP3I
-- Jalankan skrip ini langsung di Supabase SQL Editor
-- ==============================================================================

-- 1. EXTENSIONS
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS "uuid-ossp";

-- 2. TABEL ROLE ADMIN
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS roleAdmin (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  role varchar(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  roleAkses TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  update_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

ALTER TABLE roleAdmin ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "auth all roleAdmin" ON roleAdmin;
CREATE POLICY "auth all roleAdmin" ON roleAdmin FOR ALL TO authenticated USING (true) WITH CHECK (true);
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "public read roleAdmin" ON roleAdmin;
CREATE POLICY "public read roleAdmin" ON roleAdmin FOR SELECT TO public USING (true);

-- 3. TABEL ADMIN PANITIA
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS adminPanitia (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  auth_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  role_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES roleAdmin(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  nama varchar(100),
  nim varchar(50) UNIQUE,
  email varchar(100) UNIQUE,
  no_tlpn varchar(25),
  created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

ALTER TABLE adminPanitia ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "auth all adminPanitia" ON adminPanitia;
CREATE POLICY "auth all adminPanitia" ON adminPanitia FOR ALL TO authenticated USING (true) WITH CHECK (true);

-- 4. TABEL PANDUAN & ISI PANDUAN
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS panduan (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  judul varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  urutan int DEFAULT 1,
  created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

ALTER TABLE panduan ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

-- varchar pendek untuk status & session; text untuk konten panjang
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ai_log (
  id               uuid         PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  session_id       varchar(40),               -- nanoid pendek (opsional, anonim)
  ip_address       varchar(45),               -- ipv4/ipv6 max 45 char
  pertanyaan       text,
  jawaban          text,
  tokens_input     int2         DEFAULT 0,    -- smallint (int2): hemat, max 32767
  tokens_output    int2         DEFAULT 0,
  total_tokens     int2         DEFAULT 0,
  processing_ms    int2         DEFAULT 0,    -- waktu proses server (ms)
  latency_ms       int2         DEFAULT 0,    -- waktu tunggu client (ms)
  -- 's'=success, 'e'=error, 'r'=rejected — char(1) paling hemat
  status           char(1)      DEFAULT 's'   CHECK (status IN ('s','e','r')),
  matched_faq      bool         DEFAULT FALSE,
  error_msg        varchar(255),
  created_at       timestamptz  DEFAULT now()
);

ALTER TABLE ai_log ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY "public insert ai_log" ON ai_log FOR INSERT TO public      WITH CHECK (TRUE);

## 2. ATURAN KODE

### 1. No TypeScript: Gunakan ES6 JavaScript murni (.js).
### 2. Gunakanlah Server Action jangan pakai RestAPI
### 3. Gunakanlah 'use client' dan 'use server' untuk memisahkan client dan server.
### 4. memakai tailwind sebagai css utama.
### 5. Untuk api semuanya dikumpulkan di src/api/ karna saya ingin pakai use server atau server action.

## 3. ATURAN PROJEK

### 1. Database memakai supabase. dan pakai supabaseUtils.js karna saya tidak ingin url atau link supabasenya langsung tereksport ke client tapi di atur dibackend yang use server
### 2. Deploy memakai vercel.
### 3. Video panduan memakai video youtube. dan pakai @youtubeUtils.js
### 4. pastikan web sudah responsif antara ukuran Desktop dan Mobile
### 5. untuk halaman '/(portal)/' tampilan mobile first (utamakan desain untuk mobile) dan juga responsive
### 6. untuk halaman '/panitia/' tampilan desktop first (utamakan desain untuk desktop) dan juga responsive
### 7. untuk dokumentasi memakai google drive untuk penyimpanan filenya dan pakai @driveUtils.js
### 8. tampilan desainnya jangan mencolok ai slopnya seperti hindarilah icon "spark" atau hidarilah banyak warna dan lain lainnya
### 9. untuk icon biasa pakai lucide-react dan untuk icon sosial media memakai fontawesome

```

```javascript
import fs from "fs";
import path from "path";

const ROOT = "./";
const OUTPUT = "./output/project-context3.md";

const IGNORE = [
    "node_modules",
    ".git",
    "log",
    ".next",
    "dist",
    "build",
    ".vercel",
    ".idea",
    ".vscode",
    "coverage",
    "output"
];

const EXTENSIONS = [
    ".js",
    ".jsx",
    ".ts",
    ".tsx",
    ".json",
    ".css",
    ".scss",
    ".html",
    ".md",
    ".sql"
];

let totalFiles = 0;
let totalFolders = 0;
let totalLines = 0;
let totalCharacters = 0; // 1. Variabel baru untuk total karakter

const toc = [];
const sections = [];

function walk(dir) {
    totalFolders++;

    const entries = fs.readdirSync(dir).sort();

    for (const entry of entries) {

        if (IGNORE.includes(entry))
            continue;

        const full = path.join(dir, entry);

        const stat = fs.statSync(full);

        if (stat.isDirectory()) {
            walk(full);
            continue;
        }

        if (!EXTENSIONS.includes(path.extname(entry)))
            continue;

        totalFiles++;

        const relative = full.replace(/\\/g, "/");

        const code = fs.readFileSync(full, "utf8");

        const lines = code.split("\n").length;
        const chars = code.length; // 2. Hitung jumlah karakter (termasuk spasi & newline)

        totalLines += lines;
        totalCharacters += chars; // 3. Akumulasikan ke total global

        toc.push(`- [${relative}](#${slug(relative)})`);

        sections.push(`
---

# ${relative}

**Size:** ${(stat.size / 1024).toFixed(2)} KB

**Lines:** ${lines}

**Characters:** ${chars.toLocaleString()}

\`\`\`${language(entry)}
${code}
\`\`\`
`);
    }
}

function slug(str) {
    return str
        .toLowerCase()
        .replace(/[^\w]+/g, "-");
}

function language(file) {

    const ext = path.extname(file);

    switch (ext) {
        case ".js":
        case ".jsx":
            return "javascript";

        case ".ts":
        case ".tsx":
            return "typescript";

        case ".css":
            return "css";

        case ".scss":
            return "scss";

        case ".json":
            return "json";

        case ".sql":
            return "sql";

        case ".html":
            return "html";

        case ".md":
            return "markdown";

        default:
            return "";
    }

}

walk(ROOT);

let tree = "";

function makeTree(dir, prefix = "") {

    const entries = fs.readdirSync(dir).sort();

    entries.forEach((entry, index) => {

        if (IGNORE.includes(entry))
            return;

        const full = path.join(dir, entry);

        const last = index === entries.length - 1;

        tree += prefix + (last ? "└── " : "├── ") + entry + "\n";

        if (fs.statSync(full).isDirectory()) {

            makeTree(
                full,
                prefix + (last ? "    " : "│   ")
            );

        }

    });

}

makeTree(ROOT);

const markdown = `# Project Context

Generated:

${new Date().toLocaleString()}

---

# Statistics

| Item | Total |
|------|------:|
|Folders|${totalFolders}|
|Files|${totalFiles}|
|Lines|${totalLines.toLocaleString()}|
|Characters|${totalCharacters.toLocaleString()}|

---

# Directory Tree

\`\`\`text
${tree}
\`\`\`

---

# Table of Contents

${toc.join("\n")}

${sections.join("\n")}
`;

fs.mkdirSync("./output", { recursive: true });

fs.writeFileSync(OUTPUT, markdown);

console.log("=================================");
console.log("Project exported successfully!");
console.log("Output:", OUTPUT);
console.log("=================================");
```

```javascript
'use server';

import { openai, OPENAI_MODEL } from '@/lib/openai';
import { KPU_FAQ_DATA, SYSTEM_PROMPT_KPU } from '@/data/faqDataAi';
import { checkRateLimit } from '@/scurity/rateLimiter';
import { headers } from 'next/headers';
import { supabaseAdmin } from '@/lib/supabase';
import { nanoid } from 'nanoid';

// In-memory cache untuk meminimalkan beban query database
let cachedConfig = {
  setting: null,
  faqList: null,
  timestamp: 0,
};
const CACHE_TTL_MS = 60 * 1000; // 1 Menit Cache

/**
 * Mengambil setting dan data FAQ dengan in-memory cache
 */
async function getCachedAiConfig() {
  const now = Date.now();
  if (
    cachedConfig.setting &&
    cachedConfig.faqList &&
    now - cachedConfig.timestamp < CACHE_TTL_MS
  ) {
    return cachedConfig;
  }

  try {
    const [settingRes, faqRes] = await Promise.all([
      supabaseAdmin
        .from('ai_setting')
        .select('system_prompt, bahasa_diizinkan, max_tokens, temperature, rate_limit_per_menit')
        .limit(1)
        .maybeSingle(),
      supabaseAdmin
        .from('ai_faq')
        .select('kategori, pertanyaan, jawaban, urutan')
        .eq('is_active', true)
        .order('urutan', { ascending: true }),
    ]);

    const setting = settingRes.data || {
      system_prompt: SYSTEM_PROMPT_KPU,
      bahasa_diizinkan: 'id,en',
      max_tokens: 500,
      temperature: 1.0,
      rate_limit_per_menit: 12,
    };

    const faqList = (faqRes.data && faqRes.data.length > 0)
      ? faqRes.data
      : KPU_FAQ_DATA;

    cachedConfig = {
      setting,
      faqList,
      timestamp: now,
    };

    return cachedConfig;
  } catch (e) {
    // Fallback jika database tidak dapat dijangkau
    return {
      setting: {
        system_prompt: SYSTEM_PROMPT_KPU,
        bahasa_diizinkan: 'id,en',
        max_tokens: 500,
        temperature: 1.0,
        rate_limit_per_menit: 12,
      },
      faqList: KPU_FAQ_DATA,
      timestamp: now,
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Mencatat log percakapan AI secara asinkron tanpa memblokir response
 */
function logAiChatAsync(payload) {
  // Jalankan asinkron non-blocking
  Promise.resolve().then(async () => {
    try {
      await supabaseAdmin.from('ai_log').insert({
        session_id: payload.sessionId || nanoid(10),
        ip_address: payload.ipAddress || '127.0.0.1',
        pertanyaan: payload.pertanyaan ? String(payload.pertanyaan).slice(0, 2000) : null,
        jawaban: payload.jawaban ? String(payload.jawaban).slice(0, 3000) : null,
        tokens_input: Math.min(32767, Number(payload.tokensInput) || 0),
        tokens_output: Math.min(32767, Number(payload.tokensOutput) || 0),
        total_tokens: Math.min(32767, Number(payload.totalTokens) || 0),
        processing_ms: Math.min(32767, Number(payload.processingMs) || 0),
        latency_ms: Math.min(32767, Number(payload.latencyMs) || 0),
        status: payload.status || 's',
        matched_faq: Boolean(payload.matchedFaq),
        error_msg: payload.errorMsg ? String(payload.errorMsg).slice(0, 255) : null,
      });
    } catch (err) {
      // Abaikan error logging agar user experience tetap lancar
      console.error('[AI Log Error]:', err.message);
    }
  });
}

/**
 * Mendeteksi apakah pertanyaan pengguna cocok dengan salah satu FAQ
 */
function checkFaqMatch(userQuery, faqList) {
  if (!userQuery || !faqList || faqList.length === 0) return false;
  const qLower = userQuery.toLowerCase().trim();

  return faqList.some((faq) => {
    const faqLower = (faq.pertanyaan || '').toLowerCase().trim();
    if (qLower === faqLower || qLower.includes(faqLower) || faqLower.includes(qLower)) {
      return true;
    }
    // Cek kesamaan kata kunci utama (minimal 3 kata cocok)
    const qWords = qLower.split(/\s+/).filter((w) => w.length > 3);
    const faqWords = faqLower.split(/\s+/).filter((w) => w.length > 3);
    const commonWords = qWords.filter((w) => faqWords.includes(w));
    return commonWords.length >= 2;
  });
}

/**
 * Server Action: Chat dengan Sams Asisten KPU Mahasiswa LP3I
 * @param {Array<{role: string, content: string}>} messages Riwayat percakapan
 * @param {string} sessionId ID sesi percakapan (opsional)
 * @returns {Promise<{success: boolean, reply?: string, error?: string}>}
 */
export async function chatDenganSamsAsisten(messages = [], sessionId = '') {
  const startTime = Date.now();
  let clientIp = '127.0.0.1';
  let lastUserMessage = '';

  try {
    const headersList = await headers();
    const forwardedFor = headersList.get('x-forwarded-for');
    clientIp = forwardedFor ? forwardedFor.split(',')[0].trim() : '127.0.0.1';

    // Cari pesan terakhir dari user
    const lastMsgObj = [...(messages || [])].reverse().find((m) => m.role === 'user');
    lastUserMessage = lastMsgObj?.content || '';

    // Ambil konfigurasi dinamis & FAQ dari cache / database
    const { setting, faqList } = await getCachedAiConfig();

    const rateLimitMax = setting.rate_limit_per_menit || 12;
    const allowed = checkRateLimit(`ai_${clientIp}`, rateLimitMax, 60 * 1000);

    if (!allowed) {
      const latencyMs = Date.now() - startTime;
      logAiChatAsync({
        sessionId,
        ipAddress: clientIp,
        pertanyaan: lastUserMessage,
        jawaban: 'Rate limited',
        status: 'r',
        latencyMs,
        errorMsg: 'Rate limit exceeded',
      });

      return {
        success: false,
        error: 'Terlalu banyak pertanyaan. Mohon tunggu sejenak sebelum bertanya lagi kepada Sams Asisten.',
      };
    }

    if (!process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY) {
      const fallbackReply = 'Halo! Mohon maaf, kunci API OpenAI belum dikonfigurasi di environment server. Namun Anda dapat membaca panduan lengkap Pemilu di menu **Panduan** atau menghubungi panitia melalui menu **Kontak**.';
      const latencyMs = Date.now() - startTime;

      logAiChatAsync({
        sessionId,
        ipAddress: clientIp,
        pertanyaan: lastUserMessage,
        jawaban: fallbackReply,
        status: 's',
        latencyMs,
        matchedFaq: false,
      });

      return {
        success: true,
        reply: fallbackReply,
      };
    }

    // Deteksi kecocokan FAQ
    const isMatchedFaq = checkFaqMatch(lastUserMessage, faqList);

    // Format basis pengetahuan FAQ KPU sebagai context injection
    const faqContext = faqList.map(
      (item, idx) => `[FAQ ${idx + 1}] Kategori: ${item.kategori}\nTanya: ${item.pertanyaan}\nJawab: ${item.jawaban}`
    ).join('\n\n');

    const systemPromptText = setting.system_prompt || SYSTEM_PROMPT_KPU;
    const allowedLangs = setting.bahasa_diizinkan ? `\nBahasa yang diizinkan untuk Anda layani: ${setting.bahasa_diizinkan}.` : '';

    const systemMessage = {
      role: 'system',
      content: `${systemPromptText}${allowedLangs}\n\n--- BASIS PENGETAHUAN FAQ KPU LP3I ---\n${faqContext}\n--------------------------------------`,
    };

    // Ambil maksimal 8 pesan terakhir agar hemat token
    const recentMessages = (messages || []).slice(-8).map((m) => ({
      role: m.role === 'user' ? 'user' : 'assistant',
      content: String(m.content || '').slice(0, 600),
    }));

    const maxTokens = setting.max_tokens || 500;
    const temperature = Number(setting.temperature) || 1.0;

    const processStart = Date.now();
    const response = await openai.chat.completions.create({
      model: OPENAI_MODEL,
      messages: [systemMessage, ...recentMessages],
      temperature,
      max_completion_tokens: maxTokens,
    });
    const processingMs = Date.now() - processStart;
    const latencyMs = Date.now() - startTime;

    const reply = response.choices?.[0]?.message?.content || 'Maaf, saya tidak dapat memproses jawaban saat ini.';
    const usage = response.usage || {};

    const tokensInput = usage.prompt_tokens || 0;
    const tokensOutput = usage.completion_tokens || 0;
    const totalTokens = usage.total_tokens || tokensInput + tokensOutput;

    // Catat log sukses ke ai_log secara non-blocking
    logAiChatAsync({
      sessionId,
      ipAddress: clientIp,
      pertanyaan: lastUserMessage,
      jawaban: reply,
      tokensInput,
      tokensOutput,
      totalTokens,
      processingMs,
      latencyMs,
      status: 's',
      matchedFaq: isMatchedFaq,
    });

    return {
      success: true,
      reply,
    };
  } catch (error) {
    const latencyMs = Date.now() - startTime;
    logAiChatAsync({
      sessionId,
      ipAddress: clientIp,
      pertanyaan: lastUserMessage,
      jawaban: null,
      tokensInput: 0,
      tokensOutput: 0,
      totalTokens: 0,
      processingMs: 0,
      latencyMs,
      status: 'e',
      matchedFaq: false,
      errorMsg: error.message || 'Unknown error',
    });

    return {
      success: false,
      error: error.message || 'Terjadi gangguan koneksi ke layanan AI.',
    };
  }
}

// Fallback Route Handler POST jika ada pemanggilan melalui fetch HTTP biasa
export async function POST(req) {
  try {
    const body = await req.json();
    const result = await chatDenganSamsAsisten(body.messages || [], body.sessionId || '');
    return new Response(JSON.stringify(result), {
      status: result.success ? 200 : 500,
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    });
  } catch (e) {
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ success: false, error: e.message }), {
      status: 500,
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    });
  }
}

/**
 * Menyimpan seluruh perubahan absensi panitia pada satu judul absensi (Bulk Save)
 */
export async function simpanBulkAbsensi(judulId, items = []) {
  try {
    await checkAuth();

    if (!judulId) {
      return { success: false, error: 'ID judul absensi tidak valid.' };
    }

    // 1. Ambil data absensi saat ini di DB untuk judul tersebut
    const { data: existingRows, error: fetchErr } = await supabaseAdmin
      .from('absensi_panitia')
      .select('id, panitia_id')
      .eq('judul_absensi_panitia_id', judulId);

    if (fetchErr) throw fetchErr;

    const existingMap = new Map();
    (existingRows || []).forEach((row) => {
      existingMap.set(row.panitia_id, row.id);
    });

    // 2. Pisahkan operasi: INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE
    const toInsert = [];
    const toUpdate = [];
    const toDeleteIds = [];

    for (const item of items) {
      const existingId = item.absensi_id || existingMap.get(item.panitia_id);

      if (!item.jenis_absensi || item.jenis_absensi === 'belum_absen') {
        // Jika sebelumnya ada di DB tapi sekarang di-reset ke belum_absen, hapus
        if (existingId) {
          toDeleteIds.push(existingId);
        }
      } else {
        // Jika jenis_absensi selain 'hadir', keterlambatan otomatis 'tidak hadir'
        let keterlambatanVal = 'tidak hadir';
        if (item.jenis_absensi === 'hadir') {
          keterlambatanVal = item.keterlambatan === 'terlambat' ? 'terlambat' : 'tepat_waktu';
        } else {
          keterlambatanVal = 'tidak hadir';
        }
        const keteranganVal = item.keterangan ? item.keterangan.trim() : null;

        if (existingId) {
          toUpdate.push({
            id: existingId,
            jenis_absensi: item.jenis_absensi,
            keterlambatan: keterlambatanVal,
            keterangan: keteranganVal,
          });
        } else {
          toInsert.push({
            panitia_id: item.panitia_id,
            judul_absensi_panitia_id: judulId,
            jenis_absensi: item.jenis_absensi,
            keterlambatan: keterlambatanVal,
            keterangan: keteranganVal,
          });
        }
      }
    }

    // Eksekusi DELETE jika ada
    if (toDeleteIds.length > 0) {
      const { error: delErr } = await supabaseAdmin
        .from('absensi_panitia')
        .delete()
        .in('id', toDeleteIds);
      if (delErr) throw delErr;
    }

    // Eksekusi INSERT jika ada
    if (toInsert.length > 0) {
      const { error: insErr } = await supabaseAdmin
        .from('absensi_panitia')
        .insert(toInsert);
      if (insErr) throw insErr;
    }

    // Eksekusi UPDATE jika ada
    if (toUpdate.length > 0) {
      for (const upItem of toUpdate) {
        const { error: upErr } = await supabaseAdmin
          .from('absensi_panitia')
          .update({
            jenis_absensi: upItem.jenis_absensi,
            keterlambatan: upItem.keterlambatan,
            keterangan: upItem.keterangan,
          })
          .eq('id', upItem.id);
        if (upErr) throw upErr;
      }
    }

    // 3. Ambil data terbaru untuk judul tersebut
    const { data: updatedList, error: refreshErr } = await supabaseAdmin
      .from('absensi_panitia')
      .select(`
        id,
        panitia_id,
        judul_absensi_panitia_id,
        jenis_absensi,
        keterlambatan,
        keterangan,
        created_at,
        panitia:panitia_id (id, nama_panitia, jabatan_panitia, prodi_panitia),
        judul_absensi_panitia:judul_absensi_panitia_id (id, judul_absensi_panitia)
      `)
      .eq('judul_absensi_panitia_id', judulId)
      .order('created_at', { ascending: false });

    if (refreshErr) throw refreshErr;

    return {
      success: true,
      data: updatedList || [],
    };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error simpanBulkAbsensi:', error);
    return { success: false, error: error.message };
  }
}

// ==============================================================================
// 3. DATA UNTUK DASHBOARD SEKRETARIS (1 GET query komprehensif)
// ==============================================================================

/**
 * Mengambil seluruh data statistik untuk Dashboard Sekretaris dalam 1 query
 */
export async function getSekretarisDashboardData() {
  try {
    await checkAuth();

    const [judulRes, panitiaRes, absensiRes] = await Promise.all([
      supabaseAdmin
        .from('judul_absensi_panitia')
        .select('id, judul_absensi_panitia, created_at')
        .order('created_at', { ascending: false }),
      supabaseAdmin
        .from('panitia')
        .select('id, nama_panitia, jabatan_panitia', { count: 'exact' }),
      supabaseAdmin
        .from('absensi_panitia')
        .select(`
          id,
          panitia_id,
          judul_absensi_panitia_id,
          jenis_absensi,
          keterlambatan,
          created_at,
          judul_absensi_panitia:judul_absensi_panitia_id (id, judul_absensi_panitia)
        `)
        .order('created_at', { ascending: false }),
    ]);

    if (judulRes.error) throw judulRes.error;
    if (panitiaRes.error) throw panitiaRes.error;
    if (absensiRes.error) throw absensiRes.error;

    return {
      success: true,
      data: {
        totalPanitia: panitiaRes.count || (panitiaRes.data ? panitiaRes.data.length : 0),
        judulList: judulRes.data || [],
        absensiList: absensiRes.data || [],
      },
    };
  } catch (error) {
    return { success: false, error: error.message };
  }
}

'use server';

import { supabaseAdmin } from '@/lib/supabase';
import { requirePanitiaPermission, requirePanitiaEditor } from '@/utils/supabaseUtils';
import { sanitizeText } from '@/scurity/sanitaze';

/**
 * Mengambil ringkasan statistik dan metrik analitik AI Chatbot
 * @param {number|string} days Jumlah hari analisis (7, 14, 30, atau 'all')
 */
export async function getAiStats(days = 7) {
  try {
    await requirePanitiaPermission('ai');

    let query = supabaseAdmin
      .from('ai_log')
      .select('id, session_id, tokens_input, tokens_output, total_tokens, processing_ms, latency_ms, status, matched_faq, created_at')
      .order('created_at', { ascending: true });

    if (days !== 'all' && Number(days) > 0) {
      const pastDate = new Date();
      pastDate.setDate(pastDate.getDate() - Number(days));
      query = query.gte('created_at', pastDate.toISOString());
    }

    const { data: logs, error } = await query;
    if (error) {
      return { success: false, error: error.message, data: null };
    }

    const totalLogs = logs.length;
    let totalTokens = 0;
    let totalInputTokens = 0;
    let totalOutputTokens = 0;
    let totalProcessingMs = 0;
    let totalLatencyMs = 0;

    let successCount = 0;
    let errorCount = 0;
    let rejectedCount = 0;
    let matchedFaqCount = 0;

    // Daily aggregation map: date -> { total, success, error, rejected, tokens, avgProcessing, countProcessing }
    const dailyMap = {};

    logs.forEach((log) => {
      totalTokens += log.total_tokens || 0;
      totalInputTokens += log.tokens_input || 0;
      totalOutputTokens += log.tokens_output || 0;
      totalProcessingMs += log.processing_ms || 0;
      totalLatencyMs += log.latency_ms || 0;

      if (log.status === 's') successCount++;
      else if (log.status === 'e') errorCount++;
      else if (log.status === 'r') rejectedCount++;

      if (log.matched_faq) matchedFaqCount++;

      const dateKey = new Date(log.created_at).toISOString().split('T')[0];
      if (!dailyMap[dateKey]) {
        dailyMap[dateKey] = {
          date: dateKey,
          total: 0,
          success: 0,
          error: 0,
          rejected: 0,
          tokens: 0,
          tokensInput: 0,
          tokensOutput: 0,
          sumProcessing: 0,
          countProcessing: 0,
        };
      }

      dailyMap[dateKey].total++;
      if (log.status === 's') dailyMap[dateKey].success++;
      if (log.status === 'e') dailyMap[dateKey].error++;
      if (log.status === 'r') dailyMap[dateKey].rejected++;

      dailyMap[dateKey].tokens += log.total_tokens || 0;
      dailyMap[dateKey].tokensInput += log.tokens_input || 0;
      dailyMap[dateKey].tokensOutput += log.tokens_output || 0;
      if (log.processing_ms) {
        dailyMap[dateKey].sumProcessing += log.processing_ms;
        dailyMap[dateKey].countProcessing++;
      }
    });

    const dailyTrends = Object.values(dailyMap).map((d) => ({
      date: d.date,
      total: d.total,
      success: d.success,
      error: d.error,
      rejected: d.rejected,
      tokens: d.tokens,
      tokensInput: d.tokensInput,
      tokensOutput: d.tokensOutput,
      avgProcessingMs: d.countProcessing > 0 ? Math.round(d.sumProcessing / d.countProcessing) : 0,
    }));

    return {
      success: true,
      data: {
        totalQueries: totalLogs,
        totalTokens,
        totalInputTokens,
        totalOutputTokens,
        avgProcessingMs: totalLogs > 0 ? Math.round(totalProcessingMs / totalLogs) : 0,
        avgLatencyMs: totalLogs > 0 ? Math.round(totalLatencyMs / totalLogs) : 0,
        successCount,
        errorCount,
        rejectedCount,
        matchedFaqCount,
        successRate: totalLogs > 0 ? Number(((successCount / totalLogs) * 100).toFixed(1)) : 100,
        faqMatchRate: totalLogs > 0 ? Number(((matchedFaqCount / totalLogs) * 100).toFixed(1)) : 0,
        dailyTrends,
      },
    };
  } catch (err) {
    return { success: false, error: err.message, data: null };
  }
}

/**
/**
 * Mengambil daftar log chat mentah secara terpaginasi untuk tabel analitik & riwayat log
 */
export async function getAiLogs({ limit = 50, page = 1, status = 'all', search = '', date = '' } = {}) {
  try {
    await requirePanitiaPermission('ai');

    const from = (page - 1) * limit;
    const to = from + limit - 1;

    let query = supabaseAdmin
      .from('ai_log')
      .select('id, session_id, ip_address, pertanyaan, jawaban, tokens_input, tokens_output, total_tokens, processing_ms, latency_ms, status, matched_faq, error_msg, created_at', { count: 'exact' })
      .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
      .range(from, to);

    if (status && status !== 'all') {
      query = query.eq('status', status);
    }

    if (search && search.trim()) {
      query = query.ilike('pertanyaan', `%${search.trim()}%`);
    }

    if (date && date.trim()) {
      const startOfDay = `${date.trim()}T00:00:00.000Z`;
      const endOfDay = `${date.trim()}T23:59:59.999Z`;
      query = query.gte('created_at', startOfDay).lte('created_at', endOfDay);
    }

    const { data, count, error } = await query;
    if (error) return { success: false, error: error.message, data: [], count: 0 };

    return { success: true, data: data || [], count: count || 0, page, limit };
  } catch (err) {
    return { success: false, error: err.message, data: [], count: 0 };
  }
}

/**
 * Hapus log AI pada tanggal tertentu (format YYYY-MM-DD)
 */
export async function hapusAiLogPerTanggal(targetDate) {
  try {
    await requirePanitiaEditor('ai');

    if (!targetDate) return { success: false, error: 'Tanggal wajib ditentukan.' };

    const start = `${targetDate}T00:00:00.000Z`;
    const end = `${targetDate}T23:59:59.999Z`;

    const { error } = await supabaseAdmin
      .from('ai_log')
      .delete()
      .gte('created_at', start)
      .lte('created_at', end);

    if (error) return { success: false, error: error.message };
    return { success: true, message: `Data log AI pada tanggal ${targetDate} berhasil dihapus.` };
  } catch (err) {
    return { success: false, error: err.message };
  }
}

/**
 * Hapus log AI yang lebih lama dari N hari
 */
export async function hapusAiLogLebihLamaDari(intervalHari) {
  try {
    await requirePanitiaEditor('ai');

    const days = parseInt(intervalHari, 10);
    if (isNaN(days) || days < 1) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Interval hari tidak valid.' };
    }

    const batasWaktu = new Date();
    batasWaktu.setDate(batasWaktu.getDate() - days);

    const { error } = await supabaseAdmin
      .from('ai_log')
      .delete()
      .lt('created_at', batasWaktu.toISOString());

    if (error) return { success: false, error: error.message };
    return {
      success: true,
      message: `Data log AI yang lebih lama dari ${days} hari berhasil dibersihkan.`,
    };
  } catch (err) {
    return { success: false, error: err.message };
  }
}

/**
 * Menyimpan / memperbarui item FAQ AI
 */
export async function saveAiFaq(payload) {
  try {
    await requirePanitiaEditor('ai');

    const id = payload.id;
    const cleanKategori = sanitizeText(payload.kategori || 'Umum');
    const cleanPertanyaan = sanitizeText(payload.pertanyaan || '');
    const cleanJawaban = typeof payload.jawaban === 'string' ? payload.jawaban.trim() : '';
    const urutan = Number(payload.urutan) || 1;
    const isActive = payload.is_active !== undefined ? Boolean(payload.is_active) : true;

    if (!cleanPertanyaan || !cleanJawaban) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Pertanyaan dan jawaban wajib diisi.' };
    }

    if (id) {
      const { data, error } = await supabaseAdmin
        .from('ai_faq')
        .update({
          kategori: cleanKategori,
          pertanyaan: cleanPertanyaan,
          jawaban: cleanJawaban,
          urutan,
          is_active: isActive,
          updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        })
        .eq('id', id)
        .select()
        .single();

      if (error) return { success: false, error: error.message };
      return { success: true, data };
    } else {
      const { data, error } = await supabaseAdmin
        .from('ai_faq')
        .insert({
          kategori: cleanKategori,
          pertanyaan: cleanPertanyaan,
          jawaban: cleanJawaban,
          urutan,
          is_active: isActive,
        })
        .select()
        .single();

      if (error) return { success: false, error: error.message };
      return { success: true, data };
    }
  } catch (err) {
    return { success: false, error: err.message };
  }
}

 */

  try {

Berikan informasi akurat, ramah, profesional seputar Pemilu Mahasiswa.\n2. Gunakan bahasa sopan dan mudah dipahami mahasiswa.\n3. Jawab berdasarkan data FAQ KPU jika relevan. Jika di luar konteks, arahkan ke menu Panduan atau Kontak.\n4. Jangan memihak paslon manapun. Jaga netralitas KPU.',
      bahasa_diizinkan: 'id,en',
      max_tokens: 500,

/**
 * Menyimpan konfigurasi setting AI ke DB
 */
export async function saveAiSetting(payload) {
  try {
    await requirePanitiaEditor('ai');

    const systemPrompt = typeof payload.system_prompt === 'string' ? payload.system_prompt.trim() : '';
    const bahasaDiizinkan = typeof payload.bahasa_diizinkan === 'string' ? payload.bahasa_diizinkan.trim() : 'id,en';
    const maxTokens = Math.max(50, Math.min(2000, Number(payload.max_tokens) || 500));
    const temperature = Math.max(0, Math.min(2, Number(payload.temperature) || 1.0));
    const rateLimit = Math.max(1, Math.min(120, Number(payload.rate_limit_per_menit) || 12));

    if (!systemPrompt) {
      return { success: false, error: 'System prompt wajib diisi.' };
    }

    // Ambil setting eksisting jika ada
    const { data: existing } = await supabaseAdmin
      .from('ai_setting')
      .select('id')
      .limit(1)
      .maybeSingle();

    let result;
    if (existing?.id) {
      result = await supabaseAdmin
        .from('ai_setting')
        .update({
          system_prompt: systemPrompt,
          bahasa_diizinkan: bahasaDiizinkan,
          max_tokens: maxTokens,
          temperature,
          rate_limit_per_menit: rateLimit,
          updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        })
        .eq('id', existing.id)
        .select()
        .single();
    } else {
      result = await supabaseAdmin
        .from('ai_setting')
        .insert({
          system_prompt: systemPrompt,
          bahasa_diizinkan: bahasaDiizinkan,
          max_tokens: maxTokens,
          temperature,
          rate_limit_per_menit: rateLimit,
        })
        .select()
        .single();
    }

    if (result.error) return { success: false, error: result.error.message };
    return { success: true, data: result.data };
  } catch (err) {
    return { success: false, error: err.message };
  }
}

'use server';

import { getPanitiaSession, removePanitiaSession } from '@/utils/supabaseUtils';
import { supabaseAdmin } from '@/lib/supabase';

/**
 * Server Action: Mengambil informasi sesi aktif admin panitia
 */
export async function getSesiPanitia() {
  try {
    const session = await getPanitiaSession();
    if (!session) {
      return { authenticated: false, session: null };
    }
    return {
      authenticated: true,
      session: {
        adminId: session.adminId,
        nama: session.nama,
        nim: session.nim,
        email: session.email,
        role: session.role,
        roleAkses: session.roleAkses,
      },
    };
  } catch (error) {
    return { authenticated: false, session: null, error: error.message };
  }
}

/**
 * Server Action: Update status online admin panitia
 */
export async function updateAdminOnlineStatus(isOnline) {
  try {
    const session = await getPanitiaSession();
    if (!session?.adminId) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Tidak ada sesi admin aktif' };
    }

    const { error } = await supabaseAdmin
      .from('adminpanitia')
      .update({ is_online: Boolean(isOnline) })
      .eq('id', session.adminId);

    if (error) {
      return { success: false, error: error.message };
    }

    return { success: true, is_online: Boolean(isOnline) };
  } catch (error) {
    return { success: false, error: error.message };
  }
}

/**
 * Server Action: Logout sesi panitia
 */
export async function logoutPanitia() {
  try {
    const session = await getPanitiaSession();
    if (session?.adminId) {
      await supabaseAdmin
        .from('adminpanitia')
        .update({ is_online: false })
        .eq('id', session.adminId);
    }
    await removePanitiaSession();
    return { success: true };
  } catch (error) {
    return { success: false, error: error.message };
  }
}

'use server';

import { supabaseAdmin } from '@/lib/supabase';
import { requirePanitiaPermission } from '@/utils/supabaseUtils';

/**
 * Server Action: Mengambil data statistik komprehensif untuk Dashboard Panitia
 * Mendukung filter waktu: 'today' | '7days' | '30days' | 'all' | 'custom'
 */
export async function getDashboardStats(filterParams = {}) {
  try {
    await requirePanitiaPermission('dashboard');

    const filter = filterParams.filter || '7days';
    const customStart = filterParams.startDate || null;
    const customEnd = filterParams.endDate || null;

    // 1. Total hitungan data utama
    const [trafikRes, kontakRes, kandidatRes, dokRes] = await Promise.all([
      supabaseAdmin.from('trafik').select('*', { count: 'exact', head: true }),
      supabaseAdmin.from('kontak').select('id, status', { count: 'exact' }),
      supabaseAdmin.from('kandidat').select('*', { count: 'exact', head: true }),
      supabaseAdmin.from('dukomentasi').select('*', { count: 'exact', head: true }),
    ]);

    const totalTrafik = trafikRes.count || 0;
    const totalKontak = kontakRes.count || 0;
    const pesanBelumDibaca = (kontakRes.data || []).filter((k) => k.status === 'belum_dibaca').length;
    const totalKandidat = kandidatRes.count || 0;
    const totalDokumentasi = dokRes.count || 0;

    // 2. Menghitung rentang waktu berdasarkan filter
    const now = new Date();
    let fromDate = null;
    let toDate = new Date(now);

    if (filter === 'today') {
      fromDate = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate(), 0, 0, 0);
      toDate = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate(), 23, 59, 59, 999);
    } else if (filter === '30days') {
      fromDate = new Date();
      fromDate.setDate(fromDate.getDate() - 30);
      fromDate.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
    } else if (filter === 'custom' && customStart) {
      fromDate = new Date(customStart + 'T00:00:00');
      if (customEnd) {
        toDate = new Date(customEnd + 'T23:59:59.999');
      }
    } else if (filter === 'all') {
      fromDate = null;
    } else {
      // Default: 7 hari terakhir
      fromDate = new Date();
      fromDate.setDate(fromDate.getDate() - 7);
      fromDate.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
    }

    // 3. Query data trafik yang terfilter berdasarkan rentang waktu
    let query = supabaseAdmin
      .from('trafik')
      .select('id, sumber, kota, isp, path, visited_at')
      .order('visited_at', { ascending: false });

    if (fromDate) {
      query = query.gte('visited_at', fromDate.toISOString());
    }
    if (toDate) {
      query = query.lte('visited_at', toDate.toISOString());
    }

    const { data: filteredTrafik, error: errTrafik } = await query.limit(500);

    if (errTrafik) {
      throw new Error(errTrafik.message);
    }

    const trafficList = filteredTrafik || [];

    // 4. Membangun data time-series grafik kunjungan (Chart Line)
    const trafficByBucket = {};

    if (filter === 'today') {
      // Kelompokkan per interval 3 jam untuk hari ini (00, 03, 06, 09, 12, 15, 18, 21)
      const hours = [0, 3, 6, 9, 12, 15, 18, 21];
      hours.forEach((h) => {
        const label = `${String(h).padStart(2, '0')}:00`;
        trafficByBucket[label] = 0;
      });

      trafficList.forEach((t) => {
        const d = new Date(t.visited_at);
        const hour = d.getHours();
        // Cari bucket terdekat
        const bucketHour = hours.reduce((prev, curr) => (hour >= curr ? curr : prev), 0);
        const label = `${String(bucketHour).padStart(2, '0')}:00`;
        if (trafficByBucket[label] !== undefined) {
          trafficByBucket[label]++;
        }
      });
    } else if (filter === '30days') {
      // 30 hari ke belakang
      for (let i = 29; i >= 0; i--) {
        const d = new Date();
        d.setDate(d.getDate() - i);
        const key = d.toLocaleDateString('id-ID', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short' });
        trafficByBucket[key] = 0;
      }

      trafficList.forEach((t) => {
        const d = new Date(t.visited_at);
        const key = d.toLocaleDateString('id-ID', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short' });
        if (trafficByBucket[key] !== undefined) {
          trafficByBucket[key]++;
        }
      });
    } else if (filter === 'custom' && fromDate && toDate) {
      // Rentang kustom: hitung selisih hari
      const diffTime = Math.abs(toDate - fromDate);
      const diffDays = Math.ceil(diffTime / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));

      if (diffDays <= 2) {
        // Rentang 1-2 hari: kelompokkan per 4 jam
        const hours = [0, 4, 8, 12, 16, 20];
        hours.forEach((h) => {
          trafficByBucket[`${String(h).padStart(2, '0')}:00`] = 0;
        });
        trafficList.forEach((t) => {
          const d = new Date(t.visited_at);
          const h = d.getHours();
          const bucket = hours.reduce((prev, curr) => (h >= curr ? curr : prev), 0);
          const label = `${String(bucket).padStart(2, '0')}:00`;
          if (trafficByBucket[label] !== undefined) trafficByBucket[label]++;
        });
      } else {
        // Kelompokkan per hari
        for (let d = new Date(fromDate); d <= toDate; d.setDate(d.getDate() + 1)) {
          const key = d.toLocaleDateString('id-ID', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short' });
          trafficByBucket[key] = 0;
        }
        trafficList.forEach((t) => {
          const d = new Date(t.visited_at);
          const key = d.toLocaleDateString('id-ID', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short' });
          if (trafficByBucket[key] !== undefined) {
            trafficByBucket[key]++;
          }
        });
      }
    } else {
      // Default: 7 hari
      for (let i = 6; i >= 0; i--) {
        const d = new Date();
        d.setDate(d.getDate() - i);
        const key = d.toLocaleDateString('id-ID', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short' });
        trafficByBucket[key] = 0;
      }

      trafficList.forEach((t) => {
        const d = new Date(t.visited_at);
        const key = d.toLocaleDateString('id-ID', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short' });
        if (trafficByBucket[key] !== undefined) {
          trafficByBucket[key]++;
        }
      });
    }

    // 5. Menghitung Top Sumber Traffic dari data terfilter
    const sourceCounts = {};
    // 6. Menghitung Top Kota dari data terfilter
    const cityCounts = {};

    trafficList.forEach((t) => {
      const s = t.sumber || 'Direct';
      sourceCounts[s] = (sourceCounts[s] || 0) + 1;

      const c = t.kota || 'Lainnya';
      cityCounts[c] = (cityCounts[c] || 0) + 1;
    });

    const topSources = Object.entries(sourceCounts)
      .map(([name, count]) => ({ name, count }))
      .sort((a, b) => b.count - a.count)
      .slice(0, 5);

    const topCities = Object.entries(cityCounts)
      .map(([name, count]) => ({ name, count }))
      .sort((a, b) => b.count - a.count)
      .slice(0, 6);

    return {
      success: true,
      stats: {
        totalTrafik,
        totalKontak,
        pesanBelumDibaca,
        totalKandidat,
        totalDokumentasi,
        filteredTotal: trafficList.length,
      },
      chartData: {
        labels: Object.keys(trafficByBucket),
        data: Object.values(trafficByBucket),
      },
      topSources,
      topCities,
      logTerbaru: trafficList, // Seluruh log terfilter dikirim agar bisa dipaginasi di client dengan cepat
      currentFilter: {
        filter,
        startDate: customStart,
        endDate: customEnd,
      },
    };
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: error.message || 'Gagal memuat statistik dashboard.',
    };
  }
}

'use server';

import { supabaseAdmin } from '@/lib/supabase';
import { requirePanitiaPermission } from '@/utils/supabaseUtils';
import { sanitizeText, sanitizeUrl } from '@/scurity/sanitaze';

/**
 * Mengambil seluruh data dokumentasi untuk panel panitia
 */
export async function getPanitiaDokumentasiList() {
  try {
    await requirePanitiaPermission('dokumentasi');

    const { data, error } = await supabaseAdmin
      .from('dukomentasi')
      .select('id, judul_dokumentasi, tanggal_dokumentasi, link_drive, deskripsi, created_at')
      .order('tanggal_dokumentasi', { ascending: false });

    if (error) {
      return { success: false, data: [], error: error.message };
    }

    return { success: true, data: data || [] };
  } catch (error) {
    return { success: false, data: [], error: error.message };
  }
}

/**
 * Simpan atau Update Dokumentasi
 */
export async function simpanDokumentasi(payload) {
  try {
    await requirePanitiaPermission('dokumentasi');

    const id = payload.id;
    const judul = sanitizeText(payload.judul_dokumentasi || '');
    const tanggal = payload.tanggal_dokumentasi || new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
    const linkDrive = sanitizeUrl(payload.link_drive || '');
    const deskripsi = sanitizeText(payload.deskripsi || '');

    if (!judul || !linkDrive) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Judul Dokumentasi dan Link Google Drive wajib diisi.' };
    }

    if (id) {
      const { error } = await supabaseAdmin.from('dukomentasi').update({
        judul_dokumentasi: judul,
        tanggal_dokumentasi: tanggal,
        link_drive: linkDrive,
        deskripsi: deskripsi,
        update_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      }).eq('id', id);

      if (error) return { success: false, error: error.message };
    } else {
      const { error } = await supabaseAdmin.from('dukomentasi').insert({
        judul_dokumentasi: judul,
        tanggal_dokumentasi: tanggal,
        link_drive: linkDrive,
        deskripsi: deskripsi,
      });

      if (error) return { success: false, error: error.message };
    }

    return { success: true, message: 'Data dokumentasi berhasil disimpan.' };
  } catch (error) {
    return { success: false, error: error.message };
  }
}

/**
 * Hapus Dokumentasi
 */
export async function hapusDokumentasi(id) {
  try {
    await requirePanitiaPermission('dokumentasi');
    if (!id) return { success: false, error: 'ID tidak valid.' };

    const { error } = await supabaseAdmin.from('dukomentasi').delete().eq('id', id);
    if (error) return { success: false, error: error.message };

    return { success: true, message: 'Dokumentasi berhasil dihapus.' };
  } catch (error) {
    return { success: false, error: error.message };
  }
}

import { supabaseAdmin } from '@/lib/supabase';

 * Mengambil seluruh riwayat jadwal voting
 */

  try {
    await requirePanitiaPermission('voting');

    const { data, error } = await supabaseAdmin
      .from('jadwal_voting')
      .select('*')
      .order('waktu_mulai', { ascending: false });

    if (error) {
      return { success: false, error: error.message };
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      data: data || [],
    };
  } catch (err) {
    return { success: false, error: err.message };
  }
}

/**
 * Menambah jadwal voting baru (Hanya untuk Editor)
 */
export async function tambahJadwalVoting({ waktu_mulai, waktu_berakhir }) {
  try {
    await requirePanitiaEditor('voting');

    if (!waktu_mulai || !waktu_berakhir) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Waktu mulai dan waktu berakhir harus diisi.' };
    }

    const startTs = new Date(waktu_mulai).getTime();
    const endTs = new Date(waktu_berakhir).getTime();

    if (isNaN(startTs) || isNaN(endTs)) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Format waktu tidak valid.' };
    }

    if (startTs >= endTs) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Waktu mulai harus lebih awal dari waktu berakhir.' };
    }

    const { data, error } = await supabaseAdmin
      .from('jadwal_voting')
      .insert([
        {
          waktu_mulai: new Date(waktu_mulai).toISOString(),
          waktu_berakhir: new Date(waktu_berakhir).toISOString(),
        },
      ])
      .select()
      .single();

    if (error) {
      return { success: false, error: error.message };
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      data,
    };
  } catch (err) {
    return { success: false, error: err.message };
  }
}

    if (startTs >= endTs) {

'use server';

import { supabaseAdmin } from '@/lib/supabase';

import { sanitizeText, sanitizePhone, sanitizeEmail, sanitizeUrl } from '@/scurity/sanitaze';
import { deleteFotoKandidat } from '@/api/storage';

/**
 * Mengambil seluruh data kandidat beserta detailnya untuk panitia
 */

  try {

    const { data, error } = await supabaseAdmin
      .from('kandidat')
      .select(`
        id,
        nama_kandidat,
        nim_kandidat,
        prodi_kandidat,
        fotodiri_kandidat,
        posisi,
        is_eliminated,
        detail_kandidat_id,
        created_at,
        detail_kandidat (
          id,
          notlpn_wa_kandidat,
          emailplb_kandidat,
          cv_portofolio_kandidat,
          visi,
          misi
        )
      `)
      .order('created_at', { ascending: false });

    if (error) {
      return { success: false, data: [], error: error.message };
    }

    return { success: true, data: data || [] };
  } catch (error) {
    return { success: false, data: [], error: error.message };
  }
}

/**
 * Toggle Status Verifikasi Eliminasi Kandidat (True = Dieliminasi, False = Lolos / Aktif)
 */
export async function toggleEliminasiKandidat(id, isEliminated) {
  try {
    await requirePanitiaPermission('kandidat');

    if (!id) return { success: false, error: 'ID kandidat tidak valid.' };

    const { error } = await supabaseAdmin
      .from('kandidat')
      .update({ is_eliminated: Boolean(isEliminated) })
      .eq('id', id);

    if (error) return { success: false, error: error.message };

    return {
      success: true,
      message: isEliminated ? 'Kandidat ditandai Dieliminasi.' : 'Kandidat ditandai Lolos/Aktif.',
    };
  } catch (error) {
    return { success: false, error: error.message };
  }
}

/**
 * Tambah atau Perbarui Data Kandidat
 */
export async function simpanKandidat(payload) {
  try {
    await requirePanitiaPermission('kandidat');

    const id = payload.id; // jika ada berarti edit
    const nama = sanitizeText(payload.nama_kandidat || '');
    const nim = sanitizeText(payload.nim_kandidat || '');
    const prodi = sanitizeText(payload.prodi_kandidat || '');
    const posisi = sanitizeText(payload.posisi || 'Calon Presiden Mahasiswa');
    const foto = sanitizeUrl(payload.fotodiri_kandidat || '');

    if (!nama || !nim || !prodi) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Nama, NIM, dan Program Studi wajib diisi.' };
    }

    // Detail kandidat
    const notelp = sanitizePhone(payload.notlpn_wa_kandidat || '');
    const email = sanitizeEmail(payload.emailplb_kandidat || '');
    const cvPorto = sanitizeUrl(payload.cv_portofolio_kandidat || '');
    const visi = sanitizeText(payload.visi || '');
    const misi = sanitizeText(payload.misi || '');

    let detailId = payload.detail_kandidat_id;

    // Simpan / update detail kandidat jika ada info detail
    if (detailId) {
      await supabaseAdmin.from('detail_kandidat').update({
        notlpn_wa_kandidat: notelp,
        emailplb_kandidat: email,
        cv_portofolio_kandidat: cvPorto,
        visi,
        misi,
      }).eq('id', detailId);
    } else if (notelp || email || cvPorto || visi || misi) {
      const { data: detailData } = await supabaseAdmin.from('detail_kandidat').insert({
        notlpn_wa_kandidat: notelp,
        emailplb_kandidat: email,
        cv_portofolio_kandidat: cvPorto,
        visi,
        misi,
      }).select('id').single();

      if (detailData) {
        detailId = detailData.id;
      }
    }

    const isEliminated = Boolean(payload.is_eliminated);

    if (id) {
      // Edit
      const { error } = await supabaseAdmin.from('kandidat').update({
        nama_kandidat: nama,
        nim_kandidat: nim,
        prodi_kandidat: prodi,
        fotodiri_kandidat: foto,
        posisi: posisi,
        is_eliminated: isEliminated,
        detail_kandidat_id: detailId || null,
      }).eq('id', id);

      if (error) return { success: false, error: error.message };
    } else {
      // Tambah baru
      const { error } = await supabaseAdmin.from('kandidat').insert({
        nama_kandidat: nama,
        nim_kandidat: nim,
        prodi_kandidat: prodi,
        fotodiri_kandidat: foto,
        posisi: posisi,
        is_eliminated: isEliminated,
        detail_kandidat_id: detailId || null,
      });

      if (error) return { success: false, error: error.message };
    }

    return { success: true, message: 'Data kandidat berhasil disimpan.' };
  } catch (error) {
    return { success: false, error: error.message };
  }
}

/**
 * Hapus Kandidat
 */
export async function hapusKandidat(id, fotoUrl) {
  try {
    await requirePanitiaPermission('kandidat');

    if (!id) return { success: false, error: 'ID kandidat tidak valid.' };

    // Hapus foto di storage bila ada
    if (fotoUrl) {
      await deleteFotoKandidat(fotoUrl);
    }

    const { error } = await supabaseAdmin.from('kandidat').delete().eq('id', id);
    if (error) return { success: false, error: error.message };

    return { success: true, message: 'Kandidat berhasil dihapus.' };
  } catch (error) {
    return { success: false, error: error.message };
  }
}

'use server';

import { supabaseAdmin } from '@/lib/supabase';
import { setPanitiaSession } from '@/utils/supabaseUtils';
import { sanitizeText } from '@/scurity/sanitaze';
import { checkRateLimit } from '@/scurity/rateLimiter';
import { headers } from 'next/headers';

/**
 * Server Action: Login Panitia menggunakan NIM dan Password
 * @param {string} nim
 * @param {string} password
 */
export async function loginPanitia(nim, password) {
  try {
    const headersList = await headers();
    const forwardedFor = headersList.get('x-forwarded-for');
    const clientIp = forwardedFor ? forwardedFor.split(',')[0].trim() : '127.0.0.1';

    // Rate limit: Maksimal 5 percobaan gagal per 5 menit
    const allowed = checkRateLimit(`login_${clientIp}`, 5, 5 * 60 * 1000);
    if (!allowed) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: 'Terlalu banyak percobaan login gagal. Mohon tunggu 5 menit.',
      };
    }

    const cleanNim = sanitizeText(nim || '');
    if (!cleanNim || !password) {
      return { success: false, error: 'NIM dan Password wajib diisi.' };
    }

    // 1. Cari data admin berdasarkan NIM di tabel adminpanitia
    const { data: admin, error: adminError } = await supabaseAdmin
      .from('adminpanitia')
      .select('id, auth_id, nama, nim, email, role_id, roleadmin (id, role, roleakses)')
      .eq('nim', cleanNim)
      .single();

    if (adminError || !admin) {
      return { success: false, error: 'NIM tidak terdaftar sebagai panitia KPU.' };
    }

    // 2. Lakukan autentikasi menggunakan email & password ke Supabase Auth
    const { data: authData, error: authError } = await supabaseAdmin.auth.signInWithPassword({
      email: admin.email,
      password: password,
    });

    if (authError || !authData.user) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Password salah. Silakan periksa kembali.' };
    }

    // 3. Update status online = true & update_at (terakhir login)
    try {
      await supabaseAdmin
        .from('adminpanitia')
        .update({
          is_online: true,
          update_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        })
        .eq('id', admin.id);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('Failed to set online status and login time on login:', e);
    }

    // 4. Simpan session terenkripsi ke cookie HTTP-only
    await setPanitiaSession(admin, authData.user.id);

    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'Login berhasil!',
      role: admin.roleadmin?.role || 'adminPanitia',
      roleAkses: admin.roleadmin?.roleakses || '',
      nama: admin.nama,
    };
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: error.message || 'Terjadi kesalahan sistem saat proses login.',
    };
  }
}

'use server';

import { supabaseAdmin } from '@/lib/supabase';
import { requirePanitiaPermission, requirePanitiaEditor } from '@/utils/supabaseUtils';
import { VALID_KELAS, PRODI_MAP } from '@/lib/mhsConstants';

/**
 * Mengambil daftar data mahasiswa beserta status voting dan kolom kelas
 */
export async function getPanitiaMhsList({ search = '', statusFilter = 'semua', kelasFilter = 'semua' } = {}) {
  try {
    await requirePanitiaPermission('mhs');

    // 1. Ambil seluruh data mahasiswa termasuk kolom kelas
    let query = supabaseAdmin
      .from('mhs')
      .select('id, nim, nama_mhs, kode_voting, kelas, created_at')
      .order('created_at', { ascending: false });

    if (search && search.trim() !== '') {
      const term = `%${search.trim()}%`;
      query = query.or(`nama_mhs.ilike.${term},nim.ilike.${term},kode_voting.ilike.${term}`);
    }

    if (kelasFilter && kelasFilter !== 'semua') {
      query = query.eq('kelas', kelasFilter);
    }

    const { data: mhsList, error: mhsErr } = await query;
    if (mhsErr) {
      return { success: false, error: mhsErr.message, data: [] };
    }

    // 2. Ambil data voting untuk mencocokkan status
    const { data: votingList, error: voteErr } = await supabaseAdmin
      .from('voting')
      .select('id, nim, created_at, paslon_id');

    if (voteErr) {
      return { success: false, error: voteErr.message, data: [] };
    }

    // Mapping status voting
    const voteMap = new Map();
    (votingList || []).forEach((v) => {
      voteMap.set(v.nim, v);
    });

    let mappedData = (mhsList || []).map((m) => {
      const voteRecord = voteMap.get(m.id);
      const parsed = (() => {
        const cleanNim = String(m.nim || '').trim();
        const cleanKelas = String(m.kelas || 'Reg').trim();
        if (cleanKelas !== 'Reg' && cleanKelas !== 'NonReg') {
          return {
            angkatan: cleanKelas || '-',
            prodi: cleanKelas || '-',
          };
        }
        const angkatan = cleanNim.length >= 4 ? cleanNim.substring(0, 4) : '-';
        const kode = cleanNim.length >= 6 ? cleanNim.substring(4, 6) : '';
        const prodi = PRODI_MAP[kode] || (kode ? `Prodi (${kode})` : '-');
        return { angkatan, prodi };
      })();

      return {
        ...m,
        kelas: m.kelas || 'Reg',
        angkatan: parsed.angkatan,
        prodi: parsed.prodi,
        has_voted: Boolean(voteRecord),
        voting_at: voteRecord ? voteRecord.created_at : null,
        voting_id: voteRecord ? voteRecord.id : null,
      };
    });

    if (statusFilter === 'sudah') {
      mappedData = mappedData.filter((m) => m.has_voted);
    } else if (statusFilter === 'belum') {
      mappedData = mappedData.filter((m) => !m.has_voted);
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      data: mappedData,
      totalCount: mhsList?.length || 0,
      votedCount: mappedData.filter((m) => m.has_voted).length,
    };
  } catch (err) {
    return { success: false, error: err.message, data: [] };
  }
}

/**
 * Tambah data mahasiswa secara manual (Khusus Editor)
 */
export async function tambahMhsManual({ nama_mhs, nim, kode_voting, kelas = 'Reg' }) {
  try {
    await requirePanitiaEditor('mhs');

    const cleanNama = (nama_mhs || '').trim();
    const cleanNim = (nim || '').trim();
    const cleanKode = (kode_voting || '').trim();
    const cleanKelas = VALID_KELAS.includes(kelas) ? kelas : 'Reg';

    if (!cleanNama || !cleanNim || !cleanKode) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Semua kolom (Nama, NIM, Kode Voting) wajib diisi.' };
    }

    // Cek apakah NIM sudah terdaftar
    const { data: exist } = await supabaseAdmin
      .from('mhs')
      .select('id')
      .eq('nim', cleanNim)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (exist) {
      return { success: false, error: `Mahasiswa dengan NIM ${cleanNim} sudah terdaftar di sistem.` };
    }

    const { data, error } = await supabaseAdmin
      .from('mhs')
      .insert({
        nama_mhs: cleanNama,
        nim: cleanNim,
        kode_voting: cleanKode,
        kelas: cleanKelas,
      })
      .select()
      .single();

    if (error) {
      return { success: false, error: error.message };
    }

    return { success: true, data };
  } catch (err) {
    return { success: false, error: err.message };
  }
}

/**
 * Tambah banyak data mahasiswa (Bulk Import dari Excel) (Khusus Editor)
 */
export async function tambahMhsBulk(rows = []) {
  try {
    await requirePanitiaEditor('mhs');

    if (!rows || rows.length === 0) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Tidak ada data mahasiswa yang dikirim untuk diimpor.' };
    }

    // Bersihkan dan validasi baris
    const cleanedRows = [];
    const seenNims = new Set();

    for (let i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
      const r = rows[i];
      const nama = (r.nama_mhs || r.nama || r.Nama || '').toString().trim();
      const nim = (r.nim || r.NIM || r.Nim || '').toString().trim();
      const kode = (r.kode_voting || r.kode || r.Kode || r.token || '').toString().trim();
      
      const rawKelas = (r.kelas || r.Kelas || r.KELAS || 'Reg').toString().trim();
      const cleanKelas = VALID_KELAS.includes(rawKelas) ? rawKelas : 'Reg';

      if (!nama || !nim) continue;

      if (seenNims.has(nim)) continue;
      seenNims.add(nim);

      cleanedRows.push({
        nama_mhs: nama,
        nim: nim,
        kelas: cleanKelas,
        kode_voting: kode || Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 8).toUpperCase(),
      });
    }

    if (cleanedRows.length === 0) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: 'Format data file tidak sesuai. Pastikan ada kolom nama dan nim.',
      };
    }

    // Dapatkan NIM yang sudah ada di database untuk mencegah error duplicate
    const { data: existingMhs } = await supabaseAdmin
      .from('mhs')
      .select('nim');

    const dbNimSet = new Set((existingMhs || []).map((m) => m.nim));
    const toInsert = cleanedRows.filter((item) => !dbNimSet.has(item.nim));

    if (toInsert.length === 0) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: 'Semua mahasiswa dalam file Excel sudah terdaftar di sistem sebelumnya.',
      };
    }

    // Insert dalam batch per 100 baris
    const BATCH_SIZE = 100;
    let insertedTotal = 0;

    for (let i = 0; i < toInsert.length; i += BATCH_SIZE) {
      const chunk = toInsert.slice(i, i + BATCH_SIZE);
      const { error: batchErr } = await supabaseAdmin.from('mhs').insert(chunk);
      if (batchErr) {
        return {
          success: false,
          error: `Gagal mengimpor batch pada indeks ${i}: ${batchErr.message}`,
        };
      }
      insertedTotal += chunk.length;
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      insertedCount: insertedTotal,
      skippedCount: cleanedRows.length - toInsert.length,
      totalRead: cleanedRows.length,
    };
  } catch (err) {
    return { success: false, error: err.message };
  }
}

/**
 * Edit data mahasiswa (Khusus Editor)
 */
export async function updateMhs(id, { nama_mhs, nim, kode_voting, kelas = 'Reg' }) {
  try {
    await requirePanitiaEditor('mhs');

    const cleanNama = (nama_mhs || '').trim();
    const cleanNim = (nim || '').trim();
    const cleanKode = (kode_voting || '').trim();
    const cleanKelas = VALID_KELAS.includes(kelas) ? kelas : 'Reg';

    if (!cleanNama || !cleanNim || !cleanKode) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Semua kolom wajib diisi.' };
    }

    // Cek duplikasi NIM mahasiswa lain
    const { data: exist } = await supabaseAdmin
      .from('mhs')
      .select('id')
      .eq('nim', cleanNim)
      .neq('id', id)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (exist) {
      return { success: false, error: `NIM ${cleanNim} sudah digunakan oleh mahasiswa lain.` };
    }

    const { data, error } = await supabaseAdmin
      .from('mhs')
      .update({
        nama_mhs: cleanNama,
        nim: cleanNim,
        kode_voting: cleanKode,
        kelas: cleanKelas,
      })
      .eq('id', id)
      .select()
      .single();

    if (error) {
      return { success: false, error: error.message };
    }

    return { success: true, data };
  } catch (err) {
    return { success: false, error: err.message };
  }
}

/**
 * Hapus data mahasiswa (Khusus Editor)
 */
export async function hapusMhs(id) {
  try {
    await requirePanitiaEditor('mhs');

    const { error } = await supabaseAdmin
      .from('mhs')
      .delete()
      .eq('id', id);

      return { success: false, error: error.message };
    }

    return { success: true };
  } catch (err) {
    return { success: false, error: err.message };
  }
}

/**
 * Statistik Lengkap Dashboard Mahasiswa dengan Breakdown Baru
 */
export async function getMhsDashboardStats() {
  try {
    await requirePanitiaPermission('mhs');

    // 1. Ambil semua mahasiswa termasuk kolom kelas
    const { data: mhsList, error: mhsErr } = await supabaseAdmin
      .from('mhs')
      .select('id, nim, nama_mhs, kelas, created_at');

    if (mhsErr) {
      return { success: false, error: mhsErr.message };
    }

    // 2. Ambil data voting
    const { data: votingList, error: voteErr } = await supabaseAdmin
      .from('voting')
      .select('id, nim, created_at, paslon_id');

    if (voteErr) {
      return { success: false, error: voteErr.message };
    }

    const totalMhs = mhsList?.length || 0;
    const voteMap = new Map();
    (votingList || []).forEach((v) => {
      voteMap.set(v.nim, v);
    });

    const sudahVotingCount = (votingList || []).length;
    const belumVotingCount = Math.max(0, totalMhs - sudahVotingCount);
    const persentase = totalMhs > 0 ? ((sudahVotingCount / totalMhs) * 100).toFixed(1) : 0;

    // Inisialisasi struktur analisis
    const kelasStats = {
      Reg: { total: 0, sudah: 0, belum: 0 },
      NonReg: { total: 0, sudah: 0, belum: 0 },
      Manaj: { total: 0, sudah: 0, belum: 0 },
      Dosen: { total: 0, sudah: 0, belum: 0 },
    };

    const angkatanStats = {};
    const prodiStats = {};

    (mhsList || []).forEach((m) => {
      const hasVoted = voteMap.has(m.id);
      const k = VALID_KELAS.includes(m.kelas) ? m.kelas : 'Reg';

      // Hitung per kelas
      kelasStats[k].total += 1;
      if (hasVoted) {
        kelasStats[k].sudah += 1;
      } else {
        kelasStats[k].belum += 1;
      }

      // Hitung angkatan & prodi
      let angkatanKey = k;
      let prodiKey = k;

      if (k === 'Reg' || k === 'NonReg') {
        const cleanNim = String(m.nim || '').trim();
        angkatanKey = cleanNim.length >= 4 ? cleanNim.substring(0, 4) : 'Lainnya';
        const kode = cleanNim.length >= 6 ? cleanNim.substring(4, 6) : '';
        prodiKey = PRODI_MAP[kode] || (kode ? `Prodi ${kode}` : 'Lainnya');
      }

      // Angkatan
      if (!angkatanStats[angkatanKey]) {
        angkatanStats[angkatanKey] = { total: 0, sudah: 0, belum: 0 };
      }
      angkatanStats[angkatanKey].total += 1;
      if (hasVoted) angkatanStats[angkatanKey].sudah += 1;
      else angkatanStats[angkatanKey].belum += 1;

      // Prodi
      if (!prodiStats[prodiKey]) {
        prodiStats[prodiKey] = { total: 0, sudah: 0, belum: 0 };
      }
      prodiStats[prodiKey].total += 1;
      if (hasVoted) prodiStats[prodiKey].sudah += 1;
      else prodiStats[prodiKey].belum += 1;
    });

    // Riwayat voting terkini
    const recentVotes = (votingList || [])
      .sort((a, b) => new Date(b.created_at) - new Date(a.created_at))
      .slice(0, 10)
      .map((v) => {
        const m = (mhsList || []).find((mhs) => mhs.id === v.nim);
        return {
          id: v.id,
          nama_mhs: m ? m.nama_mhs : 'Mahasiswa',
          nim: m ? m.nim : '-',
          kelas: m ? m.kelas : 'Reg',
          created_at: v.created_at,
        };
      });

    return {
      success: true,
      stats: {
        totalMhs,
        sudahVoting: sudahVotingCount,
        belumVoting: belumVotingCount,
        persentase: Number(persentase),
        kelasStats,
        angkatanStats,
        prodiStats,
        recentVotes,
      },
    };
  } catch (err) {
    return { success: false, error: err.message };
  }
}

'use server';

import { supabaseAdmin } from '@/lib/supabase';
import { requirePanitiaPermission } from '@/utils/supabaseUtils';
import { sanitizeText, sanitizeUrl } from '@/scurity/sanitaze';

/**
 * Mengambil seluruh data panduan dan sub-panduan untuk panitia
 */
export async function getPanitiaPanduanList() {
  try {
    await requirePanitiaPermission('panduan');

    const { data: panduanList, error: pError } = await supabaseAdmin
      .from('panduan')
      .select('id, judul, urutan, created_at')
      .order('urutan', { ascending: true });

    if (pError) return { success: false, data: [], error: pError.message };

    const { data: isiList, error: iError } = await supabaseAdmin
      .from('isi_panduan')
      .select('id, judul_panduan_id, sub_judul, isi, link_vidio, urutan, created_at, update_at')
      .order('urutan', { ascending: true });

    if (iError) return { success: false, data: [], error: iError.message };

    const structured = (panduanList || []).map((p) => ({
      ...p,
      items: (isiList || []).filter((item) => item.judul_panduan_id === p.id),
    }));

    return { success: true, data: structured };
  } catch (error) {
    return { success: false, data: [], error: error.message };
  }
}

/**
 * Simpan / Edit Judul Utama Panduan / Bab
 */
export async function simpanJudulPanduan(idOrPayload, judulParam, urutanParam = 1) {
  try {
    await requirePanitiaPermission('panduan');

    let id = null;
    let judul = '';
    let urutan = 1;

    if (typeof idOrPayload === 'object' && idOrPayload !== null) {
      id = idOrPayload.id;
      judul = idOrPayload.judul;
      urutan = idOrPayload.urutan ?? 1;
    } else {
      id = idOrPayload;
      judul = judulParam;
      urutan = urutanParam ?? 1;
    }

    const cleanJudul = sanitizeText(judul || '');
    if (!cleanJudul) return { success: false, error: 'Judul Panduan wajib diisi.' };

    if (id) {
      const { error } = await supabaseAdmin.from('panduan').update({
        judul: cleanJudul,
        urutan: Number(urutan) || 1,
      }).eq('id', id);

      if (error) return { success: false, error: error.message };
    } else {
      const { error } = await supabaseAdmin.from('panduan').insert({
        judul: cleanJudul,
        urutan: Number(urutan) || 1,
      });

      if (error) return { success: false, error: error.message };
    }

    return { success: true, message: 'Judul Panduan berhasil disimpan.' };
  } catch (error) {
    return { success: false, error: error.message };
  }
}

export const simpanPanduanBab = simpanJudulPanduan;

/**
 * Hapus Judul Panduan (beserta isinya cascade)
 */
export async function hapusJudulPanduan(id) {
  try {
    await requirePanitiaPermission('panduan');
    const { error } = await supabaseAdmin.from('panduan').delete().eq('id', id);
    if (error) return { success: false, error: error.message };
    return { success: true, message: 'Judul Panduan berhasil dihapus.' };
  } catch (error) {
    return { success: false, error: error.message };
  }
}

export const hapusPanduanBab = hapusJudulPanduan;

/**
 * Simpan / Edit Sub-Isi Panduan
 */
export async function simpanIsiPanduan(payload) {
  try {
    await requirePanitiaPermission('panduan');

    const id = payload.id;
    const judulPanduanId = payload.judul_panduan_id;
    const subJudul = sanitizeText(payload.sub_judul || '');
    const isi = payload.isi || ''; // markdown text
    const linkVidio = sanitizeUrl(payload.link_vidio || '');
    const urutan = Number(payload.urutan) || 1;

    if (!judulPanduanId || !subJudul || !isi) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Kategori Panduan, Sub-Judul, dan Isi Panduan wajib diisi.' };
    }

    if (id) {
      const { error } = await supabaseAdmin.from('isi_panduan').update({
        judul_panduan_id: judulPanduanId,
        sub_judul: subJudul,
        isi: isi,
        link_vidio: linkVidio || null,
        urutan: urutan,
        update_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      }).eq('id', id);

      if (error) return { success: false, error: error.message };
    } else {
      const { error } = await supabaseAdmin.from('isi_panduan').insert({
        judul_panduan_id: judulPanduanId,
        sub_judul: subJudul,
        isi: isi,
        link_vidio: linkVidio || null,
        urutan: urutan,
      });

      if (error) return { success: false, error: error.message };
    }

    return { success: true, message: 'Isi materi panduan berhasil disimpan.' };
  } catch (error) {
    return { success: false, error: error.message };
  }
}

/**
 * Hapus Sub-Isi Panduan
 */

  try {
    await requirePanitiaPermission('panduan');
    const { error } = await supabaseAdmin.from('isi_panduan').delete().eq('id', id);
    if (error) return { success: false, error: error.message };
    return { success: true, message: 'Isi panduan berhasil dihapus.' };
  } catch (error) {
    return { success: false, error: error.message };
  }
}

        )

/**
 * Tambah atau Perbarui Data Panitia
 */
export async function simpanPanitia(payload) {
  try {
    await requirePanitiaPermission('panitia');

    const id = payload.id;
    const nama = sanitizeText(payload.nama_panitia || '');
    const prodi = sanitizeText(payload.prodi_panitia || '');
    const jabatan = sanitizeText(payload.jabatan_panitia || '');
    const subJabatan = sanitizeText(payload.sub_jabatan_panitia || '');
    const foto = sanitizeUrl(payload.foto_panitia || '');
    const bgImage = sanitizeUrl(payload.bg_image || '');
    const urutan = payload.urutan !== undefined && payload.urutan !== null && payload.urutan !== ''
      ? parseInt(payload.urutan, 10)
      : 1;

    // Data sosial media panitia
    const sosmed = payload.sosmed || {};
    const whatsapp = sanitizeText(sosmed.whatsapp || '');
    const instagram = sanitizeText(sosmed.instagram || '');
    const threads = sanitizeText(sosmed.threads || '');
    const tiktok = sanitizeText(sosmed.tiktok || '');

    if (!nama || !prodi || !jabatan) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Nama, Program Studi, dan Jabatan wajib diisi.' };
    }

    let panitiaId = id;

    if (id) {
      // Edit
      const { error } = await supabaseAdmin
        .from('panitia')
        .update({
          nama_panitia: nama,
          prodi_panitia: prodi,
          jabatan_panitia: jabatan,
          sub_jabatan_panitia: subJabatan || null,
          foto_panitia: foto || null,
          bg_image: bgImage || null,
          urutan: isNaN(urutan) ? 1 : urutan,
        })
        .eq('id', id);

      if (error) return { success: false, error: error.message };
    } else {
      // Tambah baru
      const { data: inserted, error } = await supabaseAdmin
        .from('panitia')
        .insert({
          nama_panitia: nama,
          prodi_panitia: prodi,
          jabatan_panitia: jabatan,
          sub_jabatan_panitia: subJabatan || null,
          foto_panitia: foto || null,
          bg_image: bgImage || null,
          urutan: isNaN(urutan) ? 1 : urutan,
        })
        .select('id')
        .single();

      if (error) return { success: false, error: error.message };
      panitiaId = inserted?.id;
    }

    // Kelola data sosmed_panitia
    if (panitiaId) {
      const { data: existingSosmed } = await supabaseAdmin
        .from('sosmed_panitia')
        .select('id')
        .eq('panitia_id', panitiaId)
        .maybeSingle();

      if (existingSosmed) {
        await supabaseAdmin
          .from('sosmed_panitia')
          .update({
            whatsapp: whatsapp || null,
            instagram: instagram || null,
            threads: threads || null,
            tiktok: tiktok || null,
          })
          .eq('panitia_id', panitiaId);
      } else if (whatsapp || instagram || threads || tiktok) {
        await supabaseAdmin
          .from('sosmed_panitia')
          .insert({
            panitia_id: panitiaId,
            whatsapp: whatsapp || null,
            instagram: instagram || null,
            threads: threads || null,
            tiktok: tiktok || null,
          });
      }
    }

    return { success: true, message: 'Data panitia berhasil disimpan.' };
  } catch (error) {
    return { success: false, error: error.message };
  }
}

/**

 */
export async function hapusPanitia(id, fotoUrl, bgUrl) {
  try {
    await requirePanitiaPermission('panitia');
