```javascript
'use server';

import sharp from 'sharp';
import { nanoid } from 'nanoid';
import { supabaseAdmin } from '@/lib/supabase';
import { requirePanitiaPermission } from '@/utils/supabaseUtils';

const BUCKET_NAME = 'kandidat';

/**
 * Server Action: Mengompres foto menggunakan Sharp dan mengunggah ke Supabase Storage
 * @param {FormData} formData
 * @returns {Promise<{success: boolean, url?: string, error?: string}>}
 */
export async function uploadFotoKandidat(formData) {
  try {
    // Pastikan hanya panitia yang memiliki izin kandidat yang bisa upload
    await requirePanitiaPermission('kandidat');

    const file = formData.get('file');
    if (!file || !(file instanceof File)) {
      return { success: false, error: 'File gambar tidak ditemukan atau tidak valid.' };
    }

    // Validasi tipe file
    const allowedTypes = ['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp', 'image/jpg'];
    if (!allowedTypes.includes(file.type)) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Format file harus berupa JPG, PNG, atau WEBP.' };
    }

    // Ambil array buffer dari file
    const bytes = await file.arrayBuffer();
    const inputBuffer = Buffer.from(bytes);

    // Kompresi gambar menggunakan Sharp (resize max 1080px, convert ke webp kualitas 80%)
    const compressedBuffer = await sharp(inputBuffer)
      .resize({
        width: 1080,
        height: 1080,
        fit: 'inside',
        withoutEnlargement: true,
      })
      .webp({ quality: 80 })
      .toBuffer();

    const fileName = `kandidat-${nanoid(10)}-${Date.now()}.webp`;
    const filePath = `foto/${fileName}`;

    // Upload buffer ke Supabase Storage
    const { error: uploadError } = await supabaseAdmin.storage
      .from(BUCKET_NAME)
      .upload(filePath, compressedBuffer, {
        contentType: 'image/webp',
        upsert: true,
      });

    if (uploadError) {
      return { success: false, error: `Gagal mengunggah foto ke storage: ${uploadError.message}` };
    }

    // Dapatkan URL publik file
    const { data: publicUrlData } = supabaseAdmin.storage
      .from(BUCKET_NAME)
      .getPublicUrl(filePath);

    return {
      success: true,
      url: publicUrlData.publicUrl,
      path: filePath,
    };
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: error.message || 'Terjadi kesalahan saat memproses dan mengompres gambar.',
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Server Action: Menghapus file foto dari Supabase Storage jika diperlukan
 * @param {string} fileUrl
 */
export async function deleteFotoKandidat(fileUrl) {
  try {
    await requirePanitiaPermission('kandidat');

    if (!fileUrl) return { success: false };

    // Ekstrak path setelah bucket name
    const marker = `${BUCKET_NAME}/`;
    const index = fileUrl.indexOf(marker);
    if (index === -1) return { success: false };

    const filePath = fileUrl.substring(index + marker.length);

    const { error } = await supabaseAdmin.storage
      .from(BUCKET_NAME)
      .remove([filePath]);

    if (error) {
      return { success: false, error: error.message };
    }

    return { success: true };
  } catch (error) {
    return { success: false, error: error.message };
  }
}

const BUCKET_PANITIA = 'panitia';

/**
 * Server Action: Mengompres foto panitia menggunakan Sharp dan mengunggah ke Supabase Storage (bucket: panitia)
 * Mendukung format PNG transparan secara utuh maupun JPG/WEBP.
 * @param {FormData} formData
 * @returns {Promise<{success: boolean, url?: string, error?: string}>}
 */
export async function uploadFotoPanitia(formData) {
  try {
    await requirePanitiaPermission('panitia');

    const file = formData.get('file');
    if (!file || !(file instanceof File)) {
      return { success: false, error: 'File gambar tidak ditemukan atau tidak valid.' };
    }

    // Validasi tipe file
    const allowedTypes = ['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp', 'image/jpg'];
    if (!allowedTypes.includes(file.type)) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Format file harus berupa JPG, PNG, atau WEBP.' };
    }

    // Ambil array buffer dari file
    const bytes = await file.arrayBuffer();
    const inputBuffer = Buffer.from(bytes);

    const isPng = file.type === 'image/png' || file.name?.toLowerCase().endsWith('.png');

    let compressedBuffer;
    let fileName;
    let contentType;

    if (isPng) {
      // Pertahankan transparansi PNG penuh
      compressedBuffer = await sharp(inputBuffer)
        .resize({
          width: 1200,
          height: 1200,
          fit: 'inside',
          withoutEnlargement: true,
        })
        .png({ quality: 90, compressionLevel: 8 })
        .toBuffer();

      fileName = `panitia-${nanoid(10)}-${Date.now()}.png`;
      contentType = 'image/png';
    } else {
      // Kompresi ke format WebP untuk format selain PNG
      compressedBuffer = await sharp(inputBuffer)
        .resize({
          width: 1200,
          height: 1200,
          fit: 'inside',
          withoutEnlargement: true,
        })
        .webp({ quality: 85 })
        .toBuffer();

      fileName = `panitia-${nanoid(10)}-${Date.now()}.webp`;
      contentType = 'image/webp';
    }

    const filePath = `foto/${fileName}`;

    // Upload buffer ke Supabase Storage bucket 'panitia'
    const { error: uploadError } = await supabaseAdmin.storage
      .from(BUCKET_PANITIA)
      .upload(filePath, compressedBuffer, {
        contentType,
        upsert: true,
      });

    if (uploadError) {
      return { success: false, error: `Gagal mengunggah foto ke storage: ${uploadError.message}` };
    }

    // Dapatkan URL publik file
    const { data: publicUrlData } = supabaseAdmin.storage
      .from(BUCKET_PANITIA)
      .getPublicUrl(filePath);

    return {
      success: true,
      url: publicUrlData.publicUrl,
      path: filePath,
    };
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: error.message || 'Terjadi kesalahan saat memproses dan mengompres gambar.',
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Server Action: Mengompres gambar background panitia dan mengunggah ke Supabase Storage (bucket: panitia)
 * @param {FormData} formData
 * @returns {Promise<{success: boolean, url?: string, error?: string}>}
 */
export async function uploadBgPanitia(formData) {
  try {
    await requirePanitiaPermission('panitia');

    const file = formData.get('file');
    if (!file || !(file instanceof File)) {
      return { success: false, error: 'File gambar background tidak ditemukan atau tidak valid.' };
    }

    const allowedTypes = ['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp', 'image/jpg'];
    if (!allowedTypes.includes(file.type)) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Format file background harus berupa JPG, PNG, atau WEBP.' };
    }

    const bytes = await file.arrayBuffer();
    const inputBuffer = Buffer.from(bytes);

    // Kompresi ke format WebP dengan lebar hingga 1600px
    const compressedBuffer = await sharp(inputBuffer)
      .resize({
        width: 1600,
        height: 1200,
        fit: 'inside',
        withoutEnlargement: true,
      })
      .webp({ quality: 80 })
      .toBuffer();

    const fileName = `bg-${nanoid(10)}-${Date.now()}.webp`;
    const filePath = `bg/${fileName}`;

    const { error: uploadError } = await supabaseAdmin.storage
      .from(BUCKET_PANITIA)
      .upload(filePath, compressedBuffer, {
        contentType: 'image/webp',
        upsert: true,
      });

    if (uploadError) {
      return { success: false, error: `Gagal mengunggah gambar background ke storage: ${uploadError.message}` };
    }

    const { data: publicUrlData } = supabaseAdmin.storage
      .from(BUCKET_PANITIA)
      .getPublicUrl(filePath);

    return {
      success: true,
      url: publicUrlData.publicUrl,
      path: filePath,
    };
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: error.message || 'Terjadi kesalahan saat memproses gambar background.',
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Server Action: Menghapus file foto atau gambar background panitia dari Supabase Storage jika diperlukan
 * @param {string} fileUrl
 */
export async function deleteFotoPanitia(fileUrl) {
  try {
    await requirePanitiaPermission('panitia');

    if (!fileUrl) return { success: false };

    // Ekstrak path setelah bucket name
    const marker = `${BUCKET_PANITIA}/`;
    const index = fileUrl.indexOf(marker);
    if (index === -1) return { success: false };

    const filePath = fileUrl.substring(index + marker.length);

    const { error } = await supabaseAdmin.storage
      .from(BUCKET_PANITIA)
      .remove([filePath]);

    if (error) {
      return { success: false, error: error.message };
    }

    return { success: true };
  } catch (error) {
    return { success: false, error: error.message };
  }
}
```

```javascript
import { getGoogleDriveEmbedUrl } from '@/utils/driveUtils';
import {
  FolderKanban,
  Calendar,
  Eye,
  ExternalLink,

  ChevronRight,

  FileText,
} from 'lucide-react';

import { useTranslatedData } from '@/hooks/useTranslatedData';
import TranslatingNotice from '@/components/public/TranslatingNotice';

export default function DokumentasiPortalPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();

  const scrollContainerRef = useRef(null);

  const scroll = (direction) => {
    if (scrollContainerRef.current) {

      scrollContainerRef.current.scrollBy({ left: scrollAmount, behavior: 'smooth' });

  };

  return (

            {/* Modal Iframe Preview */}

              {getGoogleDriveEmbedUrl(previewItem.link_drive) ? (
                <iframe
                  src={getGoogleDriveEmbedUrl(previewItem.link_drive)}
                  title={previewItem.judul_dokumentasi}
                  className="w-full h-full border-none"
                  allow="autoplay"
                />
              ) : (
                <div className="w-full h-full flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-zinc-500 space-y-2">
                  <FileText className="w-12 h-12" />
                  <p className="text-xs">{t('pg.dok_preview_fail', 'Pratinjau tidak dapat dimuat langsung.')}</p>
                  <a
                    href={previewItem.link_drive}
                    target="_blank"
                    rel="noreferrer"
                    className="text-xs text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 underline font-semibold"
                  >
                    {t('pg.dok_open_drive_direct', 'Buka langsung di Google Drive')}
                  </a>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```javascript
'use client';

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';

import { getYouTubeEmbedUrl } from '@/utils/youtubeUtils';
import { getGoogleDriveEmbedUrl } from '@/utils/driveUtils';
import { getNextMidnightWIBTimestamp } from '@/utils/dateUtils';
import BgWaveDivider from '@/components/public/bgWaveDivider';
import { useTranslation } from '@/hooks/useTranslation';
import { useTranslatedData } from '@/hooks/useTranslatedData';
import TranslatingNotice from '@/components/public/TranslatingNotice';
import {
  BookOpen,
  Menu,
  X,
  Video,
  ChevronRight,
  Hash,
  ExternalLink,
  HelpCircle,
} from 'lucide-react';

export default function PanduanPortalPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { data: panduanList, loading, translating } = useTranslatedData('panduan', getPublikPanduan);
  const [activeItemId, setActiveItemId] = useState(null);
  const [mobileMenuOpen, setMobileMenuOpen] = useState(false);

  // Set item aktif pertama saat data siap
  useEffect(() => {
    if (panduanList?.[0]?.items?.[0]) {
      setActiveItemId(`item-${panduanList[0].items[0].id}`);
    }
  }, [panduanList]);

  // Scrollspy: pantau section mana yang sedang terlihat di viewport
  useEffect(() => {
    if (loading || panduanList.length === 0) return;

    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries) => {
        entries.forEach((entry) => {
          if (entry.isIntersecting) {
            setActiveItemId(entry.target.id);
          }
        });
      },
      {
        rootMargin: '-80px 0px -60% 0px',
        threshold: 0.1,
      }
    );

    const sections = document.querySelectorAll('.panduan-content-section');
    sections.forEach((sec) => observer.observe(sec));

    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, [loading, panduanList]);

  const scrollToSection = (id) => {
    const el = document.getElementById(id);
    if (el) {
      el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
      setActiveItemId(id);
      setMobileMenuOpen(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-transparent text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 transition-colors">
      {/* Top Banner Hero Panduan */}
      <div className="relative pt-8 sm:pt-12 pb-0 bg-blue-50/60 dark:bg-[#0b0f19]">

            <BookOpen className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-400" />
            <span>{t('panduan.badge', 'Pusat Petunjuk Teknis & Regulasi')}</span>
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl sm:text-4xl font-black text-blue-950 dark:text-zinc-100 tracking-tight">
            {t('panduan.title', 'Panduan Pemilihan Umum Mahasiswa')}
          </h1>
          <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400 max-w-2xl leading-relaxed">
            {t('panduan.subtitle', 'Pelajari tata tertib pemilihan, verifikasi DPT, ketentuan pencalonan, serta video tutorial resmi pelaksanaan pemungutan suara BEM Politeknik LP3I.')}
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* BgWaveDivider Dekoratif Panduan Mulus Menuju Konten Bawah */}
        <div className="w-full -mb-px leading-none">
          <BgWaveDivider className="w-full text-white dark:text-black" />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Mobile Sub-Navbar Hamburger Bar */}
      <div className="lg:hidden sticky top-16 z-30 bg-white/95 dark:bg-zinc-950/95 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-blue-100 dark:border-zinc-800 px-4 py-2.5 flex items-center justify-between">
        <button
          onClick={() => setMobileMenuOpen(!mobileMenuOpen)}
          className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-blue-50 dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-blue-200 dark:border-zinc-800 text-xs font-semibold text-blue-950 dark:text-zinc-200 cursor-pointer"
        >
          {mobileMenuOpen ? <X className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-400" /> : <Menu className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-400" />}
          <span>{t('pg.pan_menu_list', 'Daftar Menu Panduan')}</span>

        <span className="text-[11px] text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-400 font-semibold truncate max-w-[200px]">

          <div className="space-y-6">

                {t('pg.pan_sidebar_sub', 'KPU Mahasiswa LP3I')}

            </div>

            {loading ? (
              <div className="space-y-4">
                {[1, 2, 3].map((n) => (
                  <div key={n} className="h-20 bg-blue-50/50 dark:bg-zinc-900/60 rounded-xl animate-pulse" />
                ))}
              </div>
            ) : (
              <nav className="space-y-6">
                {panduanList.map((p) => (
                  <div key={p.id} className="space-y-2">
                    <h4 className="text-xs font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wider text-blue-950 dark:text-zinc-200">
                      {p.judul}
                    </h4>
                    <ul className="space-y-1 pl-2 border-l border-blue-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
                      {(p.items || []).map((sub) => {

                        return (
```

```javascript
export default function BilikSimulasiPage() {

  const [successInfo, setSuccessInfo] = useState(null);

  // 1. Cek session simulasi (dari sessionStorage dengan flag isSimulasi)
  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      const stored = sessionStorage.getItem('kpu_simulasi_session');
      if (!stored) {
        router.replace('/simulasi/login');
        return;
      }

      const parsed = JSON.parse(stored);
      if (!parsed?.isSimulasi) {
        sessionStorage.removeItem('kpu_simulasi_session');
        router.replace('/simulasi/login');
        return;
      }

      setSimSession(parsed);
    } catch (e) {
      router.replace('/simulasi/login');
    }
  }, [router]);

    setSelectedPaslon(paslon);
    setConfirmModalOpen(true);

    if (confirm(t('sm.exit_confirm', 'Apakah Anda ingin keluar dari bilik simulasi?'))) {
      sessionStorage.removeItem('kpu_simulasi_session');
      router.push('/simulasi');
    }
  };

  const handleUlangiSimulasi = () => {
    sessionStorage.removeItem('kpu_simulasi_session');
    router.push('/simulasi/login');
  };

  // Konfirmasi pilihan simulasi — TIDAK ada submit ke database sama sekali
  const handleConfirmSimulasi = () => {
    if (!selectedPaslon || !simSession) return;

    // Hanya update UI, tidak ada API call apapun
    setSuccessInfo({
      nomorUrut: selectedPaslon.nomor_urut,
      slogan: selectedPaslon.slogan,
      capres: selectedPaslon.kandidat1?.nama_kandidat,
      cawapres: selectedPaslon.kandidat2?.nama_kandidat,
      namaMhs: simSession.nama_mhs,
      nim: simSession.nim,
    });

    // Hapus session simulasi (habis pakai, seperti aslinya)
    sessionStorage.removeItem('kpu_simulasi_session');
    setConfirmModalOpen(false);
    setVoteSuccess(true);
  };

  // Tampilan jika sudah selesai simulasi
  if (voteSuccess && successInfo) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen flex flex-col bg-transparent text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 transition-colors">
        <div className="relative pt-12 sm:pt-20 pb-0 bg-amber-50/70 dark:bg-[#120f00]">
          <div className="max-w-xl mx-auto text-center space-y-3 px-4 sm:px-6 pb-8">

              <FlaskConical className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span>{t('sm.done_badge', 'Simulasi Selesai')}</span>
            </div>

            <div className="w-16 h-16 mx-auto rounded-full bg-amber-100 dark:bg-amber-950/40 border border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-700 flex items-center justify-center text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300">
              <CheckCircle2 className="w-9 h-9" />
            </div>

            <h1 className="text-2xl sm:text-4xl font-black text-amber-950 dark:text-zinc-100 tracking-tight">
              {t('sm.done_title', 'Simulasi Berhasil!')}
            </h1>

            <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400 max-w-md mx-auto leading-relaxed">
              {t('sm.done_a', 'Ini adalah hasil simulasi. Pilihan Anda')}{' '}
              <span className="font-bold text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400">
                {t('sm.done_b', 'tidak disimpan')}
              </span>{' '}
              {t('sm.done_c', 'dan tidak memengaruhi hasil pemilihan resmi.')}
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="w-full -mb-px leading-none">
            <BgWaveDivider className="w-full text-white dark:text-black" />
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex-1 py-8 sm:py-12 px-4 max-w-md mx-auto w-full space-y-4">
          <div className="bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 rounded-3xl p-6 shadow-xs space-y-4 text-center">
            <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-amber-100 dark:bg-amber-950/40 text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-300 text-xs font-semibold">
              <FlaskConical className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>{t('sm.done_status', 'Status: Simulasi Selesai')}</span>

            <div className="py-3 border-y border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 space-y-1">
              <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{t('sm.done_chosen', 'Pilihan dalam Simulasi')}</p>
              <p className="text-lg font-black text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
                {t('ui.paslon_card_title', 'Pasangan Calon No. {n}', { n: successInfo.nomorUrut })}
              </p>
              <p className="text-xs text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400">
                {successInfo.capres} {successInfo.cawapres ? `& ${successInfo.cawapres}` : ''}
              </p>
              {successInfo.slogan && (
                <p className="text-[10px] italic text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
                  &ldquo;{successInfo.slogan}&rdquo;
                </p>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Notice: tidak tersimpan */}
            <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/30 border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-800/40 text-left flex items-start gap-2">
              <Info className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
              <p className="text-[11px] text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-300 leading-relaxed">
                {t('sm.notice_a', 'Data simulasi ini')}{' '}
                <strong>{t('sm.notice_b', 'tidak tersimpan')}</strong>{' '}
                {t('sm.notice_c', 'ke database maupun penyimpanan lokal. Untuk voting resmi, gunakan menu E-Voting.')}
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="flex flex-col gap-2.5 pt-1">
              <button
                onClick={handleUlangiSimulasi}
                className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 w-full py-3 px-4 rounded-xl bg-amber-700 hover:bg-amber-800 text-white dark:bg-amber-600 dark:hover:bg-amber-500 text-xs font-bold transition active:scale-95 cursor-pointer"
              >
                <RotateCcw className="w-4 h-4" />
                <span>{t('sm.redo', 'Ulangi Simulasi')}</span>
              </button>
              <Link
                href="/voting"
                className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 w-full py-3 px-4 rounded-xl bg-zinc-900 hover:bg-zinc-800 text-white dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-white dark:text-zinc-950 text-xs font-bold transition active:scale-95"
              >
                <Vote className="w-4 h-4" />
                <span>{t('pg.sim_to_official', 'Ke E-Voting Resmi')}</span>
              </Link>
              <Link
                href="/"
                className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 w-full py-2.5 px-4 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-900 transition"
              >
                <span>{t('sm.to_home', 'Kembali ke Beranda')}</span>
                <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4" />
              </Link>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen flex flex-col bg-transparent text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 transition-colors">
      {/* Hero Header Bilik Simulasi */}

          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 p-3.5 sm:p-4 rounded-2xl bg-white/90 dark:bg-zinc-900/90 border border-zinc-200/90 dark:border-zinc-800 backdrop-blur-md shadow-xs">

                </p>

            <button

            >
              <LogOut className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>{t('sm.exit', 'Keluar Simulasi')}</span>
            </button>
          </div>

          <div className="text-center space-y-2 pt-2">
            <h1 className="text-2xl sm:text-4xl font-black text-amber-950 dark:text-zinc-100 tracking-tight">
              {t('sm.booth_title', 'Bilik Simulasi Pemilihan')}
            </h1>
            <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400 max-w-xl mx-auto">
              {t('sm.booth_desc', 'Geser kartu paslon untuk membandingkan calon, perbesar untuk meninjau visi-misi, lalu coba pilih salah satu.')}

        {/* BgWaveDivider */}

      {/* Konten Utama Slider */}
      <div className="flex-1 py-8 sm:py-12 px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 max-w-5xl mx-auto w-full space-y-6">
        {loading ? (

        ) : (
          <PaslonSlider
            paslonList={paslonList}
            renderAction={(paslon) => (
              <button

              >
                <FlaskConical className="w-4 h-4" />

              </button>
            )}
            emptyTitle={t('vt.booth_empty_title', 'Belum Ada Pasangan Calon Resmi')}
            emptyDesc={t('vt.booth_empty_desc', 'Panitia KPU belum menetapkan daftar pasangan calon untuk pemilu saat ini.')}
          />
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Modal Konfirmasi Simulasi */}
      {confirmModalOpen && selectedPaslon && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xs animate-in fade-in duration-200">

                  {t('sm.confirm_title', 'Konfirmasi Pilihan Simulasi')}

              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setConfirmModalOpen(false)}
                className="p-1 rounded-lg text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 cursor-pointer"
              >
                <X className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900/40 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 text-center space-y-2">
              <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl bg-amber-700 text-white dark:bg-amber-600 font-black text-xl mx-auto flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs">
                {selectedPaslon.nomor_urut}
              </div>
              <div>
                <p className="text-xs font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
                  {t('ui.paslon_card_title', 'Pasangan Calon No. {n}', { n: selectedPaslon.nomor_urut })}
                </p>
                <p className="text-xs text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400 font-medium">
                  {selectedPaslon.kandidat1?.nama_kandidat}{' '}
                  {selectedPaslon.kandidat2 ? `& ${selectedPaslon.kandidat2?.nama_kandidat}` : ''}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Disclaimer simulasi */}
            <div className="space-y-2 text-xs text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400 leading-relaxed bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/20 p-3.5 rounded-2xl border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-800/40">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-bold text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-300">
                <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
                <span>{t('sm.remember', 'Ingat — Ini Mode Simulasi:')}</span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400">
                {t('sm.remember_a', 'Pilihan ini')}{' '}
                <strong>{t('sm.remember_b', 'tidak disimpan')}</strong>{' '}
                {t('sm.remember_c', 'ke database maupun penyimpanan lokal. Tidak ada efek pada hasil pemilihan resmi.')}
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-3 pt-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setConfirmModalOpen(false)}
                className="flex-1 py-2.5 px-4 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 text-xs font-bold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-900 transition cursor-pointer"
              >
                {t('vt.cancel', 'Batal')}
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleConfirmSimulasi}
                className="flex-1 inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 py-2.5 px-4 rounded-xl bg-amber-700 hover:bg-amber-800 text-white dark:bg-amber-600 dark:hover:bg-amber-500 text-xs font-bold shadow-xs transition active:scale-95 cursor-pointer"
              >
                <FlaskConical className="w-4 h-4" />
                <span>{t('sm.yes_continue', 'Ya, Lanjutkan Simulasi')}</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```javascript
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import BgWaveDivider from '@/components/public/bgWaveDivider';
import { useTranslation } from '@/hooks/useTranslation';
import {
  FlaskConical,
  CreditCard,
  KeyRound,
  ShieldAlert,
  ArrowRight,
  CheckCircle2,
  Info,
} from 'lucide-react';

// Akun demo yang sudah disiapkan untuk simulasi
const DEMO_ACCOUNT = {
  nim: 'DEMO-001',
  kode_voting: 'SIMULASI',
  id: 'simulasi-demo-id-001',
  nama_mhs: 'Peserta Simulasi',
};

export default function SimulasiLoginPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const router = useRouter();

  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    nim: DEMO_ACCOUNT.nim,
    kode_voting: DEMO_ACCOUNT.kode_voting,
  });

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [errorText, setErrorText] = useState('');

  const handleChange = (e) => {
    const { name, value } = e.target;
    setFormData((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [name]: value,
    }));
    setErrorText('');
  };

  const handleSubmit = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setErrorText('');

    if (!formData.nim.trim() || !formData.kode_voting.trim()) {
      setErrorText(t('sm.err_fill', 'Harap isi NIM dan Kode Voting simulasi secara lengkap.'));
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);

    // Simulasi: tidak perlu validasi ke server
    // Langsung set session simulasi di memory (tidak ke localStorage/sessionStorage)
    // Kita encode info ke URL params agar bisa dibaca bilik simulasi
    setTimeout(() => {
      // Simpan sesi simulasi hanya di sessionStorage dengan flag simulasi
      const simSession = {
        id: DEMO_ACCOUNT.id,
        nim: formData.nim || DEMO_ACCOUNT.nim,
        nama_mhs: 'Peserta Simulasi',
        isSimulasi: true,
      };
      sessionStorage.setItem('kpu_simulasi_session', JSON.stringify(simSession));
      router.push('/simulasi/bilik');
    }, 800);
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen flex flex-col bg-transparent text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 transition-colors">
      {/* Hero Header Section */}
      <div className="relative pt-10 sm:pt-16 pb-0 bg-amber-50/60 dark:bg-[#120f00]">
        <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto text-center space-y-3 px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 pb-8">
          <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-amber-100/70 dark:bg-amber-950/60 border border-amber-200/80 dark:border-amber-900/60 text-amber-900 dark:text-amber-300 text-xs font-semibold">
            <FlaskConical className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400" />
            <span>{t('sm.login_badge', 'Mode Simulasi — Masuk Demo')}</span>
          </div>

          <h1 className="text-2xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-black text-amber-950 dark:text-zinc-100 tracking-tight">
            {t('sm.login_title', 'Login Simulasi Bilik Suara')}
          </h1>

          <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400 max-w-xl mx-auto leading-relaxed">
            {t('sm.login_desc', 'Akun demo sudah terisi otomatis di bawah. Klik tombol masuk untuk langsung mencoba pengalaman voting.')}
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* BgWaveDivider Sambungan Mulus */}
        <div className="w-full -mb-px leading-none">
          <BgWaveDivider className="w-full text-white dark:text-black" />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Konten Form Login */}
      <div className="flex-1 py-8 sm:py-12 px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 max-w-md mx-auto w-full">
        {/* Disclaimer Banner */}
        <div className="mb-4 p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/30 border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-800/50 flex items-start gap-2.5">
          <Info className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
          <p className="text-[11px] text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-300 leading-relaxed">
            <span className="font-bold">{t('sm.banner_a', 'Mode Simulasi Aktif.')}</span>{' '}
            {t('sm.banner_b', 'Anda dapat mengubah isian di bawah, namun akun ini tidak divalidasi ke database. Tidak ada data yang tersimpan.')}
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 border border-amber-100 dark:border-zinc-800 rounded-3xl p-6 sm:p-8 shadow-xs hover:shadow-md transition space-y-6">
          <div className="border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800/80 pb-4 text-center">
            <h2 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-black text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
              {t('sm.form_title', 'Formulir Login Simulasi')}
            </h2>
            <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 mt-1">
              {t('sm.form_desc', 'Akun demo sudah disiapkan — tidak diperlukan data asli.')}
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* Pesan Error */}
          {errorText && (
            <div className="p-3.5 rounded-2xl text-xs flex items-start gap-2.5 bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-950/40 border border-red-200 dark:border-red-800 text-red-700 dark:text-red-300">
              <ShieldAlert className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
              <span className="font-semibold">{errorText}</span>
            </div>
          )}

          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
            {/* Input NIM */}
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">
                {t('sm.nim_label', 'Nomor Induk Mahasiswa (NIM)')}
              </label>
              <div className="relative">
                <div className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 pl-3.5 flex items-center pointer-events-none text-zinc-400">
                  <CreditCard className="w-4 h-4" />
                </div>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  name="nim"
                  value={formData.nim}
                  onChange={handleChange}
                  placeholder={t('sm.nim_ph', 'Contoh: DEMO-001')}
                  disabled={loading}
                  className="w-full pl-10 pr-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-amber-50/50 dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-amber-200 dark:border-zinc-800 text-xs text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 focus:outline-hidden focus:ring-2 focus:ring-amber-400 dark:focus:ring-amber-700 transition"
                />
              </div>
              <p className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
                {t('sm.nim_hint', 'Untuk simulasi, gunakan NIM demo yang sudah terisi atau isi bebas.')}
              </p>
            </div>

            {/* Input Kode Voting */}
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">
                {t('sm.code_label', 'Kode Token Voting (Simulasi)')}
              </label>
              <div className="relative">
                <div className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 pl-3.5 flex items-center pointer-events-none text-zinc-400">
                  <KeyRound className="w-4 h-4" />
                </div>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  name="kode_voting"
                  value={formData.kode_voting}
                  onChange={handleChange}
                  placeholder="SIMULASI"
                  disabled={loading}
                  className="w-full pl-10 pr-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-amber-50/50 dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-amber-200 dark:border-zinc-800 text-xs text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 focus:outline-hidden focus:ring-2 focus:ring-amber-400 dark:focus:ring-amber-700 font-mono tracking-wider transition uppercase"
                />
              </div>
              <p className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500">
                {t('sm.code_hint', 'Kode ini hanya untuk simulasi dan tidak divalidasi ke server.')}
              </p>
            </div>

            {/* Tombol Submit */}
            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={loading}
              className="w-full mt-2 inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 py-3 px-4 rounded-xl bg-amber-700 hover:bg-amber-800 text-white dark:bg-amber-600 dark:hover:bg-amber-500 text-xs font-bold shadow-xs hover:shadow-md transition active:scale-95 disabled:opacity-50 cursor-pointer"
            >
              {loading ? (
                <>
                  <span className="w-4 h-4 border-2 border-white/40 border-t-white rounded-full animate-spin" />
                  <span>{t('sm.loading', 'Memuat Bilik Simulasi...')}</span>
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <span>{t('sm.enter', 'Masuk ke Bilik Simulasi')}</span>
                  <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4" />
                </>
              )}
            </button>
          </form>

          {/* Info footer */}
          <div className="pt-2 text-center border-t border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800/80">
            <span className="text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5">
              <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400" />
              {t('sm.footer', 'Simulasi E-Voting KPU Mahasiswa Politeknik LP3I')}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```javascript
'use client';

import { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import BgWaveDivider from '@/components/public/bgWaveDivider';
import { loginVotingMhs } from '@/api/publlic/voting';
import { getStatusJadwalVoting } from '@/api/publlic/jadwalVoting';
import { useTranslation } from '@/hooks/useTranslation';
import {
  Vote,
  CreditCard,
  KeyRound,
  ShieldAlert,
  ArrowRight,
  Loader2,
  CheckCircle2,
  Clock,
  Lock,
  Timer,
  AlertCircle,
} from 'lucide-react';

export default function VotingLoginPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const router = useRouter();

  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    nim: '',
    kode_voting: '',
  });

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [errorText, setErrorText] = useState('');
  const [alreadyVotedWarning, setAlreadyVotedWarning] = useState(false);

  // State Jadwal & Waktu Server
  const [jadwalStatus, setJadwalStatus] = useState(null); // 'belum_dimulai' | 'berlangsung' | 'selesai' | 'tidak_ada_jadwal'
  const [jadwalLoading, setJadwalLoading] = useState(true);
  const [countdownSeconds, setCountdownSeconds] = useState(0);
  const [jadwalMessage, setJadwalMessage] = useState('');

  // State Contextual Pop-up Notifikasi (Tepat di atas elemen yang diklik)
  const [activePopup, setActivePopup] = useState({
    target: null, // 'nim' | 'kode_voting' | 'submit'
    message: '',
  });
  const popupTimeoutRef = useRef(null);

  // Jika sudah ada session voting tersimpan, langsung redirect ke bilik suara
  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      const stored = sessionStorage.getItem('kpu_mhs_session');
      if (stored) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(stored);
        if (parsed?.id && parsed?.nim) {
          router.replace('/voting/voting');
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      // ignore
    }
  }, [router]);

  // Fungsi Fetch Status Jadwal dari Server (WIB)
  const syncJadwal = async () => {
    try {
      const res = await getStatusJadwalVoting();
      if (res.success) {
        setJadwalStatus(res.status);
        setCountdownSeconds(res.sisaWaktuDetik || 0);
        setJadwalMessage(res.message || '');
      } else {
        setJadwalStatus('error');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setJadwalStatus('error');
    } finally {
      setJadwalLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // Lifecycle Sync Jadwal & Countdown
  // Hanya berjalan saat halaman dibuka, dan di-reset saat keluar halaman
  useEffect(() => {
    syncJadwal();

    // Polling sync server time setiap 30 detik (hanya saat halaman aktif)
    // JANGAN panggil syncJadwal() di dalam setState updater — itu side effect saat render!
    const syncInterval = setInterval(() => {
      syncJadwal();
    }, 30000);

    // Countdown lokal per 1 detik — hanya mendekremen, TIDAK memanggil fungsi async
    const tickInterval = setInterval(() => {
      setCountdownSeconds((prev) => (prev <= 0 ? 0 : prev - 1));
    }, 1000);

    return () => {
      clearInterval(syncInterval);
      clearInterval(tickInterval);
      if (popupTimeoutRef.current) clearTimeout(popupTimeoutRef.current);
    };
  }, []);

  const isVotingOpen = jadwalStatus === 'berlangsung';
  const isInputsDisabled = !jadwalLoading && !isVotingOpen;

  // Format detik menjadi format waktu HH:MM:SS atau D hari HH:MM:SS
  const formatCountdown = (totalSeconds) => {
    if (totalSeconds <= 0) return '00:00:00';
    const days = Math.floor(totalSeconds / 86400);
    const hours = Math.floor((totalSeconds % 86400) / 3600);
    const minutes = Math.floor((totalSeconds % 3600) / 60);
    const seconds = totalSeconds % 60;

    const pad = (n) => String(n).padStart(2, '0');

    if (days > 0) {
      return `${days} ${t('vt.days', 'hari')} ${pad(hours)}:${pad(minutes)}:${pad(seconds)}`;
    }
    return `${pad(hours)}:${pad(minutes)}:${pad(seconds)}`;
  };

  // Memicu notifikasi pop-up tepat di atas elemen yang diklik (Warna Netral)
  const triggerPopup = (target) => {
    if (!isInputsDisabled) return;

    let msg = t('vt.popup_default', 'Bilik suara belum dibuka oleh panitia.');
    if (jadwalStatus === 'belum_dimulai') {
      msg = t('vt.popup_not_started', 'Pemungutan suara belum dimulai. Silakan tunggu hitung mundur jadwal resmi.');
    } else if (jadwalStatus === 'selesai') {
      msg = t('vt.popup_ended', 'Waktu pemungutan suara telah selesai. Bilik suara sudah ditutup.');
    } else if (jadwalStatus === 'tidak_ada_jadwal') {
      msg = t('vt.popup_no_schedule', 'Jadwal voting belum diatur oleh Panitia KPU.');
    }

    if (popupTimeoutRef.current) clearTimeout(popupTimeoutRef.current);

    setActivePopup({
      target,
      message: msg,
    });

    // Otomatis hilang dalam 3.5 detik
    popupTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
      setActivePopup({ target: null, message: '' });
    }, 3500);
  };

  const handleChange = (e) => {
    const { name, value } = e.target;
    setFormData((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [name]: value,
    }));
    setErrorText('');
    setAlreadyVotedWarning(false);
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setErrorText('');
    setAlreadyVotedWarning(false);

    if (!isVotingOpen) {
      triggerPopup('submit');
      return;
    }

    if (!formData.nim.trim() || !formData.kode_voting.trim()) {
      setErrorText(t('vt.err_fill', 'Harap isi NIM dan Kode Voting secara lengkap.'));
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);

    try {
      const res = await loginVotingMhs({
        nim: formData.nim,
        kode_voting: formData.kode_voting,
      });

      if (!res.success) {
        setErrorText(res.error || t('vt.err_auth', 'Autentikasi gagal. Periksa kembali data Anda.'));
        if (res.alreadyVoted) {
          setAlreadyVotedWarning(true);
        }
        if (res.votingNotActive) {
          // Re-sync jika status di server sudah berubah
          syncJadwal();
        }
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }

      // Simpan session mahasiswa di sessionStorage client-side
      sessionStorage.setItem('kpu_mhs_session', JSON.stringify(res.mhs));

      // Berpindah ke bilik suara
      router.push('/voting/voting');
    } catch (err) {
      setErrorText(t('vt.err_server', 'Terjadi kendala saat menghubungi server. Silakan coba kembali.'));
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen flex flex-col bg-transparent text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 transition-colors">
      {/* Hero Header Section */}
      <div className="relative pt-10 sm:pt-16 pb-0 bg-blue-50/60 dark:bg-[#0b0f19]">
        <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto text-center space-y-3 px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 pb-8">
          <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-zinc-100/60 dark:bg-zinc-800/60 border border-blue-200/80 dark:border-blue-900/60 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400 text-xs font-semibold">
            <Vote className="w-4 h-4 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400" />
            <span>{t('vt.login_badge', 'Autentikasi Hak Suara DPT')}</span>
          </div>

          <h1 className="text-2xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-black text-blue-950 dark:text-zinc-100 tracking-tight">
            {t('vt.login_title', 'Masuk Bilik Suara Elektronik')}
          </h1>

          <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400 max-w-xl mx-auto leading-relaxed">
            {t('vt.login_desc', 'Verifikasi identitas Anda dengan memasukkan NIM dan Kode Voting resmi yang Anda peroleh dari Panitia KPU Mahasiswa.')}
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* BgWaveDivider Sambungan Mulus */}
        <div className="w-full -mb-px leading-none">
          <BgWaveDivider className="w-full text-white dark:text-black" />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Konten Form Login */}
      <div className="flex-1 py-8 sm:py-12 px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 max-w-md mx-auto w-full">
        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 rounded-3xl p-6 sm:p-8 shadow-xs hover:shadow-md transition space-y-6">
          <div className="border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800/80 pb-4 text-center">
            <h2 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-black text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
              {t('vt.login_form_title', 'Formulir Verifikasi Pemilih')}
            </h2>
            <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 mt-1">
              {t('vt.login_form_desc', 'Setiap User/Akun hanya dapat melakukan voting sebanyak 1 kali.')}
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* Pesan Error */}
          {errorText && (
            <div
              className={`p-3.5 rounded-2xl text-xs flex items-start gap-2.5 ${
                alreadyVotedWarning
                  ? 'bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/40 border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-800 text-amber-900 dark:text-amber-200'
                  : 'bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-950/40 border border-red-200 dark:border-red-800 text-red-700 dark:text-red-300'
              }`}
            >
              <ShieldAlert className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
              <div className="space-y-1">
                <span className="font-semibold block">{errorText}</span>
                {alreadyVotedWarning && (
                  <span className="text-[11px] opacity-90 block">
                    {t('vt.already_voted_help', 'Jika Anda merasa belum pernah memilih namun status ini muncul, silakan hubungi Panitia KPU melalui menu Kontak.')}
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
            {/* Input NIM dengan Pop-up Notifikasi Tepat di Atas Inputan */}
            <div className="relative space-y-1.5">
              {/* Notifikasi Pop-up Di Atas Input NIM */}
              {activePopup.target === 'nim' && (
                <div className="absolute bottom-full left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 mb-2.5 z-40 w-max max-w-[280px] sm:max-w-xs animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 pointer-events-none">
                  <div className="bg-zinc-900 text-white dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-950 px-3.5 py-2 rounded-2xl shadow-xl border border-zinc-800 dark:border-zinc-200 text-center text-xs font-semibold leading-snug">
                    <span>{activePopup.message}</span>
                  </div>
                  {/* Caret segitiga panah ke bawah */}
                  <div className="w-0 h-0 border-x-6 border-x-transparent border-t-6 border-t-zinc-900 dark:border-t-zinc-100 mx-auto" />
                </div>
              )}

              <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">
                {t('vt.nim_label', 'Nomor Induk Mahasiswa (NIM) / ID UNIK')}
              </label>

              <div className="relative">
                {/* Overlay Penangkap Klik Saat Input Disabled (Mengatasi browser memblokir klik pada disabled input) */}
                {isInputsDisabled && (
                  <div
                    onClick={(e) => {
                      e.preventDefault();
                      e.stopPropagation();
                      triggerPopup('nim');
                    }}
                    className="absolute inset-0 z-20 cursor-not-allowed bg-transparent"
                    title={t('vt.booth_closed_tip', 'Bilik suara ditutup')}
                  />
                )}
                <div className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 pl-3.5 flex items-center pointer-events-none text-zinc-400">
                  <CreditCard className="w-4 h-4" />
                </div>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  name="nim"
                  value={formData.nim}
                  onChange={handleChange}
                  placeholder={t('vt.nim_ph', 'Contoh: 200101001 / XXXXXXX')}

                    <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400" />
                    <span>{formatCountdown(countdownSeconds)}</span>

              ) : jadwalStatus === 'berlangsung' ? (

                    <Timer className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400" />
                    <span>{t('vt.time_left_label', 'Sisa Waktu: {time}', { time: formatCountdown(countdownSeconds) })}</span>

              ) : (

                  <AlertCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>{t('vt.no_schedule', 'Jadwal pemungutan suara belum ditentukan.')}</span>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </form>

          {/* Info footer */}
          <div className="pt-2 text-center border-t border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800/80">
            <span className="text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5">
              <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" />
              {t('vt.footer_system', 'Sistem E-Voting KPUM Politeknik LP3I Bandung')}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```javascript
'use client';

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import Image from 'next/image';
import Link from 'next/link';
import BgWaveDivider from '@/components/public/bgWaveDivider';
import PaslonSlider from '@/components/public/PaslonSlider';
import { getPublikPaslonList } from '@/api/publlic/paslon';
import { submitSuaraVoting, checkMhsVoted } from '@/api/publlic/voting';
import { getStatusJadwalVoting } from '@/api/publlic/jadwalVoting';
import { useTranslation } from '@/hooks/useTranslation';
import { useTranslatedData } from '@/hooks/useTranslatedData';
import TranslatingNotice from '@/components/public/TranslatingNotice';
import {
  Vote,
  User,
  CheckCircle2,
  AlertTriangle,
  Loader2,
  X,
  LogOut,
  ShieldCheck,
  ChevronRight,
  Info,
  Timer,
  Clock,
  Lock,
} from 'lucide-react';

export default function BilikVotingPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const router = useRouter();

  const [mhsSession, setMhsSession] = useState(null);
  const { data: paslonList, loading, translating } = useTranslatedData('paslon', getPublikPaslonList);
  const [selectedPaslon, setSelectedPaslon] = useState(null);
  const [confirmModalOpen, setConfirmModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [votingInProgress, setVotingInProgress] = useState(false);
  const [voteSuccess, setVoteSuccess] = useState(false);
  const [successInfo, setSuccessInfo] = useState(null);
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = useState('');

  // State Validasi Jadwal Voting
  const [jadwalStatus, setJadwalStatus] = useState('berlangsung');
  const [countdownSeconds, setCountdownSeconds] = useState(0);
  const [scheduleExpiredWarning, setScheduleExpiredWarning] = useState(false);

  // Format detik countdown
  const formatCountdown = (totalSeconds) => {
    if (totalSeconds <= 0) return '00:00:00';
    const hours = Math.floor(totalSeconds / 3600);
    const minutes = Math.floor((totalSeconds % 3600) / 60);
    const seconds = totalSeconds % 60;
    const pad = (n) => String(n).padStart(2, '0');
    return `${pad(hours)}:${pad(minutes)}:${pad(seconds)}`;
  };

  // 1. Cek session login pemilih & validasi jadwal voting aktif
  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      const stored = sessionStorage.getItem('kpu_mhs_session');
      if (!stored) {
        router.replace('/voting/login');
        return;
      }

      const parsed = JSON.parse(stored);
      if (!parsed?.id || !parsed?.nim) {
        sessionStorage.removeItem('kpu_mhs_session');
        router.replace('/voting/login');
        return;
      }

      setMhsSession(parsed);

      // A. Cek ke server apakah pemilih ini sebenarnya sudah pernah vote
      checkMhsVoted(parsed.id).then((res) => {
        if (res.voted) {
          sessionStorage.removeItem('kpu_mhs_session');
          alert(t('vt.voted_alert', 'Anda sudah pernah menggunakan hak suara. Anda akan dialihkan.'));
          router.replace('/voting/login');
        }
      });

      // B. Cek ke server apakah jadwal voting masih aktif / berlangsung
      const verifySchedule = async () => {
        try {
          const res = await getStatusJadwalVoting();
          if (!res.success || res.status !== 'berlangsung') {
            sessionStorage.removeItem('kpu_mhs_session');
            setScheduleExpiredWarning(true);
            setTimeout(() => {
              router.replace('/voting/login');
            }, 3000);
            return;
          }
          setJadwalStatus(res.status);
          setCountdownSeconds(res.sisaWaktuDetik || 0);
        } catch (e) {
          // Abaikan error jaringan sementara
        }
      };

      verifySchedule();

      // Polling sinkronisasi jadwal setiap 30 detik
      const scheduleInterval = setInterval(verifySchedule, 30000);

      // Ticker countdown 1 detik — hanya mendekremen, TIDAK memanggil async di dalam updater
      const tickInterval = setInterval(() => {
        setCountdownSeconds((prev) => (prev <= 0 ? 0 : prev - 1));
      }, 1000);

      return () => {
        clearInterval(scheduleInterval);
        clearInterval(tickInterval);
      };
    } catch (e) {
      router.replace('/voting/login');
    }
  }, [router]);


  const handleOpenConfirm = (paslon) => {
    setSelectedPaslon(paslon);
    setErrorMsg('');
    setConfirmModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleKeluarBilik = () => {
    if (confirm(t('vt.exit_confirm', 'Apakah Anda ingin membatalkan dan keluar dari bilik suara?'))) {
      sessionStorage.removeItem('kpu_mhs_session');
      router.push('/voting/login');
    }
  };

  const handleConfirmVote = async () => {
    if (!selectedPaslon || !mhsSession) return;

    setVotingInProgress(true);
    setErrorMsg('');

    try {
      const res = await submitSuaraVoting({
        mhsId: mhsSession.id,
        paslonId: selectedPaslon.id,
      });

      if (!res.success) {
        if (res.votingNotActive) {
          sessionStorage.removeItem('kpu_mhs_session');
          setConfirmModalOpen(false);
          setScheduleExpiredWarning(true);
          setVotingInProgress(false);
          return;
        }
        setErrorMsg(res.error || t('vt.err_save', 'Gagal menyimpan suara.'));
        setVotingInProgress(false);
        return;
      }

      // Berhasil vote! Hapus session agar tidak bisa vote lagi
      sessionStorage.removeItem('kpu_mhs_session');
      setVoteSuccess(true);
      setSuccessInfo({
        nomorUrut: selectedPaslon.nomor_urut,
        slogan: selectedPaslon.slogan,
        capres: selectedPaslon.kandidat1?.nama_kandidat,
        cawapres: selectedPaslon.kandidat2?.nama_kandidat,
        namaMhs: mhsSession.nama_mhs,
        nim: mhsSession.nim,
      });
      setConfirmModalOpen(false);
    } catch (err) {
      setErrorMsg(t('vt.err_record', 'Terjadi kendala saat merekam suara ke server.'));
    } finally {
      setVotingInProgress(false);
    }
  };

  // Tampilan jika sudah sukses memberikan suara
  if (voteSuccess && successInfo) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen flex flex-col bg-transparent text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 transition-colors">
        <div className="relative pt-12 sm:pt-20 pb-0 bg-zinc-100/70 dark:bg-[#071710]">
          <div className="max-w-xl mx-auto text-center space-y-3 px-4 sm:px-6 pb-8">
            <div className="w-16 h-16 mx-auto rounded-full bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-800 border border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-700 flex items-center justify-center text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
              <CheckCircle2 className="w-9 h-9" />
            </div>

            <h1 className="text-2xl sm:text-4xl font-black text-zinc-950 dark:text-zinc-100 tracking-tight">
              {t('vt.done_title', 'Hak Suara Berhasil Digunakan!')}
            </h1>

            <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400 max-w-md mx-auto leading-relaxed">
              {t('vt.done_thanks', 'Terima kasih')} <span className="font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">{successInfo.namaMhs}</span> ({t('ui.nim', 'NIM')}: {successInfo.nim}). {t('vt.done_thanks_post', 'Pilihan suara Anda telah dicatat secara sah dan rahasia oleh sistem KPU Mahasiswa.')}
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="w-full -mb-px leading-none">
            <BgWaveDivider className="w-full text-white dark:text-black" />
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex-1 py-8 sm:py-12 px-4 max-w-md mx-auto w-full space-y-6">
          <div className="bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 rounded-3xl p-6 shadow-xs space-y-4 text-center">
            <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 text-xs font-semibold">
              <ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span>{t('vt.done_status', 'Status: Selesai Memilih')}</span>
            </div>

            <div className="py-3 border-y border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 space-y-1">
              <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{t('vt.done_chosen', 'Pilihan Terpilih')}</p>
              <p className="text-lg font-black text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
                {t('ui.paslon_card_title', 'Pasangan Calon No. {n}', { n: successInfo.nomorUrut })}
              </p>
              <p className="text-xs text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400">
                {successInfo.capres} {successInfo.cawapres ? `& ${successInfo.cawapres}` : ''}
              </p>
            </div>

            <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 leading-relaxed">
              {t('vt.done_rule', 'Sesuai ketentuan KPU Mahasiswa, setiap mahasiswa hanya dapat memilih 1 kali dan akun Anda telah keluar secara otomatis dari bilik suara.')}
            </p>

            <Link
              href="/"
              className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 w-full py-3 px-4 rounded-xl bg-zinc-900 hover:bg-zinc-800 text-white dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-white dark:text-zinc-950 text-xs font-bold transition active:scale-95"
            >
              <span>{t('vt.back_home', 'Kembali ke Halaman Utama')}</span>
              <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4" />
            </Link>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen flex flex-col bg-transparent text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 transition-colors">
      {/* Hero Header Bilik Suara */}
      <div className="relative pt-8 sm:pt-14 pb-0 bg-blue-50/60 dark:bg-[#0b0f19]">
        <div className="max-w-5xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 pb-8 space-y-4">
          {/* Bar Info Pemilih & Timer Jadwal */}
          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 p-3.5 sm:p-4 rounded-2xl bg-white/90 dark:bg-zinc-900/90 border border-zinc-200/90 dark:border-zinc-800 backdrop-blur-md shadow-xs">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                <User className="w-4 h-4" />
              </div>
              <div>
                <p className="text-xs font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
                  {mhsSession?.nama_mhs || t('vt.student_default', 'Mahasiswa')}
                </p>
                <p className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500 font-mono">
                  {t('ui.nim', 'NIM')}: {mhsSession?.nim || '-'} • <span className="text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 font-semibold">{t('vt.vote_active', 'Hak Suara Aktif')}</span>
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 self-end sm:self-auto">
              {/* Badge Hitung Mundur Sisa Waktu Bilik Suara */}
              <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800/80 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 text-xs font-mono font-bold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">
                <Timer className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400" />
                <span>{t('vt.time_left_short', 'Sisa: {time}', { time: formatCountdown(countdownSeconds) })}</span>
              </div>

              <button
                onClick={handleKeluarBilik}
                className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400 hover:text-red-600 dark:hover:text-red-400 hover:bg-red-50 dark:hover:bg-red-950/40 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 transition cursor-pointer"
              >
                <LogOut className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>{t('vt.exit_booth', 'Keluar Bilik')}</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="text-center space-y-2 pt-2">
            <h1 className="text-2xl sm:text-4xl font-black text-blue-950 dark:text-zinc-100 tracking-tight">
              {t('vt.booth_title', 'Bilik Suara Pemilihan Mahasiswa')}
            </h1>
            <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400 max-w-xl mx-auto">
              {t('vt.booth_desc', 'Geser kartu paslon untuk membandingkan calon, perbesar untuk meninjau visi-misi lengkap, lalu tentukan pilihan Anda.')}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* BgWaveDivider Sambungan Mulus */}
        <div className="w-full -mb-px leading-none">
          <BgWaveDivider className="w-full text-white dark:text-black" />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Konten Utama Slider Bilik Suara */}
      <div className="flex-1 py-8 sm:py-12 px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 max-w-5xl mx-auto w-full space-y-6">
        {loading && translating ? (
          <TranslatingNotice show fullHeight />
        ) : loading ? (
          <div className="h-64 sm:h-72 rounded-3xl bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-900/50 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 animate-pulse" />
        ) : (
          <PaslonSlider
            paslonList={paslonList}
            renderAction={(paslon) => (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleOpenConfirm(paslon)}
                className="w-full sm:w-auto inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 py-2 px-4 rounded-xl bg-zinc-900 hover:bg-zinc-800 text-white dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-white dark:text-zinc-950 text-xs font-bold shadow-xs transition active:scale-95 cursor-pointer"
              >
                <Vote className="w-4 h-4" />
                <span>{t('vt.pick_paslon', 'Pilih Paslon No. {n}', { n: paslon.nomor_urut })}</span>
              </button>
            )}
            emptyTitle={t('vt.booth_empty_title', 'Belum Ada Pasangan Calon Resmi')}
            emptyDesc={t('vt.booth_empty_desc', 'Panitia KPU belum menetapkan daftar pasangan calon untuk pemilu saat ini.')}
          />
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Modal Konfirmasi Pemilihan Paslon */}
      {confirmModalOpen && selectedPaslon && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xs animate-in fade-in duration-200">
          <div className="bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 rounded-3xl max-w-md w-full p-6 space-y-5 shadow-2xl relative">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <div className="w-7 h-7 rounded-xl bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 flex items-center justify-center">
                  <Vote className="w-4 h-4" />
                </div>
                <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
                  {t('vt.confirm_title', 'Konfirmasi Pilihan Suara')}
                </h3>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setConfirmModalOpen(false)}
                disabled={votingInProgress}
                className="p-1 rounded-lg text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 cursor-pointer"
              >
                <X className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>
            </div>

            {errorMsg && (
              <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-950/40 border border-red-200 dark:border-red-800 text-red-700 dark:text-red-300 text-xs">
                {errorMsg}
              </div>
            )}

            <div className="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900/40 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 text-center space-y-2">
              <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl bg-zinc-900 text-white dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-950 font-black text-xl mx-auto flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs">
                {selectedPaslon.nomor_urut}
              </div>
              <div>
                <p className="text-xs font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
                  {t('ui.paslon_card_title', 'Pasangan Calon No. {n}', { n: selectedPaslon.nomor_urut })}
                </p>
                <p className="text-xs text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400 font-medium">
                  {selectedPaslon.kandidat1?.nama_kandidat} {selectedPaslon.kandidat2 ? `& ${selectedPaslon.kandidat2?.nama_kandidat}` : ''}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2 text-xs text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400 leading-relaxed bg-zinc-100/80 dark:bg-zinc-900/60 p-3.5 rounded-2xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
                <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
                <span>{t('vt.warn_title', 'Peringatan Penting:')}</span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400">
                {t('vt.warn_a', 'Pilihan suara Anda bersifat')} <strong>{t('vt.warn_b', 'permanen dan tidak dapat diubah')}</strong> {t('vt.warn_c', 'setelah dikonfirmasi. Setiap mahasiswa hanya memiliki 1 kali kesempatan memilih.')}
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-3 pt-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setConfirmModalOpen(false)}
                disabled={votingInProgress}
                className="flex-1 py-2.5 px-4 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 text-xs font-bold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-900 transition cursor-pointer"
              >
                {t('vt.cancel', 'Batal')}
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleConfirmVote}
                disabled={votingInProgress}
                className="flex-1 inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 py-2.5 px-4 rounded-xl bg-zinc-900 hover:bg-zinc-800 text-white dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-white dark:text-zinc-950 text-xs font-bold shadow-xs transition active:scale-95 disabled:opacity-50 cursor-pointer"
              >
                {votingInProgress ? (
                  <>
                    <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />
                    <span>{t('vt.recording', 'Merekam Suara...')}</span>
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <Vote className="w-4 h-4" />
                    <span>{t('vt.yes_confirm', 'Ya, Konfirmasi Suara')}</span>
                  </>
                )}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Modal Peringatan: Waktu Voting Telah Selesai / Ditutup */}
      {scheduleExpiredWarning && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/75 backdrop-blur-sm animate-in fade-in duration-200">
          <div className="bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 rounded-3xl max-w-sm w-full p-6 space-y-4 shadow-2xl text-center">
            <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-800 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 mx-auto flex items-center justify-center">
              <Lock className="w-6 h-6" />
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
                {t('vt.ended_title', 'Waktu Pemungutan Suara Telah Berakhir')}
              </h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400 leading-relaxed">
                {t('vt.ended_desc', 'Bilik suara resmi ditutup oleh Panitia KPU Mahasiswa. Anda akan dialihkan kembali ke halaman awal...')}
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="pt-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  sessionStorage.removeItem('kpu_mhs_session');
                  router.replace('/voting/login');
                }}
                className="w-full py-2.5 px-4 rounded-xl bg-zinc-900 hover:bg-zinc-800 text-white dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-white dark:text-zinc-950 text-xs font-bold transition active:scale-95 cursor-pointer"
              >
                {t('vt.back_login', 'Kembali ke Halaman Login')}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```
