```css
@import "tailwindcss";

@custom-variant dark (&:where(.dark, .dark *));

@theme {
  --color-kpu-50: #eff6ff;
  --color-kpu-100: #dbeafe;
  --color-kpu-200: #bfdbfe;
  --color-kpu-300: #93c5fd;
  --color-kpu-400: #60a5fa;
  --color-kpu-500: #3b82f6;
  --color-kpu-600: #2563eb;
  --color-kpu-700: #1d4ed8;
  --color-kpu-800: #1e40af;
  --color-kpu-900: #1e3a8a;
  --color-kpu-950: #172554;
}

@layer base {
  :root {
    --bg-main: #ffffff;
    --bg-card: #ffffff;
    --bg-section: #f8fafc;
    --bg-hover: #f1f5f9;
    --text-main: #0f172a;
    --text-muted: #64748b;
    --border-main: #e2e8f0;
    --accent: #1e40af;
    /* Biru KPU LP3I */
    --accent-hover: #1d4ed8;
    --accent-text: #ffffff;
    --accent-light: #eff6ff;
    --accent-border: #bfdbfe;
  }

  .dark {
    --bg-main: #000000;
    --bg-card: #09090b;
    --bg-section: #0b0f19;
    --bg-hover: #151d2f;
    --text-main: #f8fafc;
    --text-muted: #94a3b8;
    --border-main: #1e293b;
    --accent: #60a5fa;
    /* Biru KPU aksen aktif dark mode */
    --accent-hover: #93c5fd;
    --accent-text: #09090b;
    --accent-light: #172554;
    --accent-border: #1e3a8a;
  }

  body {
    background-color: var(--bg-main);
    color: var(--text-main);
    font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, sans-serif;
    overflow-x: hidden;
    scroll-behavior: smooth;
    transition: background-color 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease;
  }
}

/* Custom Scrollbar */
::-webkit-scrollbar {
  width: 6px;
  height: 6px;
}

::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
  background: transparent;
}

::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
  background: #93c5fd;
  border-radius: 9999px;
}

:root.dark ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb,
.dark ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
  background: #334155;
}

::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
  background: #3b82f6;
}

.dark ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
  background: #475569;
}

/* =========================================================
   1. POLA BINTIK-BINTIK (DOT MATRIX / DOKUMENTASI STYLE)
   ========================================================= */
.bg-dot-matrix {
  background-image: radial-gradient(rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.22) 1.25px, transparent 1.25px);
  background-size: 24px 24px;
}

.dark .bg-dot-matrix {
  background-image: radial-gradient(rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.28) 1.25px, transparent 1.25px);
  background-size: 24px 24px;
}

/* =========================================================
   2. ANIMASI HEADER CARD: CAHAYA KANAN ATAS KE BAWAH & BORDER MUTER
   ========================================================= */
@keyframes light-sweep-right {
  0% {
    top: -35%;
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(0) scale(0.9);
  }

  25% {
    opacity: 0.85;
  }

  75% {
    opacity: 0.85;
  }

  100% {
    top: 85%;
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(10%) scale(1.05);
  }
}

.animate-light-sweep-right {
  animation: light-sweep-right 3.8s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) infinite;
}

@keyframes border-spin-360 {
  from {
    transform: rotate(0deg);
  }

  to {
    transform: rotate(360deg);
  }
}

.animate-border-spin {
  animation: border-spin-360 3s linear infinite;
}

/* =========================================================
   3. ANIMASI GARIS PUTUS-PUTUS TIMELINE MENGALIR (SNAKE LINE)
   ========================================================= */
@keyframes dash-flow-right {
  from {
    background-position: 0 0;
  }

  to {
    background-position: 24px 0;
  }
}

@keyframes dash-flow-left {
  from {
    background-position: 24px 0;
  }

  to {
    background-position: 0 0;
  }
}

@keyframes dash-flow-down {
  from {
    background-position: 0 0;
  }

  to {
    background-position: 0 24px;
  }
}

.dashed-line-right {
  background-image: linear-gradient(to right, #3b82f6 55%, transparent 45%);
  background-size: 12px 2.5px;
  background-repeat: repeat-x;
  animation: dash-flow-right 0.85s linear infinite;
}

.dashed-line-left {
  background-image: linear-gradient(to right, #3b82f6 55%, transparent 45%);
  background-size: 12px 2.5px;
  background-repeat: repeat-x;
  animation: dash-flow-left 0.85s linear infinite;
}

.dashed-line-down {
  background-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, #3b82f6 55%, transparent 45%);
  background-size: 2.5px 12px;
  background-repeat: repeat-y;
  animation: dash-flow-down 0.85s linear infinite;
}

.dark .dashed-line-right,
.dark .dashed-line-left {
  background-image: linear-gradient(to right, #60a5fa 55%, transparent 45%);
}

.dark .dashed-line-down {
  background-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, #60a5fa 55%, transparent 45%);
}

/* Pause animation on scroll or when out of viewport */
.dashed-lines-paused .dashed-line-right,
.dashed-lines-paused .dashed-line-left,
.dashed-lines-paused .dashed-line-down {
  animation-play-state: paused !important;
}

/* Opening Screen Rotations (Clockwise & Counter-Clockwise) */
@keyframes opening-spin-cw {
  from {
    transform: rotate(0deg);
  }
  to {
    transform: rotate(360deg);
  }
}

@keyframes opening-spin-ccw {
  from {
    transform: rotate(0deg);
  }
  to {
    transform: rotate(-360deg);
  }
}

.animate-opening-spin-cw-1 {
  animation: opening-spin-cw 9s linear infinite;
}

.animate-opening-spin-ccw-2 {
  animation: opening-spin-ccw 11s linear infinite;
}

.animate-opening-spin-cw-3 {
  animation: opening-spin-cw 7s linear infinite;
}

.animate-opening-spin-ccw-4 {
  animation: opening-spin-ccw 8s linear infinite;
}

.animate-opening-spin-dots {
  animation: opening-spin-cw 5s linear infinite;
}

/* =========================================================
   4. 3D PERSPECTIVE & BALLOT BOX 3D
   ========================================================= */
.perspective-card-container {
  perspective: 1400px;
}

.ballot-box-3d {
  position: relative;
  transform-style: preserve-3d;
  transform: rotateY(-10deg) rotateX(8deg);
  transition: transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1);
  box-shadow:
    -14px 18px 28px -6px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.16),
    -6px 8px 12px -2px rgba(30, 58, 138, 0.14),
    0 0 0 1px rgba(30, 58, 138, 0.1);
}

/* Sisi tebal balok kanan (Depth 3D Kanan) */
.ballot-box-3d::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 4px;
  right: -14px;
  width: 14px;
  height: calc(100% - 8px);
  border-radius: 0 14px 14px 0;
  transform-origin: left;
  transform: rotateY(90deg);
  background: linear-gradient(to right, rgba(30, 58, 138, 0.6), rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.75));
  transition: width 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1), right 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1);
  pointer-events: none;
}

/* Sisi tebal balok bawah (Depth 3D Bawah) */
.ballot-box-3d::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  bottom: -14px;
  left: 4px;
  width: calc(100% - 8px);
  height: 14px;
  border-radius: 0 0 14px 14px;
  transform-origin: top;
  transform: rotateX(-90deg);
  background: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(30, 58, 138, 0.7), rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.85));
  transition: height 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1), bottom 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1);
  pointer-events: none;
}

.dark .ballot-box-3d {
  box-shadow:
    -16px 20px 32px -4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8),
    -6px 8px 16px -2px rgba(30, 58, 138, 0.35),
    0 0 0 1px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.25);
}

.dark .ballot-box-3d::before {
  background: linear-gradient(to right, rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.95), rgba(30, 58, 138, 0.5));
}

.dark .ballot-box-3d::after {
  background: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.95), rgba(30, 58, 138, 0.6));
}

.ballot-box-3d:hover {
  transform: rotateY(-18deg) rotateX(13deg) translateY(-12px) translateZ(24px);
  box-shadow:
    -30px 40px 50px -8px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.24),
    -14px 20px 28px -4px rgba(30, 58, 138, 0.28),
    0 0 25px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.18);
}

.dark .ballot-box-3d:hover {
  box-shadow:
    -32px 42px 60px -6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.95),
    -16px 22px 32px -2px rgba(30, 58, 138, 0.5),
    0 0 35px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.28);
}

.ballot-box-3d:hover::before {
  width: 22px;
  right: -22px;
}

.ballot-box-3d:hover::after {
  height: 22px;
  bottom: -22px;
}

.layer-float-sm {
  transform: translateZ(12px);
  transition: transform 0.4s ease;
}

.layer-float-md {
  transform: translateZ(22px);
  transition: transform 0.4s ease;
}

.card-3d {
  transform-style: preserve-3d;
  transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 0.4s ease;
}

.card-3d:hover {
  transform: rotateY(-6deg) rotateX(4deg) translateY(-6px);
}

@media (max-width: 640px) {
  h1 {
    font-size: 1.5rem !important;
    line-height: 2rem !important;
  }

  h2 {
    font-size: 1.25rem !important;
    line-height: 1.75rem !important;
  }

  h3 {
    font-size: 1.1rem !important;
    line-height: 1.5rem !important;
  }

  p,
  span,
  li,
  button,
  input,
  textarea {
    font-size: 0.875rem;
  }

  .ballot-box-3d {
    transform: none !important;
  }

  .ballot-box-3d::before,
  .ballot-box-3d::after {
    display: none !important;
  }
}

.glass-panel {
  background: rgba(9, 9, 11, 0.85);
  backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
}

:root:not(.dark) .glass-panel,
html:not(.dark) .glass-panel {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92);
  backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  border: 1px solid rgba(30, 58, 138, 0.12);
}

@keyframes sams-float {

  0%,
  100% {
    transform: translateY(0px) translateX(0px);
  }

  25% {
    transform: translateY(-6px) translateX(3px);
  }

  50% {
    transform: translateY(-2px) translateX(-3px);
  }

  75% {
    transform: translateY(-7px) translateX(1px);
  }
}

.animate-sams-float {
  animation: sams-float 4.5s ease-in-out infinite;
}
```

```javascript
            {trendsData.length > 0 ? (
              <Line data={performanceLineData} options={chartOptions} />
            ) : (
              <div className="h-full flex items-center justify-center text-xs text-zinc-400">
                Belum ada data latensi pada rentang waktu ini.
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Interactive Table Log Percakapan */}
      <div className="rounded-3xl bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 shadow-xs overflow-hidden">
        {/* Filter bar tabel */}
        <div className="p-4 sm:p-5 border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-3">
          <div>
            <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
              Log Interaksi Sams Asisten
            </h3>
            <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500">
              Total {totalLogsCount.toLocaleString()} riwayat percakapan tercatat
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            {/* Search input */}
            <div className="relative">
              <Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5 absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-zinc-400" />
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder="Cari pertanyaan..."
                value={searchQuery}
                onChange={(e) => {
                  setSearchQuery(e.target.value);
                  setCurrentPage(1);
                }}
                className="pl-8 pr-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 placeholder-zinc-400 focus:outline-hidden w-44 sm:w-56"
              />
            </div>

            {/* Filter Status */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1 bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-900 p-1 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
              <Filter className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-zinc-400 ml-1.5" />
              <select
                value={statusFilter}
                onChange={(e) => {
                  setStatusFilter(e.target.value);
                  setCurrentPage(1);
                }}
                className="bg-transparent text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 pr-2 py-0.5 focus:outline-hidden cursor-pointer"
              >
                <option value="all">Semua Status</option>
                <option value="s">Sukses ('s')</option>
                <option value="r">Ditolak ('r')</option>
                <option value="e">Error ('e')</option>
              </select>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Tabel Data */}
        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          <table className="w-full text-left text-xs">
            <thead className="bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900/50 text-zinc-500 border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
              <tr>
                <th className="py-3 px-4 font-semibold">Waktu</th>
                <th className="py-3 px-4 font-semibold">Pertanyaan</th>
                <th className="py-3 px-4 font-semibold">Status</th>
                <th className="py-3 px-4 font-semibold">FAQ Match</th>
                <th className="py-3 px-4 font-semibold">Token</th>
                <th className="py-3 px-4 font-semibold">Durasi</th>
                <th className="py-3 px-4 font-semibold text-right">Aksi</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody className="divide-y divide-zinc-100 dark:divide-zinc-800/80">
              {logsLoading ? (
                <tr>
                  <td colSpan="7" className="py-8 text-center text-zinc-400">
                    Memuat data riwayat percakapan...
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ) : logs.length === 0 ? (
                <tr>
                  <td colSpan="7" className="py-8 text-center text-zinc-400">
                    Tidak ditemukan data log yang sesuai.
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ) : (
                logs.map((log) => {
                  return (
                    <tr
                      key={log.id}
                      className="hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-900/40 transition"
                    >
                      <td className="py-3 px-4 whitespace-nowrap text-zinc-500 font-mono text-[11px]">
                        {formatWaktuIndo(log.created_at)}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-4 max-w-xs truncate font-medium text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
                        {log.pertanyaan || <span className="text-zinc-400 italic">Tanpa pertanyaan</span>}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-4 whitespace-nowrap">
                        {log.status === 's' && (
                          <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-800">
                            Sukses
                          </span>
                        )}
                        {log.status === 'r' && (
                          <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-950/60 dark:text-amber-300 border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-800">
                            Ditolak
                          </span>
                        )}
                        {log.status === 'e' && (
                          <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold bg-red-50 text-red-700 dark:bg-red-950/60 dark:text-red-300 border border-red-200 dark:border-red-800">
                            Error
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-4 whitespace-nowrap">
                        {log.matched_faq ? (
                          <span className="text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 font-semibold text-[11px] flex items-center gap-1">
                            <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                            Cocok
                          </span>
                        ) : (
                          <span className="text-zinc-400 text-[11px]">Umum</span>
                        )}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-4 whitespace-nowrap font-mono text-[11px] text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400">
                        {log.total_tokens || 0}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-4 whitespace-nowrap font-mono text-[11px] text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400">
                        {log.processing_ms ? `${log.processing_ms} ms` : '-'}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-4 whitespace-nowrap text-right">
                        <button
                          onClick={() => setSelectedLog(log)}
                          className="p-1.5 rounded-lg hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400 transition cursor-pointer"
                          title="Lihat Detail Pesan"
                        >
                          <Eye className="w-4 h-4" />
                        </button>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  );
                })
              )}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>

        {/* Paginasi Table */}
        <div className="p-4 border-t border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-zinc-500">
          <span>
            Halaman {currentPage} dari {totalPages}
          </span>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <button
              onClick={() => setCurrentPage((p) => Math.max(1, p - 1))}
              disabled={currentPage <= 1 || logsLoading}
              className="p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 hover:text-zinc-950 dark:hover:text-white disabled:opacity-40 transition cursor-pointer"
            >
              <ChevronLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => setCurrentPage((p) => Math.min(totalPages, p + 1))}
              disabled={currentPage >= totalPages || logsLoading}
              className="p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 hover:text-zinc-950 dark:hover:text-white disabled:opacity-40 transition cursor-pointer"
            >
              <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Modal Detail Log */}
      {selectedLog && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xs animate-in fade-in duration-200">
          <div className="w-full max-w-xl max-h-[90vh] flex flex-col rounded-3xl bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 shadow-2xl overflow-hidden">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-4.5 border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Bot className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-600" />
                <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
                  Detail Interaksi AI
                </h3>
              </div>
              <button
                onClick={() => setSelectedLog(null)}
                className="p-1 rounded-lg text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 cursor-pointer"
              >
                <X className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="p-5 space-y-4 overflow-y-auto text-xs">
              {/* Info Bar */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-2 p-3 rounded-2xl bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
                <div>
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400 block">Waktu</span>
                  <span className="font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">
                    {formatWaktuIndo(selectedLog.created_at)}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400 block">Status</span>
                  <span className="font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 uppercase">
                    {selectedLog.status}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400 block">Total Token</span>
                  <span className="font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">
                    {selectedLog.total_tokens} ({selectedLog.tokens_input} in / {selectedLog.tokens_output} out)
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400 block">Durasi</span>
                  <span className="font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">
                    {selectedLog.processing_ms} ms
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Pertanyaan */}
              <div>
                <label className="text-[11px] font-bold text-zinc-500 uppercase block mb-1.5">
                  Pertanyaan Pengguna
                </label>
                <div className="p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 whitespace-pre-wrap leading-relaxed">
                  {selectedLog.pertanyaan || '-'}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Jawaban */}
              <div>
                <label className="text-[11px] font-bold text-zinc-500 uppercase block mb-1.5">
                  Jawaban AI
                </label>
                <div className="p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-blue-50/50 dark:bg-blue-950/30 border border-blue-100 dark:border-blue-900/40 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 whitespace-pre-wrap leading-relaxed max-h-60 overflow-y-auto">
                  {selectedLog.jawaban || <span className="text-zinc-400 italic">Tidak ada balasan</span>}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Error Message jika ada */}
              {selectedLog.error_msg && (
                <div>
                  <label className="text-[11px] font-bold text-red-500 uppercase block mb-1.5">
                    Pesan Kesalahan
                  </label>
                  <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-950/40 border border-red-200 dark:border-red-900 text-red-700 dark:text-red-300">
                    {selectedLog.error_msg}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Metadata Tambahan */}
              <div className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400 pt-2 border-t border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 flex items-center justify-between">
                <span>Session ID: {selectedLog.session_id || '-'}</span>
                <span>IP: {selectedLog.ip_address || '-'}</span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="p-4 bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900 border-t border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 flex justify-end">
              <button
                onClick={() => setSelectedLog(null)}
                className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 hover:bg-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-700 transition cursor-pointer"
              >
                Tutup
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```javascript
'use client';

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import {
  Sparkles,
  Bot,
  Plus,
  Trash2,
  Edit2,
  Check,
  AlertCircle,
  Save,
  ArrowLeft,
  HelpCircle,
  Settings2,
  X,
  Sliders,
  Globe2,
} from 'lucide-react';
import {
  getAiFaqList,
  saveAiFaq,
  deleteAiFaq,
  toggleAiFaq,
  getAiSetting,
  saveAiSetting,
} from '@/api/panitia/ai';

export default function PanitiaAiSettingPage() {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('faq'); // 'faq' | 'config'
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [notification, setNotification] = useState(null); // { type: 'success' | 'error', message: string }

  // FAQ State
  const [faqList, setFaqList] = useState([]);
  const [isFaqModalOpen, setIsFaqModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editingFaq, setEditingFaq] = useState(null);
  const [faqForm, setFaqForm] = useState({
    kategori: 'Umum & Profil KPU',
    pertanyaan: '',
    jawaban: '',
    urutan: 1,
    is_active: true,
  });

  // Setting State
  const [setting, setSetting] = useState({
    system_prompt: '',
    bahasa_diizinkan: 'id,en',
    max_tokens: 500,
    temperature: 1.0,
    rate_limit_per_menit: 12,
  });

  const availableLanguages = [
    { kode: 'id', label: 'Bahasa Indonesia (ID)' },
    { kode: 'en', label: 'English (EN)' },
    { kode: 'ar', label: 'العربية (AR)' },
    { kode: 'fr', label: 'Français (FR)' },
    { kode: 'ru', label: 'Русский (RU)' },
    { kode: 'ja', label: '日本語 (JA)' },
    { kode: 'zh', label: '中文 (ZH)' },
  ];

  const showNotification = (type, message) => {
    setNotification({ type, message });
    setTimeout(() => {
      setNotification(null);
    }, 4000);
  };

  const loadData = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    const [faqRes, setRes] = await Promise.all([
      getAiFaqList(),
      getAiSetting(),
    ]);

    if (faqRes.success) {
      setFaqList(faqRes.data || []);
    }
    if (setRes.success && setRes.data) {
      setSetting({
        system_prompt: setRes.data.system_prompt || '',
        bahasa_diizinkan: setRes.data.bahasa_diizinkan || 'id,en',
        max_tokens: setRes.data.max_tokens || 500,
        temperature: Number(setRes.data.temperature) || 1.0,
        rate_limit_per_menit: setRes.data.rate_limit_per_menit || 12,
      });
    }
    setLoading(false);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadData();
  }, []);

  // Handler FAQ Modal Open
  const handleOpenFaqModal = (item = null) => {
    if (item) {
      setEditingFaq(item);
      setFaqForm({
        kategori: item.kategori || 'Umum & Profil KPU',
        pertanyaan: item.pertanyaan || '',
        jawaban: item.jawaban || '',
        urutan: item.urutan || 1,
        is_active: item.is_active !== undefined ? item.is_active : true,
      });
    } else {
      setEditingFaq(null);
      setFaqForm({
        kategori: 'Umum & Profil KPU',
        pertanyaan: '',
        jawaban: '',
        urutan: faqList.length + 1,
        is_active: true,
      });
    }
    setIsFaqModalOpen(true);
  };

  // Submit FAQ
  const handleSaveFaq = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!faqForm.pertanyaan.trim() || !faqForm.jawaban.trim()) {
      showNotification('error', 'Pertanyaan dan jawaban wajib diisi.');
      return;
    }

    setSaving(true);
    const payload = {
      ...faqForm,
      id: editingFaq?.id,
    };

    const res = await saveAiFaq(payload);
    setSaving(false);

    if (res.success) {
      showNotification('success', editingFaq ? 'FAQ berhasil diperbarui.' : 'FAQ baru berhasil ditambahkan.');
      setIsFaqModalOpen(false);
      loadData();
    } else {
      showNotification('error', res.error || 'Gagal menyimpan FAQ.');
    }
  };

  // Toggle FAQ Active
  const handleToggleFaq = async (id, currentStatus) => {
    const res = await toggleAiFaq(id, !currentStatus);
    if (res.success) {
      setFaqList((prev) =>
        prev.map((f) => (f.id === id ? { ...f, is_active: !currentStatus } : f))
      );
    } else {
      showNotification('error', res.error || 'Gagal mengubah status FAQ.');
    }
  };

  // Delete FAQ
  const handleDeleteFaq = async (id, title) => {
    if (!confirm(`Hapus FAQ: "${title}"?`)) return;

    const res = await deleteAiFaq(id);
    if (res.success) {
      showNotification('success', 'FAQ berhasil dihapus.');
      setFaqList((prev) => prev.filter((f) => f.id !== id));
    } else {
      showNotification('error', res.error || 'Gagal menghapus FAQ.');
    }
  };

  // Handle Setting Save
  const handleSaveSetting = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setSaving(true);
    const res = await saveAiSetting(setting);
    setSaving(false);

    if (res.success) {
      showNotification('success', 'Konfigurasi AI berhasil disimpan dan diperbarui.');
    } else {
      showNotification('error', res.error || 'Gagal menyimpan konfigurasi.');
    }
  };

  // Toggle Language Checkbox
  const handleToggleLanguage = (kode) => {
    const currentList = setting.bahasa_diizinkan
      ? setting.bahasa_diizinkan.split(',').map((k) => k.trim())
      : ['id'];

    let updated;
    if (currentList.includes(kode)) {
      if (kode === 'id') {
        showNotification('error', 'Bahasa Indonesia (ID) wajib aktif sebagai bahasa utama.');
        return;
      }
      updated = currentList.filter((k) => k !== kode);
    } else {
      updated = [...currentList, kode];
    }

    setSetting((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      bahasa_diizinkan: updated.join(','),
    }));
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 pb-12">
      {/* Toast Notification */}
      {notification && (
        <div
          className={`fixed top-5 right-5 z-50 flex items-center gap-2.5 px-4 py-3 rounded-2xl shadow-xl text-xs font-semibold animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-top-4 duration-200 ${
            notification.type === 'success'
              ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white'
              : 'bg-red-600 text-white'
          }`}
        >
          {notification.type === 'success' ? (
            <Check className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
          ) : (
            <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
          )}
          <span>{notification.message}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Header Panel */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 p-5 rounded-3xl bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 shadow-xs">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3.5">
          <Link
            href="/panitia/ai"
            className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-950 dark:hover:text-white transition"
            title="Kembali ke Dashboard AI"
          >
            <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
          </Link>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-lg sm:text-xl font-black text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 tracking-tight">
              Pengaturan AI & Basis Pengetahuan
            </h1>
            <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 mt-0.5">
              Kelola FAQ pertanyaan umum, parameter OpenAI, dan panduan netralitas Sams Asisten.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Tab Switcher */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 p-1 rounded-2xl bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 self-start sm:self-auto">
          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveTab('faq')}
            className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition cursor-pointer ${
              activeTab === 'faq'
                ? 'bg-white dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 shadow-xs'
                : 'text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-white'
            }`}
          >
            <HelpCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Basis FAQ ({faqList.length})</span>
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveTab('config')}
            className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition cursor-pointer ${
              activeTab === 'config'
                ? 'bg-white dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 shadow-xs'
                : 'text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-white'
            }`}
          >
            <Settings2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Konfigurasi & Prompt</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Content Tab 1: Basis FAQ */}
      {activeTab === 'faq' && (
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-sm font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
                Daftar Pertanyaan Umum (FAQ)
              </h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500">
                FAQ ini menjadi rujukan otomatis bagi AI untuk menjawab pertanyaan mahasiswa secara cepat dan akurat.
              </p>
            </div>
            <button
              onClick={() => handleOpenFaqModal()}
              className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold bg-zinc-900 text-white dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-950 hover:opacity-90 transition shadow-xs cursor-pointer"
            >
              <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span>Tambah FAQ</span>
            </button>
          </div>

          <div className="rounded-3xl bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 shadow-xs overflow-hidden">
            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
              <table className="w-full text-left text-xs">
                <thead className="bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900/50 text-zinc-500 border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
                  <tr>
                    <th className="py-3 px-4 font-semibold w-16 text-center">Urutan</th>
                    <th className="py-3 px-4 font-semibold w-44">Kategori</th>
                    <th className="py-3 px-4 font-semibold">Pertanyaan</th>
                    <th className="py-3 px-4 font-semibold">Ringkasan Jawaban</th>
                    <th className="py-3 px-4 font-semibold w-24 text-center">Status</th>
                    <th className="py-3 px-4 font-semibold w-24 text-right">Aksi</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-zinc-100 dark:divide-zinc-800/80">
                  {loading ? (
                    <tr>
                      <td colSpan="6" className="py-8 text-center text-zinc-400">
                        Memuat basis data FAQ...
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ) : faqList.length === 0 ? (
                    <tr>
                      <td colSpan="6" className="py-8 text-center text-zinc-400">
                        Belum ada FAQ tersimpan. Klik tombol Tambah FAQ untuk membuat.
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ) : (
                    faqList.map((faq) => (
                      <tr
                        key={faq.id}
                        className="hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-900/40 transition"
                      >
                        <td className="py-3 px-4 text-center font-mono text-[11px] text-zinc-500">
                          {faq.urutan}
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-3 px-4 font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">
                          <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 text-[10px]">
                            {faq.kategori}
                          </span>
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-3 px-4 font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
                          {faq.pertanyaan}
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-3 px-4 max-w-sm truncate text-zinc-500">
                          {faq.jawaban}
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-3 px-4 text-center">
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => handleToggleFaq(faq.id, faq.is_active)}
                            className={`w-9 h-5 rounded-full transition-colors relative cursor-pointer ${
                              faq.is_active ? 'bg-emerald-600' : 'bg-zinc-300 dark:bg-zinc-700'
                            }`}
                          >
                            <span
                              className={`absolute top-0.5 left-0.5 w-4 h-4 rounded-full bg-white transition-transform ${
                                faq.is_active ? 'translate-x-4' : 'translate-x-0'
                              }`}
                            />
                          </button>
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-3 px-4 text-right whitespace-nowrap">
                          <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-1">
                            <button
                              onClick={() => handleOpenFaqModal(faq)}
                              className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-zinc-500 hover:text-blue-600 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 transition cursor-pointer"
                              title="Edit FAQ"
                            >
                              <Edit2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                            </button>
                            <button
                              onClick={() => handleDeleteFaq(faq.id, faq.pertanyaan)}
                              className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-zinc-500 hover:text-red-600 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 transition cursor-pointer"
                              title="Hapus FAQ"
                            >
                              <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                            </button>
                          </div>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ))
                  )}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Content Tab 2: Konfigurasi Model & Prompt */}
      {activeTab === 'config' && (
        <form onSubmit={handleSaveSetting} className="space-y-6">
          {/* Section 1: System Prompt */}
          <div className="p-5 sm:p-6 rounded-3xl bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 shadow-xs space-y-4">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <div>
                <h2 className="text-sm font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Bot className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600" />
                  <span>System Prompt & Karakter Asisten</span>
                </h2>
                <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500 mt-0.5">
                  Instruksi panduan cara berbicara, persona, dan etika netralitas yang wajib dipatuhi model AI.
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <textarea
              rows={6}
              value={setting.system_prompt}
              onChange={(e) => setSetting({ ...setting, system_prompt: e.target.value })}
              placeholder="Masukkan instruksi instruktif system prompt..."
              className="w-full p-4 rounded-2xl text-xs bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 leading-relaxed focus:outline-hidden font-mono"
            />
          </div>

          {/* Section 2: Parameter Teknis OpenAI */}
          <div className="p-5 sm:p-6 rounded-3xl bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 shadow-xs space-y-5">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 pb-3">
              <Sliders className="w-4 h-4 text-purple-600" />
              <h2 className="text-sm font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
                Parameter Model OpenAI
              </h2>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
              {/* Max Tokens */}
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">
                  <label htmlFor="maxTokens">Max Completion Tokens</label>
                  <span className="font-mono text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400 font-bold">
                    {setting.max_tokens}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <input
                  id="maxTokens"
                  type="range"
                  min="100"
                  max="1500"
                  step="50"
                  value={setting.max_tokens}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setSetting({ ...setting, max_tokens: Number(e.target.value) })
                  }
                  className="w-full accent-purple-600 cursor-pointer"
                />
                <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400">
                  Membatasi panjang balasan asisten per percakapan demi menghemat kuota token.
                </p>
              </div>

              {/* Temperature */}
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">
                  <label htmlFor="temperature">Temperature</label>
                  <span className="font-mono text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400 font-bold">
                    {setting.temperature}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <input
                  id="temperature"
                  type="range"
                  min="0.0"
                  max="1.5"
                  step="0.1"
                  value={setting.temperature}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setSetting({ ...setting, temperature: Number(e.target.value) })
                  }
                  className="w-full accent-purple-600 cursor-pointer"
                />
                <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400">
                  0.0 = Sangat faktual & kaku, 1.0 = Seimbang ramah, 1.5 = Kreatif.
                </p>
              </div>

              {/* Rate Limit */}
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">
                  <label htmlFor="rateLimit">Rate Limit (Pesan / Menit)</label>
                  <span className="font-mono text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400 font-bold">
                    {setting.rate_limit_per_menit} / mnt
                  </span>
                </div>
                <input
                  id="rateLimit"
                  type="range"
                  min="3"
                  max="30"
                  step="1"
                  value={setting.rate_limit_per_menit}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setSetting({ ...setting, rate_limit_per_menit: Number(e.target.value) })
                  }
                  className="w-full accent-purple-600 cursor-pointer"
                />
                <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400">
                  Maksimal pertanyaan dari satu IP per menit untuk mencegah spam/DDoS.
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Section 3: Bahasa yang Diizinkan */}
          <div className="p-5 sm:p-6 rounded-3xl bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 shadow-xs space-y-4">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 pb-3">
              <Globe2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" />
              <div>
                <h2 className="text-sm font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
                  Bahasa yang Diizinkan untuk Layanan AI
                </h2>
                <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500">
                  Pilih bahasa mana saja yang boleh dijawab oleh Sams Asisten.
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-3 pt-1">
              {availableLanguages.map((lang) => {
                const isChecked = setting.bahasa_diizinkan
                  ?.split(',')
                  .map((k) => k.trim())
                  .includes(lang.kode);

                return (
                  <label
                    key={lang.kode}
                    className={`flex items-center gap-3 p-3 rounded-2xl border transition cursor-pointer text-xs font-semibold ${
                      isChecked
                        ? 'bg-blue-50/60 dark:bg-blue-950/40 border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-900 text-blue-900 dark:text-blue-300'
                        : 'bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900/40 border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400 hover:bg-zinc-100'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      checked={isChecked}
                      onChange={() => handleToggleLanguage(lang.kode)}
                      className="rounded accent-blue-600 cursor-pointer"
                    />
                    <span>{lang.label}</span>
                  </label>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Tombol Simpan */}
          <div className="flex justify-end">
            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={saving}
              className="flex items-center gap-2 px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold bg-zinc-900 text-white dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-950 hover:opacity-90 disabled:opacity-50 transition shadow-md cursor-pointer"
            >
              <Save className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span>{saving ? 'Menyimpan...' : 'Simpan Seluruh Pengaturan AI'}</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>
      )}

      {/* Modal Tambah / Edit FAQ */}
      {isFaqModalOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xs animate-in fade-in duration-200">
          <div className="w-full max-w-lg rounded-3xl bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 shadow-2xl overflow-hidden">
            <form onSubmit={handleSaveFaq}>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-4.5 border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
                <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
                  {editingFaq ? 'Edit Pertanyaan FAQ' : 'Tambah Pertanyaan FAQ Baru'}
                </h3>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setIsFaqModalOpen(false)}
                  className="p-1 rounded-lg text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <X className="w-4 h-4" />
                </button>
              </div>

              <div className="p-5 space-y-4 text-xs">
                {/* Kategori & Urutan */}
                <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3">
                  <div className="col-span-2 space-y-1">
                    <label className="font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">
                      Kategori
                    </label>
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      value={faqForm.kategori}
                      onChange={(e) => setFaqForm({ ...faqForm, kategori: e.target.value })}
                      placeholder="Contoh: Syarat Pemilih"
                      className="w-full p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 focus:outline-hidden"
                      required
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div className="space-y-1">
                    <label className="font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">
                      Urutan Tampil
                    </label>
                    <input
                      type="number"
                      min="1"
                      value={faqForm.urutan}
                      onChange={(e) => setFaqForm({ ...faqForm, urutan: e.target.value })}
                      className="w-full p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 focus:outline-hidden"
                      required
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Pertanyaan */}
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <label className="font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">
                    Pertanyaan Pengguna
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={faqForm.pertanyaan}
                    onChange={(e) => setFaqForm({ ...faqForm, pertanyaan: e.target.value })}
                    placeholder="Contoh: Apa syarat menjadi calon presiden mahasiswa?"
                    className="w-full p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 focus:outline-hidden"
                    required
                  />
                </div>

                {/* Jawaban */}
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <label className="font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">
                    Jawaban Resmi KPU
                  </label>
                  <textarea
                    rows={4}
                    value={faqForm.jawaban}
                    onChange={(e) => setFaqForm({ ...faqForm, jawaban: e.target.value })}
                    placeholder="Tuliskan jawaban yang detail, jelas, dan akurat..."
                    className="w-full p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 leading-relaxed focus:outline-hidden"
                    required
                  />
                </div>

                {/* Status Aktif */}
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 pt-1">
                  <input
                    type="checkbox"
                    id="faqActive"
                    checked={faqForm.is_active}
                    onChange={(e) => setFaqForm({ ...faqForm, is_active: e.target.checked })}
                    className="rounded accent-emerald-600 cursor-pointer"
                  />
                  <label htmlFor="faqActive" className="text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 cursor-pointer font-medium">
                    Aktifkan FAQ ini dalam basis pengetahuan Sams Asisten
                  </label>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="p-4 bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900 border-t border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 flex justify-end gap-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setIsFaqModalOpen(false)}
                  className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 hover:bg-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-700 transition cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Batal
                </button>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  disabled={saving}
                  className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold bg-zinc-900 text-white dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-950 hover:opacity-90 disabled:opacity-50 transition cursor-pointer"
                >
                  {saving ? 'Menyimpan...' : 'Simpan FAQ'}
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```javascript
'use client';

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import {
  getPanitiaAdminList,
  buatAkunPanitia,
  hapusAkunPanitia,
} from '@/api/panitia/rolePanitia';
import {
  ShieldCheck,
  UserPlus,
  Trash2,
  X,
  AlertCircle,
  RefreshCw,
  Users,
  Clock,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { formatWaktuIndo } from '@/utils/dateUtils';

export default function PanitiaAkunPage() {
  const [adminList, setAdminList] = useState([]);
  const [roleList, setRoleList] = useState([]);
  const [currentSession, setCurrentSession] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [modalOpen, setModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [errorText, setErrorText] = useState('');

  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    nama: '',
    nim: '',
    email: '',
    no_tlpn: '',
    password: '',
    role_id: '',
  });

  const loadData = async (isSilent = false) => {
    if (!isSilent) setLoading(true);
    else setRefreshing(true);

    const res = await getPanitiaAdminList();
    if (res.success) {
      setAdminList(res.data || []);
      setRoleList(res.roles || []);
      setCurrentSession(res.currentAdmin);
      if (res.roles?.length > 0 && !formData.role_id) {
        setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, role_id: res.roles[0].id }));
      }
    }
    if (!isSilent) setLoading(false);
    else setRefreshing(false);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadData(false);

    // Polling live keaktifan admin setiap 4 detik saat halaman sedang dibuka
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      if (typeof document !== 'undefined' && document.visibilityState === 'visible') {
        loadData(true);
      }
    }, 4000);

    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, []);

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setSubmitting(true);
    setErrorText('');

    if (formData.password.length < 6) {
      setErrorText('Kata sandi minimal 6 karakter.');
      setSubmitting(false);
      return;
    }

    const res = await buatAkunPanitia(formData);
    if (res.success) {
      setModalOpen(false);
      setFormData({
        nama: '',
        nim: '',
        email: '',
        no_tlpn: '',
        password: '',
        role_id: roleList[0]?.id || '',
      });
      loadData(false);
    } else {
      setErrorText(res.error || 'Gagal mendaftarkan akun panitia baru.');
    }
    setSubmitting(false);
  };

  const handleDelete = async (adminId, authId) => {
    if (confirm('Hapus akun panitia ini? Pengguna ini tidak akan bisa login lagi.')) {
      const res = await hapusAkunPanitia(adminId, authId);
      if (res.success) {
        loadData(false);
      } else {
        alert(res.error || 'Gagal menghapus akun panitia.');
      }
    }
  };

  const totalAdmins = adminList.length;
  const onlineCount = adminList.filter((a) => a.is_online).length;
  const offlineCount = Math.max(0, totalAdmins - onlineCount);

  return (
    <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 lg:p-8 space-y-6 max-w-7xl w-full mx-auto transition-colors">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 pb-4 border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
              Manajemen Akun Panitia
            </h1>
            <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 text-[10px] font-bold">
              SuperAdmin Khusus
            </span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 mt-1">
            Daftarkan akun panitia KPU baru dengan autentikasi Supabase dan pantau status aktif/offline panitia secara langsung.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <button
            onClick={() => loadData(true)}
            disabled={refreshing}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-zinc-100 hover:bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 text-xs font-semibold transition active:scale-95 cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
            title="Segarkan Data"
          >
            <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${refreshing ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
            <span className="hidden sm:inline">Refresh</span>
          </button>

          <button
            onClick={() => {
              setErrorText('');
              setModalOpen(true);
            }}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-zinc-900 hover:bg-zinc-800 text-white dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-white dark:text-zinc-950 text-xs font-bold shadow-xs transition active:scale-95 cursor-pointer"
          >
            <UserPlus className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>Tambah Akun Panitia</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Statistik Ringkas Status Online/Offline */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
        <div className="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 flex items-center justify-between shadow-2xs">
          <div className="space-y-0.5">
            <span className="text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">Total Akun Terdaftar</span>
            <p className="text-lg font-black text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">{totalAdmins}</p>
          </div>
          <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400 flex items-center justify-center">
            <Users className="w-4 h-4" />
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 flex items-center justify-between shadow-2xs">
          <div className="space-y-0.5">
            <span className="text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">Sedang Aktif (Online)</span>
            <p className="text-lg font-black text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 flex items-center gap-2">
              <span>{onlineCount}</span>
              <span className="text-[10px] font-semibold text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-800">
                Online
              </span>
            </p>
          </div>
          <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 flex items-center justify-center">
            <span className="w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-emerald-500 animate-pulse" />
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 flex items-center justify-between shadow-2xs">
          <div className="space-y-0.5">
            <span className="text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">Tidak Aktif (Offline)</span>
            <p className="text-lg font-black text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400 flex items-center gap-2">
              <span>{offlineCount}</span>
              <span className="text-[10px] font-semibold text-zinc-500 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
                Offline
              </span>
            </p>
          </div>
          <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-400 flex items-center justify-center">
            <span className="w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-zinc-400 dark:bg-zinc-600" />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Tabel Akun Panitia */}
      {loading ? (
        <div className="space-y-3">
          {[1, 2, 3].map((n) => (

                        ) : (

                        )}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4 font-mono">{admin.nim}</td>
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4">{admin.email}</td>
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4 font-mono">{admin.no_tlpn || '-'}</td>
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4">
                        <span className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
                          {roleName}
                        </span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-right">
                        {!isCurrent && (

        </div>
      )}

      {modalOpen && (
```

```javascript
'use client';

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import {
  getPanitiaContactList,
  updateStatusKontak,
  hapusPesanKontak,
} from '@/api/panitia/contact';
import { formatWaktuIndo } from '@/utils/dateUtils';
import {
  Mail,
  Search,
  Clock,
  Trash2,
  Send,
  Phone,
} from 'lucide-react';

export default function PanitiaContactPage() {
  const [list, setList] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [filterStatus, setFilterStatus] = useState('all');

  const loadData = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    const res = await getPanitiaContactList();
    if (res.success) {
      setList(res.data || []);
    }
    setLoading(false);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadData();
  }, []);

  const handleUpdateStatus = async (id, status) => {
    const res = await updateStatusKontak(id, status);
    if (res.success) {
      setList((prev) =>
        prev.map((item) => (item.id === id ? { ...item, status } : item))
      );
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async (id) => {
    if (confirm('Hapus pesan kontak ini?')) {
      const res = await hapusPesanKontak(id);
      if (res.success) {
        setList((prev) => prev.filter((item) => item.id !== id));
      } else {
        alert(res.error || 'Gagal menghapus pesan.');
      }
    }
  };

  const filteredList = list.filter((item) => {
    const matchStatus = filterStatus === 'all' || item.status === filterStatus;
    const matchQuery =
      (item.nama || '').toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
      (item.email_or_notelp || '').toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
      (item.pesan_kontak || '').toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase());
    return matchStatus && matchQuery;
  });

  return (
    <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 lg:p-8 space-y-6 max-w-7xl w-full mx-auto transition-colors">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 pb-4 border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
            Pesan Masuk & Pengaduan Pemilih
          </h1>
          <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
            Daftar pertanyaan dan aduan mahasiswa yang masuk melalui form portal publik.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <button
            onClick={() => setFilterStatus('all')}
            className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold transition cursor-pointer ${
              filterStatus === 'all'
                ? 'bg-zinc-900 text-white dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-950'
                : 'bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-950 dark:hover:text-white border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800'
            }`}
          >
            Semua ({list.length})
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => setFilterStatus('belum_dibaca')}
            className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold transition cursor-pointer ${
              filterStatus === 'belum_dibaca'
                ? 'bg-zinc-800 text-white dark:bg-zinc-200 dark:text-zinc-950'
                : 'bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-950 dark:hover:text-white border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800'
            }`}
          >
            Belum Dibaca ({list.filter((k) => k.status === 'belum_dibaca').length})
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Search Bar */}
      <div className="relative max-w-md">
        <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-zinc-400 absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2" />
        <input
          type="text"
          value={searchQuery}
          onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="Cari pesan berdasarkan nama, kontak, atau isi..."
          className="w-full pl-10 pr-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-800 text-xs text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 placeholder-zinc-500 focus:outline-hidden focus:border-zinc-500"
        />
      </div>

      {/* List Pesan */}
      {loading ? (
        <div className="space-y-4">
          {[1, 2, 3].map((n) => (
            <div key={n} className="h-32 rounded-3xl bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-900/50 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 animate-pulse" />
          ))}
        </div>
      ) : filteredList.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="p-12 text-center rounded-3xl bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 max-w-md mx-auto space-y-3">
          <Mail className="w-12 h-12 text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-600 mx-auto" />
          <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">Tidak Ada Pesan</h3>
          <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
            {searchQuery ? 'Tidak ada pesan yang sesuai pencarian.' : 'Belum ada pesan yang masuk dari pengunjung.'}
          </p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-4">
          {filteredList.map((item) => {
            const isWA = item.jenis_kontak === 'whatsapp' || !item.email_or_notelp.includes('@');
            const replyUrl = isWA
              ? `https://wa.me/${item.email_or_notelp.replace(/[^0-9]/g, '')}`
              : `mailto:${item.email_or_notelp}`;

            return (
              <div
                key={item.id}
                className={`p-5 sm:p-6 rounded-3xl border transition-all ${
                  item.status === 'belum_dibaca'
                    ? 'bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 border-zinc-400 dark:border-zinc-700 shadow-sm'
                    : 'bg-zinc-50/70 dark:bg-zinc-950/60 border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400'
                }`}
              >
                <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-start justify-between gap-3 pb-3 border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center font-bold bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
                      {isWA ? <Phone className="w-4 h-4" /> : <Mail className="w-4 h-4" />}
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 flex items-center gap-2">
                        <span>{item.nama || 'Mahasiswa Anonim'}</span>
                        {item.status === 'belum_dibaca' && (
                          <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-zinc-400 dark:bg-zinc-500 animate-pulse" />
                        )}
                      </h3>
                      <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 font-mono mt-0.5">
                        {item.email_or_notelp}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span className="text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 flex items-center gap-1 font-mono">
                      <Clock className="w-3 h-3" />
                      {formatWaktuIndo(item.created_at)}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Pesan Isi */}
                <div className="py-3 text-xs sm:text-sm text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap">
                  {item.pesan_kontak}
                </div>

                {/* Aksi */}
                <div className="pt-3 border-t border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    {/* Tombol Balas Cepat */}
                    <a
                      href={replyUrl}
                      target="_blank"
                      rel="noreferrer"
                      onClick={() => handleUpdateStatus(item.id, 'sudah_dibalas')}
                      className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 py-1.5 px-3 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold bg-zinc-900 hover:bg-zinc-800 text-white dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-white dark:text-zinc-950 transition shadow-xs"
                    >
                      <Send className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      <span>Balas via {isWA ? 'WhatsApp' : 'Email'}</span>
                    </a>

                    {item.status === 'belum_dibaca' ? (
                      <button
                        onClick={() => handleUpdateStatus(item.id, 'sudah_dibaca')}
                        className="py-1.5 px-3 rounded-xl bg-zinc-100 hover:bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 text-xs font-medium transition cursor-pointer"
                      >
                        Tandai Dibaca
                      </button>
                    ) : (
                      <span className="text-[11px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400">
                        Status: {item.status}
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  <button
                    onClick={() => handleDelete(item.id)}
                    className="p-1.5 rounded-xl text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-white transition cursor-pointer"
                    title="Hapus Pesan"
                  >
                    <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```javascript
'use client';

import { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import { getDashboardStats } from '@/api/panitia/dashboard';
import { formatWaktuIndo } from '@/utils/dateUtils';
import {
  TrendingUp,
  Users,
  FolderKanban,
  Mail,
  Activity,
  MapPin,
  RefreshCw,
  Calendar,
  ChevronLeft,
  ChevronRight,
  Filter,
  BarChart2,
} from 'lucide-react';

import {
  Chart as ChartJS,
  CategoryScale,
  LinearScale,
  PointElement,
  LineElement,
  BarElement,
  Title,
  Tooltip,
  Legend,
  Filler,
} from 'chart.js';
import { Line, Bar } from 'react-chartjs-2';

// Register Chart.js elements
ChartJS.register(
  CategoryScale,
  LinearScale,
  PointElement,
  LineElement,
  BarElement,
  Title,
  Tooltip,
  Legend,
  Filler
);

export default function PanitiaDashboardPage() {
  const [data, setData] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  // State Filter Waktu Global
  const [filterType, setFilterType] = useState('7days');
  const [startDate, setStartDate] = useState('');
  const [endDate, setEndDate] = useState('');
  const [showCustomDate, setShowCustomDate] = useState(false);

  // State Pagination untuk Aktivitas Kunjungan Terkini
  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState(1);
  const pageSize = 8;

  const fetchStats = async (overrideFilter) => {
    setLoading(true);
    const activeFilter = overrideFilter || filterType;
    const res = await getDashboardStats({
      filter: activeFilter,
      startDate: activeFilter === 'custom' ? startDate : null,
      endDate: activeFilter === 'custom' ? endDate : null,
    });

    if (res.success) {
      setData(res);
      setCurrentPage(1); // Reset page ke 1 saat filter baru
    }
    setLoading(false);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchStats();
  }, []);

  const handleFilterChange = (e) => {
    const val = e.target.value;
    setFilterType(val);
    if (val === 'custom') {
      setShowCustomDate(true);
    } else {
      setShowCustomDate(false);
      fetchStats(val);
    }
  };

  const applyCustomFilter = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (startDate) {
      fetchStats('custom');
    }
  };

  const stats = data?.stats || {
    totalTrafik: 0,
    totalKontak: 0,
    pesanBelumDibaca: 0,
    totalKandidat: 0,
    totalDokumentasi: 0,
    filteredTotal: 0,
  };

  const chartLabels = data?.chartData?.labels || [];
  const chartValues = data?.chartData?.data || [];

  // Konfigurasi Line Chart (Grafik Garis & Titik-titik Kunjungan)
  const lineChartData = {
    labels: chartLabels,
    datasets: [
      {
        label: 'Jumlah Kunjungan',

        borderColor: '#2563eb', // Blue-600
        backgroundColor: 'rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.08)',

        tension: 0.35,
        pointBackgroundColor: '#2563eb',
        pointBorderColor: '#ffffff',
        pointBorderWidth: 2,
        pointRadius: 4.5,
        pointHoverRadius: 7,
      },
    ],
  };

  const lineChartOptions = {
    responsive: true,
    maintainAspectRatio: false,
    plugins: {
      legend: { display: false },
      tooltip: {
        backgroundColor: '#09090b',

    },
  };

  // Konfigurasi Bar Chart untuk Sebaran Kota Pemilih
  const topCities = data?.topCities || [];
  const cityLabels = topCities.map((c) => c.name);
  const cityValues = topCities.map((c) => c.count);

  const barChartData = {
    labels: cityLabels,
    datasets: [
      {
        label: 'Kunjungan',
        data: cityValues,
        backgroundColor: [
          '#1d4ed8',
          '#2563eb',

          '#60a5fa',
          '#93c5fd',
          '#cbd5e1',
        ],
        borderRadius: 8,
        borderSkipped: false,
      },
    ],
  };

  const barChartOptions = {
    indexAxis: 'y', // Bar horizontal
    responsive: true,
    maintainAspectRatio: false,
    plugins: {
      legend: { display: false },
      tooltip: {
        backgroundColor: '#09090b',
        titleColor: '#ffffff',
        bodyColor: '#cbd5e1',

        cornerRadius: 10,

    scales: {

      },
      y: {

        ticks: { color: '#71717a', font: { size: 11, weight: '600' } },
      },

  };

  // Data Paginasi untuk Aktivitas Kunjungan Terkini
  const allLogs = data?.logTerbaru || [];
  const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(allLogs.length / pageSize));
  const paginatedLogs = useMemo(() => {
    const start = (currentPage - 1) * pageSize;
    return allLogs.slice(start, start + pageSize);
  }, [allLogs, currentPage, pageSize]);

  // Label filter deskriptif
  const getFilterLabel = () => {
    if (filterType === 'today') return 'Hari Ini';
    if (filterType === '30days') return '30 Hari Terakhir';

    if (filterType === 'custom') {
      return startDate ? `${startDate} s/d ${endDate || 'Sekarang'}` : 'Rentang Kustom';
    }
    return '7 Hari Terakhir';
  };

  return (
    <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 lg:p-8 space-y-6 max-w-7xl w-full mx-auto transition-colors">

      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 pb-4 border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">

          <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
            Dashboard Pemantauan Pemilu
          </h1>
          <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">

          </p>

        <button

        >

            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">

                >
                  <option value="7days">7 Hari Terakhir</option>
                  <option value="today">Hari Ini</option>
                  <option value="30days">30 Hari Terakhir</option>

                </select>
                <Filter className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-zinc-500 absolute left-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 pointer-events-none" />
              </div>

          {/* Form Input Rentang Kustom (Jika memilih custom) */}
          {showCustomDate && (
            <form
              onSubmit={applyCustomFilter}

          {/* Line Chart Container (Grafik Garis & Titik-titik) */}
          <div className="h-64 sm:h-72 w-full pt-2">

        {/* Top Sumber Trafik (Mengikuti filter yang aktif) */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-4 p-5 sm:p-6 rounded-3xl bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 space-y-4 shadow-2xs">

          <div className="space-y-3 pt-2">
            {(data?.topSources || []).length === 0 ? (
              <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500 py-6 text-center">
                Belum ada data rujukan pada rentang waktu ini.
              </p>
            ) : (
              (data?.topSources || []).map((src, i) => {
                const total = (data?.topSources || []).reduce((acc, curr) => acc + curr.count, 0) || 1;
                const percent = Math.round((src.count / total) * 100);
                return (
                  <div key={i} className="space-y-1.5">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                      <span className="text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 font-medium">{src.name}</span>
                      <span className="font-mono text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 font-bold">
                        {src.count} ({percent}%)
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="w-full bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-900 rounded-full h-1.5 overflow-hidden">
                      <div
                        style={{ width: `${Math.min(percent, 100)}%` }}
                        className="bg-blue-600 dark:bg-blue-500 h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-500"
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Row 3: Aktivitas Kunjungan Terkini (Next-Back Pagination) & Sebaran Kota Pemilih (Bar Chart) */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
        {/* Aktivitas Kunjungan Terkini dengan Tombol Next-Back Pagination */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-8 p-5 sm:p-6 rounded-3xl bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 space-y-4 shadow-2xs">
```
