```javascript
              <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
                Total {allLogs.length} kunjungan terdata ({getFilterLabel()})
              </p>
            </div>

            {/* Tombol Next - Back Pagination */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 self-end sm:self-auto">
              <span className="text-[11px] text-zinc-500 font-mono">
                Hal {currentPage} dari {totalPages}
              </span>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setCurrentPage((p) => Math.max(1, p - 1))}
                disabled={currentPage === 1}
                className="p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-zinc-100 hover:bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed transition cursor-pointer"
                title="Halaman Sebelumnya"
              >
                <ChevronLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setCurrentPage((p) => Math.min(totalPages, p + 1))}
                disabled={currentPage >= totalPages}
                className="p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-zinc-100 hover:bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed transition cursor-pointer"
                title="Halaman Berikutnya"
              >
                <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full text-left text-xs">
              <thead className="text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
                <tr>
                  <th className="pb-3 font-semibold">Kota / Wilayah</th>
                  <th className="pb-3 font-semibold">ISP / Jaringan</th>
                  <th className="pb-3 font-semibold">Sumber</th>
                  <th className="pb-3 font-semibold">Halaman</th>
                  <th className="pb-3 font-semibold">Waktu</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-zinc-100 dark:divide-zinc-800/60 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">
                {paginatedLogs.length === 0 ? (
                  <tr>
                    <td colSpan={5} className="py-8 text-center text-zinc-500">
                      Belum ada catatan aktivitas kunjungan pada rentang ini.
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ) : (
                  paginatedLogs.map((log, i) => (
                    <tr key={log.id || i} className="hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-900/50 transition">
                      <td className="py-2.5 font-medium flex items-center gap-1.5 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
                        <MapPin className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 shrink-0" />
                        <span>{log.kota || 'Indonesia'}</span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-2.5 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 font-mono text-[11px] truncate max-w-[140px]">
                        {log.isp || 'Lokal'}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-2.5">
                        <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-900 text-[10px] font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
                          {log.sumber || 'Direct'}
                        </span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-2.5 font-mono text-[11px] text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">
                        {log.path || '/'}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-2.5 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 text-[11px] whitespace-nowrap">
                        {formatWaktuIndo(log.visited_at)}
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))
                )}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Sebaran Kota Pemilih (Grafik Bar Horizontal) */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-4 p-5 sm:p-6 rounded-3xl bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 space-y-4 shadow-2xs">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
                Sebaran Kota Pemilih
              </h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
                Grafik bar wilayah ({getFilterLabel()})
              </p>
            </div>
            <div className="p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400">
              <BarChart2 className="w-4 h-4" />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="h-64 w-full pt-2">
            {cityLabels.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="h-full flex items-center justify-center text-xs text-zinc-500">
                Belum ada data wilayah pada rentang waktu ini.
              </div>
            ) : (
              <Bar data={barChartData} options={barChartOptions} />
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```javascript
'use client';

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import {
  getPanitiaDokumentasiList,
  simpanDokumentasi,
  hapusDokumentasi,
} from '@/api/panitia/dokumentasi';
import { formatTanggalIndo } from '@/utils/dateUtils';
import { getGoogleDriveEmbedUrl } from '@/utils/driveUtils';
import {
  FolderKanban,
  Plus,
  Edit,
  Trash2,
  Calendar,
  ExternalLink,
  Eye,
  X,
  AlertCircle,
} from 'lucide-react';

export default function PanitiaDokumentasiPage() {
  const [list, setList] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [modalOpen, setModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [previewItem, setPreviewItem] = useState(null);
  const [statusMsg, setStatusMsg] = useState({ success: null, text: '' });

  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    id: null,
    judul_dokumentasi: '',
    tanggal_dokumentasi: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
    link_drive: '',
    deskripsi: '',
  });

  const loadData = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    const res = await getPanitiaDokumentasiList();
    if (res.success) {
      setList(res.data || []);
    }
    setLoading(false);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadData();
  }, []);

  const openModal = (item = null) => {
    setStatusMsg({ success: null, text: '' });
    if (item) {
      setFormData({
        id: item.id,
        judul_dokumentasi: item.judul_dokumentasi || '',
        tanggal_dokumentasi: item.tanggal_dokumentasi || new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
        link_drive: item.link_drive || '',
        deskripsi: item.deskripsi || '',
      });
    } else {
      setFormData({
        id: null,
        judul_dokumentasi: '',
        tanggal_dokumentasi: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
        link_drive: '',
        deskripsi: '',
      });
    }
    setModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setSubmitting(true);
    setStatusMsg({ success: null, text: '' });

    const res = await simpanDokumentasi(formData);
    if (res.success) {
      setModalOpen(false);
      loadData();
    } else {
      setStatusMsg({ success: false, text: res.error || 'Gagal menyimpan dokumentasi.' });
    }
    setSubmitting(false);
  };

  const handleDelete = async (id) => {
    if (confirm('Hapus arsip dokumentasi ini?')) {
      const res = await hapusDokumentasi(id);
      if (res.success) {
        loadData();
      } else {
        alert(res.error || 'Gagal menghapus dokumentasi.');
      }
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 lg:p-8 space-y-6 max-w-7xl w-full mx-auto transition-colors">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 pb-4 border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
            Manajemen Dokumentasi Pemilu
          </h1>
          <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
            Kelola arsip tautan Google Drive dan pratinjau cuplikan foto kegiatan KPU.
          </p>
        </div>

        <button
          onClick={() => openModal()}
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-zinc-900 hover:bg-zinc-800 text-white dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-white dark:text-zinc-950 text-xs font-bold shadow-xs transition active:scale-95 cursor-pointer"
        >
          <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
          <span>Tambah Dokumentasi Baru</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Grid Dokumentasi */}
      {loading ? (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
          {[1, 2, 3].map((n) => (
            <div key={n} className="h-48 rounded-3xl bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-900/50 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 animate-pulse" />
          ))}
        </div>
      ) : list.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="p-12 text-center rounded-3xl bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 max-w-md mx-auto space-y-3">
          <FolderKanban className="w-12 h-12 text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-600 mx-auto" />
          <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">Belum Ada Dokumentasi</h3>
          <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
            Klik tombol Tambah Dokumentasi untuk memasukkan tautan Google Drive baru.
          </p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
          {list.map((item) => (
            <div
              key={item.id}
              className="p-6 rounded-3xl bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 flex flex-col justify-between space-y-4 shadow-xs hover:shadow-lg transition-all"
            >
              <div className="space-y-3">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 flex items-center justify-center border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
                    <FolderKanban className="w-5 h-5" />
                  </div>
                  <span className="text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 flex items-center gap-1 font-mono">
                    <Calendar className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    {formatTanggalIndo(item.tanggal_dokumentasi)}
                  </span>
                </div>

                <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 leading-snug">
                  {item.judul_dokumentasi}
                </h3>

                <p className="text-xs text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400 line-clamp-3">
                  {item.deskripsi || 'Arsip Google Drive kegiatan pemilu.'}
                </p>
              </div>

              {/* Action Buttons */}
              <div className="pt-4 border-t border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 space-y-2">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setPreviewItem(item)}
                    className="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 py-2 px-3 rounded-xl bg-zinc-100 hover:bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 text-xs font-semibold transition cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <Eye className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    <span>Preview Embed</span>
                  </button>

                  <a
                    href={item.link_drive}
                    target="_blank"
                    rel="noreferrer"
                    className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-zinc-100 hover:bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 transition"
                    title="Buka Tab Drive"
                  >
                    <ExternalLink className="w-4 h-4" />
                  </a>
                </div>

                <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 pt-1">
                  <button
                    onClick={() => openModal(item)}
                    className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-zinc-100 hover:bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 transition cursor-pointer"
                    title="Edit Data"
                  >
                    <Edit className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  </button>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => handleDelete(item.id)}
                    className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-zinc-100 hover:bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 transition cursor-pointer"
                    title="Hapus"
                  >
                    <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Modal Form */}
      {modalOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-xs">
          <div className="relative w-full max-w-lg bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 rounded-3xl p-6 sm:p-8 space-y-5 shadow-2xl transition-colors">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
              <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
                {formData.id ? 'Edit Dokumentasi' : 'Tambah Dokumentasi Baru'}
              </h2>
              <button
                onClick={() => setModalOpen(false)}
                className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-white cursor-pointer"
              >
                <X className="w-5 h-5" />
              </button>
            </div>

            {statusMsg.text && (
              <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-700 text-xs text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 flex items-center gap-2">
                <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 text-zinc-500" />
                <span>{statusMsg.text}</span>
              </div>
            )}

            <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4 text-xs">
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <label className="font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">Judul Kegiatan *</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  required
                  value={formData.judul_dokumentasi}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, judul_dokumentasi: e.target.value })}
                  placeholder="Contoh: Sosialisasi Pemilu di Aula Utama"
                  className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-800 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 placeholder-zinc-500 focus:outline-hidden focus:border-zinc-500"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <label className="font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">Tanggal Kegiatan</label>
                <input
                  type="date"
                  value={formData.tanggal_dokumentasi}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, tanggal_dokumentasi: e.target.value })}
                  className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-800 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 focus:outline-hidden focus:border-zinc-500"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <label className="font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">Tautan Google Drive (Folder/File) *</label>
                <input
                  type="url"
                  required
                  value={formData.link_drive}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, link_drive: e.target.value })}
                  placeholder="https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/..."
                  className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-800 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 placeholder-zinc-500 focus:outline-hidden focus:border-zinc-500"
                />
                <p className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500">
                  Pastikan akses link Google Drive diset ke &quot;Siapa saja yang memiliki link dapat melihat&quot;.
                </p>
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <label className="font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">Deskripsi Singkat</label>
                <textarea
                  rows={3}
                  value={formData.deskripsi}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, deskripsi: e.target.value })}
                  placeholder="Keterangan agenda atau dokumentasi..."
                  className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-800 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 placeholder-zinc-500 focus:outline-hidden focus:border-zinc-500 resize-none"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="pt-3 border-t border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 flex items-center justify-end gap-3">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setModalOpen(false)}
                  className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-zinc-100 hover:bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 font-semibold cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Batal
                </button>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  disabled={submitting}
                  className="px-5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-zinc-900 hover:bg-zinc-800 text-white dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-white dark:text-zinc-950 disabled:opacity-50 font-bold shadow-xs cursor-pointer"
                >
                  {submitting ? 'Menyimpan...' : 'Simpan'}
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Preview Embed Modal */}
      {previewItem && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-xs">
          <div className="relative w-full max-w-4xl h-[80vh] bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 rounded-3xl overflow-hidden flex flex-col shadow-2xl">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-5 py-3 bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-black border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
              <span className="text-xs font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 truncate">{previewItem.judul_dokumentasi}</span>
              <button
                onClick={() => setPreviewItem(null)}
                className="p-1 rounded-lg text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-white cursor-pointer"
              >
                <X className="w-5 h-5" />
              </button>
            </div>
            <div className="flex-1 bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-black">
              <iframe
                src={getGoogleDriveEmbedUrl(previewItem.link_drive)}
                title={previewItem.judul_dokumentasi}
                className="w-full h-full border-none"
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```javascript
'use client';

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import {
  getPanitiaJadwalList,
  simpanJadwalAcara,
  hapusJadwalAcara,
} from '@/api/panitia/jadwal';
import { formatWaktuIndo } from '@/utils/dateUtils';
import {
  CalendarDays,
  Plus,
  Edit,
  Trash2,
  MapPin,
  Clock,
  X,
  AlertCircle,
  CheckCircle,
} from 'lucide-react';

export default function PanitiaJadwalPage() {
  const [jadwalList, setJadwalList] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [modalOpen, setModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [statusMsg, setStatusMsg] = useState({ success: null, text: '' });

  // Form State
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    id: null,
    judul_acara: '',
    tanggal_mulai: '',
    tanggal_selesai: '',
    lokasi: '',
    deskripsi: '',
    status: 'akan_datang',
  });

  const loadData = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    const res = await getPanitiaJadwalList();
    if (res.success) {
      setJadwalList(res.data || []);
    }
    setLoading(false);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadData();
  }, []);

  const openModal = (jadwal = null) => {
    setStatusMsg({ success: null, text: '' });
    if (jadwal) {
      // Format tanggal ke input datetime-local format (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm)
      const formatForInput = (isoStr) => {
        if (!isoStr) return '';
        const d = new Date(isoStr);
        return new Date(d.getTime() - d.getTimezoneOffset() * 60000).toISOString().slice(0, 16);
      };

      setFormData({
        id: jadwal.id,
        judul_acara: jadwal.judul_acara || '',
        tanggal_mulai: formatForInput(jadwal.tanggal_mulai),
        tanggal_selesai: formatForInput(jadwal.tanggal_selesai),
        lokasi: jadwal.lokasi || '',
        deskripsi: jadwal.deskripsi || '',
        status: jadwal.status || 'akan_datang',
      });
    } else {
      setFormData({
        id: null,
        judul_acara: '',
        tanggal_mulai: '',
        tanggal_selesai: '',
        lokasi: '',
        deskripsi: '',
        status: 'akan_datang',
      });
    }
    setModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setSubmitting(true);
    setStatusMsg({ success: null, text: '' });

    const payload = {
      ...formData,
      tanggal_mulai: formData.tanggal_mulai ? new Date(formData.tanggal_mulai).toISOString() : null,
      tanggal_selesai: formData.tanggal_selesai ? new Date(formData.tanggal_selesai).toISOString() : null,
    };

    const res = await simpanJadwalAcara(payload);
    if (res.success) {
      setModalOpen(false);
      loadData();
    } else {
      setStatusMsg({ success: false, text: res.error || 'Gagal menyimpan jadwal acara.' });
    }
    setSubmitting(false);
  };

  const handleDelete = async (id, judul) => {
    if (confirm(`Apakah Anda yakin ingin menghapus agenda "${judul}"?`)) {
      const res = await hapusJadwalAcara(id);
      if (res.success) {
        loadData();
      } else {
        alert(res.error || 'Gagal menghapus jadwal.');
      }
    }
  };

  const getStatusBadge = (status) => {
    switch (status) {
      case 'berlangsung':
        return (
          <span className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 dark:bg-blue-950/80 dark:text-blue-300 border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-900 text-[10px] font-bold">
            Sedang Berlangsung
          </span>
        );
      case 'selesai':
        return (
          <span className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-300 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 text-[10px] font-bold">
            Selesai
          </span>
        );
      default:
        return (
          <span className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 dark:bg-emerald-950/80 dark:text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-900 text-[10px] font-bold">
            Akan Datang
          </span>
        );
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 lg:p-8 space-y-6 max-w-7xl w-full mx-auto transition-colors">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 pb-4 border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
            Manajemen Jadwal Acara Pemilu
          </h1>
          <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
            Susun dan publikasikan agenda tahapan pemilu raya, sosialisasi, pendaftaran, hingga hari pemungutan suara.
          </p>
        </div>

        <button
          onClick={() => openModal()}
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-zinc-900 hover:bg-zinc-800 text-white dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-white dark:text-zinc-950 text-xs font-bold shadow-xs transition active:scale-95 cursor-pointer"
        >
          <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
          <span>Tambah Jadwal Acara</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Jadwal Cards Grid */}
      {loading ? (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
          {[1, 2, 3].map((n) => (
            <div key={n} className="h-44 rounded-3xl bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-900/50 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 animate-pulse" />
          ))}
        </div>
      ) : jadwalList.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="p-12 text-center rounded-3xl bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 max-w-md mx-auto space-y-3">
          <CalendarDays className="w-12 h-12 text-zinc-400 mx-auto" />
          <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">Belum Ada Agenda Terdaftar</h3>
          <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
            Klik tombol Tambah Jadwal Acara untuk menambahkan agenda kegiatan pemilu baru.
          </p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
          {jadwalList.map((j) => (
            <div
              key={j.id}
              className="p-6 rounded-3xl bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 flex flex-col justify-between space-y-4 shadow-xs hover:shadow-md transition-all"
            >
              <div className="space-y-3">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  {getStatusBadge(j.status)}
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <button
                      onClick={() => openModal(j)}
                      className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-white transition cursor-pointer"
                      title="Edit"
                    >
                      <Edit className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    </button>
                    <button
                      onClick={() => handleDelete(j.id, j.judul_acara)}
                      className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-zinc-500 hover:text-red-600 dark:hover:text-red-400 transition cursor-pointer"
                      title="Hapus"
                    >
                      <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <h3 className="text-base font-extrabold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 leading-snug">
                  {j.judul_acara}
                </h3>

                <div className="space-y-1.5 text-xs text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-zinc-500 shrink-0" />
                    <span>
                      {j.tanggal_mulai ? formatWaktuIndo(j.tanggal_mulai) : 'Waktu menyusul'}
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  {j.lokasi && (
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <MapPin className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-zinc-500 shrink-0" />
                      <span className="truncate">{j.lokasi}</span>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>

                {j.deskripsi && (
                  <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 line-clamp-3 leading-relaxed pt-1">
                    {j.deskripsi}
                  </p>
                )}
              </div>

              <div className="pt-3 border-t border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 text-[10px] text-zinc-400 font-mono">
                ID: {j.id.slice(0, 8)}...
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Modal Form Jadwal */}
      {modalOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-xs">
          <div className="relative w-full max-w-lg bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 rounded-3xl p-6 sm:p-8 space-y-6 max-h-[90vh] flex flex-col shadow-2xl transition-colors">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-4 border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 shrink-0">
              <h2 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
                {formData.id ? 'Edit Agenda Acara' : 'Tambah Agenda Acara Baru'}
              </h2>
              <button
                onClick={() => setModalOpen(false)}
                className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-white cursor-pointer"
              >
                <X className="w-5 h-5" />
              </button>
            </div>

            {statusMsg.text && (
              <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-950/40 border border-red-200 dark:border-red-900/60 text-xs text-red-800 dark:text-red-300 flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
                <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 text-red-500" />
                <span>{statusMsg.text}</span>
              </div>
            )}

            <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto space-y-4 text-xs pr-1">
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <label className="font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">Judul Agenda Kegiatan *</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  required
                  value={formData.judul_acara}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, judul_acara: e.target.value })}
                  placeholder="Contoh: Debat Terbuka Pasangan Calon Presma"
                  className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-800 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 placeholder-zinc-500 focus:outline-hidden focus:border-zinc-500"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                <div className="space-y-1.5">
                  <label className="font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">Tanggal & Waktu Mulai</label>
                  <input
                    type="datetime-local"
                    value={formData.tanggal_mulai}
                    onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, tanggal_mulai: e.target.value })}
                    className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-800 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 cursor-pointer"
                  />
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-1.5">
                  <label className="font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">Tanggal & Waktu Selesai</label>
                  <input
                    type="datetime-local"
                    value={formData.tanggal_selesai}
                    onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, tanggal_selesai: e.target.value })}
                    className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-800 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 cursor-pointer"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                <div className="space-y-1.5">
                  <label className="font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">Lokasi / Tempat</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={formData.lokasi}
                    onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, lokasi: e.target.value })}
                    placeholder="Contoh: Aula Kampus LP3I Lt. 3"
                    className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-800 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 placeholder-zinc-500 focus:outline-hidden focus:border-zinc-500"
                  />
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-1.5">
                  <label className="font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">Status Pelaksanaan</label>
                  <select
                    value={formData.status}
                    onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, status: e.target.value })}
                    className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-800 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <option value="akan_datang">Akan Datang</option>
                    <option value="berlangsung">Sedang Berlangsung</option>
                    <option value="selesai">Selesai</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <label className="font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">Deskripsi / Detail Acara</label>
                <textarea
                  rows={3}
                  value={formData.deskripsi}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, deskripsi: e.target.value })}
                  placeholder="Keterangan singkat mengenai agenda kegiatan..."
                  className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-800 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 placeholder-zinc-500 focus:outline-hidden focus:border-zinc-500 resize-none"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="pt-4 border-t border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 flex items-center justify-end gap-3 sticky bottom-0 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 py-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setModalOpen(false)}
                  className="px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-zinc-100 hover:bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 font-semibold transition cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Batal
                </button>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  disabled={submitting}
                  className="px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-zinc-900 hover:bg-zinc-800 text-white dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-white dark:text-zinc-950 disabled:opacity-50 font-bold transition shadow-xs cursor-pointer"
                >
                  {submitting ? 'Menyimpan...' : 'Simpan Agenda'}
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```javascript
'use client';

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import Image from 'next/image';
import {
  getPanitiaKandidatList,
  simpanKandidat,
  hapusKandidat,
  toggleEliminasiKandidat,
} from '@/api/panitia/kandidat';
import { uploadFotoKandidat } from '@/api/storage';
import ImageCropperModal from '@/components/panitia/ImageCropperModal';
import {
  Users,
  Plus,
  Edit,
  Trash2,
  UserCheck,
  GraduationCap,
  X,
  AlertCircle,
  CheckCircle2,
  XCircle,
  Phone,
  Mail,
  FileText,
  ChevronDown,
} from 'lucide-react';

export default function PanitiaKandidatPage() {
  const [kandidatList, setKandidatList] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [modalOpen, setModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [uploadingPhoto, setUploadingPhoto] = useState(false);
  const [statusMsg, setStatusMsg] = useState({ success: null, text: '' });
  const [updatingEliminatedId, setUpdatingEliminatedId] = useState(null);

  // State untuk Image Cropper Modal
  const [cropperModal, setCropperModal] = useState({
    isOpen: false,
    imageSrc: '',
    fileName: '',
    isPng: false,
    aspectRatio: 4 / 5,
    title: 'Verifikasi & Crop Foto Diri Kandidat',
    subtitle: 'Atur posisi dan perbesaran foto diri kandidat (rasio 4:5). File PNG transparan didukung penuh.',
  });

  // State Form
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    id: null,
    nama_kandidat: '',
    nim_kandidat: '',
    prodi_kandidat: '',
    posisi: 'Calon Presiden Mahasiswa',
    fotodiri_kandidat: '',
    is_eliminated: false,
    detail_kandidat_id: null,
    notlpn_wa_kandidat: '',
    emailplb_kandidat: '',
    cv_portofolio_kandidat: '',
    visi: '',
    misi: '',
  });

  const loadData = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    const res = await getPanitiaKandidatList();
    if (res.success) {
      setKandidatList(res.data || []);
    }
    setLoading(false);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadData();
  }, []);

  const openModal = (kandidat = null) => {
    setStatusMsg({ success: null, text: '' });
    if (kandidat) {
      setFormData({
        id: kandidat.id,
        nama_kandidat: kandidat.nama_kandidat || '',
        nim_kandidat: kandidat.nim_kandidat || '',
        prodi_kandidat: kandidat.prodi_kandidat || '',
        posisi: kandidat.posisi || 'Calon Presiden Mahasiswa',
        fotodiri_kandidat: kandidat.fotodiri_kandidat || '',
        is_eliminated: Boolean(kandidat.is_eliminated),
        detail_kandidat_id: kandidat.detail_kandidat_id || null,
        notlpn_wa_kandidat: kandidat.detail_kandidat?.notlpn_wa_kandidat || '',
        emailplb_kandidat: kandidat.detail_kandidat?.emailplb_kandidat || '',
        cv_portofolio_kandidat: kandidat.detail_kandidat?.cv_portofolio_kandidat || '',
        visi: kandidat.detail_kandidat?.visi || '',
        misi: kandidat.detail_kandidat?.misi || '',
      });
    } else {
      setFormData({
        id: null,
        nama_kandidat: '',
        nim_kandidat: '',
        prodi_kandidat: '',
        posisi: 'Calon Presiden Mahasiswa',
        fotodiri_kandidat: '',
        is_eliminated: false,
        detail_kandidat_id: null,
        notlpn_wa_kandidat: '',
        emailplb_kandidat: '',
        cv_portofolio_kandidat: '',
        visi: '',
        misi: '',
      });
    }
    setModalOpen(true);
  };

  // Handler saat admin memilih file gambar foto kandidat (buka cropper modal dulu)
  const handleSelectImageFile = (e) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;

    const isPng = file.type === 'image/png' || file.name.toLowerCase().endsWith('.png');
    const objectUrl = URL.createObjectURL(file);

    setCropperModal({
      isOpen: true,
      imageSrc: objectUrl,
      fileName: file.name,
      isPng,
      aspectRatio: 4 / 5,
      title: 'Verifikasi & Crop Foto Diri Kandidat',
      subtitle: 'Atur posisi dan perbesaran foto diri kandidat (rasio 4:5). File PNG transparan didukung penuh.',
    });

    // Reset input file agar dapat memilih file yang sama jika diinginkan
    e.target.value = '';
  };

  // Handler setelah konfirmasi crop di modal
  const handleCropComplete = async (croppedFile) => {
    setCropperModal((prev) => ({ ...prev, isOpen: false }));
    setUploadingPhoto(true);

    const body = new FormData();
    body.append('file', croppedFile);

    const res = await uploadFotoKandidat(body);
    if (res.success && res.url) {
      setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, fotodiri_kandidat: res.url }));
    } else {
      alert(res.error || 'Gagal mengompres dan mengunggah gambar kandidat.');
    }
    setUploadingPhoto(false);
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setSubmitting(true);
    setStatusMsg({ success: null, text: '' });

    const res = await simpanKandidat(formData);
    if (res.success) {
      setModalOpen(false);
      loadData();
    } else {
      setStatusMsg({ success: false, text: res.error || 'Gagal menyimpan data kandidat.' });
    }
    setSubmitting(false);
  };

  const handleDelete = async (id, fotoUrl) => {
    if (confirm('Apakah Anda yakin ingin menghapus kandidat ini? Data yang dihapus tidak dapat dipulihkan.')) {
      const res = await hapusKandidat(id, fotoUrl);
      if (res.success) {
        loadData();
      } else {
        alert(res.error || 'Gagal menghapus kandidat.');
      }
    }
  };

  const handleToggleEliminasi = async (id, currentValue) => {
    const nextValue = !currentValue;
    const confirmText = nextValue
      ? 'Apakah Anda yakin ingin MENYATAKAN ELIMINASI terhadap kandidat ini?'
      : 'Kembalikan status kandidat ini menjadi LOLOS SELEKSI / AKTIF?';

    if (!confirm(confirmText)) return;

    setUpdatingEliminatedId(id);
    const res = await toggleEliminasiKandidat(id, nextValue);
    if (res.success) {
      setKandidatList((prev) =>
        prev.map((item) => (item.id === id ? { ...item, is_eliminated: nextValue } : item))
      );
    } else {
      alert(res.error || 'Gagal memperbarui status eliminasi kandidat.');
    }
    setUpdatingEliminatedId(null);
  };

  return (
    <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 lg:p-8 space-y-6 max-w-7xl w-full mx-auto transition-colors">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 pb-4 border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
            Manajemen Kandidat Mahasiswa
          </h1>
          <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
            Kelola data calon presiden dan wakil presiden mahasiswa serta status verifikasi eliminasi.
          </p>
        </div>

        <button
          onClick={() => openModal()}
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-zinc-900 hover:bg-zinc-800 text-white dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-white dark:text-zinc-950 text-xs font-bold shadow-xs transition active:scale-95 cursor-pointer"
        >
          <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
          <span>Tambah Kandidat Baru</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Kandidat Table / Card List */}
      {loading ? (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
          {[1, 2, 3].map((n) => (
            <div key={n} className="h-64 rounded-3xl bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-900/50 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 animate-pulse" />
          ))}
        </div>
      ) : kandidatList.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="p-12 text-center rounded-3xl bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 max-w-md mx-auto space-y-3">
          <Users className="w-12 h-12 text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-600 mx-auto" />
          <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">Belum Ada Kandidat</h3>
          <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
            Klik tombol Tambah Kandidat untuk mendaftarkan calon baru ke sistem portal.
          </p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
          {kandidatList.map((k) => (
            <div
              key={k.id}
              className={`rounded-3xl bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 border transition-all overflow-hidden flex flex-col justify-between shadow-xs hover:shadow-lg ${
                k.is_eliminated
                  ? 'border-red-300 dark:border-red-900/60 opacity-90'
                  : 'border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800'
              }`}
            >
              {/* Foto Profile */}
              <div className="relative w-full aspect-4/3 bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-900">
                {k.fotodiri_kandidat ? (
                  <Image
                    src={k.fotodiri_kandidat}
                    alt={k.nama_kandidat}
                    fill
                    sizes="(max-width: 768px) 100vw, 33vw"
                    className="object-cover object-top"
                  />
                ) : (
                  <div className="w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-600">
                    <UserCheck className="w-12 h-12" />
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* Badge Posisi */}
                <div className="absolute top-3 left-3">
                  <span className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-white/90 dark:bg-black/90 backdrop-blur-md text-[10px] font-bold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 shadow-xs">
                    {k.posisi}
                  </span>
                </div>

                {/* Status Eliminasi Badge */}
                <div className="absolute top-3 right-3">
                  {k.is_eliminated ? (
                    <span className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-red-600 text-white text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider shadow-sm flex items-center gap-1">
                      <XCircle className="w-3 h-3" />
                      <span>Tereliminasi</span>
                    </span>
                  ) : (
                    <span className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-emerald-600 text-white text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider shadow-sm flex items-center gap-1">
                      <CheckCircle2 className="w-3 h-3" />
                      <span>Lolos Seleksi</span>
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Info Detail */}
              <div className="p-5 space-y-3 flex-1 flex flex-col justify-between">
                <div>
                  <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">{k.nama_kandidat}</h3>
                  <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 font-mono mt-0.5">NIM: {k.nim_kandidat}</p>
                  <p className="text-xs text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 flex items-center gap-1.5 mt-2">
                    <GraduationCap className="w-4 h-4 text-zinc-500" />
                    <span>{k.prodi_kandidat}</span>
                  </p>
                </div>

                {/* Dropdown Verifikasi Status Seleksi / Eliminasi */}
                <div className="pt-3 border-t border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800/80 space-y-2">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
                      Status Verifikasi:
                    </span>
                    <select
                      value={k.is_eliminated ? 'eliminated' : 'active'}
                      disabled={updatingEliminatedId === k.id}
                      onChange={() => handleToggleEliminasi(k.id, k.is_eliminated)}
                      className={`text-[11px] font-semibold rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1 border transition cursor-pointer ${
                        k.is_eliminated
                          ? 'bg-red-50 text-red-700 border-red-300 dark:bg-red-950/40 dark:text-red-300 dark:border-red-900/60'
                          : 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 border-emerald-300 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 dark:text-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-900/60'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <option value="active">Lolos Seleksi (Aktif)</option>
                      <option value="eliminated">Dieliminasi (Tidak Lolos)</option>
                    </select>
                  </div>

                  {/* Tombol Aksi Edit & Hapus */}
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 pt-1">
                    <button
                      onClick={() => openModal(k)}
                      className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-zinc-100 hover:bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 transition cursor-pointer"
                      title="Edit Data"
                    >
                      <Edit className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    </button>
                    <button
                      onClick={() => handleDelete(k.id, k.fotodiri_kandidat)}
                      className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-zinc-100 hover:bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 transition cursor-pointer"
                      title="Hapus Kandidat"
                    >
                      <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Modal Form Kandidat (Scrollable Popup) */}
      {modalOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-5 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-xs">
          <div className="relative w-full max-w-2xl bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 rounded-3xl p-5 sm:p-7 max-h-[90vh] flex flex-col shadow-2xl transition-colors">
            {/* Modal Header */}
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-4 border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 shrink-0">
              <div>
                <h2 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
                  {formData.id ? 'Edit Data Kandidat' : 'Tambah Kandidat Baru'}
                </h2>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-500">
                  Isi data lengkap kandidat beserta visi, misi, dan berkas portofolio.
                </p>
              </div>
              <button
                onClick={() => setModalOpen(false)}
                className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-white cursor-pointer"
              >
                <X className="w-5 h-5" />
              </button>
            </div>

            {statusMsg.text && (
              <div className="p-3 my-3 rounded-xl bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-950/40 border border-red-200 dark:border-red-900/60 text-xs text-red-800 dark:text-red-300 flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
                <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 text-red-500" />
                <span>{statusMsg.text}</span>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Scrollable Form Body */}
            <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto pr-1 sm:pr-2 py-4 space-y-4 text-xs">
              {/* Upload Foto Diri */}
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <label className="font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">
                  Foto Diri Kandidat (Otomatis Dikompres)
                </label>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                  {formData.fotodiri_kandidat ? (
                    <div className="relative w-16 h-16 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-700 shrink-0">
                      <Image
                        src={formData.fotodiri_kandidat}
                        alt="Preview Foto"
                        fill
                        className="object-cover"
                      />
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    <div className="w-16 h-16 rounded-2xl bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 flex items-center justify-center text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-600 shrink-0">
                      <UserCheck className="w-6 h-6" />
                    </div>
                  )}

                  <div className="flex-1">
                    <input
                      type="file"
                      accept="image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp"
                      onChange={handleSelectImageFile}
                      disabled={uploadingPhoto}
                      className="text-xs text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400 file:mr-3 file:py-1.5 file:px-3 file:rounded-xl file:border-0 file:text-xs file:font-semibold file:bg-zinc-900 file:text-white dark:file:bg-zinc-100 dark:file:text-zinc-950 cursor-pointer"
                    />
                    <p className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500 mt-1">
                      {uploadingPhoto ? 'Sedang mengompres gambar...' : 'Format didukung: JPG, PNG, WEBP. Maks 10MB.'}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                <div className="space-y-1.5">
                  <label className="font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">Nama Lengkap *</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    required
                    value={formData.nama_kandidat}
                    onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, nama_kandidat: e.target.value })}
                    placeholder="Nama Lengkap Kandidat"
                    className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-800 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 placeholder-zinc-500 focus:outline-hidden focus:border-zinc-500"
                  />
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-1.5">
                  <label className="font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">Nomor Induk Mahasiswa (NIM) *</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    required
                    value={formData.nim_kandidat}
                    onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, nim_kandidat: e.target.value })}
                    placeholder="Contoh: 2102001"
                    className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-800 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 placeholder-zinc-500 font-mono focus:outline-hidden focus:border-zinc-500"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                <div className="space-y-1.5">
                  <label className="font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">Program Studi *</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    required
                    value={formData.prodi_kandidat}
                    onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, prodi_kandidat: e.target.value })}
                    placeholder="Contoh: Manajemen Informatika"
                    className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-800 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 placeholder-zinc-500 focus:outline-hidden focus:border-zinc-500"
                  />
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-1.5">
                  <label className="font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">Posisi Pencalonan</label>
                  <select
                    value={formData.posisi}
                    onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, posisi: e.target.value })}
                    className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-800 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 focus:outline-hidden focus:border-zinc-500 cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <option value="Calon Presiden Mahasiswa">Calon Presiden Mahasiswa</option>
                    <option value="Calon Wakil Presiden Mahasiswa">Calon Wakil Presiden Mahasiswa</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Status Seleksi di Form */}
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <label className="font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">Status Seleksi Awal</label>

                >

            </form>

      )}

      {/* Image Cropper Modal */}
      <ImageCropperModal
        isOpen={cropperModal.isOpen}

        isPng={cropperModal.isPng}

        title={cropperModal.title}
        subtitle={cropperModal.subtitle}
        onConfirm={handleCropComplete}
        onClose={() => setCropperModal((prev) => ({ ...prev, isOpen: false }))}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

```javascript
'use client';

import { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import { getMhsDashboardStats, getPanitiaMhsList } from '@/api/panitia/mhs';
import { VALID_KELAS } from '@/lib/mhsConstants';
import {
  GraduationCap,
  CheckCircle2,
  Clock,
  RefreshCw,
  Search,
  UserCheck,
  UserX,
  PieChart as PieIcon,
  Activity,
  BarChart3,
  Filter,
  ChevronDown,
  Layers,
  BookOpen,
  Calendar,
} from 'lucide-react';

const DASH_MHS_CACHE_KEY = 'kpu_panitia_mhs_dash_cache';

export default function DashboardMhsPage() {
  const [stats, setStats] = useState(null);
  const [mhsList, setMhsList] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');

  // Filter States
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('belum'); // 'semua' | 'belum' | 'sudah'
  const [kelasFilter, setKelasFilter] = useState('semua');
  const [angkatanFilter, setAngkatanFilter] = useState('semua');
  const [prodiFilter, setProdiFilter] = useState('semua');

  // State untuk Dropdown Filter UL/LI
  const [openDropdown, setOpenDropdown] = useState(null); // 'status' | 'kelas' | 'angkatan' | 'prodi'

  const loadData = async (forceRefresh = false) => {
    setLoading(true);

    if (!forceRefresh) {
      try {
        const cached = localStorage.getItem(DASH_MHS_CACHE_KEY);
        if (cached) {
          const parsed = JSON.parse(cached);
          if (parsed?.stats && Array.isArray(parsed?.list)) {
            setStats(parsed.stats);
            setMhsList(parsed.list);
            setLoading(false);
            return;
          }
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    const [statRes, listRes] = await Promise.all([
      getMhsDashboardStats(),
      getPanitiaMhsList({ search: '', statusFilter: 'semua' }),
    ]);

    let newStats = null;
    let newList = [];

    if (statRes.success) {
      newStats = statRes.stats;
      setStats(newStats);
    }
    if (listRes.success) {
      newList = listRes.data || [];
      setMhsList(newList);
    }

    try {
      if (newStats && newList) {
        localStorage.setItem(
          DASH_MHS_CACHE_KEY,
          JSON.stringify({ stats: newStats, list: newList })
        );
      }
    } catch (e) {}

    setLoading(false);
  };

  // Setup Lifecycle Caching & Reset saat Pindah Tab (Pola AdminPresenceTracker)
  useEffect(() => {
    loadData(false);

    const clearCache = () => {
      try {
        localStorage.removeItem(DASH_MHS_CACHE_KEY);
      } catch (e) {}
    };

    const handleVisibilityChange = () => {
      if (document.visibilityState !== 'visible') {
        clearCache();
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener('visibilitychange', handleVisibilityChange);
    window.addEventListener('pagehide', clearCache);
    window.addEventListener('beforeunload', clearCache);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', handleVisibilityChange);
      window.removeEventListener('pagehide', clearCache);
      window.removeEventListener('beforeunload', clearCache);
      clearCache();
    };
  }, []);

  // Tutup dropdown jika klik di luar
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleOutsideClick = (e) => {
      if (!e.target.closest('.dropdown-filter-container')) {
        setOpenDropdown(null);
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener('click', handleOutsideClick);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('click', handleOutsideClick);
  }, []);

  // Opsi Angkatan dan Prodi Unik
  const angkatanOptions = useMemo(() => {
    const set = new Set();
    mhsList.forEach((m) => {
      if (m.angkatan && m.angkatan !== '-') set.add(m.angkatan);
    });
    return Array.from(set).sort();
  }, [mhsList]);

  const prodiOptions = useMemo(() => {
    const set = new Set();
    mhsList.forEach((m) => {
      if (m.prodi && m.prodi !== '-') set.add(m.prodi);
    });
    return Array.from(set).sort();
  }, [mhsList]);

  // Data Terfilter Dinamis di Sisi Klien
  const filteredMhsList = useMemo(() => {
    return mhsList.filter((m) => {
      if (search.trim()) {
        const term = search.toLowerCase();
        const matchName = m.nama_mhs?.toLowerCase().includes(term);
        const matchNim = m.nim?.toLowerCase().includes(term);
        const matchKode = m.kode_voting?.toLowerCase().includes(term);
        if (!matchName && !matchNim && !matchKode) return false;
      }

      if (activeTab === 'sudah' && !m.has_voted) return false;
      if (activeTab === 'belum' && m.has_voted) return false;

      if (kelasFilter !== 'semua' && m.kelas !== kelasFilter) return false;
      if (angkatanFilter !== 'semua' && m.angkatan !== angkatanFilter) return false;
      if (prodiFilter !== 'semua' && m.prodi !== prodiFilter) return false;

      return true;
    });
  }, [mhsList, search, activeTab, kelasFilter, angkatanFilter, prodiFilter]);

  // Kalkulasi Analisis Dinamis Berdasarkan Data Keseluruhan atau Filter Aktif
  const dynamicAnalysis = useMemo(() => {
    const list = mhsList;
    const total = list.length;
    const sudah = list.filter((m) => m.has_voted).length;
    const belum = total - sudah;
    const persen = total > 0 ? ((sudah / total) * 100).toFixed(1) : 0;

    // Per Kelas
    const perKelas = {};
    VALID_KELAS.forEach((k) => {
      perKelas[k] = { total: 0, sudah: 0, belum: 0, persen: 0 };
    });
    list.forEach((m) => {
      const k = VALID_KELAS.includes(m.kelas) ? m.kelas : 'Reg';
      perKelas[k].total += 1;
      if (m.has_voted) perKelas[k].sudah += 1;
      else perKelas[k].belum += 1;
    });
    Object.keys(perKelas).forEach((k) => {
      const t = perKelas[k].total;
      perKelas[k].persen = t > 0 ? ((perKelas[k].sudah / t) * 100).toFixed(1) : 0;
    });

    // Per Angkatan (Top 6)
    const perAngkatan = {};
    list.forEach((m) => {
      const ang = m.angkatan || '-';
      if (!perAngkatan[ang]) perAngkatan[ang] = { total: 0, sudah: 0, belum: 0, persen: 0 };
      perAngkatan[ang].total += 1;
      if (m.has_voted) perAngkatan[ang].sudah += 1;
      else perAngkatan[ang].belum += 1;
    });
    Object.keys(perAngkatan).forEach((a) => {
      const t = perAngkatan[a].total;
      perAngkatan[a].persen = t > 0 ? ((perAngkatan[a].sudah / t) * 100).toFixed(1) : 0;
    });

    // Per Prodi
    const perProdi = {};
    list.forEach((m) => {
      const p = m.prodi || '-';
      if (!perProdi[p]) perProdi[p] = { total: 0, sudah: 0, belum: 0, persen: 0 };
      perProdi[p].total += 1;
      if (m.has_voted) perProdi[p].sudah += 1;
      else perProdi[p].belum += 1;
    });
    Object.keys(perProdi).forEach((p) => {
      const t = perProdi[p].total;
      perProdi[p].persen = t > 0 ? ((perProdi[p].sudah / t) * 100).toFixed(1) : 0;
    });

    return {
      total,
      sudah,
      belum,
      persen,
      perKelas,
      perAngkatan,
      perProdi,
    };
  }, [mhsList]);

  return (
    <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 lg:p-8 space-y-6 max-w-7xl w-full mx-auto transition-colors">
      {/* Header Dashboard Mhs (Warna Netral) */}

          <table className="w-full text-left text-xs">
            <thead className="bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900/80 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
              <tr>
                <th className="py-3 px-4 font-semibold">Nama Mahasiswa</th>
                <th className="py-3 px-3 font-semibold">NIM</th>
                <th className="py-3 px-3 font-semibold">Kelas</th>
                <th className="py-3 px-3 font-semibold">Angkatan</th>
                <th className="py-3 px-3 font-semibold">Program Studi</th>
                <th className="py-3 px-3 font-semibold">Status</th>
                <th className="py-3 px-4 font-semibold text-right">Waktu Memilih</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody className="divide-y divide-zinc-100 dark:divide-zinc-800/60 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">
              {filteredMhsList.length === 0 ? (
                <tr>
                  <td colSpan={7} className="py-10 text-center text-zinc-400">
                    Tidak ada data mahasiswa yang cocok dengan kriteria filter.
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ) : (
                filteredMhsList.slice(0, 100).map((m) => (
                  <tr key={m.id} className="hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-900/40 transition">
                    <td className="py-3 px-4 font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
                      {m.nama_mhs}
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-3 px-3 font-mono">{m.nim}</td>
                    <td className="py-3 px-3">
                      <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 font-semibold text-[10px]">
                        {m.kelas || 'Reg'}
                      </span>
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-3 px-3 font-mono font-medium">
                      {m.angkatan || '-'}
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-3 px-3 font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">
                      {m.prodi || '-'}
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-3 px-3">
                      {m.has_voted ? (
                        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-zinc-900 text-white dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-950 text-[10px] font-semibold">
                          <CheckCircle2 className="w-3 h-3" />
                          Sudah Voting
                        </span>
                      ) : (
                        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 text-[10px] font-semibold">
                          Belum Memilih
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-3 px-4 text-right text-zinc-500 font-mono text-[11px]">
                      {m.voting_at
                        ? new Date(m.voting_at).toLocaleString('id-ID', {
                            day: 'numeric',
                            month: 'short',
                            hour: '2-digit',
                            minute: '2-digit',
                          })
                        : '-'}
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))
              )}
            </tbody>
          </table>
          {filteredMhsList.length > 100 && (
            <div className="p-3 bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900/50 border-t border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400">
              Menampilkan 100 data pertama dari total {filteredMhsList.length} mahasiswa tersaring.
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```
