```javascript
'use client';

import { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { getSekretarisDashboardData } from '@/api/panitia/absensi';
import { formatWaktuIndo } from '@/utils/dateUtils';
import {
  ClipboardList,
  UserCheck,
  CheckCircle2,
  Clock,
  AlertTriangle,
  XCircle,
  TrendingUp,
  Calendar,
  ArrowRight,
  RefreshCw,
  PieChart as PieChartIcon,
  BarChart2,
} from 'lucide-react';

import {
  Chart as ChartJS,
  CategoryScale,
  LinearScale,
  BarElement,
  ArcElement,
  Title,
  Tooltip,
  Legend,
} from 'chart.js';
import { Bar, Doughnut } from 'react-chartjs-2';

ChartJS.register(
  CategoryScale,
  LinearScale,
  BarElement,
  ArcElement,
  Title,
  Tooltip,
  Legend
);

const STORAGE_KEY = 'panitia_sekretaris_dashboard_data';

export default function SekretarisDashboardPage() {
  const [data, setData] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  // 1 Query GET saat inisialisasi + simpan ke localStorage
  const loadDashboardData = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      // Ambil cache lokal dulu jika ada
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
        const cached = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
        if (cached) {
          try {
            const parsed = JSON.parse(cached);
            if (parsed && parsed.judulList) {
              setData(parsed);
              setLoading(false);
            }
          } catch (e) {}
        }
      }

      // 1 Panggilan Server Action GET
      const res = await getSekretarisDashboardData();
      if (res.success && res.data) {
        setData(res.data);
        if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
          localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(res.data));
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Gagal mengambil data dashboard sekretaris:', err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadDashboardData();
  }, []);

  // Agregasi Statistik di Client-Side
  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    if (!data) {
      return {
        totalJudul: 0,
        totalPanitia: 0,
        totalAbsensi: 0,
        hadir: 0,
        izin: 0,
        sakit: 0,
        alpha: 0,
        tepatWaktu: 0,
        terlambat: 0,
        persentaseHadir: 0,
      };
    }

    const totalJudul = data.judulList?.length || 0;
    const totalPanitia = data.totalPanitia || 0;
    const absensiList = data.absensiList || [];
    const totalAbsensi = absensiList.length;

    let hadir = 0;
    let izin = 0;
    let sakit = 0;
    let alpha = 0;
    let tepatWaktu = 0;
    let terlambat = 0;

    absensiList.forEach((a) => {
      if (a.jenis_absensi === 'hadir') hadir++;
      else if (a.jenis_absensi === 'izin') izin++;
      else if (a.jenis_absensi === 'sakit') sakit++;
      else if (a.jenis_absensi === 'alpha') alpha++;

      if (a.keterlambatan === 'tepat_waktu') tepatWaktu++;
      else if (a.keterlambatan === 'terlambat') terlambat++;
    });

    const persentaseHadir = totalAbsensi > 0 ? Math.round((hadir / totalAbsensi) * 100) : 0;

    return {
      totalJudul,
      totalPanitia,
      totalAbsensi,
      hadir,
      izin,
      sakit,
      alpha,
      tepatWaktu,
      terlambat,
      persentaseHadir,
    };
  }, [data]);

  // Data Bar Chart: Rekap 5 Agenda Terakhir (Aksen Blue 5-10%, Netral)
  const barChartData = useMemo(() => {
    if (!data || !data.judulList || data.judulList.length === 0) {
      return {
        labels: [],
        datasets: [],
      };
    }

    // Ambil maksimal 5 agenda terbaru
    const recentJudul = [...data.judulList].slice(0, 5).reverse();
    const labels = recentJudul.map((j) => {
      const title = j.judul_absensi_panitia || 'Agenda';
      return title.length > 18 ? title.slice(0, 18) + '...' : title;
    });

    const hadirCounts = [];
    const lainnyaCounts = [];

    recentJudul.forEach((j) => {
      const items = (data.absensiList || []).filter((a) => a.judul_absensi_panitia_id === j.id);
      const hadir = items.filter((a) => a.jenis_absensi === 'hadir').length;
      const lainnya = items.filter((a) => a.jenis_absensi !== 'hadir').length;
      hadirCounts.push(hadir);
      lainnyaCounts.push(lainnya);
    });

    return {
      labels,
      datasets: [
        {
          label: 'Hadir',
          data: hadirCounts,
          backgroundColor: '#2563eb', // Blue-600
          borderRadius: 6,
        },
        {
          label: 'Izin / Sakit / Alpha',
          data: lainnyaCounts,
          backgroundColor: '#71717a', // Zinc-500
          borderRadius: 6,
        },
      ],
    };
  }, [data]);

  // Data Doughnut Chart: Komposisi Jenis Kehadiran
  const doughnutChartData = useMemo(() => {
    return {
      labels: ['Hadir', 'Izin', 'Sakit', 'Alpha'],
      datasets: [
        {
          data: [stats.hadir, stats.izin, stats.sakit, stats.alpha],
          backgroundColor: [
            '#2563eb', // Hadir (Blue-600)
            '#a1a1aa', // Izin (Zinc-400)
            '#71717a', // Sakit (Zinc-500)
            '#3f3f46', // Alpha (Zinc-700)
          ],
          borderColor: '#18181b',
          borderWidth: 1,
        },
      ],
    };
  }, [stats]);

  // Absensi Terbaru (5 item)
  const recentAbsensi = useMemo(() => {
    if (!data || !data.absensiList) return [];
    return data.absensiList.slice(0, 5);
  }, [data]);

  return (
    <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 lg:p-8 space-y-6 max-w-7xl w-full mx-auto transition-colors">
      {/* Header Dashboard */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 pb-4 border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
              Dashboard Sekretaris
            </h1>
            <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 text-[10px] font-bold">
              Presensi & Notulensi
            </span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 mt-1">
            Ringkasan data kehadiran panitia, rekapitulasi agenda rapat, dan evaluasi kedisiplinan.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <button
            onClick={loadDashboardData}
            disabled={loading}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 text-xs font-semibold shadow-xs transition cursor-pointer"
            title="Muat Ulang Data"
          >
            <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${loading ? 'animate-spin text-blue-600' : ''}`} />
            <span className="hidden sm:inline">Refresh</span>
          </button>

          <Link
            href="/panitia/sekretaris/absensi"
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-zinc-900 hover:bg-zinc-800 text-white dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-white dark:text-zinc-950 text-xs font-bold shadow-xs transition active:scale-95"
          >
            <UserCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-400 dark:text-blue-600" />
            <span>Kelola Absensi</span>
          </Link>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 4 Stat Cards Utama (Warna Netral Zinc + Aksen Blue 5-10%) */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
        {/* Card 1: Total Agenda Absensi */}
        <div className="p-5 rounded-3xl bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 shadow-xs hover:shadow-md transition">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-zinc-500 uppercase tracking-wider">
              Total Agenda
            </span>
            <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-900 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 flex items-center justify-center border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
              <ClipboardList className="w-4 h-4" />
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="mt-3">
            <span className="text-2xl font-black text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
              {loading && !data ? '...' : stats.totalJudul}
            </span>
            <span className="text-xs text-zinc-400 ml-1.5 font-medium">Sesi Kegiatan</span>
          </div>
          <div className="mt-3 pt-3 border-t border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-900 flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] text-zinc-500">
            <span>Daftar agenda aktif</span>
            <Link
              href="/panitia/sekretaris/judul-absensi"
              className="text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 font-semibold hover:underline inline-flex items-center gap-0.5"
            >
              Lihat <ArrowRight className="w-3 h-3" />
            </Link>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Card 2: Total Absensi Tercatat */}
        <div className="p-5 rounded-3xl bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 shadow-xs hover:shadow-md transition">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-zinc-500 uppercase tracking-wider">
              Total Presensi
            </span>
            <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 flex items-center justify-center border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
              <UserCheck className="w-4 h-4" />
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="mt-3">
            <span className="text-2xl font-black text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
              {loading && !data ? '...' : stats.totalAbsensi}
            </span>
            <span className="text-xs text-zinc-400 ml-1.5 font-medium">Data Kehadiran</span>
          </div>
          <div className="mt-3 pt-3 border-t border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-900 flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] text-zinc-500">
            <span>Dari seluruh agenda</span>
            <span className="font-mono text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">
              {stats.totalPanitia} Panitia Terdata
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Card 3: Rata-Rata Kehadiran */}
        <div className="p-5 rounded-3xl bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 shadow-xs hover:shadow-md transition">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">

            <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-900 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 flex items-center justify-center border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">

          <div className="mt-3">

          </div>
          <div className="mt-3 pt-3 border-t border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-900 flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] text-zinc-500">

        {/* Card 4: Kedisiplinan Waktu */}
        <div className="p-5 rounded-3xl bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 shadow-xs hover:shadow-md transition">

              <Clock className="w-4 h-4" />
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="mt-3">
            <span className="text-2xl font-black text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
              {loading && !data ? '...' : stats.tepatWaktu}
            </span>
            <span className="text-xs text-zinc-400 ml-1.5 font-medium">Tepat Waktu</span>
          </div>
          <div className="mt-3 pt-3 border-t border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-900 flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] text-zinc-500">
            <span>Terlambat</span>
            <span className="font-bold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">
              {stats.terlambat} Panitia
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Bar Chart & Doughnut Chart */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
        {/* Kolom 1 & 2: Bar Chart Perbandingan per Agenda */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-2 p-5 sm:p-6 rounded-3xl bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 shadow-xs space-y-4">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <BarChart2 className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400" />
              <h2 className="text-xs font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 uppercase tracking-wider">
                Partisipasi 5 Agenda Terakhir
              </h2>
            </div>
            <span className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400">Hadir vs Tidak Hadir</span>
          </div>

          {stats.totalJudul === 0 ? (
            <div className="h-60 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-zinc-400 text-xs space-y-2">
              <ClipboardList className="w-8 h-8" />
              <p>Belum ada data agenda yang dibuat.</p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="h-64 w-full">
              <Bar
                data={barChartData}
                options={{
                  responsive: true,
                  maintainAspectRatio: false,
                  plugins: {
                    legend: {
                      position: 'top',
                      labels: {
                        boxWidth: 12,
                        font: { size: 11 },
                        color: '#a1a1aa',
                      },
                    },
                    tooltip: {
                      backgroundColor: '#18181b',
                      titleColor: '#ffffff',
                      bodyColor: '#e4e4e7',
                      borderColor: '#27272a',
                      borderWidth: 1,
                    },
                  },
                  scales: {
                    x: {
                      grid: { display: false },
                      ticks: { font: { size: 10 }, color: '#a1a1aa' },
                    },
                    y: {
                      beginAtZero: true,
                      ticks: { stepSize: 1, font: { size: 10 }, color: '#a1a1aa' },
                      grid: { color: 'rgba(161, 161, 170, 0.1)' },
                    },
                  },
                }}
              />
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Kolom 3: Doughnut Chart Status Kehadiran */}
        <div className="p-5 sm:p-6 rounded-3xl bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 shadow-xs space-y-4">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <PieChartIcon className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400" />
              <h2 className="text-xs font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 uppercase tracking-wider">
                Proporsi Kehadiran
              </h2>
            </div>
          </div>

          {stats.totalAbsensi === 0 ? (
            <div className="h-60 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-zinc-400 text-xs space-y-2">
              <UserCheck className="w-8 h-8" />
              <p>Belum ada rekaman kehadiran.</p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <div className="h-44 w-full relative">
                <Doughnut
                  data={doughnutChartData}
                  options={{
                    responsive: true,
                    maintainAspectRatio: false,
                    plugins: {
                      legend: { display: false },
                      tooltip: {
                        backgroundColor: '#18181b',
                        titleColor: '#ffffff',
                        bodyColor: '#e4e4e7',
                      },
                    },
                    cutout: '70%',
                  }}
                />
                <div className="absolute inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center pointer-events-none">
                  <span className="text-xl font-black text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
                    {stats.totalAbsensi}
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400">Total Absen</span>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Legend List */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-xs">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 p-2 rounded-xl bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900/50 border border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800">
                  <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-blue-600 shrink-0" />
                  <div className="truncate">
                    <p className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400">Hadir</p>
                    <p className="font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">{stats.hadir}</p>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 p-2 rounded-xl bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900/50 border border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800">
                  <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-zinc-400 shrink-0" />
                  <div className="truncate">
                    <p className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400">Izin</p>
                    <p className="font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">{stats.izin}</p>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 p-2 rounded-xl bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900/50 border border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800">
                  <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-zinc-500 shrink-0" />
                  <div className="truncate">
                    <p className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400">Sakit</p>
                    <p className="font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">{stats.sakit}</p>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 p-2 rounded-xl bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900/50 border border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800">
                  <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-zinc-700 shrink-0" />
                  <div className="truncate">
                    <p className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400">Alpha</p>
                    <p className="font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">{stats.alpha}</p>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Tabel 5 Rekaman Absensi Terakhir */}
      <div className="rounded-3xl bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 overflow-hidden shadow-xs">
        <div className="p-4 sm:p-5 border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Clock className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400" />
            <h2 className="text-xs font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 uppercase tracking-wider">
              Aktivitas Absensi Terbaru
            </h2>
          </div>
          <Link
            href="/panitia/sekretaris/absensi"
            className="text-xs text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 font-semibold hover:underline inline-flex items-center gap-1"
          >
            Buka Halaman Absensi <ArrowRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          </Link>
        </div>

        {recentAbsensi.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="p-8 text-center text-zinc-400 text-xs">
            Belum ada rekaman kehadiran terbaru.
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full text-left text-xs">
              <thead className="bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900/80 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
                <tr>
                  <th className="py-3 px-5 font-semibold">Agenda Kegiatan</th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-4 font-semibold">Nama Panitia</th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-4 font-semibold">Status Kehadiran</th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-4 font-semibold">Ketepatan</th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-4 font-semibold">Waktu Tercatat</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-zinc-100 dark:divide-zinc-800/60 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">
                {recentAbsensi.map((item) => (
                  <tr key={item.id} className="hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-900/40 transition">
                    <td className="py-3 px-5 font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
                      {item.judul_absensi_panitia?.judul_absensi_panitia || 'Agenda Rapat'}
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-3 px-4">
                      {item.panitia?.nama_panitia || 'Panitia'}
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-3 px-4">
                      <span
                        className={`px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider border ${
                          item.jenis_absensi === 'hadir'
                            ? 'bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-900 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800'
                            : 'bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400 border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800'
                        }`}
                      >
                        {item.jenis_absensi}
                      </span>
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-3 px-4 text-zinc-500">
                      {item.keterlambatan === 'tepat_waktu'
                        ? 'Tepat Waktu'
                        : item.keterlambatan === 'terlambat'
                        ? 'Terlambat'
                        : 'Tidak Hadir'}
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-3 px-4 font-mono text-[11px] text-zinc-400">
                      {item.created_at ? formatWaktuIndo(item.created_at) : '-'}
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```javascript
'use client';

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import {
  getPanitiaTrafikData,
  hapusSemuaTrafik,
  hapusTrafikPerTanggal,
  hapusTrafikLebihLamaDari,
  simpanTrafikSetting,
} from '@/api/panitia/trafik';
import { formatWaktuIndo } from '@/utils/dateUtils';
import {
  Activity,
  Trash2,
  Calendar,
  Settings,
  RefreshCw,
  AlertTriangle,
  MapPin,
  Check,
  Clock,
  Filter,
} from 'lucide-react';

export default function PanitiaTrafikPage() {
  const [trafikList, setTrafikList] = useState([]);
  const [totalRecords, setTotalRecords] = useState(0);
  const [filterDate, setFilterDate] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [actionLoading, setActionLoading] = useState(false);

  // Auto-delete settings
  const [autoDeleteEnabled, setAutoDeleteEnabled] = useState(false);
  const [intervalHari, setIntervalHari] = useState(7);
  const [manualInterval, setManualInterval] = useState(7);
  const [settingSavedMsg, setSettingSavedMsg] = useState('');

  const loadData = async (date = filterDate) => {
    setLoading(true);
    const res = await getPanitiaTrafikData(date || null);
    if (res.success) {
      setTrafikList(res.data || []);
      setTotalRecords(res.total || 0);
      if (res.setting) {
        setAutoDeleteEnabled(Boolean(res.setting.auto_delete_enabled));
        setIntervalHari(res.setting.interval_hari || 7);
      }
    }
    setLoading(false);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadData();
  }, []);

  const handleFilterChange = (e) => {
    const val = e.target.value;
    setFilterDate(val);
    loadData(val);
  };

  const handleResetFilter = () => {
    setFilterDate('');
    loadData('');
  };

  const handleHapusSemua = async () => {
    if (
      confirm(
        'PERINGATAN: Apakah Anda yakin ingin MENGHAPUS SELURUH data trafik kunjungan? Tindakan ini tidak dapat dibatalkan.'
      )
    ) {
      setActionLoading(true);
      const res = await hapusSemuaTrafik();
      if (res.success) {
        alert(res.message);
        loadData();
      } else {
        alert(res.error || 'Gagal menghapus data.');
      }
      setActionLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleHapusPerTanggal = async () => {
    if (!filterDate) {
      alert('Silakan pilih tanggal terlebih dahulu pada kolom filter tanggal.');
      return;
    }
    if (confirm(`Hapus seluruh catatan log kunjungan pada tanggal ${filterDate}?`)) {
      setActionLoading(true);
      const res = await hapusTrafikPerTanggal(filterDate);
      if (res.success) {
        alert(res.message);
        loadData();
      } else {
        alert(res.error || 'Gagal menghapus data per tanggal.');
      }
      setActionLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleManualCleanInterval = async () => {
    if (
      confirm(
        `Bersihkan seluruh data trafik yang lebih lama dari ${manualInterval} hari yang lalu?`
      )
    ) {
      setActionLoading(true);
      const res = await hapusTrafikLebihLamaDari(manualInterval);
      if (res.success) {
        alert(res.message);
        loadData();
      } else {
        alert(res.error || 'Gagal membersihkan data.');
      }
      setActionLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSaveSetting = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setActionLoading(true);
    setSettingSavedMsg('');
    const res = await simpanTrafikSetting(autoDeleteEnabled, intervalHari);
    if (res.success) {
      setSettingSavedMsg('Pengaturan auto-delete berhasil disimpan.');
      setTimeout(() => setSettingSavedMsg(''), 4000);
      loadData();
    } else {
      alert(res.error || 'Gagal menyimpan pengaturan.');
    }
    setActionLoading(false);
  };

  return (
    <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 lg:p-8 space-y-6 max-w-7xl w-full mx-auto transition-colors">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 pb-4 border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
            Manajemen Data Lalu Lintas (Trafik)
          </h1>
          <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
            Kelola, reset manual, dan atur jadwal pembersihan otomatis riwayat kunjungan agar database tetap ringan.
          </p>
        </div>

        <button
          onClick={() => loadData()}
          disabled={loading || actionLoading}
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-900 hover:bg-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 transition active:scale-95 cursor-pointer"
        >
          <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${loading ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
          <span>Segarkan Data</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Grid Konfigurasi & Aksi Pembersihan */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
        {/* Kolom Kiri: Form Auto-Delete & Hapus Manual */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-5 space-y-6">
          {/* Card Pengaturan Auto-Delete */}
          <div className="p-6 rounded-3xl bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 space-y-4 shadow-xs">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
              <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-blue-50 dark:bg-zinc-900 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-400 flex items-center justify-center">
                <Settings className="w-4 h-4" />
              </div>
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
                  Pembersihan Otomatis (Auto-Delete)
                </h3>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-500">
                  Jadwalkan pembersihan otomatis berkala di latar belakang
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            {settingSavedMsg && (
              <div className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 dark:bg-emerald-950/50 dark:text-emerald-300 text-xs flex items-center gap-2 border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-900/60">
                <Check className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600 shrink-0" />
                <span>{settingSavedMsg}</span>
              </div>
            )}

            <form onSubmit={handleSaveSetting} className="space-y-4 text-xs">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-3 rounded-2xl bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900/60 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
                <div>
                  <span className="font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 block">
                    Mode Otomatis
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-[11px] text-zinc-500">
                    {autoDeleteEnabled ? 'Aktif (Otomatis dibersihkan)' : 'Nonaktif (Manual saja)'}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setAutoDeleteEnabled(!autoDeleteEnabled)}
                  className={`w-12 h-6 flex items-center rounded-full p-1 transition cursor-pointer ${
                    autoDeleteEnabled ? 'bg-blue-600 justify-end' : 'bg-zinc-300 dark:bg-zinc-700 justify-start'
                  }`}
                >
                  <span className="w-4 h-4 rounded-full bg-white shadow-md" />
                </button>
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <label className="font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">
                  Interval Pembersihan Otomatis
                </label>
                <select
                  value={intervalHari}
                  onChange={(e) => setIntervalHari(parseInt(e.target.value, 10))}
                  disabled={!autoDeleteEnabled}
                  className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-800 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 disabled:opacity-50 focus:outline-hidden cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <option value={3}>Hapus data lebih dari 3 hari yang lalu</option>
                  <option value={5}>Hapus data lebih dari 5 hari yang lalu</option>
                  <option value={7}>Hapus data lebih dari 7 hari yang lalu (1 Pekan)</option>
                  <option value={14}>Hapus data lebih dari 14 hari yang lalu (2 Pekan)</option>
                  <option value={30}>Hapus data lebih dari 30 hari yang lalu (1 Bulan)</option>
                </select>
                <p className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500">
                  Data yang melewati batas hari di atas akan otomatis dipangkas saat sistem aktif.
                </p>
              </div>

              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={actionLoading}
                className="w-full py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-zinc-900 hover:bg-zinc-800 text-white dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-white dark:text-zinc-950 font-bold transition shadow-xs cursor-pointer"
              >
                {actionLoading ? 'Menyimpan...' : 'Simpan Pengaturan'}
              </button>
            </form>
          </div>

          {/* Card Pembersihan Manual */}
          <div className="p-6 rounded-3xl bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 space-y-4 shadow-xs">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
              <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-red-50 dark:bg-zinc-900 text-red-600 dark:text-red-400 flex items-center justify-center">
                <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
              </div>
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
                  Aksi Pembersihan Manual
                </h3>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-500">
                  Format instan seluruh data atau berdasarkan rentang
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-3 pt-1 text-xs">
              {/* Bersihkan data lebih lama dari X hari */}
              <div className="space-y-1.5 p-3 rounded-2xl bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900/60 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
                <label className="font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 block">
                  Pangkas Riwayat Lama (Manual):
                </label>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <select
                    value={manualInterval}
                    onChange={(e) => setManualInterval(parseInt(e.target.value, 10))}
                    className="flex-1 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-800 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <option value={3}>Lebih dari 3 hari lalu</option>
                    <option value={5}>Lebih dari 5 hari lalu</option>
                    <option value={7}>Lebih dari 7 hari lalu</option>
                    <option value={14}>Lebih dari 14 hari lalu</option>
                  </select>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={handleManualCleanInterval}
                    disabled={actionLoading}
                    className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-zinc-200 hover:bg-zinc-300 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:bg-zinc-700 text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 font-semibold transition cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    Bersihkan
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Hapus Semua Data */}
              <div className="pt-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleHapusSemua}
                  disabled={actionLoading || totalRecords === 0}
                  className="w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-700 text-white font-bold transition shadow-xs cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
                >
                  <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4" />
                  <span>Format Seluruh Data Trafik (Reset)</span>
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Kolom Kanan: Tabel Log Trafik & Filter Per Tanggal */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-7 space-y-4">
          {/* Card Filter Bar */}
          <div className="p-4 rounded-3xl bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 shadow-xs">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Calendar className="w-4 h-4 text-zinc-500" />
              <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">
                Filter Tanggal:
              </span>
              <input
                type="date"
                value={filterDate}
                onChange={handleFilterChange}
                className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-800 text-xs text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 cursor-pointer"
              />
              {filterDate && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleResetFilter}
                  className="text-xs text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 font-semibold hover:underline"
                >
                  Reset
                </button>
              )}
            </div>

            {filterDate && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleHapusPerTanggal}
                disabled={actionLoading}
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-red-100 dark:bg-red-950/60 text-red-700 dark:text-red-300 border border-red-200 dark:border-red-900 text-xs font-bold transition cursor-pointer"
              >
                <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>Hapus Data Tanggal Ini</span>
              </button>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Tabel Log */}
          <div className="p-6 rounded-3xl bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 space-y-4 shadow-xs">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Activity className="w-4 h-4 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400" />
                <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
                  Daftar Catatan Kunjungan
                </h3>
              </div>
              <span className="text-xs font-mono font-bold px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">
                {totalRecords.toLocaleString('id-ID')} Catatan
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
              <table className="w-full text-left text-xs">
                <thead className="text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
                  <tr>
                    <th className="pb-3 font-semibold">Wilayah</th>
                    <th className="pb-3 font-semibold">ISP / Jaringan</th>
                    <th className="pb-3 font-semibold">Halaman</th>
                    <th className="pb-3 font-semibold">Sumber</th>
                    <th className="pb-3 font-semibold">Waktu Kunjungan</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-zinc-100 dark:divide-zinc-800/60 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">
                  {loading ? (
                    <tr>
                      <td colSpan={5} className="py-8 text-center text-zinc-400">
                        Memuat data riwayat...
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ) : trafikList.length === 0 ? (
                    <tr>
                      <td colSpan={5} className="py-8 text-center text-zinc-400">
                        Tidak ada catatan trafik ditemukan.
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ) : (
                    trafikList.map((log) => (
                      <tr key={log.id} className="hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-900/50 transition">
                        <td className="py-2.5 font-medium flex items-center gap-1.5 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
                          <MapPin className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-zinc-400 shrink-0" />
                          <span>{log.kota || 'Indonesia'}</span>
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-2.5 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 font-mono text-[11px] truncate max-w-[140px]">
                          {log.isp || 'Lokal'}
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-2.5 font-mono text-[11px] text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">
                          {log.path || '/'}
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-2.5">
                          <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-900 text-[10px] font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
                            {log.sumber || 'Direct'}
                          </span>
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-2.5 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 text-[11px] whitespace-nowrap">
                          {formatWaktuIndo(log.visited_at)}
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ))
                  )}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```javascript
'use client';

import { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import {
  Languages,
  Plus,
  Trash2,
  Check,
  AlertCircle,
  Save,
  Search,
  Filter,
  Copy,
  RefreshCw,
  Globe2,
  X,
  FileText,
} from 'lucide-react';
import {
  getLanguagesList,
  addLanguage,
  deleteLanguage,
  toggleLanguageActive,
  getTranslationsByLanguage,
  bulkSaveTranslations,
  copyTranslationsFromIndonesian,
  upsertTranslation,
  deleteTranslation,
} from '@/api/panitia/translate';

export default function PanitiaTranslatePage() {
  const [languages, setLanguages] = useState([]);
  const [selectedLang, setSelectedLang] = useState('en');
  const [translations, setTranslations] = useState([]);
  const [editedValues, setEditedValues] = useState({}); // { [key_teks]: string }

  const [loadingLangs, setLoadingLangs] = useState(true);
  const [loadingTrans, setLoadingTrans] = useState(true);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [notification, setNotification] = useState(null);

  // Search & Filter Category
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [categoryFilter, setCategoryFilter] = useState('all');

  // Modal Tambah Bahasa
  const [isLangModalOpen, setIsLangModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [newLangForm, setNewLangForm] = useState({
    kode: '',
    nama: '',
    flag: '🌐',
    urutan: 1,
    is_active: true,
    copyFromId: true,
  });

  // Modal Tambah Key Baru
  const [isKeyModalOpen, setIsKeyModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [newKeyForm, setNewKeyForm] = useState({
    key_teks: '',
    value_teks: '',
  });

  const showNotification = (type, message) => {
    setNotification({ type, message });
    setTimeout(() => {
      setNotification(null);
    }, 4000);
  };

  // 1. Fetch Languages List
  const fetchLanguages = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoadingLangs(true);
    const res = await getLanguagesList();
    if (res.success) {
      setLanguages(res.data || []);
      // Jika bahasa terpilih belum diset atau dihapus, default ke 'en' atau item pertama
      if (!res.data.some((l) => l.kode === selectedLang)) {
        const fallback = res.data.find((l) => l.kode !== 'id') || res.data[0];
        if (fallback) setSelectedLang(fallback.kode);
      }
    }
    setLoadingLangs(false);
  }, [selectedLang]);

  // 2. Fetch Translations for Selected Language
  const fetchTranslations = useCallback(async (kode) => {
    if (!kode) return;
    setLoadingTrans(true);
    const res = await getTranslationsByLanguage(kode);
    if (res.success) {
      setTranslations(res.data || []);
      // Reset edited values mapping
      const initialMap = {};
      (res.data || []).forEach((t) => {
        initialMap[t.key_teks] = t.value_teks || '';
      });
      setEditedValues(initialMap);
    }
    setLoadingTrans(false);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchLanguages();
  }, [fetchLanguages]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (selectedLang) {
      fetchTranslations(selectedLang);
    }
  }, [selectedLang, fetchTranslations]);

  // Handle Switch Active Language
  const handleToggleLangActive = async (kode, currentStatus) => {
    const res = await toggleLanguageActive(kode, !currentStatus);
    if (res.success) {
      setLanguages((prev) =>
        prev.map((l) => (l.kode === kode ? { ...l, is_active: !currentStatus } : l))
      );
      showNotification('success', `Status bahasa [${kode.toUpperCase()}] berhasil diubah.`);
    } else {
      showNotification('error', res.error || 'Gagal mengubah status bahasa.');
    }
  };

  // Handle Delete Language
  const handleDeleteLanguage = async (kode, nama) => {
    if (!confirm(`Hapus bahasa ${nama} (${kode}) beserta seluruh terjemahannya?`)) return;

    const res = await deleteLanguage(kode);
    if (res.success) {
      showNotification('success', `Bahasa ${nama} berhasil dihapus.`);
      if (selectedLang === kode) setSelectedLang('id');
      fetchLanguages();
    } else {
      showNotification('error', res.error || 'Gagal menghapus bahasa.');
    }
  };

  // Handle Add Language Submit
  const handleAddLanguageSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!newLangForm.kode.trim() || !newLangForm.nama.trim()) {
      showNotification('error', 'Kode dan nama bahasa wajib diisi.');
      return;
    }

    setSaving(true);
    const res = await addLanguage(newLangForm);
    setSaving(false);

    if (res.success) {
      showNotification('success', `Bahasa ${newLangForm.nama} berhasil ditambahkan.`);
      setIsLangModalOpen(false);
      setSelectedLang(newLangForm.kode.toLowerCase());
      fetchLanguages();
    } else {
      showNotification('error', res.error || 'Gagal menambahkan bahasa.');
    }
  };

  // Handle Inline Value Change
  const handleValueChange = (key, val) => {
    setEditedValues((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [key]: val,
    }));
  };

  // Handle Bulk Save Translations
  const handleBulkSave = async () => {
    setSaving(true);
    const entries = Object.entries(editedValues).map(([key_teks, value_teks]) => ({
      key_teks,
      value_teks,
    }));

    const res = await bulkSaveTranslations(selectedLang, entries);
    setSaving(false);

    if (res.success) {
      showNotification('success', `Berhasil menyimpan ${res.count || entries.length} teks terjemahan.`);
      fetchTranslations(selectedLang);
      fetchLanguages();
    } else {
      showNotification('error', res.error || 'Gagal menyimpan terjemahan.');
    }
  };

  // Handle Copy from Indonesian (ID)
  const handleCopyFromIndonesian = async () => {
    if (!confirm(`Salin seluruh teks acuan Bahasa Indonesia (ID) ke bahasa [${selectedLang.toUpperCase()}] untuk key yang belum ada?`)) {
      return;
    }

    setSaving(true);
    const res = await copyTranslationsFromIndonesian(selectedLang);
    setSaving(false);

    if (res.success) {
      showNotification('success', `Berhasil menyalin ${res.copiedCount || 0} key dari Bahasa Indonesia.`);
      fetchTranslations(selectedLang);
      fetchLanguages();
    } else {
      showNotification('error', res.error || 'Gagal menyalin teks terjemahan.');
    }
  };

  // Handle Add New Key Submit
  const handleAddKeySubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!newKeyForm.key_teks.trim()) {
      showNotification('error', 'Nama key wajib diisi.');
      return;
    }

    setSaving(true);
    // Simpan ke bahasa aktif sekaligus buat di ID jika belum ada
    const res = await upsertTranslation(
      selectedLang,
      newKeyForm.key_teks,
      newKeyForm.value_teks
    );
    setSaving(false);

    if (res.success) {
      showNotification('success', `Key [${newKeyForm.key_teks}] berhasil dibuat.`);
      setIsKeyModalOpen(false);
      setNewKeyForm({ key_teks: '', value_teks: '' });
      fetchTranslations(selectedLang);
    } else {
      showNotification('error', res.error || 'Gagal membuat key baru.');
    }
  };

  // Handle Delete Single Translation Key
  const handleDeleteKey = async (keyTeks) => {
    if (!confirm(`Hapus teks terjemahan untuk key: "${keyTeks}" di bahasa ini?`)) return;

    const res = await deleteTranslation(selectedLang, keyTeks);
    if (res.success) {
      showNotification('success', `Key ${keyTeks} berhasil dihapus.`);
      fetchTranslations(selectedLang);
    } else {
      showNotification('error', res.error || 'Gagal menghapus key.');
    }
  };

  // Filter translations by search & category
  const filteredTranslations = translations.filter((item) => {
    const matchesSearch =
      item.key_teks.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
      (editedValues[item.key_teks] || '').toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
      (item.id_reference || '').toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase());

    if (!matchesSearch) return false;

    if (categoryFilter === 'all') return true;
    return item.key_teks.startsWith(categoryFilter + '.');
  });

  const categories = [
    { id: 'all', label: 'Semua Kategori' },
    { id: 'nav', label: 'Navbar (nav)' },
    { id: 'hero', label: 'Beranda (hero)' },
    { id: 'kandidat', label: 'Kandidat (kandidat)' },
    { id: 'voting', label: 'Voting (voting)' },
    { id: 'panduan', label: 'Panduan (panduan)' },
    { id: 'dokumentasi', label: 'Dokumentasi (dokumentasi)' },
    { id: 'kontak', label: 'Kontak (kontak)' },
    { id: 'umum', label: 'Umum (umum)' },
  ];

  const currentLangObj = languages.find((l) => l.kode === selectedLang) || {
    kode: selectedLang,
    nama: selectedLang,
    flag: '🌐',
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 pb-12">
      {/* Toast Notification */}
      {notification && (
        <div
          className={`fixed top-5 right-5 z-50 flex items-center gap-2.5 px-4 py-3 rounded-2xl shadow-xl text-xs font-semibold animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-top-4 duration-200 ${
            notification.type === 'success'
              ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white'
              : 'bg-red-600 text-white'
          }`}
        >
          {notification.type === 'success' ? (
            <Check className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
          ) : (
            <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
          )}
          <span>{notification.message}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Header Panel */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 p-5 rounded-3xl bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 shadow-xs">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3.5">
          <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl bg-zinc-900 text-white dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-950 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 shadow-md">
            <Languages className="w-6 h-6" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <h1 className="text-lg sm:text-xl font-black text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 tracking-tight">
                Manajemen Bahasa & Terjemahan Website
              </h1>
              <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-950/60 dark:text-amber-300 border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-900">
                SuperAdmin
              </span>
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 mt-0.5">
              Kelola multi-bahasa portal publik, tambahkan bahasa baru, dan sesuaikan terjemahan antarmuka secara instan.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 self-start sm:self-auto">
          <button
            onClick={() => {
              fetchLanguages();
              fetchTranslations(selectedLang);
            }}
            disabled={loadingLangs || loadingTrans}
            className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 hover:text-zinc-950 dark:hover:text-white transition cursor-pointer"
            title="Muat Ulang"
          >
            <RefreshCw className={`w-4 h-4 ${loadingLangs || loadingTrans ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
          </button>

          <button
            onClick={() => setIsLangModalOpen(true)}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold bg-zinc-900 text-white dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-950 hover:opacity-90 transition shadow-xs cursor-pointer"
          >
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>Tambah Bahasa</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Main Split Layout: Left (Daftar Bahasa) - Right (Editor Terjemahan) */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
        {/* Left Panel: Daftar Bahasa (4 Kolom di Desktop) */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-4 space-y-3">
          <div className="p-4 rounded-3xl bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 shadow-xs space-y-3">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-2 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800">
              <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <Globe2 className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600" />
                <span>Bahasa Sistem ({languages.length})</span>
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              {loadingLangs ? (
                <div className="py-6 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400">
                  Memuat daftar bahasa...
                </div>
              ) : (
                languages.map((lang) => {
                  const isSelected = selectedLang === lang.kode;

                  return (
                    <div
                      key={lang.kode}
                      onClick={() => setSelectedLang(lang.kode)}
                      className={`flex items-center justify-between p-3 rounded-2xl border transition cursor-pointer ${
                        isSelected
                          ? 'bg-zinc-900 text-white dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-950 border-zinc-900 dark:border-zinc-100 shadow-xs'
                          : 'bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900/40 border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-900'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 truncate">
                        <span className="text-lg">{lang.flag}</span>
                        <div className="truncate">
                          <p className="text-xs font-bold leading-tight truncate">
                            {lang.nama}
                          </p>
                          <p className={`text-[10px] font-mono ${isSelected ? 'text-zinc-300 dark:text-zinc-600' : 'text-zinc-400'}`}>
                            Kode: {lang.kode} • {lang.translationCount || 0} teks
                          </p>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
                        {/* Toggle Status Aktif */}
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => handleToggleLangActive(lang.kode, lang.is_active)}
                          title={lang.is_active ? 'Bahasa Aktif' : 'Bahasa Nonaktif'}
                          className={`w-7 h-4 rounded-full transition-colors relative cursor-pointer ${
                            lang.is_active ? 'bg-emerald-500' : 'bg-zinc-300 dark:bg-zinc-700'
                          }`}
                        >
                          <span
                            className={`absolute top-0.5 left-0.5 w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-white transition-transform ${
                              lang.is_active ? 'translate-x-3' : 'translate-x-0'
                            }`}
                          />
                        </button>

                        {/* Hapus Bahasa (kecuali ID) */}
                        {lang.kode !== 'id' && (
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => handleDeleteLanguage(lang.kode, lang.nama)}
                            className={`p-1 rounded-lg transition cursor-pointer ${
                              isSelected
                                ? 'text-zinc-300 hover:text-red-300'
                                : 'text-zinc-400 hover:text-red-600'
                            }`}
                            title="Hapus Bahasa"
                          >
                            <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          </button>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  );
                })
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Right Panel: Editor Terjemahan (8 Kolom di Desktop) */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-8 space-y-4">
          <div className="p-5 rounded-3xl bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 shadow-xs space-y-4">
            {/* Top Bar Editor */}
            <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 pb-3 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span className="text-2xl">{currentLangObj.flag}</span>
                <div>
                  <h2 className="text-sm font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
                    Kamus Terjemahan: {currentLangObj.nama} ({currentLangObj.kode.toUpperCase()})
                  </h2>
                  <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500">
                    {translations.length} kunci terjemahan terdaftar
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                {selectedLang !== 'id' && (
                  <button
                    onClick={handleCopyFromIndonesian}
                    disabled={saving}
                    className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950/60 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300 border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-900 hover:bg-blue-100 transition cursor-pointer"
                    title="Otomatis salin key dari ID yang belum ada"
                  >
                    <Copy className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    <span>Salin dari Indonesia</span>
                  </button>
                )}

                <button
                  onClick={() => setIsKeyModalOpen(true)}
                  className="flex items-center gap-1 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 hover:bg-zinc-200 transition cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Key Baru</span>
                </button>

                <button
                  onClick={handleBulkSave}
                  disabled={saving || loadingTrans}
                  className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold bg-zinc-900 text-white dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-950 hover:opacity-90 disabled:opacity-40 transition shadow-xs cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <Save className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>{saving ? 'Menyimpan...' : 'Simpan Perubahan'}</span>
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Filter & Search Bar */}
            <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center gap-2.5">
              {/* Search Key or Value */}
              <div className="relative flex-1 w-full">
                <Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5 absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-zinc-400" />
                <input
                  type="text"
                  placeholder="Cari nama key atau teks terjemahan..."
                  value={searchQuery}
                  onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full pl-8 pr-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 placeholder-zinc-400 focus:outline-hidden"
                />
              </div>

              {/* Category Filter */}
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1 bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-900 p-1 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 shrink-0 w-full sm:w-auto">
                <Filter className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-zinc-400 ml-1.5" />
                <select
                  value={categoryFilter}
                  onChange={(e) => setCategoryFilter(e.target.value)}
                  className="bg-transparent text-xs font-medium text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 pr-2 py-0.5 focus:outline-hidden cursor-pointer"
                >
                  {categories.map((c) => (
                    <option key={c.id} value={c.id}>
                      {c.label}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Translation Strings List / Table */}
            <div className="space-y-3 max-h-[600px] overflow-y-auto pr-1">
              {loadingTrans ? (
                <div className="py-12 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400">
                  Memuat teks terjemahan...
                </div>
              ) : filteredTranslations.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="py-12 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400">
                  Tidak ditemukan teks yang sesuai dengan kriteria pencarian.
                </div>
              ) : (
                filteredTranslations.map((item) => {
                  const currentValue = editedValues[item.key_teks] ?? '';
                  const isMissing = !currentValue.trim();

                  return (
                    <div
                      key={item.key_teks}
                      className="p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900/40 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800/80 space-y-2 hover:border-zinc-300 dark:hover:border-zinc-700 transition"
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          <span className="font-mono text-xs font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
                            {item.key_teks}
                          </span>
                          {isMissing ? (
                            <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md text-[10px] font-semibold bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-950/60 dark:text-amber-300 border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-900">
                              Belum Diterjemahkan
                            </span>
                          ) : (
                            <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md text-[10px] font-semibold bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-900">
                              Ada Terjemahan
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </div>

                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => handleDeleteKey(item.key_teks)}
                          className="p-1 rounded-lg text-zinc-400 hover:text-red-600 transition cursor-pointer"
                          title="Hapus Key Terjemahan Ini"
                        >
                          <Trash2 className="w-3 h-3" />
                        </button>
                      </div>

                      {/* Indonesian Reference Text */}
                      {selectedLang !== 'id' && item.id_reference && (
                        <div className="text-[11px] text-zinc-500 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 p-2 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200/60 dark:border-zinc-800/60">
                          <span className="font-semibold text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400 mr-1.5">
                            🇮🇩 Indonesia:
                          </span>
                          <span>{item.id_reference}</span>
                        </div>
                      )}

                      {/* Translation Input */}
                      <div>
                        <input
                          type="text"
                          value={currentValue}
                          onChange={(e) => handleValueChange(item.key_teks, e.target.value)}
                          placeholder={`Terjemahan dalam bahasa ${currentLangObj.nama}...`}
                          className="w-full p-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 focus:outline-hidden focus:border-zinc-400"
                        />
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  );
                })
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Bottom Save Reminder */}
            {filteredTranslations.length > 0 && (
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-3 border-t border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800">
                <span className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400">
                  Perubahan tersimpan sementara di form. Klik "Simpan Perubahan" untuk menerapkan ke database publik.
                </span>
                <button
                  onClick={handleBulkSave}
                  disabled={saving || loadingTrans}
                  className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold bg-zinc-900 text-white dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-950 hover:opacity-90 disabled:opacity-40 transition shadow-xs cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <Save className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>{saving ? 'Menyimpan...' : 'Simpan Perubahan'}</span>
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Modal Tambah Bahasa Baru */}
      {isLangModalOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xs animate-in fade-in duration-200">
          <div className="w-full max-w-md rounded-3xl bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 shadow-2xl overflow-hidden">
            <form onSubmit={handleAddLanguageSubmit}>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-4.5 border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
                <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">

                </h3>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setIsLangModalOpen(false)}

                >
                  <X className="w-4 h-4" />
                </button>
              </div>

              <div className="p-5 space-y-3.5 text-xs">
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                  <div className="space-y-1">
                    <label className="font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">
                      Kode ISO (2-5 huruf)
                    </label>
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      maxLength={5}
                      value={newLangForm.kode}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        setNewLangForm({ ...newLangForm, kode: e.target.value.toLowerCase() })
                      }
                      placeholder="Contoh: de, es, ko"
                      className="w-full p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 focus:outline-hidden font-mono"
                      required
                    />
                  </div>

                  <div className="space-y-1">
                    <label className="font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">
                      Emoji Bendera
                    </label>
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      maxLength={5}
                      value={newLangForm.flag}
                      onChange={(e) => setNewLangForm({ ...newLangForm, flag: e.target.value })}
                      placeholder="🇩🇪 / 🇪🇸"
                      className="w-full p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 focus:outline-hidden text-center text-lg"
                      required
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <label className="font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">
                    Nama Bahasa
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={newLangForm.nama}
                    onChange={(e) => setNewLangForm({ ...newLangForm, nama: e.target.value })}
                    placeholder="Contoh: Deutsch, Español"
                    className="w-full p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 focus:outline-hidden"
                    required
                  />
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <label className="font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">
                    Urutan
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    min="1"
                    value={newLangForm.urutan}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      setNewLangForm({ ...newLangForm, urutan: Number(e.target.value) })
                    }
                    className="w-full p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 focus:outline-hidden"
                    required
                  />
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-2 pt-2">
                  <label className="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer font-medium text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      checked={newLangForm.copyFromId}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        setNewLangForm({ ...newLangForm, copyFromId: e.target.checked })
                      }
                      className="rounded accent-blue-600"
                    />
                    <span>Otomatis salin seluruh string dari Bahasa Indonesia</span>
                  </label>
                  <label className="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer font-medium text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      checked={newLangForm.is_active}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        setNewLangForm({ ...newLangForm, is_active: e.target.checked })
                      }
                      className="rounded accent-emerald-600"
                    />
                    <span>Langsung aktifkan bahasa ini di portal publik</span>
                  </label>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="p-4 bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900 border-t border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 flex justify-end gap-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setIsLangModalOpen(false)}
                  className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 hover:bg-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-700 transition cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Batal
                </button>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  disabled={saving}
                  className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold bg-zinc-900 text-white dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-950 hover:opacity-90 disabled:opacity-50 transition cursor-pointer"
                >
                  {saving ? 'Menambahkan...' : 'Tambah Bahasa'}
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Modal Tambah Key Baru */}
      {isKeyModalOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xs animate-in fade-in duration-200">
          <div className="w-full max-w-md rounded-3xl bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 shadow-2xl overflow-hidden">
            <form onSubmit={handleAddKeySubmit}>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-4.5 border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
                <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <FileText className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600" />
                  <span>Tambah Key Teks Baru</span>
                </h3>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setIsKeyModalOpen(false)}
                  className="p-1 rounded-lg text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <X className="w-4 h-4" />
                </button>
              </div>

              <div className="p-5 space-y-3.5 text-xs">
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <label className="font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">
                    Nama Key (Gunakan dot notation)
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={newKeyForm.key_teks}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      setNewKeyForm({ ...newKeyForm, key_teks: e.target.value.toLowerCase().trim() })
                    }
                    placeholder="Contoh: hero.deskripsi_baru"
                    className="w-full p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 focus:outline-hidden font-mono"
                    required
                  />
                  <p className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400">
                    Gunakan awalan kategori seperti: nav.*, hero.*, kandidat.*, umum.*
                  </p>
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <label className="font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">
                    Teks Terjemahan ({currentLangObj.nama})
                  </label>
                  <textarea
                    rows={3}
                    value={newKeyForm.value_teks}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      setNewKeyForm({ ...newKeyForm, value_teks: e.target.value })
                    }
                    placeholder="Masukkan teks terjemahan..."
                    className="w-full p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 focus:outline-hidden leading-relaxed"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="p-4 bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900 border-t border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 flex justify-end gap-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setIsKeyModalOpen(false)}
                  className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 hover:bg-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-700 transition cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Batal
                </button>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  disabled={saving}
                  className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold bg-zinc-900 text-white dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-950 hover:opacity-90 disabled:opacity-50 transition cursor-pointer"
                >
                  {saving ? 'Menyimpan...' : 'Simpan Key'}
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```
