```javascript
'use client';

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import {
  getPanitiaJadwalVotingList,
  tambahJadwalVoting,
  updateJadwalVoting,
  hapusJadwalVoting,
} from '@/api/panitia/jadwalVoting';
import { formatWaktuIndo } from '@/utils/dateUtils';
import {
  CalendarDays,
  Clock,
  Plus,
  RefreshCw,
  Edit3,
  Trash2,
  X,
  AlertCircle,
  CheckCircle2,
  Calendar,
  Timer,
  PlayCircle,
  StopCircle,
  Loader2,
} from 'lucide-react';

export default function JadwalVotingPanitiaPage() {
  const [jadwalList, setJadwalList] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [modalOpen, setModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editId, setEditId] = useState(null);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    waktu_mulai: '',
    waktu_berakhir: '',
  });
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [errorText, setErrorText] = useState('');

  const loadData = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    const res = await getPanitiaJadwalVotingList();
    if (res.success) {
      setJadwalList(res.data || []);
    } else {
      setErrorText(res.error || 'Gagal memuat jadwal voting.');
    }
    setLoading(false);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadData();
  }, []);

  // Helper konversi ISO Date ke input type="datetime-local" (format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm dalam waktu lokal)
  const toLocalInputValue = (isoString) => {
    if (!isoString) return '';
    const d = new Date(isoString);
    if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return '';
    const pad = (n) => String(n).padStart(2, '0');
    const year = d.getFullYear();
    const month = pad(d.getMonth() + 1);
    const date = pad(d.getDate());
    const hours = pad(d.getHours());
    const minutes = pad(d.getMinutes());
    return `${year}-${month}-${date}T${hours}:${minutes}`;
  };

  const handleOpenAdd = () => {
    setEditId(null);
    setFormData({
      waktu_mulai: '',
      waktu_berakhir: '',
    });
    setErrorText('');
    setModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleOpenEdit = (item) => {
    setEditId(item.id);
    setFormData({
      waktu_mulai: toLocalInputValue(item.waktu_mulai),
      waktu_berakhir: toLocalInputValue(item.waktu_berakhir),
    });
    setErrorText('');
    setModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setErrorText('');

    if (!formData.waktu_mulai || !formData.waktu_berakhir) {
      setErrorText('Waktu mulai dan waktu berakhir wajib diisi.');
      return;
    }

    const startTs = new Date(formData.waktu_mulai).getTime();
    const endTs = new Date(formData.waktu_berakhir).getTime();

    if (startTs >= endTs) {
      setErrorText('Waktu mulai harus lebih awal daripada waktu berakhir.');
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    let res;
    if (editId) {
      res = await updateJadwalVoting({
        id: editId,
        waktu_mulai: formData.waktu_mulai,
        waktu_berakhir: formData.waktu_berakhir,
      });
    } else {
      res = await tambahJadwalVoting({
        waktu_mulai: formData.waktu_mulai,
        waktu_berakhir: formData.waktu_berakhir,
      });
    }

    setSubmitting(false);

    if (res.success) {
      setModalOpen(false);
      loadData();
    } else {
      setErrorText(res.error || 'Gagal menyimpan jadwal voting.');
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async (id) => {
    if (confirm('Hapus jadwal voting ini? Pastikan tidak ada proses voting aktif yang terganggu.')) {
      const res = await hapusJadwalVoting(id);
      if (res.success) {
        loadData();
      } else {
        alert(res.error || 'Gagal menghapus jadwal voting.');
      }
    }
  };

  // Status perhitungan jadwal saat ini
  const getJadwalStatus = (start, end) => {
    const now = Date.now();
    const startTs = new Date(start).getTime();
    const endTs = new Date(end).getTime();

    if (now < startTs) {
      return {
        label: 'Akan Datang',
        badge: 'bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700',
        icon: Clock,
      };
    } else if (now >= startTs && now <= endTs) {
      return {
        label: 'Sedang Berlangsung',
        badge: 'bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-800 animate-pulse',
        icon: PlayCircle,
      };
    } else {
      return {
        label: 'Telah Selesai',
        badge: 'bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700',
        icon: StopCircle,
      };
    }
  };

  // Hitung durasi jam/menit
  const getDurasi = (start, end) => {
    const startTs = new Date(start).getTime();
    const endTs = new Date(end).getTime();
    const diffMs = endTs - startTs;
    if (isNaN(diffMs) || diffMs <= 0) return '-';
    const hours = Math.floor(diffMs / (1000 * 60 * 60));
    const minutes = Math.floor((diffMs % (1000 * 60 * 60)) / (1000 * 60));
    if (hours > 0 && minutes > 0) return `${hours} jam ${minutes} menit`;
    if (hours > 0) return `${hours} jam`;
    return `${minutes} menit`;
  };

  // Jadwal aktif terkini (jadwal paling baru)
  const activeJadwal = jadwalList[0] || null;
  const activeStatus = activeJadwal
    ? getJadwalStatus(activeJadwal.waktu_mulai, activeJadwal.waktu_berakhir)
    : null;

  return (
    <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 lg:p-8 space-y-6 max-w-7xl w-full mx-auto transition-colors">
      {/* Header Halaman (Netral) */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 pb-4 border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
              Pengaturan Jadwal E-Voting
            </h1>
            <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 text-[10px] font-bold">
              Bilik Suara
            </span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 mt-1">
            Atur rentang waktu pembukaan dan penutupan bilik suara elektronik. Sistem akan membatasi login pemilih sesuai jadwal resmi.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 self-start sm:self-auto">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={loadData}
            title="Perbarui Data"
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 hover:text-zinc-950 dark:hover:text-white text-xs font-semibold shadow-xs transition active:scale-95 cursor-pointer"
          >
            <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${loading ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
            <span>Refresh</span>
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleOpenAdd}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-zinc-900 text-white dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-950 hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:bg-white text-xs font-bold shadow-xs transition active:scale-95 cursor-pointer"
          >
            <Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Atur Jadwal Baru</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Ringkasan Jadwal Terkini */}
      {activeJadwal && activeStatus && (
        <div className="p-5 rounded-3xl bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 shadow-xs space-y-4">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 pb-3">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <div className="w-7 h-7 rounded-lg bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 flex items-center justify-center">
                <Timer className="w-4 h-4" />
              </div>
              <h2 className="text-sm font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
                Jadwal Voting Terkini
              </h2>
            </div>
            <span
              className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 rounded-full border text-[11px] font-bold ${activeStatus.badge}`}
            >
              <activeStatus.icon className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>{activeStatus.label}</span>
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
            <div className="p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900/40 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
              <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 block">
                Waktu Mulai (WIB)
              </span>
              <span className="text-sm font-black text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 mt-1 block">
                {formatWaktuIndo(activeJadwal.waktu_mulai)}
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900/40 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
              <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 block">
                Waktu Berakhir (WIB)
              </span>
              <span className="text-sm font-black text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 mt-1 block">
                {formatWaktuIndo(activeJadwal.waktu_berakhir)}
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900/40 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
              <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 block">
                Total Durasi Pemungutan
              </span>
              <span className="text-sm font-black text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 mt-1 block">
                {getDurasi(activeJadwal.waktu_mulai, activeJadwal.waktu_berakhir)}
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Tabel Riwayat Jadwal */}
      <div className="rounded-3xl bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 overflow-hidden shadow-xs">
        <div className="p-4 sm:p-5 border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <div className="w-7 h-7 rounded-lg bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 flex items-center justify-center">
              <CalendarDays className="w-4 h-4" />
            </div>
            <h2 className="text-sm font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
              Daftar Periode Jadwal Voting
            </h2>
          </div>
          <span className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400 font-mono">
            {jadwalList.length} Jadwal Terdaftar
          </span>
        </div>

        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          <table className="w-full text-left text-xs">
            <thead className="bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900/80 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
              <tr>
                <th className="py-3 px-4 font-semibold text-center w-12">No</th>
                <th className="py-3 px-4 font-semibold">Waktu Mulai (WIB)</th>
                <th className="py-3 px-4 font-semibold">Waktu Berakhir (WIB)</th>
                <th className="py-3 px-4 font-semibold">Durasi</th>
                <th className="py-3 px-4 font-semibold">Status</th>
                <th className="py-3 px-4 font-semibold text-center w-28">Aksi</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody className="divide-y divide-zinc-100 dark:divide-zinc-800 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">
              {loading ? (
                <tr>
                  <td colSpan={6} className="py-10 text-center text-zinc-400">
                    <Loader2 className="w-5 h-5 animate-spin mx-auto mb-2 text-zinc-500" />
                    Memuat data jadwal voting...
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ) : jadwalList.length === 0 ? (
                <tr>
                  <td colSpan={6} className="py-10 text-center text-zinc-400">
                    Belum ada jadwal voting yang ditentukan. Klik tombol &ldquo;Atur Jadwal Baru&rdquo; di atas.
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ) : (
                jadwalList.map((item, idx) => {
                  const statusInfo = getJadwalStatus(item.waktu_mulai, item.waktu_berakhir);
                  return (
                    <tr key={item.id} className="hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-900/40 transition">
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-center font-mono text-zinc-400">
                        {idx + 1}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4 font-medium text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
                        {formatWaktuIndo(item.waktu_mulai)}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4 font-medium text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
                        {formatWaktuIndo(item.waktu_berakhir)}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400 font-mono">
                        {getDurasi(item.waktu_mulai, item.waktu_berakhir)}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4">
                        <span
                          className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full border text-[10px] font-bold ${statusInfo.badge}`}
                        >
                          <statusInfo.icon className="w-3 h-3" />
                          <span>{statusInfo.label}</span>
                        </span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-center">
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5">
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => handleOpenEdit(item)}
                            title="Edit Jadwal"
                            className="p-1.5 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400 hover:text-blue-600 dark:hover:text-blue-400 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-900 transition cursor-pointer"
                          >
                            <Edit3 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          </button>
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => handleDelete(item.id)}
                            title="Hapus Jadwal"
                            className="p-1.5 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400 hover:text-red-600 dark:hover:text-red-400 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-900 transition cursor-pointer"
                          >
                            <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  );
                })
              )}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Modal Tambah/Edit Jadwal */}
      {modalOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xs animate-in fade-in">
          <div className="bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 rounded-3xl p-6 sm:p-7 max-w-md w-full shadow-2xl space-y-5">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800 pb-3">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <CalendarDays className="w-5 h-5 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100" />
                <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
                  {editId ? 'Ubah Periode Jadwal Voting' : 'Tambah Periode Jadwal Voting'}
                </h3>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setModalOpen(false)}
                className="p-1 rounded-xl text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-zinc-100 transition cursor-pointer"
              >
                <X className="w-5 h-5" />
              </button>
            </div>

            {errorText && (
              <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-950/40 border border-red-200 dark:border-red-800 text-red-700 dark:text-red-300 text-xs flex items-center gap-2">
                <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
                <span>{errorText}</span>
              </div>
            )}

            <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">
                  Waktu Mulai Voting (WIB)
                </label>
                <input
                  type="datetime-local"
                  value={formData.waktu_mulai}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, waktu_mulai: e.target.value }))}
                  required
                  className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 text-xs text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 focus:outline-hidden focus:ring-2 focus:ring-zinc-400 dark:focus:ring-zinc-600 transition"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">
                  Waktu Berakhir Voting (WIB)
                </label>
                <input
                  type="datetime-local"
                  value={formData.waktu_berakhir}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, waktu_berakhir: e.target.value }))
                  }
                  required
                  className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 text-xs text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 focus:outline-hidden focus:ring-2 focus:ring-zinc-400 dark:focus:ring-zinc-600 transition"
                />
              </div>

              <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500 leading-relaxed">
                Waktu yang Anda masukkan akan menjadi batas aktif bilik suara mahasiswa. Pastikan waktu mulai mendahului waktu selesai.
              </p>

              <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2.5 pt-3 border-t border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setModalOpen(false)}
                  disabled={submitting}
                  className="px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-900 transition cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Batal
                </button>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  disabled={submitting}
                  className="px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-zinc-900 text-white dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-950 hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:hover:bg-white text-xs font-bold shadow-xs transition active:scale-95 disabled:opacity-50 cursor-pointer inline-flex items-center gap-2"
                >
                  {submitting ? (
                    <>
                      <Loader2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" />
                      <span>Menyimpan...</span>
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    <span>{editId ? 'Perbarui Jadwal' : 'Simpan Jadwal'}</span>
                  )}
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```javascript
'use client';

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import Image from 'next/image';
import { getPanitiaVotingList, hapusVoting } from '@/api/panitia/voting';
import {
  ClipboardList,
  Vote,
  Search,
  Filter,
  RefreshCw,
  Eye,
  Trash2,
  X,
  User,
  ShieldCheck,
  Calendar,
} from 'lucide-react';

export default function ManajemenVotingPanitiaPage() {
  const [votingList, setVotingList] = useState([]);
  const [paslonOptions, setPaslonOptions] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [paslonFilter, setPaslonFilter] = useState('semua');

  // Modal Lihat Foto Paslon
  const [photoModalOpen, setPhotoModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [selectedPaslonDetail, setSelectedPaslonDetail] = useState(null);

  const loadData = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    const res = await getPanitiaVotingList({ search, paslonFilter });
    if (res.success) {
      setVotingList(res.data || []);
      setPaslonOptions(res.paslonOptions || []);
    }
    setLoading(false);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadData();
  }, [paslonFilter]);

  const handleSearchSubmit = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    loadData();
  };

  const handleOpenPhoto = (paslon) => {
    if (!paslon) return;
    setSelectedPaslonDetail(paslon);
    setPhotoModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleDeleteVote = async (id, namaMhs) => {
    if (
      confirm(
        `Batalkan dan hapus catatan suara pemilih ${namaMhs}? Mahasiswa bersangkutan akan dapat melakukan voting ulang jika diizinkan.`
      )
    ) {
      const res = await hapusVoting(id);
      if (res.success) {
        loadData();
      } else {
        alert(res.error || 'Gagal menghapus catatan voting.');
      }
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 lg:p-8 space-y-6 max-w-7xl w-full mx-auto transition-colors">
      {/* Header Halaman (Netral) */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 pb-4 border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
              Manajemen Log Voting Masuk
            </h1>
            <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 text-[10px] font-bold">
              Audit Suara
            </span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 mt-1">
            Daftar seluruh transaksi suara masuk dari mahasiswa DPT, verifikasi pilihan paslon, dan tinjau foto kandidat.
          </p>
        </div>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={loadData}
          title="Perbarui Log Voting"
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-900 text-white dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-950 text-xs font-semibold shadow-xs transition active:scale-95 cursor-pointer self-start sm:self-auto"
        >
          <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${loading ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
          <span>Refresh Data</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Filter & Bar Pencarian */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-stretch sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 p-3 rounded-2xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 shadow-xs">
        <form onSubmit={handleSearchSubmit} className="flex-1 relative">
          <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-zinc-400 absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 pointer-events-none" />
          <input
            type="text"
            value={search}
            onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Cari nama mahasiswa, NIM, atau kode voting..."
            className="w-full pl-10 pr-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 text-xs text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 focus:outline-hidden focus:ring-2 focus:ring-zinc-400 dark:focus:ring-zinc-600"
          />
        </form>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="text-xs text-zinc-500 font-semibold hidden md:inline">
              Filter Paslon:
            </span>
            <select
              value={paslonFilter}
              onChange={(e) => setPaslonFilter(e.target.value)}
              className="px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 text-xs text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 focus:outline-hidden focus:ring-2 focus:ring-zinc-400 dark:focus:ring-zinc-600 cursor-pointer"
            >
              <option value="semua">Semua Pasangan Calon</option>
              {paslonOptions.map((opt) => (
                <option key={opt.id} value={opt.id}>
                  {opt.label}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Tabel Log Voting */}
      {loading ? (
        <div className="space-y-3">
          {[1, 2, 3, 4].map((n) => (
            <div
              key={n}
              className="h-16 rounded-2xl bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-900/50 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 animate-pulse"
            />
          ))}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="rounded-3xl bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 overflow-hidden shadow-xs hover:shadow-lg transition-all">
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full text-left text-xs">
              <thead className="bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900/80 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
                <tr>
                  <th className="py-3.5 px-5 font-semibold">Nama Mahasiswa</th>
                  <th className="py-3.5 px-4 font-semibold">NIM</th>
                  <th className="py-3.5 px-4 font-semibold">Kode Token</th>

                  <th className="py-3.5 px-4 font-semibold">Waktu Pencoblosan</th>

                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-zinc-100 dark:divide-zinc-800/60 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">
                {votingList.length === 0 ? (
                  <tr>
                    <td colSpan={6} className="py-12 text-center text-zinc-400">
                      Tidak ada catatan voting yang ditemukan.
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ) : (
                  votingList.map((v) => {
                    const paslon = v.paslon;

                    return (
                      <tr key={v.id} className="hover:bg-zinc-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-900/40 transition">
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-5 font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
                          {v.mhs.nama_mhs}
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-4 font-mono">{v.mhs.nim}</td>
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-4 font-mono font-bold text-[11px] text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">
                          {v.mhs.kode_voting}
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-4">
                          {paslon ? (
                            <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2">
                              <span className="w-6 h-6 rounded-lg bg-zinc-900 text-white dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-950 font-bold flex items-center justify-center text-[10px] shrink-0">
                                {paslon.nomor_urut}
                              </span>
                              <div className="truncate max-w-xs">
                                <span className="font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 block truncate">
                                  Paslon {paslon.nomor_urut}
                                </span>
                                <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500 truncate block">
                                  {paslon.kandidat1?.nama_kandidat}
                                </span>
                              </div>
                            </div>
                          ) : (
                            <span className="text-zinc-400 italic">Paslon Tidak Ditemukan</span>
                          )}
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-zinc-500 font-mono text-[11px]">
                          {new Date(v.created_at).toLocaleString('id-ID', {
                            day: 'numeric',
                            month: 'short',
                            year: 'numeric',
                            hour: '2-digit',
                            minute: '2-digit',
                          })}
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-5 text-right space-x-2">
                          {paslon && (
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => handleOpenPhoto(paslon)}
                              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 font-semibold text-[11px] hover:bg-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-zinc-700 transition cursor-pointer"
                              title="Lihat Foto Paslon"
                            >
                              <Eye className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                              <span>Foto Paslon</span>
                            </button>
                          )}

                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => handleDeleteVote(v.id, v.mhs.nama_mhs)}
                            className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-zinc-400 hover:text-red-600 dark:hover:text-red-400 hover:bg-red-50 dark:hover:bg-red-950/40 transition cursor-pointer inline-flex items-center"
                            title="Hapus Suara Ini"
                          >
                            <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          </button>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    );
                  })
                )}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Modal Lihat Foto Paslon yang Dipilih */}
      {photoModalOpen && selectedPaslonDetail && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xs animate-in fade-in duration-200">
          <div className="bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 rounded-3xl max-w-lg w-full p-6 space-y-5 shadow-2xl relative">
            {/* Header Modal */}
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800">

                  {selectedPaslonDetail.nomor_urut}

                <div>
                  <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">

                  <p className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400">

              <button

              >
                <X className="w-4 h-4" />

            {/* Foto Kedua Kandidat Berdampingan */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">

                <div className="relative aspect-3/4 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
                  {selectedPaslonDetail.kandidat1?.fotodiri_kandidat ? (
                    <Image
                      src={selectedPaslonDetail.kandidat1.fotodiri_kandidat}

                      fill

                  ) : (

                  <span className="absolute top-2 left-2 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xs text-[9px] font-bold text-white">
                    Calon Presiden

                </div>
                <div>
                  <p className="text-xs font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 line-clamp-1">
                    {selectedPaslonDetail.kandidat1?.nama_kandidat}

                  <p className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500 font-mono">
                    {selectedPaslonDetail.kandidat1?.nim_kandidat || '-'}

                  <p className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400 line-clamp-1">

              {/* Kandidat 2: Cawapres */}
              <div className="space-y-2 text-center">

                  {selectedPaslonDetail.kandidat2?.fotodiri_kandidat ? (
                    <Image
                      src={selectedPaslonDetail.kandidat2.fotodiri_kandidat}
                      alt={selectedPaslonDetail.kandidat2.nama_kandidat || 'Cawapres'}

                      className="object-cover"
                    />
                  ) : (
                    <div className="w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center text-zinc-400">
                      <User className="w-12 h-12" />
                    </div>
                  )}
                  <span className="absolute top-2 left-2 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xs text-[9px] font-bold text-white">
                    Calon Wakil
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <p className="text-xs font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 line-clamp-1">
                    {selectedPaslonDetail.kandidat2?.nama_kandidat || '-'}

                  <p className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500 font-mono">
                    {selectedPaslonDetail.kandidat2?.nim_kandidat || '-'}

            {/* Slogan Paslon */}

            <div className="pt-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setPhotoModalOpen(false)}
                className="w-full py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-zinc-900 hover:bg-zinc-850 text-white dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-white dark:text-zinc-950 text-xs font-bold transition active:scale-95 cursor-pointer"
              >
                Tutup Pratinjau
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```javascript
'use client';

import { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import Image from 'next/image';
import { getVotingDashboardStats } from '@/api/panitia/voting';
import {
  Vote,
  Trophy,
  Users,
  Activity,
  RefreshCw,
  BarChart2,
  PieChart as PieIcon,
  TrendingUp,
  User,
  ShieldCheck,
  CheckCircle2,
  Clock,
  AlertCircle,
  HelpCircle,
  Calculator,
  Award,
} from 'lucide-react';

import {
  Chart as ChartJS,
  CategoryScale,
  LinearScale,
  BarElement,
  ArcElement,
  Title,
  Tooltip,
  Legend,
} from 'chart.js';
import { Bar, Doughnut } from 'react-chartjs-2';

// Registrasi modul Chart.js
ChartJS.register(
  CategoryScale,
  LinearScale,
  BarElement,
  ArcElement,
  Title,
  Tooltip,
  Legend
);

const VOTING_CACHE_KEY = 'kpu_panitia_voting_cache';

export default function DashboardVotingPanitiaPage() {
  const [stats, setStats] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [lastRefreshed, setLastRefreshed] = useState(null);

  const loadData = async (forceRefresh = false) => {
    setLoading(true);

    if (!forceRefresh) {
      try {
        const cached = localStorage.getItem(VOTING_CACHE_KEY);
        if (cached) {
          const parsed = JSON.parse(cached);
          if (parsed?.stats) {
            setStats(parsed.stats);
            setLastRefreshed(new Date(parsed.time || Date.now()));
            setLoading(false);
            return;
          }
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    const res = await getVotingDashboardStats();
    if (res.success) {
      setStats(res.stats);
      const now = new Date();
      setLastRefreshed(now);
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(
          VOTING_CACHE_KEY,
          JSON.stringify({ stats: res.stats, time: now.toISOString() })
        );
      } catch (e) {}
    }
    setLoading(false);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadData(false);

    const clearCache = () => {
      try {
        localStorage.removeItem(VOTING_CACHE_KEY);
      } catch (e) {}
    };

    const handleVisibilityChange = () => {
      if (document.visibilityState !== 'visible') {
        clearCache();
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener('visibilitychange', handleVisibilityChange);
    window.addEventListener('pagehide', clearCache);
    window.addEventListener('beforeunload', clearCache);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', handleVisibilityChange);
      window.removeEventListener('pagehide', clearCache);
      window.removeEventListener('beforeunload', clearCache);
      clearCache();
    };
  }, []);

  // Urutkan peringkat paslon berdasarkan total suara masuk
  const rankedPaslon = useMemo(() => {
    if (!stats?.perolehanPaslon) return [];
    return [...stats.perolehanPaslon].sort((a, b) => b.total_suara - a.total_suara);
  }, [stats]);

  // Kalkulasi analisis mendalam
  const analisis = useMemo(() => {
    const totalDpt = stats?.totalDpt || 0;
    const totalSuara = stats?.totalSuara || 0;
    const sisaSuara = Math.max(0, totalDpt - totalSuara);
    const sisaPersen = totalDpt > 0 ? ((sisaSuara / totalDpt) * 100).toFixed(1) : 0;
    
    const leader = rankedPaslon[0] || null;
    const runnerUp = rankedPaslon[1] || null;

    const selisihSuara = leader && runnerUp ? leader.total_suara - runnerUp.total_suara : 0;
    const selisihPersen = leader && runnerUp ? (leader.persentase - runnerUp.persentase).toFixed(1) : 0;

    // Kemenangan matematis terkunci: jika selisih suara lebih besar dari seluruh sisa suara DPT yang belum voting
    const isLocked = Boolean(
      totalSuara > 0 &&
      leader &&
      sisaSuara >= 0 &&
      (rankedPaslon.length <= 1 || selisihSuara > sisaSuara)
    );

    const rataRataSuara = rankedPaslon.length > 0 ? Math.round(totalSuara / rankedPaslon.length) : 0;

    return {
      sisaSuara,
      sisaPersen,
      selisihSuara,
      selisihPersen,
      isLocked,
      rataRataSuara,
      leader,
      runnerUp,
    };
  }, [stats, rankedPaslon]);

  // Palet Warna Blue Khusus Grafik Sesuai Permintaan
  const blueChartColors = [
    'rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.9)',    // blue-600
    'rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.85)',  // blue-500
    'rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.85)',  // blue-400
    'rgba(29, 78, 216, 0.9)',    // blue-700
    'rgba(147, 197, 253, 0.85)', // blue-300
    'rgba(30, 64, 175, 0.9)',    // blue-800
  ];

  // Data Grafik Bar Suara Tiap Paslon (Warna Blue)
  const barChartData = {
    labels: (stats?.perolehanPaslon || []).map(
      (p) => `No. ${p.nomor_urut} - ${p.kandidat1?.nama_kandidat?.split(' ')[0] || ''}`
    ),
    datasets: [
      {
        label: 'Jumlah Suara Sah',
        data: (stats?.perolehanPaslon || []).map((p) => p.total_suara),
        backgroundColor: blueChartColors.slice(0, (stats?.perolehanPaslon || []).length),
        borderRadius: 8,
      },
    ],
  };

  const barChartOptions = {
    responsive: true,
    maintainAspectRatio: false,
    plugins: {
      legend: { display: false },
      tooltip: {
        backgroundColor: '#18181b',
        titleColor: '#f4f4f5',
        bodyColor: '#e4e4e7',
        borderColor: '#3b82f6',
        borderWidth: 1,
        callbacks: {
          label: (context) => ` ${context.raw} Suara Sah (${stats?.totalSuara > 0 ? ((context.raw / stats.totalSuara) * 100).toFixed(1) : 0}%)`,
        },
      },
    },
    scales: {
      y: {
        beginAtZero: true,
        ticks: {
          stepSize: 1,
          font: { size: 10 },
          color: '#71717a',
        },
        grid: {
          color: 'rgba(113, 113, 122, 0.12)',
        },
      },
      x: {
        ticks: {
          font: { size: 10 },
          color: '#71717a',
        },
        grid: { display: false },
      },
    },
  };

  // Data Grafik Doughnut Proporsi Suara (Warna Blue)
  const doughnutChartData = {
    labels: (stats?.perolehanPaslon || []).map((p) => `Paslon No. ${p.nomor_urut}`),
    datasets: [
      {
        data: (stats?.perolehanPaslon || []).map((p) => p.total_suara),
        backgroundColor: blueChartColors.slice(0, (stats?.perolehanPaslon || []).length),
        borderWidth: 2,
        borderColor: '#18181b',
      },
    ],
  };

  const doughnutOptions = {
    responsive: true,
    maintainAspectRatio: false,
    plugins: {
      legend: {
        position: 'bottom',
        labels: {
          boxWidth: 10,
          font: { size: 11 },
          color: '#a1a1aa',
        },
      },
      tooltip: {
        backgroundColor: '#18181b',
        titleColor: '#f4f4f5',
        bodyColor: '#e4e4e7',
        borderColor: '#3f3f46',
        borderWidth: 1,
        callbacks: {
          label: (context) => ` ${context.label}: ${context.raw} Suara`,
        },
      },
    },
    cutout: '72%',
  };

  return (
    <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 lg:p-8 space-y-6 max-w-7xl w-full mx-auto transition-colors">
      {/* Header Halaman (Netral) */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 pb-4 border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
              Dashboard Rekapitulasi & Analisis E-Voting
            </h1>
            <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 text-[10px] font-bold">
              KPU Live Data
            </span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 mt-1">
            Pantau rekapitulasi perolehan suara pasangan calon, analisis margin selisih, kuorum DPT, dan kepastian hasil pemilihan.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 self-start sm:self-auto">
          {lastRefreshed && (
            <span className="text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 font-mono hidden md:inline">
              Update: {lastRefreshed.toLocaleTimeString('id-ID')}
            </span>
          )}
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => loadData(true)}
            title="Perbarui Hasil Suara"
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-900 text-white dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-950 text-xs font-semibold shadow-xs transition active:scale-95 cursor-pointer"
          >
            <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${loading ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
            <span>Perbarui Data</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 4 Stat Cards Utama (Warna Netral) */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
        {/* Total Suara Masuk */}
        <div className="p-5 rounded-3xl bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 shadow-xs space-y-2">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">

            <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 flex items-center justify-center">

            </div>
          </div>
          <p className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-black text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 font-mono">

          </p>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">

        {/* Tingkat Partisipasi DPT */}

            </div>

          <p className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 truncate">

            <tbody className="divide-y divide-zinc-100 dark:divide-zinc-800 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">
              {rankedPaslon.length === 0 ? (

                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                          <span className="w-6 h-6 rounded-lg bg-zinc-900 text-white dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-950 flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-xs shrink-0">
                            {paslon.nomor_urut}
                          </span>
                          <div>
                            <p className="font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
                              {paslon.kandidat1?.nama_kandidat || '-'}
                            </p>
                            <p className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400 font-mono">
                              {paslon.kandidat1?.prodi_kandidat || '-'}
                            </p>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4">
                        <p className="font-medium text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">
                          {paslon.kandidat2?.nama_kandidat || '-'}
                        </p>
                        <p className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400 font-mono">
                          {paslon.kandidat2?.prodi_kandidat || '-'}
                        </p>
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-right font-mono font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 text-sm">
                        {paslon.total_suara.toLocaleString('id-ID')}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-right font-mono font-bold text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200">
                        {paslon.persentase}%
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4">
                        {isLeader ? (
                          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-zinc-900 text-white dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-950 text-[10px] font-bold">
                            <Trophy className="w-3 h-3" />
                            Peringkat 1 (Memimpin)
                          </span>
                        ) : (
                          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 text-[10px] font-semibold">
                            Tertinggal {analisis.leader ? analisis.leader.total_suara - paslon.total_suara : 0} Suara
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  );
                })
              )}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```javascript
'use client';

import { useEffect, useRef, Suspense } from 'react';
import { usePathname, useSearchParams } from 'next/navigation';
import { catatTrafikKunjungan } from '@/api/publlic/trafik';

function TrackerContent() {
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const lastTrackedPath = useRef('');

  useEffect(() => {
    // Hindari tracking berulang di path yang persis sama dalam 1 sesi singkat
    if (lastTrackedPath.current === pathname) return;
    lastTrackedPath.current = pathname;

    try {
      const referrer = typeof document !== 'undefined' ? document.referrer : '';
      const utmSource = searchParams?.get('utm_source') || searchParams?.get('ref') || '';

      // Kirim tracking ke server action
      catatTrafikKunjungan({
        referrer,
        utmSource,
        path: pathname,
      }).catch(() => {
        // Abaikan error pada sisi klien
      });
    } catch (e) {
      // Abaikan error klien
    }
  }, [pathname, searchParams]);

  return null;
}

export default function ClientTracker() {
  return (
    <Suspense fallback={null}>
      <TrackerContent />
    </Suspense>
  );
}
```

```javascript
'use client';

import { useState, useEffect, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
import { Bot, X, Send, RefreshCw, HelpCircle, ChevronDown, Move, Check } from 'lucide-react';
import ReactMarkdown from 'react-markdown';
import { chatDenganSamsAsisten } from '@/api/openai/route';
import { getPublicAiFaq } from '@/api/publlic/ai';
import { KPU_FAQ_DATA } from '@/data/faqDataAi';
import { TIMING_CONFIG } from '@/lib/timingConfig';
import { useTranslation } from '@/hooks/useTranslation';

export default function SamsAsisten() {
  const { t, lang } = useTranslation();

  const getInitialMessage = useCallback(
    () => ({
      role: 'assistant',
      content: t(
        'sams.initial_message',
        'Halo! Saya **Sams Asisten**, asisten cerdas resmi dari Komisi Pemilihan Umum (KPU) Mahasiswa Politeknik LP3I. Ada yang bisa saya bantu seputar tata cara, syarat pemilih, syarat calon, atau jadwal Pemilu Raya BEM?'
      ),
    }),
    [t]
  );

  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState(() => [getInitialMessage()]);
  const [input, setInput] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [faqData, setFaqData] = useState(KPU_FAQ_DATA);
  const [showFaqList, setShowFaqList] = useState(false);
  const chatBottomRef = useRef(null);
  const sessionIdRef = useRef('');

  // Sinkronkan pesan pembuka jika user mengganti bahasa
  useEffect(() => {
    setMessages((prev) => {
      if (prev.length === 1 && prev[0].role === 'assistant') {
        return [getInitialMessage()];
      }
      return prev;
    });
  }, [getInitialMessage, lang]);

  // State Notifikasi Bubble (hanya tampil pertama kali dan persist per session)
  const [showNotif, setShowNotif] = useState(false);

  // State Draggable Position & Drag Mode
  const [isDragMode, setIsDragMode] = useState(false);
  const [position, setPosition] = useState(null); // { x: number, y: number }
  const containerRef = useRef(null);

  // Refs untuk tracking pointer & timer
  const pointerDownPosRef = useRef({ x: 0, y: 0, time: 0 });
  const isDraggingRef = useRef(false);
  const dragOffsetRef = useRef({ x: 0, y: 0 });
  const clickTimerRef = useRef(null);
  const holdTimerRef = useRef(null);

  // Inisialisasi notifikasi & session ID & fetch FAQ dinamis
  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      let currentSession = sessionStorage.getItem('sams_session_id');
      if (!currentSession) {
        currentSession = 'sams_' + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 10);
        sessionStorage.setItem('sams_session_id', currentSession);
      }
      sessionIdRef.current = currentSession;

      const dismissed = sessionStorage.getItem('sams_notif_dismissed');
      if (!dismissed) {
        const timer = setTimeout(() => {
          setShowNotif(true);
        }, TIMING_CONFIG.SAMS_NOTIF_DELAY);
        return () => clearTimeout(timer);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      // ignore
    }

    // Ambil basis data FAQ terbaru dari database publik
    getPublicAiFaq().then((res) => {
      if (res.success && res.data && res.data.length > 0) {
        setFaqData(res.data);
      }
    });
  }, []);

  const handleDismissNotif = (e) => {
    e?.stopPropagation();
    setShowNotif(false);
    try {
      sessionStorage.setItem('sams_notif_dismissed', 'true');
    } catch (e) {
      // ignore
    }
  };

  // Scroll chat ke bawah saat pesan bertambah
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      chatBottomRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
    }
  }, [messages, isOpen, loading]);

  // Update posisi di dalam batas viewport layar
  const updatePosition = useCallback((clientX, clientY) => {
    const newX = Math.max(16, Math.min(window.innerWidth - 76, clientX - dragOffsetRef.current.x));
    const newY = Math.max(16, Math.min(window.innerHeight - 80, clientY - dragOffsetRef.current.y));
    setPosition({ x: newX, y: newY });
  }, []);

  // Handler Pointer Down pada tombol Move khusus (Bisa langsung drag seketika!)
  const handleMoveButtonPointerDown = (e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    e.preventDefault();
    isDraggingRef.current = true;
    setIsDragMode(true);

    const rect = containerRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect();
    dragOffsetRef.current = {
      x: e.clientX - (rect ? rect.left : 0),
      y: e.clientY - (rect ? rect.top : 0),
    };

    const onPointerMove = (ev) => {
      updatePosition(ev.clientX, ev.clientY);
    };

    const onPointerUp = () => {
      isDraggingRef.current = false;
      window.removeEventListener('pointermove', onPointerMove);
      window.removeEventListener('pointerup', onPointerUp);
      window.removeEventListener('pointercancel', onPointerUp);
    };

    window.addEventListener('pointermove', onPointerMove);
    window.addEventListener('pointerup', onPointerUp);
    window.addEventListener('pointercancel', onPointerUp);
  };

  // Handler Pointer Down pada Icon Bot (Mendukung Double Click, Tahan / Long Press, dan Drag)
  const handleBotPointerDown = (e) => {
    if (isOpen) return;

    pointerDownPosRef.current = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY, time: Date.now() };
    isDraggingRef.current = false;

    const rect = containerRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect();
    dragOffsetRef.current = {
      x: e.clientX - (rect ? rect.left : 0),
      y: e.clientY - (rect ? rect.top : 0),
    };

    // Tahan (Long Press) 350ms langsung aktifkan mode geser
    holdTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
      setIsDragMode(true);
      isDraggingRef.current = true;
      if (navigator.vibrate) navigator.vibrate(40);
    }, 350);

    const onPointerMove = (ev) => {
      const dx = Math.abs(ev.clientX - pointerDownPosRef.current.x);
      const dy = Math.abs(ev.clientY - pointerDownPosRef.current.y);

      // Jika bergerak sebelum 350ms, batalkan long press
      if (dx > 5 || dy > 5) {
        if (!isDragMode && !isDraggingRef.current) {
          clearTimeout(holdTimerRef.current);
        }
      }

      if (isDragMode || isDraggingRef.current) {
        isDraggingRef.current = true;
        updatePosition(ev.clientX, ev.clientY);
      }
    };

    const onPointerUp = (ev) => {
      clearTimeout(holdTimerRef.current);
      window.removeEventListener('pointermove', onPointerMove);
      window.removeEventListener('pointerup', onPointerUp);
      window.removeEventListener('pointercancel', onPointerUp);

      const dist = Math.hypot(
        ev.clientX - pointerDownPosRef.current.x,
        ev.clientY - pointerDownPosRef.current.y
      );

      // Jika telah digeser (> 8px) atau sedang dragging, jangan buka chat
      if (dist > 8 || isDraggingRef.current) {
        setTimeout(() => {
          isDraggingRef.current = false;
        }, 60);
        return;
      }

      // Jika dalam mode drag, klik biasa mengunci kembali posisi
      if (isDragMode) {
        setIsDragMode(false);
        return;
      }

      // Deteksi Double Click (klik 2x untuk toggle mode geser)
      if (clickTimerRef.current) {
        clearTimeout(clickTimerRef.current);
        clickTimerRef.current = null;
        setIsDragMode(true);
        if (navigator.vibrate) navigator.vibrate(40);
      } else {
        // Single Click: tunggu 220ms untuk memastikan bukan double-click
        clickTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
          clickTimerRef.current = null;
          setIsOpen(true);
        }, 220);
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener('pointermove', onPointerMove);
    window.addEventListener('pointerup', onPointerUp);
    window.addEventListener('pointercancel', onPointerUp);
  };

  const handleSend = async (textToSend = null) => {
    const content = (textToSend || input).trim();
    if (!content || loading) return;

    const newMessages = [...messages, { role: 'user', content }];
    setMessages(newMessages);
    setInput('');
    setShowFaqList(false);
    setLoading(true);

    try {
      const res = await chatDenganSamsAsisten(newMessages, sessionIdRef.current);
      if (res.success && res.reply) {
        setMessages([...newMessages, { role: 'assistant', content: res.reply }]);
      } else {
        setMessages([
          ...newMessages,
          {
            role: 'assistant',
            content: res.error || t('sams.err_server', 'Maaf, terjadi gangguan saat menghubungi server AI. Silakan coba kembali nanti.'),
          },
        ]);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setMessages([
        ...newMessages,
        {
          role: 'assistant',
          content: t('sams.err_busy', 'Maaf, jaringan sedang sibuk. Silakan coba beberapa saat lagi.'),
        },
      ]);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleReset = () => {
    setMessages([getInitialMessage()]);
    setShowFaqList(false);
  };

  // Inline style untuk floating position (hanya dipakai saat chatbox tertutup)
  const containerStyle = !isOpen && position
    ? {
        position: 'fixed',
        left: `${position.x}px`,
        top: `${position.y}px`,
        bottom: 'auto',
        right: 'auto',
      }
    : undefined;

  return (
    <div
      ref={containerRef}
      style={containerStyle}
      className={`${
        isOpen || !position ? 'fixed bottom-18 md:bottom-6 right-4 sm:right-6' : ''
      } z-50 select-none`}
    >
      {/* Floating Toggle Button (Icon Only + Floating + Draggable) */}
      {!isOpen && (
        <div className="relative flex items-center">
          {/* Div Notifikasi Bubble (Menempel di samping icon) */}
          {showNotif && (
            <div className="absolute right-15 bottom-0 flex items-center gap-2 pl-3.5 pr-2 py-2 rounded-2xl bg-white/95 dark:bg-zinc-900/95 backdrop-blur-md border border-blue-200/90 dark:border-zinc-800 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 shadow-xl whitespace-nowrap animate-in fade-in zoom-in-90 slide-in-from-right-3 duration-400 ease-out">
              <div className="flex flex-col text-left">
                <span className="text-xs font-bold leading-tight text-blue-950 dark:text-zinc-100">
                  {t('sams.notif_title', 'Tanya Sams Asisten')}
                </span>
                <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 font-medium">
                  {t('sams.notif_sub', 'AI Pemilu Raya LP3I')}
                </span>
              </div>

              {/* Tombol X untuk menutup notifikasi permanen di sesi ini */}
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleDismissNotif}
                title={t('sams.notif_close', 'Tutup Notifikasi')}
                className="p-1 rounded-lg text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-700 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 transition cursor-pointer ml-1"
                aria-label={t('sams.notif_close', 'Tutup Notifikasi')}
              >
                <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              </button>

              {/* Segitiga speech bubble pointer yang mengarah ke icon */}
              <div className="absolute -right-1.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-3 h-3 bg-white/95 dark:bg-zinc-900/95 border-t border-r border-blue-200/90 dark:border-zinc-800 rotate-45 pointer-events-none" />
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Tombol Pindah Posisi (SELALU MUNCUL agar user mudah memindahkan posisi) */}
          <button
            type="button"
            onPointerDown={handleMoveButtonPointerDown}
            onClick={(e) => {
              e.stopPropagation();
              setIsDragMode((prev) => !prev);
            }}
            title={
              isDragMode
                ? t('sams.btn_drag_lock', 'Klik untuk mengunci posisi')
                : t('sams.btn_drag_move', 'Geser tombol ini untuk memindahkan Sams Asisten, atau klik untuk mengaktifkan mode geser')
            }
            className={`absolute -top-2.5 -left-2.5 z-30 w-7 h-7 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center shadow-md transition-all touch-none cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing ${
              isDragMode
                ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white ring-2 ring-white dark:ring-zinc-950 scale-110'
                : 'bg-white dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-200 border border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-700 hover:scale-110 active:scale-95'
            }`}
            aria-label={t('sams.btn_drag_move', 'Pindahkan posisi Sams Asisten')}
          >
            {isDragMode ? (
              <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            ) : (
              <Move className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            )}
          </button>

          {/* Tombol Icon Sams Asisten Bulat Saja dengan Animasi Float Naik-Turun Kanan-Kiri */}
          <div
            onPointerDown={handleBotPointerDown}
            title={
              isDragMode
                ? t('sams.bot_drag_mode', 'Mode geser aktif. Geser untuk memindahkan, klik tombol centang untuk mengunci.')
                : t('sams.bot_click_mode', 'Klik untuk membuka chat. Klik 2x atau tahan untuk menggeser posisi.')
            }
            className={`relative w-13 h-13 sm:w-14 sm:h-14 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center transition-all duration-300 select-none ${
              isDragMode
                ? 'cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing ring-4 ring-blue-500/80 scale-105 shadow-2xl bg-blue-700 text-white touch-none'
                : 'cursor-pointer hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 shadow-xl bg-zinc-900 text-white dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-950 border border-zinc-700/80 dark:border-zinc-300 animate-sams-float'
            }`}
            aria-label={t('sams.header_title', 'Sams Asisten KPU')}
          >
            <Bot className="w-6 h-6" />

            {/* Badge status / mode indicator */}
            {isDragMode ? (
              <span className="absolute -bottom-1 -right-1 w-4 h-4 rounded-full bg-blue-500 text-white text-[9px] font-bold flex items-center justify-center ring-2 ring-white dark:ring-zinc-950 shadow-xs">
                <Move className="w-2.5 h-2.5" />
              </span>
            ) : (
              <span className="absolute top-0 right-0 w-3 h-3 bg-blue-500 rounded-full ring-2 ring-white dark:ring-zinc-950 animate-pulse" />
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Floating Chat Modal Box */}
      {isOpen && (
        <div className="w-[92vw] sm:w-[390px] h-[530px] max-h-[85vh] flex flex-col rounded-3xl bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 shadow-2xl overflow-hidden animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-200">
          {/* Header Dialog */}
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-3.5 bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-black border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
              <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 flex items-center justify-center text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
                <Bot className="w-4 h-4" />
              </div>
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <span>{t('sams.header_title', 'Sams Asisten KPU')}</span>
                </h3>
                <p className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 flex items-center gap-1">
                  <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-zinc-400 dark:bg-zinc-500" />
                  {t('sams.header_status', 'Online • Pemilu Raya BEM LP3I')}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleReset}
                title={t('sams.reset_title', 'Reset Percakapan')}
                className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-950 dark:hover:text-white hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-900 transition cursor-pointer"
              >
                <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setIsOpen(false)}
                title={t('sams.close_title', 'Tutup Chat')}
                className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-950 dark:hover:text-white hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-900 transition cursor-pointer"
              >
                <X className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Messages Area */}
          <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4 space-y-3.5 text-xs sm:text-sm">
            {messages.map((msg, i) => (
              <div
                key={i}
                className={`flex gap-2.5 ${msg.role === 'user' ? 'justify-end' : 'justify-start'}`}
              >
                {msg.role === 'assistant' && (
                  <div className="w-6 h-6 rounded-lg bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 mt-0.5">
                    <Bot className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  </div>
                )}
                <div
                  className={`max-w-[84%] px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-2xl leading-relaxed ${msg.role === 'user'
                    ? 'bg-zinc-900 text-white dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-950 rounded-br-none shadow-xs'
                    : 'bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 rounded-bl-none'
                    }`}
                >
                  <div className="prose dark:prose-invert prose-xs max-w-none prose-p:my-1 prose-ul:my-1 prose-li:my-0.5">
                    <ReactMarkdown>{msg.content}</ReactMarkdown>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}

            {loading && (
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 text-xs py-1">
                <div className="w-6 h-6 rounded-lg bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                  <Bot className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" />
                </div>
                <span>{t('sams.loading', 'Sams Asisten sedang merumuskan jawaban...')}</span>
              </div>
            )}

            <div ref={chatBottomRef} />
          </div>

          {/* Quick FAQ Dropdown / Chips */}
          <div className="px-3 py-2 bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-black/60 border-t border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-1.5">
              <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400 flex items-center gap-1">
                <HelpCircle className="w-3 h-3 text-zinc-500" />
                {t('sams.faq_title', 'Pertanyaan Populer Pemilu')}
              </span>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setShowFaqList(!showFaqList)}
                className="text-[10px] text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 hover:underline flex items-center gap-0.5 cursor-pointer font-medium"
              >
                {showFaqList ? t('sams.faq_close', 'Tutup Daftar') : t('sams.faq_see_all', 'Lihat Semua')}
                <ChevronDown className={`w-3 h-3 transition-transform ${showFaqList ? 'rotate-180' : ''}`} />
              </button>
            </div>

            {showFaqList ? (
              <div className="max-h-28 overflow-y-auto space-y-1 py-1">
                {faqData.map((faq, idx) => (
                  <button
                    key={idx}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => handleSend(faq.pertanyaan)}
                    disabled={loading}
                    className="w-full text-left text-[11px] py-1 px-2 rounded-lg bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 transition line-clamp-1 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    • {faq.pertanyaan}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar py-0.5">
                {faqData.slice(0, 3).map((faq, idx) => (
                  <button
                    key={idx}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => handleSend(faq.pertanyaan)}
                    disabled={loading}
                    className="shrink-0 text-[10px] px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 transition cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    {faq.pertanyaan}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Form Input Pesan */}
          <form
            onSubmit={(e) => {
              e.preventDefault();
              handleSend();
            }}
            className="p-3 bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-black border-t border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 flex items-center gap-2"
          >
            <input
              type="text"
              value={input}
              onChange={(e) => setInput(e.target.value)}
              placeholder={t('sams.input_ph', 'Tanyakan seputar Pemilu KPU...')}
              disabled={loading}
              className="flex-1 bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-800 rounded-xl px-3.5 py-2 text-xs text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 placeholder-zinc-500 focus:outline-hidden focus:border-zinc-500 transition"
            />
            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={loading || !input.trim()}
              className="p-2.5 bg-zinc-900 hover:bg-zinc-800 disabled:opacity-40 text-white dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-white dark:text-zinc-950 rounded-xl transition cursor-pointer"
              aria-label={t('sams.send_aria', 'Kirim Pesan')}
            >
              <Send className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>
          </form>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```javascript
'use client';

import { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import Image from 'next/image';
import { usePathname } from 'next/navigation';
import logoKpu from '@/aseets/logo.png';
import { TIMING_CONFIG } from '@/lib/timingConfig';

export default function SiteOpening({ children }) {
  const pathname = usePathname();

  // Fase animasi: 'init' | 'dark' | 'slide' | 'expand' | 'fading' | 'done'
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState('init');
  const [renderChildren, setRenderChildren] = useState(false);
  const timersRef = useRef([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    // 1. Lewati opening jika di halaman login panitia
    if (pathname === '/panitia/login') {
      setPhase('done');
      setRenderChildren(true);
      return;
    }

    // 2. Cek apakah user sudah melihat opening di sesi browser ini
    try {
      const hasSeen = sessionStorage.getItem('kpu_site_opening_seen');
      if (hasSeen) {
        setPhase('done');
        setRenderChildren(true);
        return;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      // Abaikan jika sessionStorage dibatasi browser
    }

    // Kunci scroll saat opening berjalan
    const originalOverflow = document.body.style.overflow;
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';

    // Mulai alur opening:
    // Tahap 1: Layar Hitam Pekat
    setPhase('dark');
    setRenderChildren(false);

    // Tahap 2: Logo Meluncur dari Bawah ke Tengah
    const tSlide = setTimeout(() => {
      setPhase('slide');
    }, TIMING_CONFIG.OPENING_DARK_DELAY);

    // Tahap 3: Logo Perbesar & Ring Border Berputar
    const tExpand = setTimeout(() => {
      setPhase('expand');
    }, TIMING_CONFIG.OPENING_EXPAND_START);

    // Tahap 4: Zoom Super Besar Menutup Halaman + Fade Out Overlay
    const tFade = setTimeout(() => {
      setRenderChildren(true);
      setPhase('fading');
    }, TIMING_CONFIG.OPENING_FADE_OUT_START);

    // Tahap 5: Opening Selesai
    const tDone = setTimeout(() => {
      setPhase('done');
      document.body.style.overflow = originalOverflow;
      try {
        sessionStorage.setItem('kpu_site_opening_seen', 'true');
      } catch (e) { }
    }, TIMING_CONFIG.OPENING_TOTAL_DURATION);

    timersRef.current = [tSlide, tExpand, tFade, tDone];

    return () => {
      timersRef.current.forEach((t) => clearTimeout(t));
      document.body.style.overflow = originalOverflow;
    };
  }, [pathname]);

  const isOverlayVisible = phase !== 'done';
  const isExpandPhase = phase === 'expand' || phase === 'fading';
  const isFading = phase === 'fading';

  return (
    <>
      {/* OVERLAY OPENING SPLASH SCREEN */}
      {isOverlayVisible && (
        <div
          aria-hidden="true"
          className={`fixed inset-0 z-[99999] flex items-center justify-center bg-black transition-opacity duration-1000 ease-in-out pointer-events-none select-none ${isFading ? 'opacity-0' : 'opacity-100'
            }`}
        >
          {/* Background Ambient Glow */}
          <div className="absolute inset-0 overflow-hidden pointer-events-none flex items-center justify-center">
            <div
              className={`w-[450px] h-[450px] rounded-full bg-blue-600/20 blur-3xl transition-all duration-1000 ${isFading
                  ? 'scale-[10] opacity-0'
                  : isExpandPhase
                    ? 'scale-125 opacity-100'
                    : 'scale-50 opacity-0'
                }`}
            />
          </div>

          {/* Kontainer Utama Animasi (Membesar ekstrem saat fase fading) */}
          <div
            className={`relative flex items-center justify-center transition-all duration-1200 ease-in-out transform ${isFading ? 'scale-[15] sm:scale-[20] opacity-0' : 'scale-100 opacity-100'
              }`}
          >
            {/* 4 LAYER GARIS BORDER BERPUTAR */}
            <div
              className={`absolute flex items-center justify-center transition-all duration-1000 ease-out ${isExpandPhase
                  ? 'opacity-100 scale-100'
                  : 'opacity-0 scale-75 pointer-events-none'
                }`}
            >
              {/* Layer 4: Baris Terluar */}
              <div className="absolute w-60 h-60 sm:w-72 sm:h-72 rounded-full border border-blue-500/25 border-t-blue-400 border-r-blue-500/40 animate-opening-spin-cw-1" />

              {/* Layer 3: Baris ke-3 */}
              <div className="absolute w-48 h-48 sm:w-58 sm:h-58 rounded-full border border-dashed border-zinc-500/35 border-b-blue-400/70 animate-opening-spin-ccw-2" />

              {/* Layer 2: Baris ke-2 */}
              <div className="absolute w-38 h-38 sm:w-46 sm:h-46 rounded-full border-2 border-indigo-500/30 border-l-blue-400/80 animate-opening-spin-cw-3" />

              {/* Layer 1: Baris ke-1 */}
              <div className="absolute w-28 h-28 sm:w-34 sm:h-34 rounded-full border border-dotted border-cyan-400/70 animate-opening-spin-ccw-4" />

              {/* Partikel Titik Cahaya Mengorbit */}
              <div className="absolute w-60 h-60 sm:w-72 sm:h-72 rounded-full animate-opening-spin-dots pointer-events-none">
                <span className="absolute -top-1 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-blue-400 shadow-[0_0_10px_#60a5fa]" />
                <span className="absolute top-1/2 -right-1 -translate-y-1/2 w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-cyan-300 shadow-[0_0_8px_#67e8f9]" />
                <span className="absolute -bottom-1 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-indigo-400 shadow-[0_0_10px_#818cf8]" />
                <span className="absolute top-1/2 -left-1 -translate-y-1/2 w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-blue-500 shadow-[0_0_8px_#3b82f6]" />
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Inner Ring Bingkai Logo */}
            <div
              className={`absolute w-24 h-24 sm:w-28 sm:h-28 rounded-full bg-black/80 border border-white/20 backdrop-blur-xs flex items-center justify-center shadow-2xl transition-all duration-1000 ${isExpandPhase ? 'scale-100 opacity-100' : 'scale-75 opacity-0'
                }`}
            />

            {/* LOGO KPU UTAMA */}
            <div
              className={`relative z-10 w-20 h-20 sm:w-24 sm:h-24 rounded-full overflow-hidden p-2 flex items-center justify-center drop-shadow-[0_0_25px_rgba(59,130,246,0.5)] transform ${phase === 'init' || phase === 'dark'
                  ? 'translate-y-[120vh] opacity-0 scale-75 transition-none'
                  : phase === 'slide'
                    ? 'translate-y-0 opacity-100 scale-95 transition-all duration-1000 ease-out'
                    : 'translate-y-0 opacity-100 scale-110 transition-all duration-1000 ease-out'
                }`}
            >
              <Image
                src={logoKpu}
                alt="Logo KPU Mahasiswa"
                width={96}
                height={96}
                priority
                className="w-full h-full object-contain"
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* KONTEN HALAMAN UTAMA */}
      {renderChildren ? children : null}
    </>
  );
}
```

```javascript
'use client';

import { useTheme } from 'next-themes';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Sun, Moon } from 'lucide-react';

export default function ThemeToggle({ className = '' }) {
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false);
  const { resolvedTheme, setTheme } = useTheme();

  useEffect(() => {
    setMounted(true);
  }, []);

  if (!mounted) {
    return (
      <div className={`w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 flex items-center justify-center ${className}`}>
        <span className="w-3.5 h-3.5 rounded-full bg-zinc-300 dark:bg-zinc-700 animate-pulse" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  const isDark = resolvedTheme === 'dark';

  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={() => setTheme(isDark ? 'light' : 'dark')}
      aria-label="Toggle Theme Mode"
      className={`relative inline-flex items-center justify-center w-9 h-9 rounded-xl transition-all duration-200 border cursor-pointer ${
        isDark
          ? 'bg-zinc-900 border-zinc-800 text-zinc-200 hover:bg-zinc-800 hover:border-zinc-700'
          : 'bg-white border-zinc-200 text-zinc-700 hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:border-zinc-300'
      } shadow-xs ${className}`}
    >
      {isDark ? (
        <Sun className="w-4 h-4 text-zinc-200 transition-transform duration-300 hover:rotate-45" />
      ) : (
        <Moon className="w-4 h-4 text-zinc-800 transition-transform duration-300 hover:-rotate-12" />
      )}
    </button>
  );
}
```
