```javascript
'use client';

import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { updateAdminOnlineStatus } from '@/api/panitia/auth';

const ACTIVE_TAB_KEY = 'kpu_panitia_active_tab';
const ACTIVE_TIME_KEY = 'kpu_panitia_active_time';

export default function AdminPresenceTracker() {
  const tabIdRef = useRef('');
  const isOnlineRef = useRef(false);
  const hiddenTimeoutRef = useRef(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    // Generate unique ID untuk tab ini
    const tabId = 'tab_' + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 10);
    tabIdRef.current = tabId;

    let heartbeatInterval = null;

    const setOnline = async () => {
      if (hiddenTimeoutRef.current) {
        clearTimeout(hiddenTimeoutRef.current);
        hiddenTimeoutRef.current = null;
      }

      try {
        localStorage.setItem(ACTIVE_TAB_KEY, tabId);
        localStorage.setItem(ACTIVE_TIME_KEY, String(Date.now()));
      } catch (e) {}

      isOnlineRef.current = true;
      try {
        await updateAdminOnlineStatus(true);
      } catch (e) {
        // Abaikan jika jaringan terputus sementara
      }
    };

    const setOffline = async (forceImmediate = false) => {
      const doOffline = async () => {
        // Cek apakah ada tab panitia lain yang sedang aktif
        try {
          const activeTab = localStorage.getItem(ACTIVE_TAB_KEY);
          const activeTime = Number(localStorage.getItem(ACTIVE_TIME_KEY) || '0');
          const isOtherTabRecentlyActive =
            activeTab && activeTab !== tabId && Date.now() - activeTime < 2500;

          if (isOtherTabRecentlyActive && !forceImmediate) {
            // Ada tab lain yang sedang dibuka oleh admin yang sama
            return;
          }
        } catch (e) {}

        isOnlineRef.current = false;
        try {
          await updateAdminOnlineStatus(false);
        } catch (e) {}
      };

      if (forceImmediate) {
        await doOffline();
      } else {
        if (hiddenTimeoutRef.current) {
          clearTimeout(hiddenTimeoutRef.current);
        }
        hiddenTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(doOffline, 700);
      }
    };

    // Handler ketika tab berubah visibilitas (berpindah tab / minimize / kembali)
    const handleVisibilityChange = () => {
      if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') {
        setOnline();
      } else {
        setOffline(false);
      }
    };

    // Handler ketika jendela difokuskan atau dibuka kembali
    const handleFocus = () => {
      if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') {
        setOnline();
      }
    };

    // Handler ketika jendela/tab ditutup atau keluar dari website
    const handlePageHide = () => {
      setOffline(true);
    };

    const handleBeforeUnload = () => {
      try {
        const activeTab = localStorage.getItem(ACTIVE_TAB_KEY);
        if (activeTab === tabId) {
          localStorage.removeItem(ACTIVE_TAB_KEY);
          localStorage.removeItem(ACTIVE_TIME_KEY);
        }
      } catch (e) {}
      updateAdminOnlineStatus(false);
    };

    // Inisialisasi status saat mount jika halaman sedang aktif
    if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') {
      setOnline();
    }

    // Pasang listener browser
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', handleVisibilityChange);
    window.addEventListener('focus', handleFocus);
    window.addEventListener('pagehide', handlePageHide);
    window.addEventListener('beforeunload', handleBeforeUnload);

    // Heartbeat berkala setiap 45 detik saat tab visible untuk memastikan status tetap aktif
    heartbeatInterval = setInterval(() => {
      if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') {
        setOnline();
      }
    }, 45000);

    return () => {
      if (heartbeatInterval) clearInterval(heartbeatInterval);
      if (hiddenTimeoutRef.current) clearTimeout(hiddenTimeoutRef.current);

      document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', handleVisibilityChange);
      window.removeEventListener('focus', handleFocus);
      window.removeEventListener('pagehide', handlePageHide);
      window.removeEventListener('beforeunload', handleBeforeUnload);

      // Jalankan offline saat unmount
      setOffline(true);
    };
  }, []);

  return null;
}
```

```javascript
'use client';

import { useState, useRef, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import {
  X,
  Check,
  RotateCw,
  ZoomIn,
  ZoomOut,
  RefreshCw,
  Crop as CropIcon,
} from 'lucide-react';


/**
 * ImageCropperModal
 * Modal interaktif untuk verifikasi dan pemotongan (crop) gambar foto panitia maupun gambar background kartu.
 * Mendukung drag untuk menggeser, zoom slider, rotasi 90 derajat, transparansi PNG utuh,
 * dan rasio aspek yang terkunci sesuai kebutuhan card panitia.
 */
export default function ImageCropperModal({
  isOpen,
  imageSrc,
  fileName = 'image.png',
  isPng = false,
  aspectRatio = 4 / 5, // Default 4:5 untuk foto diri portrait, atau 16:9 untuk background
  title = 'Verifikasi & Crop Gambar',
  subtitle = 'Atur posisi dan perbesaran gambar agar pas dengan rasio tampilan kartu.',
  onConfirm,
  onClose,
}) {
  const canvasRef = useRef(null);
  const imgRef = useRef(null);

  const [scale, setScale] = useState(1);
  const [minScale, setMinScale] = useState(0.5);
  const [rotation, setRotation] = useState(0); // 0, 90, 180, 270
  const [offset, setOffset] = useState({ x: 0, y: 0 });
  const [isDragging, setIsDragging] = useState(false);
  const [dragStart, setDragStart] = useState({ x: 0, y: 0 });
  const [imgLoaded, setImgLoaded] = useState(false);
  const [isProcessing, setIsProcessing] = useState(false);

  // Ukuran viewport canvas internal
  const VIEW_WIDTH = 520;
  const VIEW_HEIGHT = 420;

  // Hitung ukuran kotak crop di tengah canvas
  const getCropRect = useCallback(() => {
    const padding = 32;
    const maxW = VIEW_WIDTH - padding * 2;
    const maxH = VIEW_HEIGHT - padding * 2;

    let width = maxW;
    let height = width / aspectRatio;

    if (height > maxH) {
      height = maxH;
      width = height * aspectRatio;
    }

    const x = (VIEW_WIDTH - width) / 2;
    const y = (VIEW_HEIGHT - height) / 2;

    return { x, y, width, height };
  }, [aspectRatio]);

  // Load gambar sumber
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!imageSrc || !isOpen) {
      setImgLoaded(false);
      return;
    }

    const img = new Image();
    img.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';
    img.onload = () => {
      imgRef.current = img;

      // Hitung skala default agar gambar menutupi kotak crop
      const crop = getCropRect();
      const scaleX = crop.width / img.width;
      const scaleY = crop.height / img.height;
      const fitScale = Math.max(scaleX, scaleY);

      setMinScale(Math.max(0.2, fitScale * 0.8));
      setScale(fitScale);
      setOffset({ x: 0, y: 0 });
      setRotation(0);
      setImgLoaded(true);
    };
    img.src = imageSrc;
  }, [imageSrc, isOpen, getCropRect]);

  // Gambar ke canvas setiap ada perubahan transformasi
  const renderCanvas = useCallback(() => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    const img = imgRef.current;
    if (!canvas || !img || !imgLoaded) return;

    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    const crop = getCropRect();

    // Reset transform
    ctx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, VIEW_WIDTH, VIEW_HEIGHT);

    // Jika file adalah PNG, gambar pattern checkerboard halus di area crop sebagai indikator transparansi
    if (isPng) {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.rect(crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height);
      ctx.clip();

      const sq = 12;
      for (let i = crop.x; i < crop.x + crop.width; i += sq) {
        for (let j = crop.y; j < crop.y + crop.height; j += sq) {
          ctx.fillStyle =
            (Math.floor(i / sq) + Math.floor(j / sq)) % 2 === 0
              ? 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)'
              : 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02)';
          ctx.fillRect(i, j, sq, sq);
        }
      }
      ctx.restore();
    }

    // Gambar gambar dengan transformasi
    ctx.save();
    // Titik pusat crop
    const cropCenterX = crop.x + crop.width / 2;
    const cropCenterY = crop.y + crop.height / 2;

    ctx.translate(cropCenterX + offset.x, cropCenterY + offset.y);
    ctx.rotate((rotation * Math.PI) / 180);
    ctx.scale(scale, scale);

    // Gambar posisi tengah
    ctx.drawImage(img, -img.width / 2, -img.height / 2);
    ctx.restore();

    // Gambar mask gelap di luar kotak crop
    ctx.save();
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.65)';

    // Atas
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, VIEW_WIDTH, crop.y);
    // Bawah
    ctx.fillRect(0, crop.y + crop.height, VIEW_WIDTH, VIEW_HEIGHT - (crop.y + crop.height));
    // Kiri
    ctx.fillRect(0, crop.y, crop.x, crop.height);
    // Kanan
    ctx.fillRect(crop.x + crop.width, crop.y, VIEW_WIDTH - (crop.x + crop.width), crop.height);

    // Border kotak crop
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    ctx.strokeRect(crop.x, crop.y, crop.width, crop.height);

    // Garis bantu Rule of Thirds
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.beginPath();
    // Vertikal
    ctx.moveTo(crop.x + crop.width / 3, crop.y);
    ctx.lineTo(crop.x + crop.width / 3, crop.y + crop.height);
    ctx.moveTo(crop.x + (crop.width * 2) / 3, crop.y);
    ctx.lineTo(crop.x + (crop.width * 2) / 3, crop.y + crop.height);
    // Horizontal
    ctx.moveTo(crop.x, crop.y + crop.height / 3);
    ctx.lineTo(crop.x + crop.width, crop.y + crop.height / 3);
    ctx.moveTo(crop.x, crop.y + (crop.height * 2) / 3);
    ctx.lineTo(crop.x + crop.width, crop.y + (crop.height * 2) / 3);
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.restore();
  }, [imgLoaded, scale, offset, rotation, isPng, getCropRect]);

  useEffect(() => {
    renderCanvas();
  }, [renderCanvas]);

  // Interaksi Drag dengan Mouse & Touch
  const handleMouseDown = (e) => {
    setIsDragging(true);
    setDragStart({ x: e.clientX - offset.x, y: e.clientY - offset.y });
  };

  const handleMouseMove = (e) => {
    if (!isDragging) return;
    setOffset({
      x: e.clientX - dragStart.x,
      y: e.clientY - dragStart.y,
    });
  };

  const handleMouseUp = () => {
    setIsDragging(false);
  };

  const handleTouchStart = (e) => {
    if (e.touches.length === 1) {
      const touch = e.touches[0];
      setIsDragging(true);
      setDragStart({ x: touch.clientX - offset.x, y: touch.clientY - offset.y });
    }
  };

  const handleTouchMove = (e) => {
    if (!isDragging || e.touches.length !== 1) return;
    const touch = e.touches[0];
    setOffset({
      x: touch.clientX - dragStart.x,
      y: touch.clientY - dragStart.y,
    });
  };

  const handleTouchEnd = () => {
    setIsDragging(false);
  };

  // Zoom dengan Wheel Mouse
  const handleWheel = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const delta = e.deltaY * -0.001;
    setScale((prev) => Math.min(3.5, Math.max(minScale * 0.5, prev + delta)));
  };

  // Rotasi 90 derajat
  const handleRotate = () => {
    setRotation((prev) => (prev + 90) % 360);
  };

  // Reset Posisi
  const handleReset = () => {
    const img = imgRef.current;
    if (!img) return;
    const crop = getCropRect();
    const fitScale = Math.max(crop.width / img.width, crop.height / img.height);
    setScale(fitScale);
    setOffset({ x: 0, y: 0 });
    setRotation(0);
  };

  // Proses Crop & Ekspor File
  const handleCropConfirm = async () => {
    const img = imgRef.current;
    if (!img) return;

    setIsProcessing(true);
    try {
      const crop = getCropRect();

      // Tentukan resolusi output tinggi berdasarkan tipe (portrait foto vs landscape bg)
      let outWidth = 960;
      let outHeight = Math.round(outWidth / aspectRatio);

      if (aspectRatio > 1) {
        // Landscape (misal 16:9 bg)
        outWidth = 1440;
        outHeight = Math.round(outWidth / aspectRatio);
      }

      const outCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
      outCanvas.width = outWidth;
      outCanvas.height = outHeight;
      const outCtx = outCanvas.getContext('2d');

      // Terapkan rasio skala antara tampilan di canvas UI dengan resolusi output sebenarnya
      const exportRatio = outWidth / crop.width;

      outCtx.translate(outWidth / 2, outHeight / 2);
      outCtx.translate(offset.x * exportRatio, offset.y * exportRatio);
      outCtx.rotate((rotation * Math.PI) / 180);
      outCtx.scale(scale * exportRatio, scale * exportRatio);

      // Gambar gambar dengan resolusi penuh
      outCtx.drawImage(img, -img.width / 2, -img.height / 2);

      // Tentukan format ekspor: jika PNG pertahankan PNG murni dengan alpha channel
      const mimeType = isPng ? 'image/png' : 'image/webp';
      const outputName = isPng
        ? (fileName || 'foto-panitia').replace(/\.[^/.]+$/, '') + '.png'
        : (fileName || 'gambar-panitia').replace(/\.[^/.]+$/, '') + '.webp';

      outCanvas.toBlob(
        (blob) => {
          if (!blob) {
            setIsProcessing(false);
            alert('Gagal memproses hasil pemotongan gambar.');
            return;
          }

          const file = new File([blob], outputName, { type: mimeType });
          setIsProcessing(false);
          onConfirm(file);
        },
        mimeType,
        isPng ? 0.95 : 0.88
      );
    } catch (err) {
      setIsProcessing(false);
      alert('Terjadi kesalahan saat memotong gambar: ' + err.message);
    }
  };

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-60 flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-4 bg-black/85 backdrop-blur-sm overflow-y-auto">
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-2xl bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 rounded-3xl p-5 sm:p-7 space-y-5 my-6 shadow-2xl transition-all">
        {/* Header Modal */}
        <div className="flex items-start justify-between pb-3.5 border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <div className="w-7 h-7 rounded-lg bg-blue-50 dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-blue-200/80 dark:border-zinc-800 flex items-center justify-center text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400">
                <CropIcon className="w-4 h-4" />
              </div>
              <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">{title}</h2>
              {isPng && (
                <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-purple-50 dark:bg-purple-950/60 border border-purple-200 dark:border-purple-800 text-[10px] font-bold text-purple-700 dark:text-purple-300">
                  PNG Transparan
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">{subtitle}</p>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            disabled={isProcessing}
            className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-white transition cursor-pointer"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Viewport Canvas Crop */}
        <div className="relative w-full aspect-5/4 sm:aspect-13/9 bg-zinc-900 dark:bg-black rounded-2xl overflow-hidden border border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-800 flex items-center justify-center select-none shadow-inner">
          <canvas
            ref={canvasRef}
            width={VIEW_WIDTH}
            height={VIEW_HEIGHT}
            onMouseDown={handleMouseDown}
            onMouseMove={handleMouseMove}
            onMouseUp={handleMouseUp}
            onMouseLeave={handleMouseUp}
            onTouchStart={handleTouchStart}
            onTouchMove={handleTouchMove}
            onTouchEnd={handleTouchEnd}
            onWheel={handleWheel}
            className="w-full h-full object-contain cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing touch-none"
          />

          {!imgLoaded && (
            <div className="absolute inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-zinc-400 gap-2">
              <RefreshCw className="w-6 h-6 animate-spin text-blue-500" />
              <span className="text-xs font-medium">Memuat pratinjau gambar...</span>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Indikator Rasio di sudut viewport */}
          <div className="absolute top-3 left-3 pointer-events-none">
            <span className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-black/75 backdrop-blur-md text-[10px] font-bold text-zinc-300 border border-white/10 shadow-xs">
              {aspectRatio === 4 / 5 ? 'Rasio Foto 4:5 (Portrait)' : 'Rasio Background 16:9'}
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="absolute bottom-3 left-3 pointer-events-none">
            <span className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-black/75 backdrop-blur-md text-[10px] text-zinc-400 border border-white/10 shadow-xs">
              Geser untuk memindahkan • Scroll/Slider untuk zoom
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Kontrol Transformasi: Zoom, Rotasi, Reset */}
        <div className="p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900/80 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 space-y-3">
          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-3">
            {/* Zoom Slider */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 w-full sm:w-72">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setScale((prev) => Math.max(minScale * 0.5, prev - 0.1))}
                className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-white transition"
                title="Perkecil"
              >
                <ZoomOut className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>
              <input
                type="range"
                min={minScale * 0.5}
                max={Math.max(3, minScale * 3.5)}
                step="0.02"
                value={scale}
                onChange={(e) => setScale(parseFloat(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full accent-blue-600 h-1.5 bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-700 rounded-lg cursor-pointer"
              />
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setScale((prev) => Math.min(3.5, prev + 0.1))}
                className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-900 dark:hover:text-white transition"
                title="Perbesar"
              >
                <ZoomIn className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Tombol Aksi Tambahan: Rotasi & Reset */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 self-end sm:self-auto">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleRotate}
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 transition shadow-xs cursor-pointer"
                title="Putar 90 Derajat"
              >
                <RotateCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>Putar ({rotation}°)</span>
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleReset}
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 transition shadow-xs cursor-pointer"
                title="Reset Posisi & Zoom"
              >
                <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>Reset</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Tombol Aksi Bawah */}
        <div className="pt-2 border-t border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 flex items-center justify-end gap-3">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            disabled={isProcessing}
            className="px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-900 text-xs font-semibold cursor-pointer transition"
          >
            Batal
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleCropConfirm}
            disabled={isProcessing || !imgLoaded}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-zinc-900 hover:bg-zinc-800 text-white dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-white dark:text-zinc-950 text-xs font-bold shadow-xs transition active:scale-95 disabled:opacity-50 cursor-pointer"
          >
            {isProcessing ? (
              <>
                <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" />
                <span>Memproses Crop...</span>
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>Terapkan & Unggah</span>
              </>
            )}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```javascript
'use client';

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import PanitiaNavbar from '@/components/panitia/navbar';
import AdminPresenceTracker from '@/components/panitia/AdminPresenceTracker';

export default function PanitiaLayoutWrapper({ currentAdmin, children }) {
  const [collapsed, setCollapsed] = useState(false);
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem('panitia_sidebar_collapsed');
      if (saved !== null) {
        setCollapsed(saved === 'true');
      }
    } catch (e) {}
    setMounted(true);
  }, []);

  const toggleCollapsed = () => {
    setCollapsed((prev) => {
      const next = !prev;
      try {
        localStorage.setItem('panitia_sidebar_collapsed', String(next));
      } catch (e) {}
      return next;
    });
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-white dark:bg-black text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 flex flex-col transition-colors">
      {/* Tracker Presence Online/Offline Admin */}
      {currentAdmin && <AdminPresenceTracker />}

      {/* Navbar Panitia dengan Collapsible Sidebar & Mobile Fixed Topbar */}
      {currentAdmin && (
        <PanitiaNavbar
          currentAdmin={currentAdmin}
          collapsed={collapsed}
          toggleCollapsed={toggleCollapsed}
        />
      )}

      {/* Konten Utama dengan Margin Kiri Dinamis Menyesuaikan Sidebar Desktop */}
      <main
        className={`flex-1 flex flex-col transition-all duration-300 ${
          currentAdmin
            ? collapsed
              ? 'lg:pl-20'
              : 'lg:pl-64'
            : ''
        }`}
      >
        {children}
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```javascript
                  <div className="h-px bg-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 my-1 mx-2" />

                {/* Daftar Menu UL LI (Bisa Ditutup Default Tertutup saat Expanded, selalu tampil icon saat Collapsed) */}
                {(!collapsed ? isGroupOpen : true) && (

          >

      {/* Mobile Drawer (Overlay) */}
      {mobileDrawerOpen && (
        <div className="lg:hidden fixed inset-0 z-50 flex">

          <div className="relative w-72 bg-white dark:bg-black border-r border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 p-5 flex flex-col h-full z-10 transition-colors">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-4 border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">

                    {isGroupOpen && (

                        {visibleItems.map((item) => {

                          const Icon = item.icon;

                                className={`flex items-center gap-3 px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold transition ${
                                  isActive
                                    ? 'bg-zinc-900 text-white dark:bg-zinc-100 dark:text-zinc-950'
                                    : 'text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-900'
                                }`}
                              >
                                <Icon className="w-4 h-4" />
```

```javascript
import Link from 'next/link';

export default function TombolPanitia({
  children,
  href,
  onClick,
  variant = 'primary',
  size = 'md',
  className = '',
  disabled = false,
  type = 'button',
  icon: Icon,
}) {
  const baseStyles = 'inline-flex items-center justify-center font-medium rounded-xl transition-all duration-150 active:scale-95 disabled:opacity-50 disabled:pointer-events-none cursor-pointer';

  const sizeStyles = {
    sm: 'text-xs px-2.5 py-1.5 gap-1.5',
    md: 'text-xs sm:text-sm px-4 py-2 gap-2',
    lg: 'text-sm px-5 py-2.5 gap-2.5',
  };

  const variantStyles = {
    primary: 'bg-blue-700 hover:bg-blue-800 text-white dark:bg-blue-600 dark:hover:bg-blue-500 dark:text-white shadow-sm shadow-blue-900/15',
    secondary: 'bg-blue-50/80 hover:bg-blue-100 text-blue-950 border border-blue-200/80 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800',
    danger: 'bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-700 text-white shadow-xs',
    outline: 'border border-blue-200 dark:border-zinc-800 text-blue-950 dark:text-zinc-300 hover:bg-blue-50/60 dark:hover:bg-zinc-900',
    ghost: 'text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 hover:text-blue-700 dark:hover:text-white hover:bg-blue-50/60 dark:hover:bg-zinc-900',
  };

  const combinedClasses = `${baseStyles} ${sizeStyles[size] || sizeStyles.md} ${variantStyles[variant] || variantStyles.primary} ${className}`;

  if (href) {
    return (
      <Link href={href} className={combinedClasses}>
        {Icon && <Icon className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />}
        {children}
      </Link>
    );
  }

  return (
    <button
      type={type}
      onClick={onClick}
      disabled={disabled}
      className={combinedClasses}
    >
      {Icon && <Icon className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />}
      {children}
    </button>
  );
}
```

```javascript
'use client';

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Calendar } from 'lucide-react';
import { getActiveTimelineStage } from '@/utils/timelineUtils';
import { useTranslation } from '@/hooks/useTranslation';

export default function HeroTimelineProgress() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [stage, setStage] = useState(() => getActiveTimelineStage());

  useEffect(() => {
    setStage(getActiveTimelineStage());
  }, []);

  const stageTitle = stage?.itemNumber
    ? t(`timeline_kpu.t${parseInt(stage.itemNumber, 10)}_judul`, stage.title)
    : stage?.title === 'Pemungutan Suara Selesai'
    ? t('timeline_kpu.status_selesai', stage.title)
    : stage?.title;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-2">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
        <span className="text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400 flex items-center gap-1.5 font-medium">
          <Calendar className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400" />
          <span>{t('hero.current_stage', 'Tahapan Berjalan')}</span>
        </span>
        <span
          className="text-blue-950 dark:text-zinc-100 font-bold truncate max-w-[200px]"
          title={stageTitle}
        >
          {stageTitle}
        </span>
      </div>
      <div className="w-full bg-blue-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 rounded-full h-2.5 overflow-hidden">
        <div
          className="bg-blue-700 dark:bg-blue-500 h-2.5 rounded-full transition-all duration-700 shadow-xs"
          style={{ width: `${stage.progressPercent}%` }}
        />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```javascript
'use client';

import { useEffect } from 'react';
import Image from 'next/image';
import {
  X,
  GraduationCap,
  UserCheck,
  CheckCircle2,
  FileText,
  Mail,
  Phone,
  Compass,
  Target,
  ExternalLink,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { useTranslation } from '@/hooks/useTranslation';

export default function KandidatFullscreenModal({ kandidat, onClose }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  // Cegah scroll pada body saat modal terbuka
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!kandidat) return;
    const originalOverflow = document.body.style.overflow;
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';

    const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') onClose();
    };

    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => {
      document.body.style.overflow = originalOverflow;
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    };
  }, [kandidat, onClose]);

  if (!kandidat) return null;

  const detail = kandidat.detail_kandidat || {};

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-6 bg-black/85 backdrop-blur-md animate-in fade-in duration-200">
      {/* Backdrop click to close */}
      <div className="absolute inset-0" onClick={onClose} />

      {/* Modal Container */}
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-4xl max-h-[92vh] bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 rounded-3xl overflow-hidden flex flex-col shadow-2xl z-10 transition-colors">
        {/* Header Modal */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-6 py-4 border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 bg-white/90 dark:bg-zinc-950/90 backdrop-blur-md shrink-0">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">

              <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>{t('ui.verified', 'Terverifikasi KPU')}</span>
            </span>
          </div>

          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-zinc-100 hover:bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300 transition cursor-pointer"
            aria-label={t('ui.close_detail', 'Tutup Detail')}
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Modal Body Scrollable */}
        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-6 sm:p-8 space-y-6">
          {/* Top Section: Foto & Biodata Ringkas */}
          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-6 items-center sm:items-start pb-6 border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800">
            {/* Foto Kandidat */}
            <div className="relative w-44 sm:w-52 aspect-4/5 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 shadow-md shrink-0">
              {kandidat.fotodiri_kandidat ? (
                <Image
                  src={kandidat.fotodiri_kandidat}
                  alt={kandidat.nama_kandidat}
                  fill
                  className="object-cover object-top"
                  sizes="(max-width: 640px) 176px, 208px"
                  priority
                />
              ) : (
```

```javascript
'use client';

import { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import KandidatCard from '@/components/public/KandidatCard';
import KandidatFullscreenModal from '@/components/public/KandidatFullscreenModal';
import { Users, Info, CheckCircle2, XCircle } from 'lucide-react';
import { useTranslation } from '@/hooks/useTranslation';
import { useTranslatedData } from '@/hooks/useTranslatedData';
import { getPublikKandidat } from '@/api/publlic/kandidat';
import TranslatingNotice from '@/components/public/TranslatingNotice';

export default function KandidatPortalClient() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { data: kandidatList, loading, translating } = useTranslatedData('kandidat', getPublikKandidat);
  const [selectedKandidat, setSelectedKandidat] = useState(null);

  // Sorting: yang lolos seleksi (!is_eliminated) di atas, yang tereliminasi (is_eliminated) di bawah
  const sortedKandidat = useMemo(() => {
    return [...kandidatList].sort((a, b) => {
      const aElim = Boolean(a.is_eliminated);
      const bElim = Boolean(b.is_eliminated);
      if (aElim === bElim) return 0;
      return aElim ? 1 : -1;
    });
  }, [kandidatList]);

  const totalLolos = kandidatList.filter((k) => !k.is_eliminated).length;
  const totalEliminasi = kandidatList.filter((k) => k.is_eliminated).length;

  if (loading) {
    return translating ? (
      <TranslatingNotice show fullHeight />
    ) : (
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-4 sm:gap-6">
        {[1, 2].map((n) => (
          <div key={n} className="h-56 rounded-3xl bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-900/60 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 animate-pulse" />
        ))}
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 sm:space-y-8">
      {/* Banner Informasi Status Seleksi Pemilu */}
      <div className="p-4 sm:p-5 rounded-2xl bg-blue-50/80 dark:bg-blue-950/40 border border-blue-200/90 dark:border-blue-900/60 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between gap-3.5 backdrop-blur-md shadow-xs">
        <div className="flex items-start sm:items-center gap-3">
          <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 text-white flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 shadow-xs">
            <Info className="w-4 h-4" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h2 className="text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold text-blue-950 dark:text-zinc-100">
              {t('kandidat.banner_title', 'Tahapan Seleksi Berkas & Verifikasi Kandidat')}
            </h2>
            <p className="text-[11px] sm:text-xs text-blue-900/80 dark:text-zinc-400 leading-relaxed">
              {t(
                'kandidat.banner_desc',
                'Saat ini KPU Mahasiswa sedang melaksanakan tahapan verifikasi berkas dan uji kualifikasi calon. Kandidat di bawah ini ditampilkan berdasarkan status hasil verifikasi seleksi.'
              )}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Ringkasan Jumlah Status */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0 self-end sm:self-center">
          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-white/90 dark:bg-zinc-900/90 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-200/80 dark:border-emerald-900/50 text-[10px] sm:text-xs font-bold shadow-2xs">
            <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>{totalLolos} {t('kandidat.lolos', 'Lolos')}</span>
          </span>
          {totalEliminasi > 0 && (
            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-white/90 dark:bg-zinc-900/90 text-red-700 dark:text-red-400 border border-red-200/80 dark:border-red-900/50 text-[10px] sm:text-xs font-bold shadow-2xs">
              <XCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>{totalEliminasi} {t('kandidat.tereliminasi', 'Tereliminasi')}</span>
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Konten Daftar Card Kandidat Horizontal */}
      {sortedKandidat.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="p-12 text-center rounded-3xl bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 max-w-md mx-auto space-y-3 shadow-xs">
          <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto">
            <Users className="w-6 h-6" />
          </div>
          <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
            {t('kandidat.empty_title', 'Belum Ada Data Kandidat')}
          </h3>
          <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
            {t(
              'kandidat.empty_desc',
              'Daftar calon kandidat akan segera ditampilkan setelah tahapan pendaftaran dan verifikasi berkas dibuka oleh panitia.'
            )}
          </p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-4 sm:gap-6">
          {sortedKandidat.map((kandidat, idx) => (
            <KandidatCard
              key={kandidat.id || idx}
              kandidat={kandidat}
              onEnlarge={(k) => setSelectedKandidat(k)}
            />
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Fullscreen Detail Modal (Preview Zoom) */}
      {selectedKandidat && (
        <KandidatFullscreenModal
          kandidat={selectedKandidat}
          onClose={() => setSelectedKandidat(null)}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```javascript
'use client';

import { useState, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useTranslation } from '@/hooks/useTranslation';
import { ChevronDown, Check, Globe } from 'lucide-react';

export default function LanguageDropdown() {
  const { lang, languages, changeLanguage, t } = useTranslation();
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const dropdownRef = useRef(null);

  const currentLang = languages.find((l) => l.kode === lang) || {
    kode: 'id',
    nama: 'Bahasa Indonesia',
    flag: '🇮🇩',
  };

  // Close when clicking outside
  useEffect(() => {
    function handleClickOutside(event) {
      if (dropdownRef.current && !dropdownRef.current.contains(event.target)) {
        setIsOpen(false);
      }
    }
    if (isOpen) {
      document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    }
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    };
  }, [isOpen]);

  const handleSelect = (code) => {
    changeLanguage(code);
    setIsOpen(false);
  };

  return (
    <div className="relative" ref={dropdownRef}>
      {/* Tombol Trigger: Hanya Emote/Icon Bendera Negara + Chevron (Tanpa tulisan kode ID / EN) */}
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setIsOpen(!isOpen)}
        className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-zinc-100/80 hover:bg-zinc-200/80 dark:bg-zinc-900/80 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-200 border border-zinc-200/80 dark:border-zinc-800 text-xs font-semibold transition-all duration-200 cursor-pointer active:scale-95 shadow-2xs"
        aria-label="Pilih Bahasa Situs"
        title={`Bahasa Aktif: ${currentLang.nama}`}
      >
        <span className="text-base sm:text-lg leading-none select-none">
          {currentLang.flag}
        </span>
        <ChevronDown
          className={`w-3 h-3 text-zinc-500 transition-transform duration-200 ${
            isOpen ? 'rotate-180 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400' : ''
          }`}
        />
      </button>

      {/* Popover Dropdown Menu */}
      {isOpen && (
        <div className="absolute right-0 mt-1.5 w-48 rounded-2xl bg-white/95 dark:bg-zinc-950/95 backdrop-blur-md border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 shadow-xl py-1.5 z-50 animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-150">
          <div className="px-3 py-1.5 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800/80 mb-1">
            <span className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-zinc-400 dark:text-zinc-500 flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <Globe className="w-3 h-3" />
              <span>{t('umum.bahasa_situs', 'Bahasa Situs')}</span>
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-0.5 px-1">
            {languages.map((l) => {
              const isSelected = l.kode === lang;

              return (
                <button
                  key={l.kode}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => handleSelect(l.kode)}
                  className={`w-full flex items-center justify-between px-2.5 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-medium transition cursor-pointer ${
                    isSelected
                      ? 'bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950/60 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300 font-bold'
                      : 'text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-900'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                    <span className="text-base select-none">{l.flag}</span>
                    <span className="truncate">{l.nama}</span>
                  </div>

                  {isSelected && (
                    <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 shrink-0" />
                  )}
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```javascript
'use client';

import { useState, useRef } from 'react';
import Image from 'next/image';
import {
  UserCheck,
  GraduationCap,
  Briefcase,
  Maximize2,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { recordTrafikSosmed } from '@/api/publlic/panitia';
import { useTranslation } from '@/hooks/useTranslation';

/**
 * Helper untuk memformat URL sosial media
 */
function formatSosmedLink(type, input) {
  if (!input) return null;
  const trimmed = input.trim();
  if (trimmed.startsWith('http://') || trimmed.startsWith('https://')) {
    return trimmed;
  }

  switch (type) {
    case 'whatsapp': {
      let clean = trimmed.replace(/\D/g, '');
      if (clean.startsWith('0')) clean = '62' + clean.slice(1);
      return `https://wa.me/${clean}`;
    }
    case 'instagram': {
      const clean = trimmed.replace(/^@/, '');
      return `https://instagram.com/${clean}`;
    }
    case 'tiktok': {
      const clean = trimmed.replace(/^@/, '');
      return `https://www.tiktok.com/@${clean}`;
    }
    case 'threads': {
      const clean = trimmed.replace(/^@/, '');
      return `https://www.threads.net/@${clean}`;
    }
    default:
      return trimmed;
  }
}

export default function PanitiaCard({ panitia, onEnlarge }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const cardRef = useRef(null);
  const defaultRotateX = 1.5;
  const defaultRotateY = -2.5;

  const [rotX, setRotX] = useState(defaultRotateX);
  const [rotY, setRotY] = useState(defaultRotateY);
  const [isHovered, setIsHovered] = useState(false);

  // Ambil data sosmed
  const sosmedItem = Array.isArray(panitia.sosmed_panitia) && panitia.sosmed_panitia.length > 0
    ? panitia.sosmed_panitia[0]
    : (panitia.sosmed_panitia || {});

  const waLink = formatSosmedLink('whatsapp', sosmedItem.whatsapp);
  const igLink = formatSosmedLink('instagram', sosmedItem.instagram);
  const tiktokLink = formatSosmedLink('tiktok', sosmedItem.tiktok);
  const threadsLink = formatSosmedLink('threads', sosmedItem.threads);

  const hasSosmed = Boolean(waLink || igLink || tiktokLink || threadsLink);
  const isPngPhoto = panitia.foto_panitia?.toLowerCase().includes('.png');

  const handleMouseMove = (e) => {
    if (!cardRef.current) return;
    const rect = cardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
    const y = e.clientY - rect.top;

    const centerX = rect.width / 2;
    const centerY = rect.height / 2;

    const calcY = ((x - centerX) / centerX) * 4; // Max 4 deg
    const calcX = -((y - centerY) / centerY) * 4;

    setRotX(calcX);
    setRotY(calcY);
  };

  const handleMouseEnter = () => {
    setIsHovered(true);
  };

  const handleMouseLeave = () => {
    setIsHovered(false);
    setRotX(defaultRotateX);
    setRotY(defaultRotateY);
  };

  return (
    <div
      className="w-[calc(100vw-2.5rem)] sm:w-[calc(100vw-3.5rem)] md:w-[calc((100%-1.5rem)/2)] shrink-0 snap-start"
      style={{ perspective: '1200px' }}
    >
      <div
        ref={cardRef}
        onMouseMove={handleMouseMove}
        onMouseEnter={handleMouseEnter}
        onMouseLeave={handleMouseLeave}
        style={{
          transform: `rotateX(${rotX}deg) rotateY(${rotY}deg) ${isHovered ? 'translateY(-4px) scale(1.008)' : 'translateY(0)'
            }`,
          transition: isHovered
            ? 'transform 0.1s ease-out'
            : 'transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1)',
        }}
        className="group relative rounded-3xl bg-white/95 dark:bg-zinc-950/95 border border-zinc-200/90 dark:border-zinc-800/90 shadow-[0_12px_28px_-10px_rgba(30,58,138,0.1)] dark:shadow-[0_16px_32px_-12px_rgba(0,0,0,0.85)] backdrop-blur-md overflow-hidden transition-all duration-300 hover:shadow-[0_20px_40px_-10px_rgba(30,58,138,0.18)] dark:hover:shadow-[0_24px_48px_-12px_rgba(0,0,0,0.95)] flex flex-col justify-between"
      >
        {/* Background Image Opsional Transparansi ~60% */}
        {panitia.bg_image && (
          <div
            className="absolute inset-0 z-0 bg-cover bg-center pointer-events-none dark:opacity-100 opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-300"
            style={{ backgroundImage: `url(${panitia.bg_image})` }}
          />
        )}

        {/* Lapisan Tint Netral untuk Keterbacaan Teks Maksimal */}
        {panitia.bg_image && (
          <div className="absolute inset-0 z-0 bg-white/80 dark:bg-zinc-950/80 backdrop-blur-[2px] pointer-events-none" />
        )}

        {/* Soft Lighting Glare */}
        <div
          className="absolute inset-0 z-0 pointer-events-none rounded-3xl opacity-30 dark:opacity-20 transition-opacity duration-300 group-hover:opacity-50"
          style={{
            background:
              'radial-gradient(circle at 80% 20%, rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.12), transparent 60%)',

        {/* KONTEN KARTU PANITIA */}
        <div className="relative z-10 flex flex-row items-stretch justify-between p-4 sm:p-5 md:p-6 gap-3.5 sm:gap-5 min-h-[200px] sm:min-h-[220px]">
```

```javascript
'use client';

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom';
import Image from 'next/image';
import {
  UserCheck,
  GraduationCap,
  X,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { recordTrafikSosmed } from '@/api/publlic/panitia';
import { useTranslation } from '@/hooks/useTranslation';

/**
 * Helper untuk memformat URL sosial media
 */
function formatSosmedLink(type, input) {
  if (!input) return null;
  const trimmed = input.trim();
  if (trimmed.startsWith('http://') || trimmed.startsWith('https://')) {
    return trimmed;
  }

  switch (type) {
    case 'whatsapp': {
      let clean = trimmed.replace(/\D/g, '');
      if (clean.startsWith('0')) clean = '62' + clean.slice(1);
      return `https://wa.me/${clean}`;
    }
    case 'instagram': {
      const clean = trimmed.replace(/^@/, '');
      return `https://instagram.com/${clean}`;
    }
    case 'tiktok': {
      const clean = trimmed.replace(/^@/, '');
      return `https://www.tiktok.com/@${clean}`;
    }
    case 'threads': {
      const clean = trimmed.replace(/^@/, '');
      return `https://www.threads.net/@${clean}`;
    }
    default:
      return trimmed;
  }
}

export default function PanitiaFullscreenModal({ panitia, onClose }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    setMounted(true);
  }, []);

  // ESC key listener dan body scroll lock
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!panitia) return;

    const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        onClose();
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    };
  }, [panitia, onClose]);

  if (!mounted || !panitia) return null;

  const sosmedItem = Array.isArray(panitia.sosmed_panitia) && panitia.sosmed_panitia.length > 0
    ? panitia.sosmed_panitia[0]
    : (panitia.sosmed_panitia || {});

  const waLink = formatSosmedLink('whatsapp', sosmedItem.whatsapp);
  const igLink = formatSosmedLink('instagram', sosmedItem.instagram);
  const tiktokLink = formatSosmedLink('tiktok', sosmedItem.tiktok);
  const threadsLink = formatSosmedLink('threads', sosmedItem.threads);

  const hasSosmed = Boolean(waLink || igLink || tiktokLink || threadsLink);
  const isPngPhoto = panitia.foto_panitia?.toLowerCase().includes('.png');

  return createPortal(
    <div
      className="fixed inset-0 z-[9999] flex items-center justify-center p-0 sm:p-4 bg-black/85 backdrop-blur-md overflow-hidden animate-in fade-in duration-200"
      onClick={onClose}
    >
      <div
        className="relative w-full h-[100dvh] sm:h-auto max-w-2xl bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 sm:border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 rounded-none sm:rounded-3xl p-4 sm:p-7 sm:space-y-6 shadow-2xl overflow-hidden flex flex-col justify-between animate-in zoom-in-95 duration-200"
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
        {/* Background Image di Modal jika ada (~60% transparansi) */}
        {panitia.bg_image && (
          <div
            className="absolute inset-0 z-0 bg-cover bg-center pointer-events-none opacity-60"
            style={{ backgroundImage: `url(${panitia.bg_image})` }}
          />
        )}
        {panitia.bg_image && (
          <div className="absolute inset-0 z-0 bg-white/85 dark:bg-zinc-950/85 backdrop-blur-xs pointer-events-none" />
        )}

        {/* Header Modal Fullscreen Tanpa Nomor Urut */}
        <div className="relative z-10 flex items-center justify-between pb-3 sm:pb-4 border-b border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 shrink-0">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 sm:gap-2">
            <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 sm:px-3 sm:py-1 rounded-full bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950/80 border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800 text-[11px] sm:text-xs font-bold text-blue-900 dark:text-blue-300">
              {panitia.jabatan_panitia}
            </span>
            {panitia.sub_jabatan_panitia && (
              <span className="px-2 py-0.5 sm:px-2.5 sm:py-1 rounded-full bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700 text-[11px] sm:text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300">
                {panitia.sub_jabatan_panitia}
              </span>
            )}
          </div>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-1.5 sm:p-2 rounded-xl bg-zinc-100 hover:bg-zinc-200 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 transition cursor-pointer"
            title={t('ui.close_view', 'Tutup Tampilan')}
          >
            <X className="w-4 h-4 sm:w-5 sm:h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Konten Diperbesar */}
        <div className="relative z-10 flex-1 overflow-y-auto py-3 sm:py-0 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center sm:items-stretch gap-4 sm:gap-6">
          {/* Foto Diperbesar */}

            {panitia.foto_panitia ? (

                sizes="(max-width: 640px) 150px, 320px"
```

```javascript
              <div className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-900/40 border border-zinc-200/80 dark:border-zinc-800/80">
                <span className="text-[9px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-zinc-400 block">
                  {t('ui.capresma', 'Capresma')}
                </span>
                <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 truncate">
```

```javascript
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';

    const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') onClose();
    };

    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
```

```javascript
'use client';

import PaslonSlider from '@/components/public/PaslonSlider';
import TranslatingNotice from '@/components/public/TranslatingNotice';
import { useTranslatedData } from '@/hooks/useTranslatedData';
import { getPublikPaslonList } from '@/api/publlic/paslon';

export default function PaslonPortalClient() {
  const { data, loading, translating } = useTranslatedData('paslon', getPublikPaslonList);

  if (loading) {
    return translating ? (
      <TranslatingNotice show fullHeight />
    ) : (
      <div className="h-72 rounded-3xl bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-900/60 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 animate-pulse" />
    );
  }

  return <PaslonSlider paslonList={data} />;
}
```

```javascript
'use client';

import { useState, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import PaslonCard from '@/components/public/PaslonCard';
import PaslonFullscreenModal from '@/components/public/PaslonFullscreenModal';
import { ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, Vote, SlidersHorizontal } from 'lucide-react';
import { useTranslation } from '@/hooks/useTranslation';

export default function PaslonSlider({
  paslonList = [],
  renderAction = null,
  emptyTitle,
  emptyDesc,
}) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [selectedPaslon, setSelectedPaslon] = useState(null);
  const [currentIndex, setCurrentIndex] = useState(0);
  const sliderRef = useRef(null);

  // Perbarui current index saat user menggeser (scroll)
  const handleScroll = () => {
    if (!sliderRef.current) return;
    const { scrollLeft, clientWidth } = sliderRef.current;
    if (clientWidth === 0) return;
    const newIndex = Math.round(scrollLeft / clientWidth);
    setCurrentIndex(newIndex);
  };

  const scrollToIndex = (index) => {
    if (!sliderRef.current) return;
    const target = Math.max(0, Math.min(paslonList.length - 1, index));
    const cardWidth = sliderRef.current.clientWidth;
    sliderRef.current.scrollTo({
      left: target * cardWidth,
      behavior: 'smooth',
    });
    setCurrentIndex(target);
  };

  const handlePrev = () => scrollToIndex(currentIndex - 1);
  const handleNext = () => scrollToIndex(currentIndex + 1);

  if (paslonList.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="p-12 text-center rounded-3xl bg-white dark:bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 max-w-md mx-auto space-y-3 shadow-xs">
        <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto">
          <Vote className="w-6 h-6" />
        </div>
        <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
          {emptyTitle || t('ui.paslon_empty_title', 'Belum Ada Pasangan Calon')}
        </h3>
        <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
          {emptyDesc || t('ui.paslon_empty_desc', 'Daftar pasangan calon akan segera diumumkan setelah penetapan nomor urut oleh panitia KPU.')}
        </p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-5 w-full">
      {/* Bar Header Navigasi Slider */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-1">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400">
          <SlidersHorizontal className="w-4 h-4 text-zinc-400" />
          <span>
            {t('ui.slider_of', 'Paslon {n} dari {total}', { n: currentIndex + 1, total: paslonList.length })}
          </span>
        </div>

        {/* Tombol Geser Kiri / Kanan */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handlePrev}
            disabled={currentIndex === 0}
            className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed transition shadow-xs cursor-pointer active:scale-95"
            aria-label={t('ui.prev_aria', 'Geser ke Paslon Sebelumnya')}
            title={t('ui.prev', 'Sebelumnya')}
          >
            <ChevronLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleNext}
            disabled={currentIndex >= paslonList.length - 1}
            className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed transition shadow-xs cursor-pointer active:scale-95"
            aria-label={t('ui.next_aria', 'Geser ke Paslon Berikutnya')}
            title={t('ui.next', 'Berikutnya')}
          >
            <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Container Carousel Horizontal Swipeable */}
      <div
        ref={sliderRef}
        onScroll={handleScroll}
        className="flex overflow-x-auto snap-x snap-mandatory scroll-smooth no-scrollbar gap-4 sm:gap-6 py-2 px-1 focus:outline-hidden"
        style={{ scrollSnapType: 'x mandatory', scrollbarWidth: 'none', msOverflowStyle: 'none' }}
      >
        {paslonList.map((paslon, idx) => (
          <div
            key={paslon.id || idx}
            className="shrink-0 w-full snap-center"
          >
            <PaslonCard
              paslon={paslon}
              onEnlarge={(p) => setSelectedPaslon(p)}
              actionButton={renderAction ? renderAction(paslon) : null}
            />
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Indikator Titik (Dots Indicator) */}
      {paslonList.length > 1 && (
        <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 pt-2">
          {paslonList.map((_, dotIdx) => (
            <button
              key={dotIdx}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => scrollToIndex(dotIdx)}
              className={`h-2 rounded-full transition-all duration-300 cursor-pointer ${
                dotIdx === currentIndex
                  ? 'w-7 bg-zinc-900 dark:bg-zinc-100'
                  : 'w-2 bg-zinc-300 dark:bg-zinc-700 hover:bg-zinc-400'
              }`}
              aria-label={t('ui.see_paslon', 'Lihat Paslon {n}', { n: dotIdx + 1 })}
            />
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Modal Fullscreen Detail Paslon */}
      {selectedPaslon && (
        <PaslonFullscreenModal
          paslon={selectedPaslon}
          onClose={() => setSelectedPaslon(null)}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```javascript
'use client';

import { useState, useRef, useMemo } from 'react';
import PanitiaCard from '@/components/public/PanitiaCard';
import PanitiaFullscreenModal from '@/components/public/PanitiaFullscreenModal';
import {
  ChevronLeft,
  ChevronRight,
  Briefcase,
  Filter,
  Users,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { useTranslation } from '@/hooks/useTranslation';

function PanitiaJabatanRow({ jabatanName, members, onEnlarge }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const scrollRef = useRef(null);

  const scroll = (direction) => {
    if (scrollRef.current) {
      const containerWidth = scrollRef.current.clientWidth;
      // Pada desktop geser per kartu (~50% container), pada mobile geser penuh kartu (~100% container)
      const scrollAmount =
        direction === 'left'
          ? -(containerWidth >= 768 ? containerWidth / 2 : containerWidth)
          : containerWidth >= 768 ? containerWidth / 2 : containerWidth;
      scrollRef.current.scrollBy({ left: scrollAmount, behavior: 'smooth' });
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* Header Jabatan dengan Tombol Navigasi Horizontal Scroll */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-blue-100/70 dark:border-zinc-800/80">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
          <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950/60 border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-900/60 flex items-center justify-center text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-400 shrink-0">
            <Briefcase className="w-4 h-4" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h2 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-black text-blue-950 dark:text-zinc-100">
              {jabatanName}
            </h2>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 font-mono">
              {members.length} {t('panitia.members_count', 'Anggota Terdaftar')}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Tombol Geser Horizontal (Kiri/Kanan) */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => scroll('left')}
            className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-blue-50 hover:bg-blue-100 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 text-blue-950 dark:text-zinc-300 border border-blue-200 dark:border-zinc-800 transition active:scale-95 cursor-pointer shadow-xs"
            aria-label={`Geser ke kiri ${jabatanName}`}
          >
            <ChevronLeft className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-400" />
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => scroll('right')}
            className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-blue-50 hover:bg-blue-100 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 text-blue-950 dark:text-zinc-300 border border-blue-200 dark:border-zinc-800 transition active:scale-95 cursor-pointer shadow-xs"
            aria-label={`Geser ke kanan ${jabatanName}`}
          >
            <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-400" />
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Horizontal Scrollable Row (seperti dokumentasi) */}
      <div
        ref={scrollRef}
        className="flex gap-4 sm:gap-6 overflow-x-auto pb-4 pt-1 snap-x snap-mandatory scroll-smooth no-scrollbar"
        style={{ scrollbarWidth: 'thin' }}
      >
        {members.map((panitia, idx) => (
          <PanitiaCard
            key={panitia.id || idx}
            panitia={panitia}
            index={idx}
            onEnlarge={onEnlarge}
          />
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function StrukturPanitiaClient({ panitiaList = [] }) {
  const [selectedJabatan, setSelectedJabatan] = useState('all');
  const [fullscreenPanitia, setFullscreenPanitia] = useState(null);

  // Kelompokkan panitia berdasarkan jabatan_panitia
  const { groupedByJabatan, uniqueJabatanList } = useMemo(() => {
    const groups = {};
    const order = [];

    panitiaList.forEach((item) => {
      const jab = (item.jabatan_panitia || 'Anggota Panitia').trim();
      if (!groups[jab]) {
        groups[jab] = [];
        order.push(jab);
      }
      groups[jab].push(item);
    });

    return {
      groupedByJabatan: groups,
      uniqueJabatanList: order,
    };
  }, [panitiaList]);

  // Filter kelompok yang ditampilkan
  const displayedJabatanList = useMemo(() => {
    if (selectedJabatan === 'all') {
      return uniqueJabatanList;
    }
    return uniqueJabatanList.filter((jab) => jab === selectedJabatan);
  }, [uniqueJabatanList, selectedJabatan]);

  if (panitiaList.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="p-12 text-center rounded-3xl bg-white/90 dark:bg-zinc-950/90 border border-blue-100 dark:border-zinc-800 max-w-md mx-auto space-y-3 shadow-xs my-8">
        <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl bg-blue-50 dark:bg-zinc-900 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-400 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto">
          <Users className="w-6 h-6" />
        </div>
        <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-blue-950 dark:text-zinc-100">
          Data Panitia Sedang Diperbarui
        </h2>
        <p className="text-xs text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400">
          Daftar susunan panitia KPU sedang dalam tahap finalisasi surat keputusan kepengurusan.
        </p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-10 sm:space-y-12">
      {/* Bar Filter Dropdown Jabatan di Atas Card */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 p-4 sm:p-5 rounded-2xl bg-white/80 dark:bg-zinc-900/20 border border-blue-100/90 dark:border-zinc-800/90 backdrop-blur-md shadow-xs">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs sm:text-sm font-semibold text-blue-950 dark:text-zinc-100">
          <Filter className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-400 shrink-0" />
          <span>Filter Berdasarkan Jabatan:</span>
        </div>

        {/* Dropdown Select Jabatan */}
        <div className="relative w-full sm:w-72">
          <select
            value={selectedJabatan}
            onChange={(e) => setSelectedJabatan(e.target.value)}
            className="w-full appearance-none px-4 py-2.5 pr-10 rounded-xl bg-blue-50/60 dark:bg-zinc-950 border border-blue-200/80 dark:border-zinc-800 text-xs font-semibold text-blue-950 dark:text-zinc-100 focus:outline-hidden focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-600 cursor-pointer transition shadow-xs"
          >
            <option value="all">
              Semua Jabatan ({panitiaList.length} Panitia)
            </option>
            {uniqueJabatanList.map((jab) => (
              <option key={jab} value={jab}>
                {jab} ({(groupedByJabatan[jab] || []).length})
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
          <div className="pointer-events-none absolute right-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-zinc-400">
            <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4 rotate-90" />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Daftar Kelompok Jabatan (Kebawah), Masing-masing Jabatan Scroll Horizontal */}
      <div className="space-y-10 sm:space-y-14">
        {displayedJabatanList.map((jabatanName) => (
          <PanitiaJabatanRow
            key={jabatanName}
            jabatanName={jabatanName}
            members={groupedByJabatan[jabatanName] || []}
            onEnlarge={setFullscreenPanitia}
          />
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Modal Fullscreen Preview Panitia Terbuka di Root Halaman */}
      <PanitiaFullscreenModal
        panitia={fullscreenPanitia}
        onClose={() => setFullscreenPanitia(null)}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

```javascript
'use client';

import { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import BgWaveDivider from '@/components/public/bgWaveDivider';
import { Clock, CheckCircle2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { TIMELINE_KPU_ITEMS, computeTimelineStatus } from '@/utils/timelineUtils';
import { useTranslation } from '@/hooks/useTranslation';

export default function TimelineSection() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const sectionRef = useRef(null);
  const scrollTimeoutRef = useRef(null);

  const [isInView, setIsInView] = useState(false);
  const [isScrolling, setIsScrolling] = useState(false);
  const [nowDate, setNowDate] = useState(() => new Date());

  // 1. Perbarui tanggal saat component mount
  useEffect(() => {
    setNowDate(new Date());
  }, []);

  // 2. IntersectionObserver: Hanya aktifkan animasi garis saat section ada di viewport
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = sectionRef.current;
    if (!el) return;

    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      ([entry]) => {
        setIsInView(entry.isIntersecting);
      },
      {
        threshold: 0.1,
        rootMargin: '50px 0px 50px 0px',
      }
    );

    observer.observe(el);
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, []);

  // 3. Scroll Listener: Jeda animasi garis putus-putus saat user sedang scroll
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleScroll = () => {
      setIsScrolling(true);

      if (scrollTimeoutRef.current) {
        clearTimeout(scrollTimeoutRef.current);
      }

      scrollTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
        setIsScrolling(false);
      }, 180);
    };

    window.addEventListener('scroll', handleScroll, { passive: true });
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('scroll', handleScroll);
      if (scrollTimeoutRef.current) {
        clearTimeout(scrollTimeoutRef.current);
      }
    };
  }, []);

  // Animasi garis dijeda jika section TIDAK di viewport ATAU sedang discroll
  const isAnimationPaused = !isInView || isScrolling;

  // Hitung status dinamis untuk setiap agenda
  const timelineItems = TIMELINE_KPU_ITEMS.map((item) => ({
    ...item,
    status: computeTimelineStatus(item.tanggal, nowDate),
  }));

  const getStatusLabel = (status) => {
    if (status === 'Aktif') return t('timeline_kpu.status_berlangsung', 'Sedang Berlangsung');
    if (status === 'Selesai') return t('timeline_kpu.status_selesai', 'Selesai');
    return t('timeline_kpu.status_akan_datang', 'Akan Datang');
  };

  return (
    <section
      ref={sectionRef}
      className="relative flex flex-col justify-between pt-16 sm:pt-24 pb-0 bg-blue-50/80 dark:bg-[#0b0f19]/85 backdrop-blur-[1px] text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 transition-colors"
    >
      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto w-full my-auto space-y-14 px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-12">
        {/* Header Section Timeline */}
        <div className="text-center max-w-2xl mx-auto space-y-3">
          <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-white/90 dark:bg-zinc-900/90 border border-blue-200/80 dark:border-zinc-800 text-blue-800 dark:text-blue-400 text-xs font-semibold shadow-2xs">
            <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-blue-600 dark:bg-blue-400 animate-pulse" />
            <span>{t('timeline_kpu.badge', 'Jadwal Resmi KPU 2026')}</span>
          </div>
          <h2 className="text-2xl sm:text-4xl font-black text-blue-950 dark:text-zinc-100 tracking-tight">
            {t('timeline_kpu.title', 'Timeline Kegiatan KPU 2026')}
          </h2>
          <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300 leading-relaxed">
            {t(
              'timeline_kpu.desc',
              'Rangkaian tanggal pelaksanaan dari pendaftaran calon hingga hari pemungutan suara Pemilihan Umum Raya Mahasiswa Politeknik LP3I.'
            )}
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* GRID TIMELINE ZIG-ZAG */}
        <div
          className={`relative grid grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-x-6 gap-y-10 sm:gap-x-10 sm:gap-y-14 ${isAnimationPaused ? 'dashed-lines-paused' : ''
            }`}
        >
          {timelineItems.map((item) => {
            const itemIdx = parseInt(item.no, 10);
            const judulTerjemah = t(`timeline_kpu.t${itemIdx}_judul`, item.judul);
            const descTerjemah = t(`timeline_kpu.t${itemIdx}_desc`, item.deskripsi);
            const statusLabel = getStatusLabel(item.status);

            return (
              <div
                key={item.no}
                className={`relative flex flex-col ${item.orderClass || ''}`}
              >
                {/* KARTU JADWAL TIMELINE */}
                <div className="relative z-10 h-full p-4 sm:p-6 rounded-2xl bg-white/95 dark:bg-zinc-900/95 border border-blue-200/80 dark:border-zinc-800 hover:border-blue-500 dark:hover:border-blue-400 shadow-xs hover:shadow-lg transition-all duration-300 flex flex-col justify-between group overflow-hidden">
                  <div className="pointer-events-none absolute -top-10 -right-10 w-24 h-24 rounded-full bg-blue-500/10 dark:bg-blue-500/15 blur-xl group-hover:bg-blue-500/25 transition-all" />

                  <div className="space-y-3">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                      <div className="w-10 h-10 sm:w-11 sm:h-11 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-700 to-indigo-600 dark:from-blue-600 dark:to-indigo-500 text-white font-black flex items-center justify-center text-sm sm:text-base shadow-sm group-hover:scale-105 transition-transform">
                        {item.no}
                      </div>

                      {/* Status Badge */}
                      <span
                        className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider border ${item.status === 'Aktif'
                            ? 'bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950/80 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300 border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800'
                            : item.status === 'Selesai'
                              ? 'bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/70 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-800'
                              : 'bg-slate-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400 border-slate-200 dark:border-zinc-700'
                          }`}
                      >
                        {statusLabel}
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] sm:text-xs font-extrabold text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-400 tracking-wide pt-1">
                      <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0" />
                      <span>{item.tanggal}</span>
                    </div>

                    <h3 className="text-sm sm:text-base font-extrabold text-blue-950 dark:text-zinc-100 group-hover:text-blue-700 dark:group-hover:text-blue-400 transition-colors leading-snug">
                      {judulTerjemah}
                    </h3>

                    <p className="text-[11px] sm:text-xs text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400 leading-relaxed">
                      {descTerjemah}
                    </p>
                  </div>

                  {/* Footer Kartu */}
                  <div className="pt-4 mt-4 border-t border-blue-100/80 dark:border-zinc-800/80 flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
                    <span className="font-semibold">Agenda #{item.no}</span>
                    <CheckCircle2
                      className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 transition-opacity ${item.status === 'Selesai'
                          ? 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 opacity-100'
                          : 'text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 opacity-70 group-hover:opacity-100'
                        }`}
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* CONNECTOR GARIS PUTUS-PUTUS DESKTOP (lg: 4 div per baris) */}
                {item.desktopLine === 'right' && (
                  <div
                    aria-hidden="true"
                    className="hidden lg:flex items-center absolute top-1/2 -right-10 w-10 -translate-y-1/2 z-0 pointer-events-none"
                  >
                    <div className="w-full h-[3px] dashed-line-right" />
                    <div className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-blue-600 dark:bg-blue-400 -ml-1 shadow-[0_0_8px_#3b82f6]" />
                  </div>
                )}

                {item.desktopLine === 'down' && (
                  <div
                    aria-hidden="true"
                    className="hidden lg:flex flex-col items-center absolute -bottom-14 left-1/2 h-14 -translate-x-1/2 z-0 pointer-events-none"
                  >
                    <div className="h-full w-[3px] dashed-line-down" />
                    <div className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-blue-600 dark:bg-blue-400 -mt-1 shadow-[0_0_8px_#3b82f6]" />
                  </div>
                )}

                {item.desktopLine === 'left' && (
                  <div
                    aria-hidden="true"
                    className="hidden lg:flex items-center absolute top-1/2 -left-10 w-10 -translate-y-1/2 z-0 pointer-events-none"
                  >
                    <div className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-blue-600 dark:bg-blue-400 -mr-1 z-10 shadow-[0_0_8px_#3b82f6]" />
                    <div className="w-full h-[3px] dashed-line-left" />
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* CONNECTOR GARIS PUTUS-PUTUS MOBILE (< lg: 2 div per baris) */}
                {item.mobileLine === 'right' && (
                  <div
                    aria-hidden="true"

                  >
                    <div className="w-full h-[3px] dashed-line-right" />
                    <div className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-blue-600 dark:bg-blue-400 -ml-1 shadow-[0_0_8px_#3b82f6]" />
                  </div>
                )}

                {item.mobileLine === 'down' && (
                  <div
                    aria-hidden="true"
```

```javascript
'use client';

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Compass, X, ArrowDown } from 'lucide-react';
import { TIMING_CONFIG } from '@/lib/timingConfig';
import { useTranslation } from '@/hooks/useTranslation';

export default function MobileNavHint() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [showHint, setShowHint] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      const seen = sessionStorage.getItem('kpu_mobile_nav_hint_seen');
      if (!seen) {
        // Tampilkan dengan delay agar muncul setelah SiteOpening selesai
        const timer = setTimeout(() => {
          setShowHint(true);
        }, TIMING_CONFIG.MOBILE_NAV_HINT_DELAY);
        return () => clearTimeout(timer);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      // ignore
    }
  }, []);

  const handleDismiss = () => {
    setShowHint(false);
    try {
      sessionStorage.setItem('kpu_mobile_nav_hint_seen', 'true');
    } catch (e) {
      // ignore
    }
  };

  if (!showHint) return null;

  return (
    <aside
      aria-label="Petunjuk Navigasi Mobile"
      className="md:hidden fixed bottom-20 left-4 right-4 z-40 max-w-sm mx-auto animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 slide-in-from-bottom-3 duration-400 ease-out pointer-events-auto"
    >
      <div className="relative p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-white/95 dark:bg-zinc-900/95 backdrop-blur-md border border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100 shadow-[0_12px_30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.15)] dark:shadow-[0_12px_30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.6)] space-y-2">
        {/* Header Hint */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800/80 pb-2">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <div className="w-6 h-6 rounded-lg bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950/60 border border-blue-200/80 dark:border-blue-900/60 flex items-center justify-center text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-400 shrink-0">
              <Compass className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            </div>
            <span className="text-xs font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
              {t('hint.title', 'Navigasi Halaman')}
            </span>
          </div>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleDismiss}
            className="p-1 rounded-lg text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 transition cursor-pointer"
            aria-label="Tutup petunjuk navigasi"
          >
            <X className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Teks Petunjuk */}
        <p className="text-[11.5px] text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-300 leading-relaxed">
          {t('hint.desc', 'Menu utama dan bilik voting tersedia melalui panel navigasi di bagian bawah layar Anda.')}
        </p>

        {/* Action Button & Panah Arah ke Navbar Bawah */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-1">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleDismiss}
            className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-400 hover:underline cursor-pointer"
          >
            {t('hint.btn', 'Mengerti')}
          </button>

          {/* Elemen tanda panah terarah ke navbar bawah */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
            <span>Lihat ke bawah</span>
            <ArrowDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 animate-bounce" />
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Segitiga pointer yang mengarah langsung ke navbar di bawah */}
        <div className="absolute -bottom-2 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 w-4 h-4 bg-white/95 dark:bg-zinc-900/95 border-b border-r border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-800 rotate-45 pointer-events-none" />
      </div>
    </aside>
  );
}
```

```javascript
export default function PublicNavbar() {

  const [mobileOpenDropdownId, setMobileOpenDropdownId] = useState(null);
  const [desktopOpenDropdownId, setDesktopOpenDropdownId] = useState(null);
  const desktopNavRef = useRef(null);

  // Tutup dropdown saat pindah halaman
  useEffect(() => {
    setMobileOpenDropdownId(null);
    setDesktopOpenDropdownId(null);
  }, [pathname]);

  // Click outside untuk desktop dropdown
  useEffect(() => {
    function handleClickOutside(event) {
      if (desktopNavRef.current && !desktopNavRef.current.contains(event.target)) {
        setDesktopOpenDropdownId(null);
      }
    }
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    };
  }, []);

  // Cek apakah suatu menu aktif berdasarkan URL
  const isMenuGroupActive = (item) => {
    if (!item.isDropdown) {

    }
    return item.subItems.some((sub) => pathname.startsWith(sub.href));

    if (pathname === '/') return 0;

    if (pathname.startsWith('/voting') || pathname.startsWith('/simulasi')) return 2;

    if (
      pathname.startsWith('/panduan') ||
      pathname.startsWith('/contact') ||
      pathname.startsWith('/dokumentasi')
    ) {
      return 4;
    }
    return 0;

    ];

            {PORTAL_NAV_STRUCTURE.map((item) => {

              // Jika bukan dropdown (Beranda, Panitia)
              if (!item.isDropdown) {
```
