```javascript
      {/* Backdrop penutup saat sub-menu dropdown aktif di mobile */}
      {mobileOpenDropdownId && (
        <div
          onClick={() => setMobileOpenDropdownId(null)}
          className="md:hidden fixed inset-0 z-40 bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-2xs transition-opacity duration-200"
          aria-hidden="true"
        />
      )}

      {/* Popover Sub-Menu UL-LI Mengambang di atas Navbar Mobile */}
      {activeMobileItem && activeMobileItem.isDropdown && (
        <div className="md:hidden fixed bottom-20 left-3 right-3 z-50 animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-bottom-3 duration-200">
          <div className="bg-white/95 dark:bg-zinc-950/95 backdrop-blur-xl border border-blue-200/90 dark:border-zinc-800 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl p-3 space-y-2">
            {/* Header Dropdown Mobile */}
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-2 pb-2 border-b border-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800/80">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <div className="w-6 h-6 rounded-lg bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-950/60 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-400 flex items-center justify-center">
                  <activeMobileItem.icon className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                </div>
                <span className="text-xs font-bold text-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-100">
                  {t('header.menu_prefix', 'Menu')} {t(activeMobileItem.key, activeMobileItem.name)}
                </span>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setMobileOpenDropdownId(null)}
                className="p-1 rounded-lg text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:text-zinc-200"
                aria-label="Tutup Menu"
              >
                <X className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* List UL - LI Menu Mobile */}
            <ul className="space-y-1.5 pt-1">
              {activeMobileItem.subItems.map((sub) => {
                const isSubActive = pathname.startsWith(sub.href);
                const SubIcon = sub.icon;
                return (
                  <li key={sub.href}>
                    <Link
                      href={sub.href}
                      onClick={() => setMobileOpenDropdownId(null)}
                      className={`flex items-center justify-between p-2.5 rounded-xl transition-all ${
                        isSubActive
                          ? 'bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950/50 border border-blue-200/80 dark:border-blue-900/60 text-blue-900 dark:text-blue-300'
                          : 'hover:bg-zinc-100 dark:hover:bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                        <div
                          className={`w-8 h-8 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 ${
                            isSubActive
                              ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white shadow-xs'
                              : 'bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400'
                          }`}
                        >
                          <SubIcon className="w-4 h-4" />
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex flex-col text-left">
                          <span className="text-xs font-bold leading-tight">
                            {t(sub.key, sub.name)}
                          </span>
                          <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 font-medium">
                            {t(sub.descKey, sub.desc)}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <ChevronRight
                        className={`w-4 h-4 shrink-0 transition-transform ${
                          isSubActive
                            ? 'text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 translate-x-0.5'
                            : 'text-zinc-400'
                        }`}
                      />
                    </Link>
                  </li>
                );
              })}
            </ul>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Mobile Bottom Navigation Bar (5 Menu dengan Efek 3D Bulat Menembus) */}
      <nav className="md:hidden fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 z-40 bg-white dark:bg-black border-t border-blue-200/80 dark:border-zinc-800 shadow-[0_-8px_25px_rgba(0,0,0,0.06)] dark:shadow-[0_-8px_25px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)] safe-area-bottom overflow-visible">
        <div className="relative grid grid-cols-5 w-full h-16 overflow-visible">
          {activeMobileIndex >= 0 && (
            <div
              className="absolute top-0 bottom-0 left-0 w-1/5 pointer-events-none transition-transform duration-300 ease-out z-20 flex items-center justify-center"
              style={{
                transform: `translateX(${activeMobileIndex * 100}%)`,
              }}
            >
              <div className="relative -top-4 flex items-center justify-center">
                <div className="w-14 h-14 rounded-full bg-white dark:bg-black border-[3px] border-blue-200/90 dark:border-zinc-800 shadow-[0_-6px_16px_rgba(0,0,0,0.1)] dark:shadow-[0_-6px_22px_rgba(0,0,0,0.8)] flex items-center justify-center transition-all duration-300">
                  <div className="w-11 h-11 rounded-full bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-200/60 dark:border-zinc-800/80 shadow-inner" />
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {PORTAL_NAV_STRUCTURE.map((item, idx) => {
            const isActive = idx === activeMobileIndex;
            const Icon = item.icon;
            const itemName = t(item.key, item.name);

            const handleClick = (e) => {
              if (item.isDropdown) {
                e.preventDefault();
                setMobileOpenDropdownId((prev) => (prev === item.id ? null : item.id));
              }
            };

            const content = isActive ? (
              <div className="relative flex flex-col items-center justify-center w-full h-full">
                <div className="w-14 h-14 flex items-center justify-center -translate-y-4 transition-transform duration-300">
                  <Icon className="w-6.5 h-6.5 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 drop-shadow-xs" />
                </div>
                <span className="absolute bottom-1.5 text-[9.5px] font-bold text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 whitespace-nowrap tracking-tight transition-all duration-300">
                  {itemName}
                </span>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1 py-1 text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400 hover:text-blue-600 dark:hover:text-blue-400 transition-colors duration-200 w-full h-full">
                <Icon className="w-5 h-5 transition-transform group-hover:scale-105" />
                <span className="text-[9.5px] font-medium whitespace-nowrap leading-none transition-all duration-300">
                  {itemName}
                </span>
              </div>
            );

            if (item.isDropdown) {
              return (
                <button
                  key={item.id}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleClick}
                  className="relative z-30 col-span-1 w-full h-full flex flex-col items-center justify-center cursor-pointer focus:outline-hidden"
                  aria-expanded={mobileOpenDropdownId === item.id}
                  aria-label={`Menu ${item.name}`}
                >
                  {content}
                </button>
              );
            }

            return (
              <Link
                key={item.id}
                href={item.href}
                className="relative z-30 col-span-1 w-full h-full flex flex-col items-center justify-center focus:outline-hidden"
              >
                {content}
              </Link>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </nav>
    </>
  );
}
```

```javascript
import Link from 'next/link';

export default function TombolPublik({
  children,
  href,
  onClick,
  variant = 'primary',
  size = 'md',
  className = '',
  disabled = false,
  type = 'button',
  icon: Icon,
}) {
  const baseStyles = 'inline-flex items-center justify-center font-semibold rounded-xl transition-all duration-200 active:scale-95 disabled:opacity-50 disabled:pointer-events-none cursor-pointer';

  const sizeStyles = {
    sm: 'text-xs px-3 py-1.5 gap-1.5',
    md: 'text-xs sm:text-sm px-4 py-2.5 gap-2',
    lg: 'text-sm sm:text-base px-6 py-3.5 gap-2.5',
  };

  const variantStyles = {
    primary: 'bg-blue-700 hover:bg-blue-800 text-white dark:bg-blue-600 dark:hover:bg-blue-500 dark:text-white shadow-sm shadow-blue-900/15',
    secondary: 'bg-blue-50/80 hover:bg-blue-100 text-blue-950 border border-blue-200/80 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-100 dark:border-zinc-800',
    outline: 'border border-blue-200 hover:border-blue-400 text-blue-950 hover:bg-blue-50/60 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:hover:border-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-zinc-900',
    ghost: 'text-zinc-600 hover:text-blue-700 hover:bg-blue-50/70 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-white dark:hover:bg-zinc-900',
  };

  const combinedClasses = `${baseStyles} ${sizeStyles[size] || sizeStyles.md} ${variantStyles[variant] || variantStyles.primary} ${className}`;

  if (href) {
    return (
      <Link href={href} className={combinedClasses}>
        {Icon && <Icon className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />}
        {children}
      </Link>
    );
  }

  return (
    <button
      type={type}
      onClick={onClick}
      disabled={disabled}
      className={combinedClasses}
    >
      {Icon && <Icon className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />}
      {children}
    </button>
  );
}
```

```javascript
'use client';

import { useEffect, useState, useRef } from 'react';
import { useTranslation } from '@/hooks/useTranslation';

const PREFIX = 'kpu_dyn_trans_v2:';

/**
 * Hook pengambil data database yang ikut diterjemahkan sesuai bahasa aktif.
 *
 * - Bahasa 'id'  : data asli DB, tanpa notifikasi terjemahan.
 * - Bahasa lain  : fetcher(lang) memanggil server action (terjemahan AI + Vercel Data Cache).
 *                  Hasilnya disimpan di sessionStorage (otomatis hilang saat tab/website ditutup),
 *                  sehingga membuka ulang halaman yang sama tidak menerjemahkan lagi.
 *
 * @param {string} key      Identitas data, misal 'kandidat'
 * @param {(lang:string)=>Promise<{success:boolean,data:any}>} fetcher
 * @returns {{ data:any, loading:boolean, translating:boolean, lang:string }}
 */
export function useTranslatedData(key, fetcher, initial = []) {
  const { lang } = useTranslation();
  const [data, setData] = useState(initial);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const fetcherRef = useRef(fetcher);
  fetcherRef.current = fetcher;

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    const cacheKey = `${PREFIX}${key}:${lang}`;

    async function load() {
      if (lang !== 'id') {
        try {
          const cached = sessionStorage.getItem(cacheKey);
          if (cached) {
            setData(JSON.parse(cached));
            setLoading(false);
            return;
          }
        } catch (e) {
          // sessionStorage tidak tersedia, lanjut fetch
        }
      }

      setLoading(true);
      try {
        const res = await fetcherRef.current(lang);
        if (cancelled) return;
        const result = res?.success ? res.data ?? initial : initial;
        setData(result);
        if (lang !== 'id' && res?.success) {
          try {
            sessionStorage.setItem(cacheKey, JSON.stringify(result));
          } catch (e) {
            // kuota penuh, abaikan
          }
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error(`[useTranslatedData:${key}]`, err);
        if (!cancelled) setData(initial);
      } finally {
        if (!cancelled) setLoading(false);
      }
    }

    load();
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [key, lang]);

  return { data, loading, translating: loading && lang !== 'id', lang };
}
```

```javascript
'use client';

import { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect, useCallback, useMemo } from 'react';
import { NextIntlClientProvider } from 'next-intl';
import idMessages from '@/messages/id.json';
import enMessages from '@/messages/en.json';
import japanMessages from '@/messages/japan.json';
import arabMessages from '@/messages/arab.json';

const LanguageContext = createContext(null);

const STORAGE_KEY = 'kpu_site_lang';
const COOKIE_KEY = 'NEXT_LOCALE';

export const SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES = [
  { kode: 'id', nama: 'Bahasa Indonesia', flag: '🇮🇩' },
  { kode: 'en', nama: 'English (US)', flag: '🇺🇸' },
  { kode: 'japan', nama: '日本語 (Japan)', flag: '🇯🇵' },
  { kode: 'arab', nama: 'العربية (Arab)', flag: '🇸🇦' },
];

const MESSAGES_MAP = {
  id: idMessages,
  en: enMessages,
  japan: japanMessages,
  arab: arabMessages,
};

/**
 * Helper untuk mengambil nilai nested object dengan dot notation, misal "hero.title_part1"
 */
function getNestedValue(obj, path) {
  if (!obj || !path) return undefined;
  const keys = path.split('.');
  let current = obj;
  for (const k of keys) {
    if (current && typeof current === 'object' && k in current) {
      current = current[k];
    } else {
      return undefined;
    }
  }
  return typeof current === 'string' ? current : undefined;
}

function interpolate(str, params) {
  if (!params || typeof str !== 'string') return str;
  return str.replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, (m, k) => (k in params ? String(params[k]) : m));
}

export function LanguageProvider({ children }) {
  const [lang, setLang] = useState('id');
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false);

  // Ambil pilihan bahasa tersimpan saat pertama kali mount
  useEffect(() => {
    let savedLang = 'id';
    try {
      savedLang = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY) || 'id';
      if (!MESSAGES_MAP[savedLang]) savedLang = 'id';
    } catch (e) {
      savedLang = 'id';
    }
    setLang(savedLang);
    setMounted(true);
  }, []);

  const changeLanguage = useCallback((newLang) => {
    if (!newLang || !MESSAGES_MAP[newLang]) return;
    setLang(newLang);

    try {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, newLang);
      document.cookie = `${COOKIE_KEY}=${newLang}; path=/; max-age=31536000; SameSite=Lax`;
    } catch (e) {
      // ignore
    }
  }, []);

  const activeMessages = useMemo(() => {
    return MESSAGES_MAP[lang] || MESSAGES_MAP['id'];
  }, [lang]);

  /**
   * Helper t(key, fallbackText)
   */
  const t = useCallback(
    (key, fallbackText = '', params = null) => {
      if (!key) return '';

      // Cek di bahasa aktif
      const val = getNestedValue(activeMessages, key);
      if (val !== undefined) return interpolate(val, params);

      // Fallback ke bahasa Indonesia default jika di EN belum ada
      const fallbackVal = getNestedValue(MESSAGES_MAP['id'], key);
      if (fallbackVal !== undefined) return interpolate(fallbackVal, params);

      return interpolate(fallbackText || key, params);
    },
    [activeMessages]
  );

  const contextValue = useMemo(
    () => ({
      lang,
      languages: SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES,
      changeLanguage,
      t,
      messages: activeMessages,
      loading: !mounted,
    }),
    [lang, changeLanguage, t, activeMessages, mounted]
  );

  return (
    <LanguageContext.Provider value={contextValue}>
      <NextIntlClientProvider locale={lang} messages={activeMessages}>
        {children}
      </NextIntlClientProvider>
    </LanguageContext.Provider>
  );
}

export function useTranslation() {
  const context = useContext(LanguageContext);
  if (!context) {
    return {
      lang: 'id',
      languages: SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES,
      changeLanguage: () => { },
      t: (key, fallbackText = '', params = null) => {
        const val = getNestedValue(MESSAGES_MAP['id'], key);
        return interpolate(val !== undefined ? val : (fallbackText || key), params);
      },
      messages: MESSAGES_MAP['id'],
      loading: false,
    };
  }
  return context;
}
```

```javascript
    id: 'akun',
    label: 'Manajemen Akun Panitia',
    category: 'Pengaturan Khusus (SuperAdmin)',
    desc: 'Pendaftaran akun baru panitia dan pengaturan hak akses',
    superAdminOnly: true,
  },
  {
    id: 'roleakses',
    label: 'Manajemen Role Akses',
    category: 'Pengaturan Khusus (SuperAdmin)',
    desc: 'Pembuatan role dan konfigurasi izin modul sistem',
    superAdminOnly: true,
  },
];

export const ROLE_PERMISSIONS = {
  superAdmin: [
    'all',
    'dashboard',
    'trafik',
    'kandidat',
    'paslon',
    'mhs',
    'voting',
    'panitia',
    'trafik_sosmed',
    'sekretaris',
    'dokumentasi',
    'jadwal',
    'panduan',
    'contact',
    'ai',
    'translate',
    'akun',
    'roleakses',
  ],
  adminPanitia: [
    'dashboard',
    'trafik',
    'kandidat',
    'paslon',
    'mhs',
    'voting',
    'panitia',
    'trafik_sosmed',
    'sekretaris',
    'dokumentasi',
    'jadwal',
    'panduan',
    'contact',
    'ai',
  ],
};

export const PERMISSION_ROUTE_MAP = {
  dashboard: '/panitia/dashboard',
  trafik: '/panitia/trafik',
  kandidat: '/panitia/kandidat',
  paslon: '/panitia/paslon',
  mhs: '/panitia/mhs',
  voting: '/panitia/voting',
  panitia: '/panitia/panitia',
  trafik_sosmed: '/panitia/panitia/trafik-sosmed',
  sekretaris: '/panitia/sekretaris',
  dokumentasi: '/panitia/dokumentasi',
  jadwal: '/panitia/jadwal',
  panduan: '/panitia/panduan',
  contact: '/panitia/contact',
  ai: '/panitia/ai',
  translate: '/panitia/translate',
  akun: '/panitia/akun',
  roleakses: '/panitia/roleakses',
};

export function getFirstAccessibleRoute(roleAkses = '', role = '') {
  if (roleAkses) {
    const perms = roleAkses
      .split(',')
      .map((p) => p.trim().toLowerCase())
      .filter(Boolean);

    for (const perm of perms) {
      if (perm === 'all') {
        return '/panitia/dashboard';
      }
      if (PERMISSION_ROUTE_MAP[perm]) {
        return PERMISSION_ROUTE_MAP[perm];
      }
    }
  }

  // Jika superAdmin default ke dashboard
  if (role === 'superAdmin' || role === ROLES.SUPER_ADMIN) {
    return '/panitia/dashboard';
  }

  // Fallback default
  return '/panitia/dashboard';
}

export function hasPermission(roleName, requiredPermission, roleAkses = null) {
  if (!roleName) return false;
  if (roleName === ROLES.SUPER_ADMIN || roleName === 'superAdmin') return true;

  // Cek permissions dinamis dari string roleAkses di tabel roleadmin
  if (roleAkses) {
    if (roleAkses === 'all' || roleAkses.includes('all')) return true;
    const perms = roleAkses.split(',').map((p) => p.trim());
    if (perms.includes(requiredPermission)) return true;

    // Kompatibilitas alias izin modul turunan
    if (requiredPermission === 'paslon' && perms.includes('kandidat')) return true;
    if (requiredPermission === 'trafik' && perms.includes('dashboard')) return true;
    if (requiredPermission === 'jadwal' && perms.includes('dokumentasi')) return true;
    if (requiredPermission === 'trafik_sosmed' && perms.includes('panitia')) return true;
  }

  // Fallback ke permission statis berdasarkan roleName
  const permissions = ROLE_PERMISSIONS[roleName] || [];
  return permissions.includes(requiredPermission);
}
```

```javascript
// Konstanta dan helper NIM untuk fitur Mahasiswa
// Dipindahkan ke sini agar tidak bertabrakan dengan 'use server' di mhs.js

export const VALID_KELAS = ['Reg', 'NonReg', 'Manaj', 'Dosen'];

export const PRODI_MAP = {
  '01': 'Administrasi Bisnis',
  '02': 'Manajemen Informatika',
  '03': 'Akuntansi',
  '04': 'Hubungan Masyarakat',
  '41': 'Bisnis Digital',
  '42': 'Akuntansi Perpajakan',
};

/**
 * Helper untuk parsing angkatan dan prodi dari NIM berdasarkan kelas
 * @param {string} nim
 * @param {string} kelas
 * @returns {{ angkatan: string, prodi: string, kodeProdi: string }}
 */
export function parseNimHelper(nim, kelas) {
  const cleanNim = String(nim || '').trim();
  const cleanKelas = String(kelas || 'Reg').trim();

  if (cleanKelas !== 'Reg' && cleanKelas !== 'NonReg') {
    return {
      angkatan: cleanKelas || '-',
      prodi: cleanKelas || '-',
      kodeProdi: '',
    };
  }

  const angkatan = cleanNim.length >= 4 ? cleanNim.substring(0, 4) : '-';
  const kodeProdi = cleanNim.length >= 6 ? cleanNim.substring(4, 6) : '';
  const prodi = PRODI_MAP[kodeProdi] || (kodeProdi ? `Prodi (${kodeProdi})` : '-');

  return {
    angkatan,
    prodi,
    kodeProdi,
  };
}
```

```javascript
import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';

const supabaseUrl = process.env.SUPABASE_URL || process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL || '';
const supabaseServiceKey = process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY || '';
const supabaseAnonKey = process.env.SUPABASE_ANON_KEY || process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY || '';

// Supabase client dengan Service Role Key untuk operasi server-side privileged (Server Actions)
export const supabaseAdmin = createClient(
  supabaseUrl,
  supabaseServiceKey || supabaseAnonKey,
  {
    auth: {
      persistSession: false,
      autoRefreshToken: false,
    },
  }
);

// Supabase public client untuk baca data publik
export const supabasePublic = createClient(
  supabaseUrl,
  supabaseAnonKey || supabaseServiceKey,
  {
    auth: {
      persistSession: false,
    },
  }
);
```

```javascript
 */

export const TIMING_CONFIG = {
  // === 1. SITE OPENING (SPLASH SCREEN) ===
  // 1a. Waktu layar gelap pekat sebelum logo meluncur dari bawah
  OPENING_DARK_DELAY: 800, // Diperlama dari 500ms

  // 1b. Waktu logo mencapai tengah, membesar + muncul ring border berputar
  OPENING_EXPAND_START: 2200, // Diperlama dari 1300ms (memberi waktu logo meluncur pelan)

  // 1c. Waktu logo & border meledak/membesar memenuhi layar + fade out dimulai
  OPENING_FADE_OUT_START: 4800, // Diperlama dari 2800ms (memberi waktu border berputar lebih lama)

  // 1d. Total durasi SiteOpening hingga overlay di-unmount dari DOM
  OPENING_TOTAL_DURATION: 6000, // Diperlama dari 3400ms (total ~6 detik)

  // === 2. NOTIFIKASI NAVBAR MOBILE (MOBILE NAV HINT) ===
  MOBILE_NAV_HINT_DELAY: 7000,

  // === 3. NOTIFIKASI SAMS ASISTEN AI ===
  SAMS_NOTIF_DELAY: 9000,
};

export default TIMING_CONFIG;
```

```javascript
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';

const SESSION_COOKIE_NAME = 'kpu_panitia_session';

/**
 * Proxy / Middleware Auth Guard untuk memproteksi rute internal panitia
 * @param {import('next/server').NextRequest} request
 */
export function proxyMiddleware(request) {
  const { pathname } = request.nextUrl;
  const sessionCookie = request.cookies.get(SESSION_COOKIE_NAME);

  let isLoggedIn = false;
  let userRole = '';

  if (sessionCookie?.value) {
    try {
      const decoded = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(sessionCookie.value, 'base64').toString('utf-8'));
      if (decoded && decoded.adminId && (!decoded.exp || Date.now() < decoded.exp)) {
        isLoggedIn = true;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      isLoggedIn = false;
    }
  }

  // Jika halaman panitia (kecuali /panitia/login) diakses tanpa login, redirect ke login
  if (pathname.startsWith('/panitia') && !pathname.startsWith('/panitia/login')) {
    if (!isLoggedIn) {
      const loginUrl = new URL('/panitia/login', request.url);
      loginUrl.searchParams.set('redirect', pathname);
      return NextResponse.redirect(loginUrl);
    }
  }

  // Jika sudah login dan membuka /panitia/login, alihkan ke root /panitia
  if (pathname === '/panitia/login' && isLoggedIn) {
    return NextResponse.redirect(new URL('/panitia', request.url));
  }

  return NextResponse.next();
}

export default proxyMiddleware;
```

```javascript
// In-memory sliding rate limiter per IP / key

const trackers = new Map();

/**
 * Memeriksa apakah identifier melebihi batas request dalam window milidetik
 * @param {string} key Identifier unik (misal IP address)
 * @param {number} limit Batas maksimum pemanggilan
 * @param {number} windowMs Rentang waktu dalam milidetik
 * @returns {boolean} true jika diizinkan, false jika melebihi kuota
 */
export function checkRateLimit(key, limit = 10, windowMs = 60 * 1000) {
  const now = Date.now();
  const record = trackers.get(key) || [];

  // Filter timestamps yang masih berada dalam windowMs
  const validTimestamps = record.filter((timestamp) => now - timestamp < windowMs);

  if (validTimestamps.length >= limit) {
    trackers.set(key, validTimestamps);
    return false; // Rate limit tercapai
  }

  validTimestamps.push(now);
  trackers.set(key, validTimestamps);

  // Bersihkan memori secara berkala jika map terlalu besar
  if (trackers.size > 10000) {
    trackers.clear();
  }

  return true;
}
```

```javascript
// Utilitas sanitasi input untuk mencegah XSS & input berbahaya

export function sanitizeText(str) {
  if (typeof str !== 'string') return '';
  return str
    .trim()
    .replace(/[<>]/g, '') // hilangkan karakter tag HTML mentah
    .slice(0, 1000); // batasi panjang
}

export function sanitizeEmail(email) {
  if (typeof email !== 'string') return '';
  const clean = email.trim().toLowerCase();
  const emailRegex = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;
  return emailRegex.test(clean) ? clean : '';
}

export function sanitizePhone(phone) {
  if (typeof phone !== 'string' && typeof phone !== 'number') return '';
  const str = String(phone).trim();
  // Ambil hanya angka dan tanda plus di depan jika ada
  const clean = str.replace(/[^0-9+]/g, '');
  return clean.slice(0, 20);
}

export function sanitizeUrl(url) {
  if (typeof url !== 'string') return '';
  const clean = url.trim();
  if (clean.startsWith('http://') || clean.startsWith('https://')) {
    return clean;
  }
  return '';
}
```

```javascript
// Utilitas tanggal dan waktu Indonesia (WIB)

export function formatTanggalIndo(dateString) {
  if (!dateString) return '-';
  try {
    const date = new Date(dateString);
    if (isNaN(date.getTime())) return dateString;
    return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('id-ID', {
      day: 'numeric',
      month: 'long',
      year: 'numeric',
      timeZone: 'Asia/Jakarta',
    }).format(date);
  } catch (error) {
    return dateString;
  }
}

export function formatWaktuIndo(dateString) {
  if (!dateString) return '-';
  try {
    const date = new Date(dateString);
    if (isNaN(date.getTime())) return dateString;
    return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('id-ID', {
      day: 'numeric',
      month: 'short',
      year: 'numeric',
      hour: '2-digit',
      minute: '2-digit',
      timeZone: 'Asia/Jakarta',
    }).format(date) + ' WIB';
  } catch (error) {
    return dateString;
  }
}

// Menghitung timestamp milidetik untuk jam 00:00:00 WIB hari berikutnya
// Digunakan untuk masa berlaku cache localStorage panduan
export function getNextMidnightWIBTimestamp() {
  const now = new Date();
  // Offset WIB = UTC+7 (420 menit)
  const utc = now.getTime() + now.getTimezoneOffset() * 60000;
  const wibTime = new Date(utc + 7 * 3600000);

  // Buat jam 00:00:00 WIB esok hari
  const nextMidnightWib = new Date(wibTime);
  nextMidnightWib.setDate(nextMidnightWib.getDate() + 1);
  nextMidnightWib.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);

  // Konversi kembali ke timestamp lokal milidetik
  const diff = nextMidnightWib.getTime() - wibTime.getTime();
  return Date.now() + diff;
}
```

```javascript
// Helper untuk konversi URL Google Drive ke format Embed/Preview tanpa API Key

export function getGoogleDriveEmbedUrl(url) {
  if (!url || typeof url !== 'string') return null;

  try {
    const trimmed = url.trim();

    // 1. Ekstrak Folder ID: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/ID atau ?id=ID
    const folderMatch = trimmed.match(/\/folders\/([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)/);
    if (folderMatch && folderMatch[1]) {
      return `https://drive.google.com/embeddedfolderview?id=${folderMatch[1]}#grid`;
    }

    // 2. Ekstrak File ID: https://drive.google.com/file/d/ID/view
    const fileMatch = trimmed.match(/\/file\/d\/([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)/);
    if (fileMatch && fileMatch[1]) {
      return `https://drive.google.com/file/d/${fileMatch[1]}/preview`;
    }

    // 3. Query param id=ID
    const paramMatch = trimmed.match(/[?&]id=([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)/);
    if (paramMatch && paramMatch[1]) {
      if (trimmed.includes('folders') || trimmed.includes('embeddedfolderview')) {
        return `https://drive.google.com/embeddedfolderview?id=${paramMatch[1]}#grid`;
      }
      return `https://drive.google.com/file/d/${paramMatch[1]}/preview`;
    }

    // Jika URL sudah mengandung /preview atau embeddedfolderview
    if (trimmed.includes('/preview') || trimmed.includes('embeddedfolderview')) {
      return trimmed;
    }

    return trimmed;
  } catch (error) {
    return null;
  }
}
```

```javascript
import { cookies } from 'next/headers';
import { supabaseAdmin } from '@/lib/supabase';
import { hasPermission } from '@/lib/adminRoleData';

const SESSION_COOKIE_NAME = 'kpu_panitia_session';

/**
 * Mengambil session admin panitia dari cookie HTTP-Only server
 */
export async function getPanitiaSession() {
  try {
    const cookieStore = await cookies();
    const sessionCookie = cookieStore.get(SESSION_COOKIE_NAME);
    if (!sessionCookie || !sessionCookie.value) {
      return null;
    }

    // Decode session payload
    const decoded = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(sessionCookie.value, 'base64').toString('utf-8'));
    if (!decoded || !decoded.adminId || !decoded.authId) {
      return null;
    }

    // Cek kadaluwarsa session (7 hari)
    if (decoded.exp && Date.now() > decoded.exp) {
      return null;
    }

    // Verifikasi validitas admin di database
    const { data: admin, error } = await supabaseAdmin
      .from('adminpanitia')
      .select('id, nama, nim, email, no_tlpn, role_id, roleadmin (id, role, roleakses, jenis)')
      .eq('id', decoded.adminId)
      .single();

    if (error || !admin) {
      return null;
    }

    return {
      adminId: admin.id,
      authId: decoded.authId,
      nama: admin.nama,
      nim: admin.nim,
      email: admin.email,
      role: admin.roleadmin?.role || 'adminPanitia',
      roleAkses: admin.roleadmin?.roleakses || '',
      jenis: admin.roleadmin?.jenis || 'Editor',
    };
  } catch (error) {
    return null;
  }
}

/**
 * Menyimpan data session panitia ke dalam HTTP-only Cookie
 */
export async function setPanitiaSession(adminData, authId) {
  const cookieStore = await cookies();
  const sessionPayload = {
    adminId: adminData.id,
    authId: authId,
    nim: adminData.nim,
    exp: Date.now() + 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000, // 7 hari
  };

  const encoded = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(sessionPayload)).toString('base64');

  cookieStore.set(SESSION_COOKIE_NAME, encoded, {
    httpOnly: true,
    secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production',
    sameSite: 'lax',
    path: '/',
    maxAge: 7 * 24 * 60 * 60,
  });
}

/**
 * Menghapus cookie session panitia
 */
export async function removePanitiaSession() {
  const cookieStore = await cookies();
  cookieStore.delete(SESSION_COOKIE_NAME);
}

/**
 * Memastikan user sudah login & punya izin role yang sesuai
 */
export async function requirePanitiaPermission(requiredPermission) {
  const session = await getPanitiaSession();
  if (!session) {
    throw new Error('Akses ditolak: Anda harus login terlebih dahulu.');
  }

  if (requiredPermission && !hasPermission(session.role, requiredPermission, session.roleAkses)) {
    throw new Error('Akses ditolak: Anda tidak memiliki izin untuk tindakan ini.');
  }

  return session;
}

/**
 * Memastikan panitia memiliki hak akses sekaligus bertipe Editor (bukan Viewer)
 */
export async function requirePanitiaEditor(requiredPermission) {
  const session = await requirePanitiaPermission(requiredPermission);
  if (session.jenis === 'Viewer') {
    throw new Error('Akses dibatasi: Role Anda adalah Viewer (hanya dapat melihat data, tidak dapat menambah/mengubah/menghapus).');
  }
  return session;
}
```

```javascript
const BULAN_MAP = {
  januari: 0,
  februari: 1,
  maret: 2,
  april: 3,
  mei: 4,
  juni: 5,
  juli: 6,
  agustus: 7,
  september: 8,
  oktober: 9,
  november: 10,
  desember: 11,
};

export function parseTimelineDates(tanggalStr) {
  const cleanStr = tanggalStr.replace(/[–—]/g, '-').trim();

  // Format Rentang: "17 - 19 OKTOBER 2026"
  const rangeMatch = cleanStr.match(/^(\d{1,2})\s*-\s*(\d{1,2})\s+([A-Za-z]+)\s+(\d{4})$/);
  if (rangeMatch) {
    const startDay = parseInt(rangeMatch[1], 10);
    const endDay = parseInt(rangeMatch[2], 10);
    const month = BULAN_MAP[rangeMatch[3].toLowerCase()] ?? 9;
    const year = parseInt(rangeMatch[4], 10);
    return {
      startDate: new Date(year, month, startDay, 0, 0, 0),
      endDate: new Date(year, month, endDay, 23, 59, 59, 999),
    };
  }

  // Format Tanggal Tunggal: "21 OKTOBER 2026"
  const singleMatch = cleanStr.match(/^(\d{1,2})\s+([A-Za-z]+)\s+(\d{4})$/);
  if (singleMatch) {
    const day = parseInt(singleMatch[1], 10);
    const month = BULAN_MAP[singleMatch[2].toLowerCase()] ?? 9;
    const year = parseInt(singleMatch[3], 10);
    return {
      startDate: new Date(year, month, day, 0, 0, 0),
      endDate: new Date(year, month, day, 23, 59, 59, 999),
    };
  }

  return {
    startDate: new Date(2026, 9, 1),
    endDate: new Date(2026, 10, 30),
  };
}

export function computeTimelineStatus(tanggalStr, now = new Date()) {
  const { startDate, endDate } = parseTimelineDates(tanggalStr);
  if (now < startDate) {
    return 'Mendatang';
  } else if (now > endDate) {
    return 'Selesai';
  } else {
    return 'Aktif';
  }
}

export function getActiveTimelineStage(now = new Date()) {
  const itemsWithStatus = TIMELINE_KPU_ITEMS.map((item, index) => {
    const status = computeTimelineStatus(item.tanggal, now);
    return { ...item, status, index };
  });

  // 1. Cari tahapan yang sedang 'Aktif'
  const activeItem = itemsWithStatus.find((item) => item.status === 'Aktif');
  if (activeItem) {
    const progressPercent = Math.round(((activeItem.index + 1) / itemsWithStatus.length) * 100);
    return {
      title: activeItem.judul,
      status: 'Aktif',
      progressPercent,
      itemNumber: activeItem.no,
    };
  }

  // 2. Jika tidak ada yang aktif, cari tahapan mendatang pertama
  const upcomingItem = itemsWithStatus.find((item) => item.status === 'Mendatang');
  if (upcomingItem) {
    if (upcomingItem.index === 0) {
      return {
        title: upcomingItem.judul,
        status: 'Mendatang',
        progressPercent: 12,
        itemNumber: upcomingItem.no,
      };
    }
    const progressPercent = Math.round((upcomingItem.index / itemsWithStatus.length) * 100);
    return {
      title: upcomingItem.judul,
      status: 'Menuju Tahapan',
      progressPercent,
      itemNumber: upcomingItem.no,
    };
  }

  // 3. Jika semua sudah selesai
  return {
    title: 'Pemungutan Suara Selesai',
    status: 'Selesai',
    progressPercent: 100,
    itemNumber: '08',
  };
}
```

```javascript
// Helper untuk parsing URL YouTube menjadi embed format yang aman

export function getYouTubeEmbedUrl(url) {
  if (!url || typeof url !== 'string') return null;

  try {
    const trimmed = url.trim();

    // Sudah format embed
    if (trimmed.includes('youtube.com/embed/') || trimmed.includes('youtube-nocookie.com/embed/')) {
      return trimmed;
    }

    let videoId = null;

    // Format https://youtu.be/ID
    const shortMatch = trimmed.match(/youtu\.be\/([a-zA-Z0-9_-]{11})/);
    if (shortMatch && shortMatch[1]) {
      videoId = shortMatch[1];
    }

    // Format https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ID
    if (!videoId) {
      const watchMatch = trimmed.match(/[?&]v=([a-zA-Z0-9_-]{11})/);
      if (watchMatch && watchMatch[1]) {
        videoId = watchMatch[1];
      }
    }

    // Format https://www.youtube.com/shorts/ID
    if (!videoId) {
      const shortsMatch = trimmed.match(/youtube\.com\/shorts\/([a-zA-Z0-9_-]{11})/);
      if (shortsMatch && shortsMatch[1]) {
        videoId = shortsMatch[1];
      }
    }

    if (videoId) {
      return `https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/${videoId}?rel=0&modestbranding=1`;
    }

    return null;
  } catch (error) {
    return null;
  }
}
```
